chapters.title: Chapter 51: There’s a Sneaky One!
paragraphs: The clouds dissipated, revealing a messy camp.
There were a few tattered tents pitched above, with piles of wood, iron pots, weapon racks, and other tools scattered on the ground.
In the center of the camp, a group of green-skinned creatures was lighting a fire, a large pot boiling with unknown contents.
As soon as these green-skinned creatures noticed the humans intruding, they immediately turned around.
Han Xing met their gaze: sunken pupils, sharp fangs, and pointed ears.
These physical features prompted Han Xing to blurt out their name,
"Goblins!"
Han Xing hadn’t expected to see such common creatures from games in this world.
The attributes of this group of goblins also appeared in front of him.
[Goblin Warrior (One-Star Creature)]
[Level: lv6]
[Power: 31, Agility: 25, Spirit: 13, Constitution: 27]
[Skills: Beast Hammer Frenzy, Upward Slash]
[Goblin Mage (One-Star Creature)]
[Level: lv6]
[Power: 14, Agility: 18, Spirit: 35, Constitution: 18]
[Skills: Large Fireball, Dark Mind Technique]
[Goblin Assassin...]
[Goblin Supervisor...]
[Goblin Laborer...]
There were a total of 8 goblins.
Among them, there were 4 level 6 goblin professionals, plus one level 7 goblin supervisor, and three level 5 goblin laborers.
This setup was strong, and their numbers were considerable.
Survivors experience a significant power surge after reaching level 6, and similarly, the monsters’ attributes also dramatically enhance.
Even with Han Xing’s current attributes, he couldn’t afford to be careless.
As soon as Han Xing was noticed, the goblins’ eyes turned red, and they raised their weapons, charging towards him.
Meanwhile, the goblin assassin wavered the dagger in its hand and vanished from sight.
"Roar!"
The goblin warrior was the first to launch a charge, rampaging like an out-of-control bull.
In an instant, it was at Han Xing’s side.
"So fast!" Han Xing was astonished.
He quickly performed a roll on the ground to evade the goblin warrior’s charge, then used his nearly 50 points of agility attribute to swiftly widen the distance.
But just then, a cold gleam flashed by.
Unbeknownst to him, the goblin assassin had appeared behind Han Xing.
A coldness crept up against his neck.
"Damn, there’s a lurker!"
Han Xing felt a chill run down his spine; being a hunter, it’s dangerous to have an assassin close in, especially in a scenario where they were outnumbered.
He had already grabbed a bottle of Life Secret Elixir from his bag, prepared to take the potion immediately if he got stabbed.
At that moment, a black light instantly flashed, striking the goblin assassin.
"Awoo!" Coal Ball roared in fury, seemingly enraged at the goblin assassin’s sneak attack on Han Xing.
Swish! Swish!
Coal Ball’s claws slashed across the goblin assassin’s face, instantly ripping away a swath of flesh and blood.
"Roar!"
Struck by intense pain, the goblin assassin let out a cry and instantly turned around, searching for the culprit’s figure.
Han Xing’s eyes lit up, and he drew his longbow.
Skill, Wind Chasing Arrow activated!
As the arrow was about to be released, Han Xing suddenly lowered his aim slightly, targeting the goblin assassin’s... posterior...
Swoosh!
This arrow was incredibly fast, and at such close range, there was no chance for the goblin assassin to dodge.
Han Xing heard the sound of the arrow piercing flesh.
The goblin assassin’s murky eyes widened suddenly, and it looked back in disbelief at the arrow that was now halfway into its rear.
The next moment, a blood-curdling scream erupted.
This scream left the other goblins dumbfounded, and they even forgot to continue their attack.
Han Xing happily clapped his hands, laughing, "Hahaha, that’ll teach you to be a sneaky bastard!"
Before the goblin assassin could react, a second arrow was shot out fiercely, striking directly into its back of the head, piercing through the skull!
With icy determination in his eyes, after dealing with the goblin assassin, Han Xing nocked another arrow, aiming at the other goblins.
At this point, the remaining goblins seemed to finally react.
A large fireball came hurtling towards Han Xing, accompanied by two goblin warriors rushing from different angles.
However, with Han Xing’s agility attribute already higher than that of the goblins, he easily sidestepped the fireball attack.
Coal Ball was about to intercept when Han Xing issued a new command: "Coal Ball, go handle the goblins in the back, leave these two to me."
Receiving the command, Coal Ball flashed with a dark glow and directly charged in front of the goblin mage.
The goblin supervisor, seeing this, raised the beast bone hammer high, slamming it towards Coal Ball, while at the same time, three goblin laborers were also drawn to Coal Ball.
With Coal Ball taking on five goblins by itself, Han Xing’s side faced significantly reduced pressure, left only against the two level 6 goblin warriors.
After surviving the initial chaos, Han Xing found his rhythm.
He quickly gulped down a bottle of [Wild Bear Power Secret Elixir], strength surging!
Swish! Swish!
Skill: Double Arrow activated.
Two arrows were released, one hitting the right leg of a goblin warrior, the other hitting the shoulder of another goblin warrior, forcing them to halt their charge.
Han Xing then took half a step back, fully ready for an attack.
Skill: Multi-Shot activated.
But unlike before, Han Xing suddenly felt a powerful force emerging from within when the shot was fired.
"Is the Moon Crown Longbow’s special effect, Moonlight Flow triggered?" Han Xing instantly realized.
Feeling a surge of joy, knowing that this multi-shot attack would be unprecedentedly powerful!
Thud! Thud! Thud!
Arrows were shot repeatedly, producing sounds resembling those of piercing cowhide.
The next moment, each of the two goblin warriors had two or three fine iron arrows lodged into their hearts and chests.
With their hearts pierced, the goblin warriors died instantly!
The powerful attack power of the Moon Crown Longbow was demonstrated for the first time!
With the two goblin warriors dealt with.
There were still 5 goblins left in the camp.
Coal Ball fought alone against the goblin supervisor and goblin mage, unleashing its terrifying speed to the fullest!
The remaining three goblin laborers brandished their wooden sticks wildly, but with their attributes, they couldn’t even touch a single hair of Coal Ball.
Seeing Coal Ball darting back and forth among the 5 goblins, continuously inflicting damage with its tender little claws,
Han Xing decided to eliminate the three goblin laborers first, letting Coal Ball battle alone for a while longer.
Anyway, with its attributes, holding out for a bit longer wouldn’t be difficult.
Swoosh! Swoosh swoosh!
Three arrows shot simultaneously, hitting the three goblin laborers, who were attracted to Han Xing.
However, by this time Han Xing’s attack power already far exceeded what these level 5 creatures could endure. Even if not hitting critical spots, each arrow inflicted severe injuries on them.
After just over ten seconds, the three goblin laborers fell to the ground.
Han Xing exclaimed with joy, "Haha, soft targets are always easy."
But at that moment.
The previously bright sky suddenly darkened.
Han Xing instinctively looked up, and was surprised to see a black crescent moon appear in the overhead sky!

chapters.title: Chapter 52: Encountering a Survivor
paragraphs: A dark purple full moon hung high overhead.
The dark purple full moon seemed to absorb most of the light, turning the entire camp into a dark purple hue.
Legendary Effect, Dark Moon Descent!
The trigger condition is the continuous killing of five enemies.
At this moment, Han Xing felt a strange power enveloping his hands.
He could clearly feel his attack speed increasing.
Moreover, not only Han Xing was affected, but also Coal Ball, who was fighting.
When the Power of Dark Moon appeared, Coal Ball’s attack speed suddenly surged.
Although its power was only in the tens, making its damage relatively weak, at this moment, Coal Ball showed Han Xing what it meant to have an attack speed at its most extreme level.

Black light flashed continuously, and the Goblin Wizard and Goblin Supervisor were constantly left with dense blood claw marks, looking as if an invisible monster was continuously gnawing at their flesh.
In less than a dozen seconds, hundreds of scars appeared on these two goblins, with their entire bodies covered in blood and flesh.
And at this moment, at the twentieth second when the dark purple full moon appeared.
Suddenly, cracks appeared on the surface of the dark purple moon.
Han Xing knew, the strongest strike of this Legendary Effect was coming.
Once the Dark Moon Descent state ends, the Dark Moon will automatically explode, causing Agility * 300% explosion damage to surrounding enemies!
Sure enough, in the next moment, the dark purple moon suddenly exploded, and the terrifying Power of Dark Moon descended from the sky and began to rampage.
These two goblins, already injured by Coal Ball, were hit even harder, as if struck by lightning.
Buzz!
The entire camp was swept as if by a hurricane, and the Power of Dark Moon began to rage madly.
When the aftershocks of the Dark Moon’s explosion dissipated, a system prompt appeared.
[You have killed the Goblin Warrior, Goblin Wizard, and Goblin Supervisor..., gaining 1200 experience value, and your pet Coal Ball gains 960 experience value.]
Reaching level 6 requires more experience value, but correspondingly, killing level 6 monsters yields more experience value as well.
However, at this moment, Han Xing was still immersed in the powerful effect of that legendary effect.
He exclaimed in shock, "Damn, is this the legendary level effect? It’s so damn cool!"
Directly affecting environmental changes, even able to summon a moon during battle, it’s simply a divine artifact for showing off!
Moreover, the damage from the final strike of this effect is not weak, and it’s an area-of-effect damage, which can be used as a clearing skill.
Han Xing was overjoyed inside.
After testing the effect of the Dark Moon Longbow, Han Xing prepared to merge this goblin camp into his own territory.
A sky island over a hundred square meters could increase his territory’s area by a tenth.
A system prompt appeared.
[You have successfully merged the Goblin Camp. Your territory area has expanded. You have gained territory resources: ’Fertile Soil * 18’, ’Simple Tent * 7’, ’Iron Pot * 2’, ’Iron Spoon * 7’...]
Most of these territory resources were simple tools made by this group of goblins.
Among them, every few meters, there was an area that emitted a foul stench.
Han Xing looked disgusted and said, "Damn, these goblins are really unhygienic, damn, relieving themselves anywhere!"
Disdainfully, he separated these dozen pieces of land and threw them out along with the tools used by the goblins.
After dealing with these, Han Xing prepared to head towards the next cloud for exploration.
Just then, Han Xing suddenly saw a large sky island rapidly approaching him from afar.
Han Xing immediately became alert, cautiously observing this sky island, which was over a thousand square meters.
He noticed that there were no clouds covering the sky island, which meant it shouldn’t be a monster’s territory.
If it’s not a monster, then there’s only one possibility left: the sky island is the territory of another survivor.
Moreover, it was obvious that the target was heading straight for him.
"Coming towards me?" Han Xing became vigilant.
Although everyone was a survivor from Blue Star, it’s essential to stay cautious of others.
He didn’t want to die at the hands of a fellow human after avoiding death by monsters.
Han Xing quickly had Coal Ball hide under the sofa, while he prepared for battle.
Currently, no one has defensive facilities on their sky islands, which means they are in an open-door state, and others can easily see what’s on your sky island.
Thankfully, Han Xing had placed some wooden boards in advance, covering his Storage Box so others couldn’t see what’s inside.
Otherwise, at this stage, seeing a dozen large chests in your territory might arouse suspicion among the other survivors.
A few seconds later.
The other party came straight towards him, stopping abruptly less than thirty meters away between the two sky island territories.
Han Xing saw a figure appear on the opposite side, standing at the edge of the territory and waving at him.
After a moment of thought, Han Xing also approached, wanting to see what the other party intended to do.
At this moment, he also got a clear look at the other person’s face.
It was a young male, dressed in half a set of green armor light armor, holding a refined iron great sword, and looked to be in his early twenties.
Upon seeing Han Xing, the other person seemed extremely excited.
He waved his hand and shouted, "Brother! Look at me, look at me!"
Han Xing frowned slightly and also waved back at him.
After receiving Han Xing’s response, the person seemed very excited and said enthusiastically, "Great, finally I see a living person!"
This young man then manipulated the Sky Island to approach again.
And at that moment, Han Xing suddenly spoke, "Stop."
The young man clearly heard the coldness in Han Xing’s voice, he was momentarily stunned, and then seemed to understand something.
He smiled bitterly, "Brother, I don’t mean any harm, it’s just that I haven’t seen any of my kind for days, I got a bit too excited, don’t misunderstand me!"
Han Xing also vaguely felt at this time that this man indeed had no ill intentions,
but he still kept his guard up and asked, "Is there something you need?"
Seeing Han Xing’s attitude soften, the young man quickly said, "There’s nothing much, brother, just thought I’d get to know you, maybe become friends, so we could look out for one another later."
At this, the young man sighed, "Honestly, ever since I arrived in this world, constantly facing those monsters, it’s almost driven me to a mental breakdown..."
Han Xing shook his head, "No need to make friends, for now, everyone has their own problems, there’s no way to look after others, the priority is to quickly level up and increase one’s strength."
"I still need to train, if there’s nothing else, I’ll be off."
Han Xing said, turning to leave.
The young man hurriedly said, "Hey! Brother, don’t rush off just yet!"
"My name is Bubble Fish, real name Chu Yu, local of Xinyang City, level 5 warrior, I see your gear is pretty good and you have quite a large territory, wanna form a team together?"
After speaking, he looked at Han Xing with anticipation.
At this point, Han Xing also figured out his purpose.
It turned out that this person had eagerly come to team up with other survivors after seeing the regional protection lifted.
This young man named Chu Yu continued, "Rest assured, brother, I have some confidence in my strength, if we team up, I definitely won’t be a burden!"
After a moment of thought, Han Xing shook his head and said, "No, I don’t intend to team up at this time."
Han Xing did not reveal his name, and the other person did not know that he was that rather famous Star River from area 107.
Upon hearing Han Xing’s refusal, Chu Yu seemed not to understand and asked, "Brother, it’s hard to survive alone in this world..."

"Now, many people in the chat channel are sharing their coordinates, looking for nearby people to team up with, but this world seems larger than imagined, it’s hard for even two people to meet up, I think, maybe you and I..."
He seemed to want to give it another try.
However, Han Xing still shook his head and said, "No need."
Chu Yu hesitated, but considering Han Xing’s attitude, sighed and said, "Alright, then, I’ll go look for the next person, you... be careful."
Han Xing nodded.

Chu Yu turned around and controlled the Sky Island Territory to slowly move away, before leaving, he said, "By the way, just to let you know, someone in the chat channel mentioned they found a Two-Star Secret Realm, the coordinates are not far from here, I’m heading in this direction because of the information."
"But that Two-Star Secret Realm requires five people to enter, many are heading there looking to team up, I see your gear looks pretty good, if you’re interested, you could check it out."
Han Xing nodded and thanked him.
After Chu Yu left, Han Xing pondered, "A Two-Star Secret Realm, huh?"
"The system announcement says the currently open highest difficulty Secret Realm is Two-Star, with the current strength of these survivors, it’s probably hard to conquer it."
"Better hurry and level up, at least get Coal Ball to level 6 first."
With that in mind, Han Xing called Coal Ball out from under the sofa.
He remembered that on Coal Ball’s skills panel, there were two skills yet to be unlocked.
One of the skills, ’Void Absorption’, could be unlocked at level 6.
The other one, ’Void Frenzy’, required level 10 to unlock.
Coal Ball’s first four skills had already shown Han Xing what true Divine Skill is.
This Void Absorption surely would not be weak either!
Taking a deep breath, Han Xing once again felt motivated to level up.
The territory continued to advance at a speed of over 400 kilometers per hour.
Han Xing noticed that even though the territory had reached this size, it encountered no resistance while advancing.
It was as if its speed was constant, unaffected by gravity, unless something obstructed it midway, only then would the speed decrease.
Such a phenomenon clearly defies science.
But in such a magical world, what does science matter?
At that moment, Coal Ball suddenly flashed with black light and instantly moved to the edge of the territory.
Han Xing looked over in confusion.
A cloud only about ten square meters wide appeared a few kilometers ahead.
But unlike other clouds, this one had a black vortex around it.
"Cloud Secret Realm!"

Han Xing said, turning to leave.
The young man hurriedly said, "Hey!
Brother, don’t rush off just yet!"
"My name is Bubble Fish, real name Chu Yu, local of Xinyang City, level 5 warrior, I see your gear is pretty good and you have quite a large territory, wanna form a team together?"
After speaking, he looked at Han Xing with anticipation.
At this point, Han Xing also figured out his purpose.
It turned out that this person had eagerly come to team up with other survivors after seeing the regional protection lifted.
This young man named Chu Yu continued, "Rest assured, brother, I have some confidence in my strength, if we team up, I definitely won’t be a burden!"
After a moment of thought, Han Xing shook his head and said, "No, I don’t intend to team up at this time."
Han Xing did not reveal his name, and the other person did not know that he was that rather famous Star River from area 107.
Upon hearing Han Xing’s refusal, Chu Yu seemed not to understand and asked, "Brother, it’s hard to survive alone in this world..."

"Now, many people in the chat channel are sharing their coordinates, looking for nearby people to team up with, but this world seems larger than imagined, it’s hard for even two people to meet up, I think, maybe you and I..."
He seemed to want to give it another try.
However, Han Xing still shook his head and said, "No need."
Chu Yu hesitated, but considering Han Xing’s attitude, sighed and said, "Alright, then, I’ll go look for the next person, you... be careful."
Han Xing nodded.

Chu Yu turned around and controlled the Sky Island Territory to slowly move away, before leaving, he said, "By the way, just to let you know, someone in the chat channel mentioned they found a Two-Star Secret Realm, the coordinates are not far from here, I’m heading in this direction because of the information."
"But that Two-Star Secret Realm requires five people to enter, many are heading there looking to team up, I see your gear looks pretty good, if you’re interested, you could check it out."
Han Xing nodded and thanked him.
After Chu Yu left, Han Xing pondered, "A Two-Star Secret Realm, huh?"
"The system announcement says the currently open highest difficulty Secret Realm is Two-Star, with the current strength of these survivors, it’s probably hard to conquer it."
"Better hurry and level up, at least get Coal Ball to level 6 first."
With that in mind, Han Xing called Coal Ball out from under the sofa.
He remembered that on Coal Ball’s skills panel, there were two skills yet to be unlocked.
One of the skills, ’Void Absorption’, could be unlocked at level 6.
The other one, ’Void Frenzy’, required level 10 to unlock.
Coal Ball’s first four skills had already shown Han Xing what true Divine Skill is.
This Void Absorption surely would not be weak either!
Taking a deep breath, Han Xing once again felt motivated to level up.
The territory continued to advance at a speed of over 400 kilometers per hour.
Han Xing noticed that even though the territory had reached this size, it encountered no resistance while advancing.
It was as if its speed was constant, unaffected by gravity, unless something obstructed it midway, only then would the speed decrease.
Such a phenomenon clearly defies science.
But in such a magical world, what does science matter?
At that moment, Coal Ball suddenly flashed with black light and instantly moved to the edge of the territory.
Han Xing looked over in confusion.
A cloud only about ten square meters wide appeared a few kilometers ahead.
But unlike other clouds, this one had a black vortex around it.
"Cloud Secret Realm!"

chapters.title: Chapter 53: One-Star Secret Realm
paragraphs: "Cloud Secret Realm!"
Han Xing blurted out.
Encountering a Cloud Secret Realm here can be considered quite lucky.
Han Xing maneuvered the Sky Island to gradually approach this Cloud Secret Realm.
As he got closer, he saw a star appear above the vortex.
This represents the difficulty of the Secret Realm.
"A one-star Secret Realm?"
Han Xing manipulated the Sky Island to hover near the edge of the vortex, and at this moment, a system prompt appeared.
[One-Star Cloud Secret Realm: Lost Palace]
[Difficulty: Medium, Players Allowed: 1~2, Suggested Level: 6~10.]
[Enter?]
"Lost Palace. Should I enter?" Han Xing hesitated for a moment.
Although it’s just a one-star Secret Realm, it still has its difficulties.
The suggestion indicates 1~2 players. With a companion, the risk would be significantly reduced.
At this time, Han Xing suddenly wondered if he should turn back and find Chu Yu to form a team.
However, he quickly shook his head.
He had many special items on him, like the Space Backpack, the S+ Growth Level Coal Ball, and the legendary quality Purple Armor.
Any of these items would be enough to make other survivors envious.
If he teamed up with others, it would inevitably expose him.
If it were someone he knew, it would be fine, but if it were an unfamiliar person who spread the word about what he had, he would attract a lot of unwanted attention.
Before setting up territorial defenses, Han Xing decided not to take the risk.
At this moment, Han Xing suddenly thought of something and, rubbing his chin, pondered, "Does the system’s suggestion of 1~2 include pets?"
"At the current stage, besides me, there shouldn’t be any other survivors with a pet. So, Coal Ball’s combat power shouldn’t be counted."
"If that’s the case, my actual combat power is equivalent to two people right now."
"Moreover, Coal Ball’s strength is far superior to most survivors. With its assistance, the performance would be much better than teaming up with others!"
Han Xing’s eyes lit up, sensing a chance.
After a comprehensive consideration, he realized he could challenge this Secret Realm alone!
So, Han Xing summoned Coal Ball to his side and clicked confirm.
The next moment, the vortex suddenly emitted a faint light, and the Teleportation Gate opened.
Then, he entered the vortex with Coal Ball.
At the moment of stepping into the vortex, Han Xing felt the world around him shake, and the scene spun wildly.
When his vision returned to normal, the scenery before him changed completely.
Han Xing found himself on a field of architectural ruins.
This place seemed to have been a palace once, surrounded by collapsed bricks and stones, and columns...
The entire area of the palace was massive, at least five to six thousand square meters.
The ground was paved with slabs, covered in a thick layer of dust.
The palace seemed to be situated in a valley, shrouded by thick cloud layers on all sides, rendering no view beyond the palace itself.
When Han Xing attempted to walk toward the cloud layer region, a system prompt appeared.
[You have reached the edge of the map, please return the way you came.]
Han Xing pondered, "So the cloud-covered areas are impassable, meaning my activity is confined within these palace ruins?"
Another system prompt appeared at this moment.
[Cloud Secret Realm: Lost Palace Stage One Challenge Task Activated. Survivors, please prepare for battle.]
Once the prompt ended, Han Xing suddenly felt a mild tremor on the ground.
"What! The battle begins immediately?" Han Xing exclaimed in surprise.
"This Secret Realm challenge is way too direct!"
Simultaneously, a massive hand suddenly shot out from the ruins.
Han Xing immediately became alert.
Rumble~
With the sound of bricks falling, a gigantic yellow humanoid monster sat up from the ruins.
Just the upper half of its body was exposed, and it was already over two meters tall, with the rest still buried beneath the ruins, hinting at its enormity!
In the next moment, this sleeping giant slowly propped itself up to stand.
Only now could Han Xing see the monster’s full appearance clearly.
Its height exceeded four meters. Its whole body appeared to be molded from earth, yet it was made of a special material resembling brass, but even harder, comparable to refined iron!
The Earth Giant’s body surface faintly bore white patterns like human veins, with energy subtly flowing within.
These were actually energy circuits made of mithril.
A human-sized special device on its chest emitted a brilliant green light, continuously supplying it with energy for movement.
In Han Xing’s view, the monster’s attributes appeared.
[Spiritual Puppet (One-Star Special Creature)]
[Level: lv7]
[Power: 48, Agility: 37, Spirit: 35, Constitution: 55]
[Spiritual Core Remaining Spiritual Energy: 30]
[Spiritual Core Remaining Defense Value: 100]
[Skills: Energy Shot, Rock Body (Passive Skill, reduces physical attack damage by 30%).]
"Spiritual Puppet? What kind of thing is this?"

Seeing its attributes, Han Xing exclaimed, "Its constitution is monstrously high at 55 points! And with that passive ability reducing physical damage by 30%, normal survivors wouldn’t even scratch its defense."
Evidently, Han Xing was also a physical profession, and the Spiritual Puppet’s passive affected him as well.
However, fortunately, his Attack Power greatly exceeded those at the same tier, allowing him to inflict substantial damage even with some reduction.
Meanwhile, the Spiritual Puppet developed a strong aggression towards Han Xing, opening its flat mouth and emitting a mechanical synthesized voice.
"Intruder, die!"
The energy core on the Spiritual Puppet’s chest began to emit intense green light. Concurrently, a cluster of energy gathered in its palm, seemingly charging up.
Buzz!
The Spiritual Puppet’s attack finished charging, and a burst of energy shot out from the energy circuit in its palm!
Han Xing sensed an overwhelming crisis from this strike.
Getting hit would likely result in serious injury or worse.
Han Xing executed a swift roll, evading the attack.
Before rolling, he had already released the arrow that had been held ready in his hand.
Swoosh!
The Fine Iron Arrow, powered by the Moon Crown Longbow’s formidable attack bonus, struck the left side of the Spiritual Puppet’s face directly.
However, in the next moment, Han Xing noticed that this arrow did not cause any damage to it.
The arrow hit its target but penetrated less than ten centimeters, as if hitting a stone head-on.
For the Spiritual Puppet, this wound felt like a mere scratch.
"Damn, that’s all the damage it dealt?" Han Xing was a bit flabbergasted.
The attack seemed to have enraged the Spiritual Puppet.
It began to move its giant steps, charging toward Han Xing.
"For... Lord Kaelon!"
Thud! Thud thud!
Every step of the Spiritual Puppet slammed into the ground like a boulder, producing a dull sound.
Even before it approached, a powerful sense of oppression overwhelmed Han Xing!

chapters.title: Chapter 54: Disassembling the Puppet Remains
paragraphs: The Spiritual Puppet gradually approached, and the sense of oppression followed closely.
At this moment, Little Coal Ball suddenly flashed above the Spiritual Puppet’s head and clawed swiftly at its eyes.
In an instant, the earth scattered, and two chunks of soil from the puppet’s eye region were scraped away.
The effect was there, but creatures like puppets seemed not to need eyes to capture information from the outside world.
Even though Coal Ball’s attack hit, it did not impede its steps at all.
However, when Han Xing saw the wounds in the puppet’s eye sockets emitting wisps of black gas, his eyes lit up.
"The Power of the Void’s weakening effect works!"
The Void Power skill of Coal Ball has the effect of reducing enemy defense and suppressing healing, cutting up to 30% defense.
Especially against such high-armor enemies, it can be particularly effective.
Han Xing did not expect the weakening effect of the Power of the Void to still be effective against this puppet monster.
So, Han Xing immediately took out a bottle of potion from his Space Backpack and drank it down in one gulp.
[Wild Bear Power Secret Elixir]: Increases 30% power.
With the attack enhanced once again, Han Xing quickly turned and shot a Wind Chasing Arrow.
"Hey! Take this arrow from me!"
Seeing the attack coming, the Spiritual Puppet instinctively raised its arm.
Bang!
The soil splattered.
This arrow felt like shooting into a rock.
But even if it was a rock, Han Xing’s powerful attack pierced through it.
The Fine Iron Arrow penetrated the puppet’s palm, then relentlessly plunged into its shoulder.
"Effective!"
Han Xing’s heart leaped.
Previously, his attacks could cause some damage, but it was negligible — simply put, they couldn’t break the defense.
But now, after Coal Ball’s armor weakening and the power gain from the Wild Bear Power Secret Elixir, the damage from the second arrow soared.
Little Coal Ball made another significant contribution!
Han Xing smiled knowingly, regaining his confidence.
Before, the substantial defensive power displayed by this Spiritual Puppet could despair any survivor at this stage.
But now, Han Xing knew his attacks could inflict damage.
And as long as he could break the defense, even a god couldn’t escape!
In the next moment, Multiple Arrows burst out.
Fortunately, this time the burst also triggered the ’Moonlight Flow’ effect of the Moon Crown Longbow.
Agility attribute suddenly increased by 40 points, coupled with the 30% power bonus from the Wild Bear Power Secret Elixir, Han Xing felt unprecedented power!
When the Spiritual Puppet saw the arrows coming, it also sensed the threat and raised its arm, clumsily trying to block Han Xing’s attack.
But, its speed was too slow.
Before it could lift its hand, all five arrows hit and pierced deep into its body.
One of the arrows hit the Spiritual Puppet’s core, which Han Xing deliberately aimed at.
But surprisingly, this place was not its weakness.
On the contrary, the defense at the spiritual core was even stronger than other parts of its body.
It seemed to be an independent component on the puppet with a defense value of 100 points. Han Xing’s arrow took off only 5 points of defense.
By this calculation, it would take at least 20 arrows to destroy its core.
However, the agility attribute of this Spiritual Puppet was low.
Compared to Coal Ball and Han Xing, both had extremely high agility, making the puppet unable to catch up with their pace.
So next, there was only one fate awaiting this puppet.
It would be kited to death by Han Xing.
Han Xing fought and retreated, leaping across the ruins, occasionally pulling back to some distance before turning to shoot an arrow.
Thud! Thud thud!
Han Xing counted in his mind how many arrows he shot.
After the thirtieth Fine Iron Arrow, the puppet’s rock-like upper body was filled with arrows like a porcupine.
A black smoke rose, and the monster finally collapsed.
Han Xing took a deep breath, "Finally took this guy down, this Spiritual Puppet is really a torment, almost as tough as an Elite Monster!"

In fact, the Spiritual Puppet’s defense was stronger than that of an average Elite Monster. If not for its other low attributes and obvious shortcomings, Han Xing would have to pay a price to take it down.
At this moment, a system prompt appeared.
[Spiritual Puppet killed, Level 7, gained 150 experience points, Coal Ball gained 125 experience points.]
[One-Star Secret Realm, Lost Palace Stage One completed, survivors please prepare, the Lost Palace Secret Realm Stage Two challenge will begin in 30 seconds.]
"Damn, there’s a Stage Two?" Han Xing was shocked.
He underestimated the difficulty of the Secret Realm; even the Stage One monsters were nearly as strong as Elite Monsters, so what about Stage Two?
And this was only a One-Star Secret Realm; if it was a Two-Star, the difficulty would probably rise by several grades.
Earlier, Chu Yu mentioned planning to team up with other survivors to challenge a Two-Star Secret Realm. Here, Han Xing could only lament for him silently for half a second.
Han Xing quickly walked to the puppet’s remains, ready to recover his arrows.
At this moment, another system prompt appeared.
[Disassemble the remains of the Spiritual Puppet?]
"It can be disassembled?"
Han Xing clicked yes.
In the next moment, the over-three-meter-high puppet remains collapsed, turning into powder like a boulder.
[Successfully disassembled Spiritual Puppet remains, received Special Magic Clay *647, Damaged Spiritual Core *1, Mithril *35, Refined Iron *464...]
Han Xing hefted the mechanical component weighing twenty to thirty kilograms in his hand, which was the thing supporting the puppet’s mobility — the Spiritual Core.
At this moment, another system prompt appeared.
"Repairing ’Damaged Spiritual Core’ requires Spirit Core *3000, Mithril *245, Ether *8000, repair?"
"It can be repaired, but what’s it for?" Han Xing was a bit puzzled.
Unable to figure out its use, he could only put it aside for now.
At this moment, the thirty-second preparation period was over.
The ground shook violently again.
Rumble~
In the ruins, one puppet giant after another extended their arms, revealing their massive upper bodies.
In an instant, Han Xing saw at least six Spiritual Puppets stand up from the ruins.
"Hiss..."
Han Xing took a sharp breath.
In Stage One, just one puppet made him take nearly ten minutes to deal with.
Now, suddenly there were six, making it nearly impossible.
A huge pressure suddenly loomed over his heart.
Han Xing tightened his grip on the Longbow, questioning himself.
Can it be fought?
It can be fought.
Only it will take more time.
This is going to be a long battle, testing not only Han Xing’s combat awareness but also his endurance.
Meanwhile, Coal Ball seemingly realized the strength of this lineup.
Its limbs tensed, fangs bared, and it emitted threatening growls.
Though it knew these puppets were tough to deal with, it would charge with no hesitation at Han Xing’s command.
The battle is about to erupt!

chapters.title: Chapter 55: The Bloody Incident
paragraphs: The second phase challenge of the Cloud Secret Realm is about to begin.
Before all six Spiritual Puppets fully awoke, Han Xing glanced at his backpack.
Two space backpacks, a total of 60 slots of storage space, filled with various items.
Among them, 900 Fine Iron Arrows occupy 30 slots.
In addition, with Life Secret Elixirs grouped in tens, he brought 200 bottles, occupying 20 slots.
There are also 50 bottles of Wild Bear Power Secret Elixir, taking up 5 slots.
The remaining 5 slots are used for miscellaneous food, drinking water, and spoils of war.
At this time, Han Xing felt grateful in his heart that he had such an item as a space backpack, which allowed him to carry so many items, perfectly suited for long-lasting battles.
If it were other survivors, even if they could deal with Spiritual Puppets, they would soon be defeated due to insufficient supplies.
At this moment, Han Xing suddenly thought, after this secret realm is over, should he produce a batch of space backpacks and take them to the market for trading?
Although his space backpack is just white equipment, at the current stage, no one has heard of any other spatial storage items that can be carried around.
A spatial item that can carry equipment around is, at this stage, even better than a piece of blue equipment, undoubtedly a divine artifact!
Moreover, the materials needed to make space backpacks are simple, just spirit cores and one-star beast hides, which he has plenty of in his warehouse.
"There’s potential!"
Han Xing thought to himself, "Once everyone has experienced the Cloud Secret Realm and understands the strength of the monsters inside, they will urgently need some spatial items."
"By then, it will be my time to act!"
However, the most urgent task now is to deal with the battle at hand.
While Han Xing was contemplating, the six Spiritual Puppets had already locked onto their targets.
They simultaneously raised their right hands, and the mithril patterns on their arms emitted a dazzling light at that moment, as if a terrifying energy was gathering in their palms.
Han Xing quickly fired an arrow and immediately retreated.
Coal Ball flickered, rushing to the side of one of the Spiritual Puppets.
And just then.
The attacks of the six Spiritual Puppets were all charged, and four or five energy beams simultaneously attacked Han Xing!
Buzz!
Han Xing suddenly felt a sense of crisis coming from behind, almost without thinking, he used the hunter’s early divine skill.
Roll!
Han Xing rolled on the spot, barely dodging this concentrated bombardment.
Boom!
A loud explosion was heard.
The place where Han Xing was originally standing seemed to have experienced a violent explosion, and a large pit over a meter deep and two meters wide appeared on the ground.
Seeing the scene before him, Han Xing’s scalp tingled, and he couldn’t help but shiver!
If that shot had hit him, he didn’t dare imagine!
"Damn it!"
Without thinking, Han Xing started sprinting furiously, desperately trying to distance himself from these Spiritual Puppets.
During the run, he did not forget to occasionally shoot a cold arrow back.
Thud!
The arrow hit one of the Spiritual Puppets on the cheek, but without the defense reduction effect from Coal Ball, it only caused slight damage.
However, Han Xing’s attack behavior completely enraged these Spiritual Puppets.
They started moving their tree trunk-like thick legs, beginning to chase Han Xing, while Han Xing was frantically fleeing forward.
A peculiar scene appeared before him.
A nimble figure continuously jumping back and forth on fallen stone pillars, followed by five or six Puppet Giants, launching energy attacks at him.
There was also a wolf cub closely following, flickering constantly, each time causing minor damage to these puppets.
At this moment, Han Xing wanted to say, "Master Qiu, stop flea bites..."
However, although Coal Ball’s damage seemed as minimal as flea bites.
But Han Xing didn’t need Coal Ball to output damage, just to help reduce the puppets’ defenses.
Before long, all six puppets had multiple layers of the Void’s power effect stacked on them.
And Han Xing’s arrows could finally cause more damage.
He started running wildly while seizing the chance to shoot cold arrows.
After more than ten minutes.
Han Xing was already panting heavily, cursing between breaths, "These damn stones are really freaking hard!"
Not only that, after such a long battle, the puppets showed no signs of weariness, still relentlessly pursuing him.
At this time, Han Xing suddenly remembered that these Spiritual Puppets needed energy to operate, and after such a long time, they should have consumed a lot of energy value.
But when he looked at the panels of these puppets, his heart sank.
[Remaining Spiritual Energy Value]: 30
After fighting for over ten minutes, they only consumed 10 points of spiritual energy. Calculating this way, it would take nearly an additional hour to exhaust these puppets’ energy.
Well, it seems this tactic is not reliable.
Han Xing could only continue his messy fleeing.
And just as Han Xing was being chased by the six Spiritual Puppets, the outside world was also quietly undergoing some changes.
On a Sky Island Territory of the survivors, it seemed a battle had just occurred.
Above, two human survivors were staring fiercely at another male mage.
All three were slightly injured, indicating a scuffle had just taken place.
However, the male mage’s injuries were clearly more severe.

At this moment, the male mage, with an angry expression, was the first to speak: "Damn, you two said you wanted to team up to explore the secret realm, but your real target all along was my equipment!"

One of the human swordsmen growled, "It’s you who’s being unreasonable. We told you to lend us your blue equipment for a while and we’ll return it after a few days, but you refused, so don’t blame us for taking action!"
Beside him, the other human stalker sneered, "Brother Lin, why bother talking to him? Once we get rid of him, not only is his equipment ours, but all the resources in his territory will be ours too!"
The male mage was filled with grief and indignation, knowing he had invited wolves into his house.
In this unrestrained world, once targeted by such people, it’s practically a death sentence.
However, the male mage did not give up struggling and swung his magic staff, seemingly trying to make a last stand.
Then, as a mage, with two melee professions getting close, he had no chance.
Faced with their siege, a sense of despair gradually filled his heart.
As a sharp Fine Iron Dagger stabbed into his chest,
A scream marked the end of the battle.
Moments later, a stripped human corpse was thrown down from the sky.
The human swordsman and the stalker exchanged glances, both showing a hint of bloodthirsty light on their faces.
They then divided the resources from this human survivor’s territory and annexed his Sky Island Territory, strengthening themselves.
The same scenes repeatedly happened among human survivors.
For resources or equipment, some released their entangled greed and murderous desires, choosing to turn on others.
And those unlucky ones chosen, before dying, sent out their cries in the chat channel.
For a time, cries occasionally echoed in the chat channel, making everyone uneasy.
And it was at this moment.
In a Sky Island over a thousand square meters in size, a burly human warrior was meditating with his eyes closed.
His equipment was of impressive quality, with at least three or four pieces of blue equipment, his top, bottoms, and weapon all were of blue grade.
At this stage, although his equipment’s strength was far beyond many other survivors, it also drew the covetous attention of others.
This human warrior was Cheng Jianyong.
Raising his eyelids, Cheng Jianyong suddenly noticed a floating territory rapidly approaching him...

chapters.title: Chapter 56: Unlocking New Skills
paragraphs: Two Sky Islands moved closer to Cheng Jianyong.
Seeing the appearance of those two territories, Cheng Jianyong instantly realized that they might be other survivors.
Remembering Han Xing’s warning in his heart, Cheng Jianyong immediately became vigilant and gripped the blue great sword.
When the Sky Island approached.
Cheng Jianyong saw a human Hunter and a human Warrior standing on it.
If two survivors appear on one Sky Island, it means either they have a very good relationship or something has gone wrong in one of their territories.
Moreover, these two people looked somewhat miserable, covered in blood and filth, and their equipment was tattered and torn.
The human Warrior seemed to be severely injured, unable to stand steadily, needing the support of the Hunter companion beside them.
When the two saw Cheng Jianyong, they immediately showed a gleam of excitement and exclaimed, "Great! It’s another survivor; we are finally saved, Xiao Jiang!"
Cheng Jianyong frowned and asked, "What’s wrong with you?"

The human Hunter’s face showed a painful expression, and with a sigh, he said, "It’s complicated. Simply put, we encountered a terrifying monster. It’s a giant bird, attacking human survivors’ territories everywhere."
"We were also unlucky to be attacked by that giant bird, almost killed by it, and barely escaped with our lives. Because of it, my brother’s territory was destroyed."
"Then we fled all the way, avoiding the bird’s attack range, and after half a day, we finally met you."
Listening to their tragic experience, Cheng Jianyong felt some sympathy.
At this time, the human Hunter continued, "Brother, my friend is not going to make it..."
"If you have any healing items, could you save his life? We will remember your life-saving kindness..."
Looking at their appearance, Cheng Jianyong thought they didn’t seem to be lying, and he felt compassion momentarily.
After a moment, he sighed and said, "Come over, I still have some Life Secret Elixir here."
Upon hearing this, the human Hunter’s face lit up, and he quickly thanked him.
Then, the two Sky Islands came close together.
As the human Hunter and human Warrior boarded the Sky Island Territory, they exchanged a glance and revealed a sinister smile.
"You guys..."
Cheng Jianyong saw their expression, and suddenly his face changed.
In the Lost Palace.
Han Xing was still engaged in a lengthy tug-of-war with six puppets.
More than twenty minutes passed.
Han Xing’s shooting hand was already numb; his index and middle fingers pulling the bowstring had become very swollen, with blood marks on them.
Each time he pulled the bowstring, he felt a heart-piercing pain in his fingers.
He felt that if he continued to fight, his right hand would be crippled.
But the battle had already begun, and these Spiritual Puppets wouldn’t give him any time to rest midway.
Han Xing clenched his teeth and continued turning to shoot.
The terrain of the ruins wasn’t too large, and these puppets surrounded him from many angles.
If it weren’t for Little Coal Ball occasionally diverting the hatred of these puppets, Han Xing would have been caught by now.
He had already lost count of how many arrows he had fired, but conservatively estimated, there were more than three hundred.
Taking away the arrows that missed, now each puppet had at least over thirty arrows stuck in them.
The bodies of these Stone Men monsters were like they had grown roots of grass.
Looking at this scene, Han Xing found it somewhat amusing.
But as he just grinned, a terrifying energy beam blasted towards him.
"Damn!"
Han Xing gritted his teeth and rolled on the spot.
After opening the distance, he instinctively pulled the bowstring again.
Skill: Multiple Arrows activated!
Thunk! Thunk thunk!
Five arrows concentrated fire on the puppet with the lowest remaining core Defense Value.
Just then, the situation finally changed.
The core Defense of this Spiritual Puppet was finally cleared under his relentless efforts!
Han Xing shouted excitedly, "Yes!"
The Spiritual Puppet mainly relies on its core to provide energy for activities. Now that the Defense Value is cleared, destroying its core will make it automatically lose combat ability.
Han Xing quickly turned and shot another Wind Chasing Arrow.
This was his most frequently used skill, for no other reason than the speed of Wind Chasing Arrow was higher than other skills, and its hit rate was also higher.
Whoosh!
Wind Chasing Arrow hit.
The core of the Spiritual Puppet was pierced, and its advancing motion suddenly came to a halt.
Crack... crack...
After a burst of black smoke appeared, the Spiritual Puppet stopped in its tracks.
"It’s done!" Han Xing said with joy.
After dealing with this Spiritual Puppet, there were still 5 left, and Han Xing’s stress drastically decreased!
He poured another bottle of Wild Bear Power Secret Elixir into his mouth, as if injected with adrenaline, and crazily started shooting arrows again!
"I’ll shoot! I’ll shoot! I’ll shoot you stone men to death! Hahaha!" Han Xing screamed, not caring how embarrassing his cries sounded.
Anyway, there was no one else here, so he wasn’t afraid of anyone hearing him.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
The sound of arrows hitting the Spiritual Puppets kept coming.
Five minutes later, the second Spiritual Puppet fell.
Another three minutes later, the third Spiritual Puppet toppled.
The subsequent battles held no suspense.
When the last Spiritual Puppet’s core was pierced, Han Xing collapsed to the ground as if utterly exhausted.
It took one hour and twenty-seven minutes, and he fired more than four hundred arrows.
Finally, he wore down the six stone monsters.
Tears of excitement nearly fell from Han Xing’s eyes.
Since coming to this world, he had never experienced such a long and arduous battle.
The two fingers that plucked the bowstring were already bloody and mangled, and his shoulder ached with soreness.
He hurriedly took out a bottle of Life Secret Elixir from his backpack to heal himself.
"Whew..."
The cool elixir flowed down his throat, not only replenishing his bodily fluids but also alleviating the soreness throughout his body.
At the same time, the Life Secret Elixir quickly took effect; the two nearly useless fingers promptly grew new flesh and were fully restored in seconds.
This is the formidable healing power of a Life Secret Elixir, and fortunately, this is a world of magic; otherwise, modern biology could not explain this healing effect.
At this moment, Han Xing suddenly noticed that Coal Ball in the distance seemed to be in an unusual state.
Even after the battle ended, the little wolf cub still had bloodshot eyes, continually huffing warm air through its nose, and remained in a tense state.
Han Xing quickly called it over.
"Coal Ball, come here."
Upon hearing Han Xing’s shout, Coal Ball snapped back to reality, and the ferocious aura it had vanished instantly.
Then, with a flash of black light, Coal Ball appeared beside Han Xing.
"Stop baring your teeth, it’s over."
Coal Ball, hearing this, seemed to relax its guard and returned to its usual obedient puppy-like demeanor.
Han Xing patted its head and took out a few Spirit Cores from his backpack to feed it.
"Good job, Little Coal Ball."
After gobbling several Spirit Cores, Coal Ball’s state improved significantly.
It rubbed against Han Xing’s palm.
Then, a system message appeared before his eyes.
[One-Star Secret Realm, Lost Palace challenge completed, calculating Secret Realm rewards...]
"Completed?"
Han Xing sighed in relief, fearing the system might suddenly throw in a third stage or fourth stage, which would have made him cry.
However, thinking about it, that was impossible.
After all, this was just a One-Star Secret Realm; if it were set to such high difficulty, no one else would be able to beat it.
The system messages continued to flow by.
[Secret Realm rewards calculation completed.]
[You received the following item rewards: Strong Fragment*3, Rune Crystal*170, Silver Treasure Chest*1 (the chest is located within the Secret Realm map, please open it yourself.)]
[You have received experience rewards: 4700, pet ’Coal Ball’ receives 3760 experience points.]
[Pet Coal Ball has leveled up, current level lv6, skill ’Void Absorption’ unlocked.]
After the system message ended, a white light flashed over Coal Ball.
Han Xing was amazed, "Level 6 already?"
"Does this mean that new skill is finally unlocked?" He couldn’t wait to check Coal Ball’s attributes.
[Pet Information: Void Ghost Wolf (Juvenile)]
[Race: Void Race]
[Level: LV6]
[Power: 21, Agility: 39, Spirit: 20, Constitution: 23]
[Pet ’Coal Ball’ has unlocked a new skill: Void Absorption]

[Void Absorption]: When Void Ghost Wolf enters a battle state, it continuously absorbs power from the Void, increasing all attributes by 50%, significantly enhancing recovery ability after injury, and can automatically generate one Void Spike within its body per second, culminating in ten spikes before bursting all at once.
Seeing Coal Ball’s newly activated skill, Han Xing exhaled slowly, then gritted his teeth and said, "Perverse!"
He admitted that he was indeed a bit envious of Coal Ball, this pet.
Void Absorption, compared to Coal Ball’s first four skills, is even more perverse.
The mere 50% increase in all attributes is enough to be called a Divine Skill.
Moreover, the second attribute greatly enhances Coal Ball’s recovery ability, indirectly improving its survival capacity.
And the last attribute directly turns Coal Ball’s second skill ’Counterattack Spike’ into an Active Skill.
As Coal Ball’s most powerful burst method, the ’Counterattack Spike’ has demanding trigger conditions, needing to be attacked ten times before it can be actively released.
Even though Coal Ball’s evasion rate is high, it has its own weakness, which is having too low of a Constitution.
Additionally, the enemies Han Xing challenges are generally quite strong; a single failed evasion for Coal Ball meant a severe injury.
Thus, Han Xing has always prioritized preserving Coal Ball’s life, avoiding it from engaging other monsters.
And this Counterattack Spike had turned into a redundant skill.
But now, with the Void Absorption skill activated, Coal Ball’s weakness has been directly compensated, achieving a qualitative leap!
This skill can be said to have elevated Coal Ball’s combat effectiveness by several tiers once again.
Moreover, upon reaching Level 6, the attribute boost is equivalent to two previous level-ups, significantly enhanced.
If it were the present Coal Ball facing the six Spiritual Puppets’ siege, Han Xing wouldn’t be so helpless in battle.
"Indeed, not disappointing as a Growth Level S+ pet, truly impressive!" Han Xing was very pleased.

"Coal Ball, come here."
Upon hearing Han Xing’s shout, Coal Ball snapped back to reality, and the ferocious aura it had vanished instantly.
Then, with a flash of black light, Coal Ball appeared beside Han Xing.
"Stop baring your teeth, it’s over."
Coal Ball, hearing this, seemed to relax its guard and returned to its usual obedient puppy-like demeanor.
Han Xing patted its head and took out a few Spirit Cores from his backpack to feed it.
"Good job, Little Coal Ball."
After gobbling several Spirit Cores, Coal Ball’s state improved significantly.
It rubbed against Han Xing’s palm.
Then, a system message appeared before his eyes.
[One-Star Secret Realm, Lost Palace challenge completed, calculating Secret Realm rewards...]
"Completed?"
Han Xing sighed in relief, fearing the system might suddenly throw in a third stage or fourth stage, which would have made him cry.
However, thinking about it, that was impossible.
After all, this was just a One-Star Secret Realm; if it were set to such high difficulty, no one else would be able to beat it.
The system messages continued to flow by.
[Secret Realm rewards calculation completed.]
[You received the following item rewards: Strong Fragment*3, Rune Crystal*170, Silver Treasure Chest*1 (the chest is located within the Secret Realm map, please open it yourself.)]
[You have received experience rewards: 4700, pet ’Coal Ball’ receives 3760 experience points.]
[Pet Coal Ball has leveled up, current level lv6, skill ’Void Absorption’ unlocked.]
After the system message ended, a white light flashed over Coal Ball.
Han Xing was amazed, "Level 6 already?"
"Does this mean that new skill is finally unlocked?" He couldn’t wait to check Coal Ball’s attributes.
[Pet Information: Void Ghost Wolf (Juvenile)]
[Race: Void Race]
[Level: LV6]
[Power: 21, Agility: 39, Spirit: 20, Constitution: 23]
[Pet ’Coal Ball’ has unlocked a new skill: Void Absorption]

[Void Absorption]: When Void Ghost Wolf enters a battle state, it continuously absorbs power from the Void, increasing all attributes by 50%, significantly enhancing recovery ability after injury, and can automatically generate one Void Spike within its body per second, culminating in ten spikes before bursting all at once.
Seeing Coal Ball’s newly activated skill, Han Xing exhaled slowly, then gritted his teeth and said, "Perverse!"
He admitted that he was indeed a bit envious of Coal Ball, this pet.
Void Absorption, compared to Coal Ball’s first four skills, is even more perverse.
The mere 50% increase in all attributes is enough to be called a Divine Skill.
Moreover, the second attribute greatly enhances Coal Ball’s recovery ability, indirectly improving its survival capacity.
And the last attribute directly turns Coal Ball’s second skill ’Counterattack Spike’ into an Active Skill.
As Coal Ball’s most powerful burst method, the ’Counterattack Spike’ has demanding trigger conditions, needing to be attacked ten times before it can be actively released.
Even though Coal Ball’s evasion rate is high, it has its own weakness, which is having too low of a Constitution.
Additionally, the enemies Han Xing challenges are generally quite strong; a single failed evasion for Coal Ball meant a severe injury.
Thus, Han Xing has always prioritized preserving Coal Ball’s life, avoiding it from engaging other monsters.
And this Counterattack Spike had turned into a redundant skill.
But now, with the Void Absorption skill activated, Coal Ball’s weakness has been directly compensated, achieving a qualitative leap!
This skill can be said to have elevated Coal Ball’s combat effectiveness by several tiers once again.
Moreover, upon reaching Level 6, the attribute boost is equivalent to two previous level-ups, significantly enhanced.
If it were the present Coal Ball facing the six Spiritual Puppets’ siege, Han Xing wouldn’t be so helpless in battle.
"Indeed, not disappointing as a Growth Level S+ pet, truly impressive!" Han Xing was very pleased.

chapters.title: Chapter 57: Hidden Challenge Quest Triggered!
paragraphs: After reading Coal Ball’s new skills, Han Xing began to check the other rewards that the system had just settled.
The first of which was the ’Stronger Fragment’.
[Stronger Fragment]: Collect 100 fragments to synthesize a Stronger’s Mark, which can be used for the ’Abyssal Rift’ challenge.
In the item description, Han Xing saw the name of a new map.
"Abyssal Rift? Does it have any connection to the Abyss Realm?"
He keenly noticed the word abyss.
This was because, when he encountered that terrifying demon, he learned from its mouth that it came from the Abyss Realm.
That place seems to be the stronghold of the Demon Race, where countless terrifying beings gather.
"Could it be that the system wants us to go to such a place to fight monsters?" Han Xing shivered instantly.
With his current attributes, going to the Abyss Realm would probably leave him in pieces.
Or rather, even if all the survivors of Blue Star were thrown into the Abyss Realm, it wouldn’t cause a ripple.
But thinking about it, the system probably wouldn’t let them go to such a high-level map at this stage, that would be tantamount to suicide.
So, Han Xing clicked open the introduction of the ’Abyssal Rift’ after the Stronger Fragment.
[Abyssal Rift (Special Scene)]

Tens of thousands of years ago, the Demon Emperor sacrificed all his power and wielded the strongest sword to open a road from the Abyss Realm to the Holy Spirit Realm. Through this channel, the grand Demon Army invaded the Holy Spirit Realm recklessly, igniting a protracted demon war.

Under the war, countries fell one by one, and beings were plunged into misery. Ultimately, the four strongest entities of the Holy Spirit Realm came together and, at the cost of life, severely wounded the Demon Emperor.
For hundreds of years, the battlefield between the Holy Spirit Realm and the Abyss Realm shifted to this opened channel.

Countless demons and Holy Spirit Realm warriors died here, and innumerable treasures were lost. After hundreds of years, the Demon Race was defeated, the entry to the Abyssal Rift was closed, and countless treasures remain lost within the Abyssal Rift.
Only those holding a Stronger’s Mark can enter the Abyssal Rift.
Note: The Abyssal Rift is a special scene, divided into 1-100 layers. Survivors need to start the challenge from the first layer and gradually deeper into the rift.
Entry scene level requirement: lv10.
After reading this long introduction, Han Xing realized.
It turns out that the so-called Abyssal Rift is a special space, which seems to have been the main battlefield and passage between two worlds a long time ago.
There might be very powerful monsters inside, along with countless treasures.
And as long as 100 Stronger Fragments are collected, a Stronger’s Mark can be synthesized, allowing entry to the Abyssal Rift challenge.
Moreover, the challenge starts from the first layer, similar to a tower-climbing mechanism.
"It sounds quite good, although the difficulty of this map shouldn’t be low, requiring at least level 10 to enter."
"Moreover, collecting 100 fragments is also fairly challenging."

After all, Han Xing only received 3 fragments from challenging a One-Star Secret Realm. Based on this ratio, at least thirty more One-Star Secret Realms have to be challenged to gather enough for a Stronger’s Mark.
This suggests that Stronger Fragments should be relatively precious items.
Thinking of this, Han Xing suddenly had an idea.
It’s difficult to collect 100 fragments on his own, needing a lot of time.
But if it is put on the shoulders of almost ten thousand survivors in Area 107, it becomes much simpler.

He just needs to use the items he has to harvest, no, exchange for a large number of Stronger Fragments from other survivors, synthesize many Stronger’s Marks quickly, and then continue to enter the Abyssal Rift.
This idea needs implementation, but Han Xing felt it’s highly feasible.
At this stage, he doesn’t believe there is any survivor who can resist the allure of the Space Backpack.
Han Xing immediately decided, that once out, he will begin batch-producing Space Backpacks and then find a suitable opportunity to put them on the trading market.
After checking the introduction of the Stronger Fragments, Han Xing looked at another material in his backpack.
[Rune Crystal]: One of the main materials for making equipment runes, requires the corresponding Rune Blueprint for crafting.
The introduction is simple and straightforward.
Han Xing glanced at it and didn’t pay further attention, instead, he gazed forward.
He hadn’t forgotten that there was still a Silver Treasure Chest in the secret realm settlement reward.
The system said that this treasure chest has to be found by oneself within the Secret Realm map.
Han Xing searched among the ruins, then discovered a silvery corner next to a collapsed stone pillar.
Han Xing’s eyes lit up, "There it is!"
Under the debris, a wholly silver-white treasure chest was pressed beneath stones.
Han Xing hurried over and then directly opened the Silver Treasure Chest, revealing numerous dazzling materials before his eyes.
[Successfully opened silver treasure chest, obtained Spirit Core*124, Mithril*17, Rare Earth*243, Ether*147...]
[Obtained Chaos Rune Blueprint (Weak)*1, obtained Barbarian Bracelet (Blue)*1]
"Rune Blueprint?"
Han Xing picked up the blue blueprint from the treasure chest, "It appeared so quickly? Lucky!"
He quickly clicked to learn it.
In the crafting interface, a Rune Blueprint column was added, currently containing only this Chaos Rune Blueprint.
Han Xing checked the blueprint’s attributes.
[Chaos Rune (Weak)]: Adds rune effects to equipment, slightly increasing a random attribute.
Materials needed for crafting: Rune Crystal*100, Spirit Core*10, Ether*200.
"Not bad, the required materials aren’t complicated, I can mass-produce it after going out."
There was still a piece of blue equipment, the Barbarian Bracelet, left in the treasure chest that hadn’t been picked up.
The luck with the treasure chests was pretty good this time.
So far, Han Xing’s secret realm challenge had yielded quite decent results.
The last piece of equipment he picked up was something he had never obtained before from the gauntlet slot.
Han Xing excitedly checked its attributes.
[Barbarian Bracelet (Blue) lv6, Quality - Refined, Defense 4~5, Power +10, Agility +5, Attached Effect - Barbarian Power (When attacking, 50% chance to increase Power by 20 points)]
"Another piece of equipment that increases power; if this keeps up, my strength attribute will soon surpass my agility!"
Han Xing was both delighted and speechless; he didn’t want to become the Muscle Bully Hunter.
But he still equipped it immediately, after all, it was a piece of blue equipment, and the increased attributes were quite powerful.
By now, the rewards from the secret realm had almost all been collected, so Han Xing planned to decompose the remnants of the spiritual puppets on the ground before leaving.
Just then, a different kind of prompt appeared.

[Attention, Survivor, as you have completed the secret realm alone, your strength has gained the recognition of the Lost Palace’s master, Kaelon’s will, triggering a hidden task, Kaelon’s Experimental Report.]
[Upon accepting this task, the third stage of the Lost Palace challenge will automatically begin, please make your choice quickly, Survivor.]
"Hmm? A hidden task?"
Han Xing was instantly invigorated.
In Sky Island Paradise, hidden tasks are rare opportunities, each hiding significant chance.
Just like when he engaged with the Great Demon Monarch’s request in the Dark Elf Camp, in that task, he gained the powerful pet ’Coal Ball’.
Though at that time, he was forced to accept, and this palace’s hidden task didn’t have the same prestige as that of the Great Demon Monarch’s task.
But each hidden task often comes with unique rewards.
Han Xing hesitated slightly, very much wanting to accept.
Yet, recalling the earlier chaos when he was chased by six spiritual puppets, he felt a bit apprehensive.
The difficulty of the second stage was already so tremendous, surely the third stage challenge would be even fiercer.
As he hesitated, the system prompt appeared once more.
[Survivor, please make your choice swiftly, either give up or accept.]
[If you do not respond in 60 seconds, it will be considered an automatic forfeit...]
Han Xing initially intended to give up, but just then, a hint from the side, Coal Ball seemed to discover something, and its silhouette flashed instantly, appearing dozens of meters away in a corner.
Seeing the little one’s speed, Han Xing’s eyes suddenly lit up.
"After Coal Ball reached level 6, its strength underwent a massive enhancement, almost a qualitative leap, and I also acquired a piece of blue equipment, further boosting my damage..."
"Both of our powers have notably increased compared to the second stage..."
After thinking for a moment, Han Xing gritted his teeth and said, "Let’s do it!"
He decided to accept the hidden task.
[You have accepted the Lost Palace hidden task, ’Kaelon’s Experimental Report’, the third stage challenge will start in ten minutes, please prepare quickly, Survivor.]
"Ten minutes to prepare? That’s alright."
At this time, Coal Ball was standing on a collapsed stone pillar, head lowered, nose twitching from time to time, as if searching for something.
Han Xing walked over and asked, "What’s up, found some treasure?"
Coal Ball, with its head down, was using its little wolf paws to paw at the rubble, and upon seeing Han Xing approach, it excitedly jumped up and down.
It frequently looked at Han Xing with its clear eyes and then at the pile of ruins, seemingly trying to convey some message.
"Hmm? Is there really treasure down there?" Han Xing asked somewhat unsurely.
Coal Ball panted with excitement, then resumed digging, gesturing for Han Xing to join in.
Seeing this, Han Xing also began clearing the surrounding debris with Coal Ball.
Within two minutes, the stone fragments in the area were cleaned up.
Revealed on the ground was a wooden door, looking like the entrance to some kind of basement.
Upon seeing this door appear, Han Xing looked at Coal Ball with surprise, not having expected there to actually be something underneath.
He approached the wooden door, and before even opening it, caught the scent of mixed herbs and fermentation.
"Hmm... smells good!"
"Could it be that there’s..." Han Xing hurriedly opened the wooden door.
Sure enough, as soon as it opened, a long-sealed brewed fragrance wafted up.
The system prompt appeared.
[You have discovered a Dwarf Race wine cellar.]
Inside was a small space that seemed to have been used as a wine cellar at some point.
At a glance, Han Xing saw several jar-sized wine pots below, having been stored for an unknown amount of years.
Unfortunately, most of these were shattered due to the palace’s collapse.
The wine mash on the ground had long since dried up.
But now, there was still one last wine pot that hadn’t been broken!
Han Xing’s eyes lit up!
