chapters.title: Chapter 58: The Void Ghost Wolf’s Metamorphosis!
paragraphs: Due to the collapse of the palace, most of the wine jars in the Dwarf Cellar were shattered, leaving only the last jar intact.
"Fortunately, there’s one left for me!" Han Xing exclaimed in relief.
Even though Han Xing wasn’t a heavy drinker, he understood the rarity of such aged liquor.
Of course, such a precious item must be taken away.
However, with the jar being a meter high and half a meter in diameter, taking it away was indeed a challenge.
So, Han Xing tried to store it in his backpack, and in the next moment, the black wine jar disappeared from its original spot.
"Oh? It really worked?" Han Xing was surprised.
Although the jar was large, it only occupied two slots in the space backpack.
Just then, a system notification appeared.
[Obtained Black Vine Wine (760 years), 230L.]
"Whoa! 760 years, did I read that right?" Han Xing rubbed his eyes.
When he confirmed the year on the item information, he was even more shocked.
He then looked at the note beneath the Black Vine Wine.
Note: The Dwarf Race has unique research in brewing, second only to forging, which is a talent that stands out in the Holy Spirit Realm.

Black Vine Wine is one of the Dwarf Race’s best brews. Its ingredients include black vine from the Mysterious Forest, magic leaves from the Elf Forest, egg whites from the Giant Roc Egg, Ghost Soul Spring Water... combined with the Dwarf Race’s unique brewing skill, it results in a jar of original liquid. The older the vintage, the more mellow the taste, beloved by Dwarf Nobility.
The brewing technology of the Dwarf Race is as outstanding as their forging technology.
The fragrance of the wine was intoxicating, even with the seal unbroken.
Moreover, this was a 760-year-old Black Vine Wine. If it were on Blue Star, one can’t imagine how many drink enthusiasts would go crazy over it!
If it weren’t for the imminent battle, Han Xing might have wanted to take a sip right then and there.
At this moment, Coal Ball was wagging its tail in front of Han Xing, as if asking for credit.
Han Xing patted its head and praised, "Not bad, your dog nose is really sharp."
By now, five minutes of the ten-minute preparation time given by the system had passed.
Han Xing quickly walked over to the remains of the six spiritual puppet carcasses and disassembled each one to prevent them from being destroyed by the impending battle’s aftermath.

From these six puppet remains, Han Xing recovered a large number of fine iron arrows, then added a lot of special magic clay to his backpack, along with six damaged spiritual cores and some mithril and refined iron.
After doing all this, Han Xing took a piece of dried beast meat from his backpack, chewed it for a while, and swallowed it.
He had to hurry and return to his best state.
Time flew by, and the ten-minute time quickly passed.
[The third-stage challenge has begun, Survivor, good luck...]
As the prompt ended, Han Xing suddenly felt an unprecedented trembling beneath the palace!
Rumble~
Not only did the palace tremble, but Han Xing even felt the entire valley start to shake.
Then, a terrifying giant hand emerged from the center of the ruins, shaking off countless stone blocks and bricks.
A half-body slowly sat up from the rubble, like a giant who had been asleep for many years, awakened by some will today.
When it stood up, a colossal dark yellow being over six meters tall appeared before Han Xing.
The attribute panel of this monster also appeared in front of him.
[Enhanced Spiritual Puppet (Elite Level)]
[Level: lv7]
[Power: 64, Agility: 48, Spirit: 49, Constitution: 67]
[Remaining Spiritual Energy: 80]
[Remaining Defense Value of Spiritual Core: 300]

[Skills: Energy Bombardment, Rock Body (Passive Skill, reduces 30% of physical attack damage when attacked), Earthquake Shock (The spiritual puppet leaps high into the air and slams heavily onto the ground, causing a huge ground shock, dealing massive damage to enemies within range).]
Seeing the puppet’s attributes, Han Xing actually breathed a sigh of relief.
"Good, just an elite level."
He was really afraid that the system would suddenly toss out a leader-level monster, which would complicate things.
But thinking about it, the first two rounds of battles were already so tough, if a leader level appeared now, it wouldn’t even be worth fighting.
Because, even he doesn’t have confidence in soloing a leader-level creature.
If he couldn’t pass, how many people could complete this hidden task?
However, even though it’s an elite-level puppet, it can’t be underestimated.
Because even ordinary spiritual puppets have defense comparable to elite monsters, so this enhanced puppet’s flesh defensive ability nearing leader monsters isn’t surprising!
The battle began, and Han Xing immediately entered a state of full concentration.
The familiar Wind Chasing Arrow started it off.
Ding!
This arrow bounced off the spiritual puppet upon impact.
Han Xing’s eyes narrowed, as he expected.
This guy’s defense was beyond that of stone, comparable to refined iron.
Without Coal Ball’s defense reduction buff, this arrow didn’t cause any damage.
The elite puppet, enraged by Han Xing’s arrow, was about to launch an attack.
At this moment, Han Xing suddenly saw many purple lines appearing on Coal Ball’s body, extending out as if connecting to another space.
This was the newly activated fifth skill of Coal Ball, Void Absorption.
The next moment, the black light on Coal Ball surged, and the entire wolf dashed forward, instantly appearing beside the Elite Puppet.

With the enhancement of the Power of the Void, all attributes of Coal Ball increased by 50%, coupled with the 200% speed boost from Void Flashes. At this moment, Coal Ball’s movement speed even faintly surpassed the limit of a One-Star Monster.
Swish! Swish swish!
The Elite Puppet didn’t have time to react, and more than a dozen claw marks appeared on its body.
Although it seemed not to cause much damage, each claw mark was emitting purple mist.
In an instant, Coal Ball stacked the armor reduction state to the limit, directly reducing its defense by 30%.
Compared to before reaching Level 6, wasn’t this speed more than doubled!

At the same time, Han Xing also saw that Coal Ball’s figure constantly flickered, often appearing beside the Spiritual Puppet’s core. Every time it appeared, it took away seven or eight defense values from its core.
The Elite Puppet seemed angered by this annoying little creature, uttering a dull mechanical sound.
"Those who disobey Lord Kaelon’s orders, die!"
The Spiritual Puppet swung its millstone-sized palm in retaliation. Compared to Coal Ball’s small physique, if it got hit randomly by this, it would undoubtedly be smashed into pulp.
In such a situation, usually, without Han Xing’s reminder, Coal Ball would rely on its instinctive combat awareness to evade.
But now it had no fear at all, enduring the Spiritual Puppet’s attacks, and furiously outputting.
Bam! Bam! Bam!
Although the Spiritual Puppet kept attacking Coal Ball, the strange thing was, its palm hit Coal Ball’s body but had no effect.
It was as if attacking a mere shadow, and the Spiritual Puppet’s hand passed directly through Coal Ball’s body.
Skill: Body of Nothingness with a 50% dodge chance kept triggering.

Moreover, Coal Ball’s attack rhythm was getting faster and faster. Each appearance left many wolf claw prints on the Elite Puppet, and that speed made even Han Xing on the side feel his scalp tingling.
Less than five seconds had passed since the battle started.
The core defense value of the Spiritual Puppet flowed away like water, directly dropping below 250 points.
Han Xing was dumbfounded from the sidelines.
He held the longbow, standing bewildered, watching Coal Ball perform alone.
After reaching Level 6, this little creature had completely transformed into a little boss, suppressing the Elite Monster in a one-on-one fight.
At this moment, the core device of the Spiritual Puppet was operating at its limit, with output power already at its maximum.
In other words, its "CPU" was about to smoke, yet even so, it couldn’t keep up with Coal Ball’s rhythm.
Han Xing suspected that if it wasn’t for the Spiritual Puppet’s lack of emotions, it might have gone mad by now.
Just then, energy suddenly gathered in the Spiritual Puppet’s palm, and a terrifying aura erupted in an instant.
"For... Lord Kaelon!"
It chose to detonate the energy orb in front of its chest, determined to inflict mutual damage and severely wound Coal Ball!
"Watch out!" Han Xing exclaimed in shock.
Coal Ball was engulfed by the explosion’s energy before it could dodge.
Boom!
As the smoke cleared, Coal Ball’s figure flew backward.
Han Xing quickly rushed over, ready to assist.
However, he found that Coal Ball’s aura not only didn’t weaken but instead, the Power of the Void on its body began to surge.
Han Xing clearly saw that Coal Ball’s fur had been scorched black from the explosion injury just now.
But now, these injuries were healing at a speed visible to the naked eye, soon restored, comparable to the recovery effect of Han Xing using a Life Secret Elixir.
"This..." Han Xing stopped in confusion.
The next moment, the fully recovered Coal Ball charged towards the Elite Spiritual Puppet again like a moth drawn to a flame.
Han Xing muttered blankly, "Seems like there’s nothing left for me to do here?"
At that moment, Han Xing saw Coal Ball’s body suddenly turn transparent.
Ten Void Spikes became faintly discernible.
Then, the Void Spikes abruptly erupted, bombarding the body of the Spiritual Puppet.
Pu pu pu pu!
A dense sound of metal penetration rang out.
This strike, two Void Spikes alone reduced the Spiritual Puppet’s core defense value by more than 50 points, and all the other spikes hit as well, causing extremely terrifying damage!
Han Xing saw that the right shoulder of the Spiritual Puppet was even pierced by a Void Spike, breaking the Mithril patterns, rendering its right arm completely useless.
At the same time, the core defense value had dropped to less than 100 points, and the Spiritual Puppet entered into berserk mode.
Its two giant legs, as thick as millstones, shone brightly with Secret Patterns, as if all energy was converging between its legs.
The next moment, the Spiritual Puppet leaped high.
Han Xing’s face suddenly changed.
This was the third skill of the Elite Puppet, Earthquake Shock, a very terrifying area damage skill.
Without thinking, Han Xing rolled once, then quickly ran towards the edge of the palace.
"Coal Ball, run!"

sentences.text: Due to the collapse of the palace, most of the wine jars in the Dwarf Cellar were shattered, leaving only the last jar intact.
"Fortunately, there’s one left for me!" Han Xing exclaimed in relief.
Even though Han Xing wasn’t a heavy drinker, he understood the rarity of such aged liquor.
Of course, such a precious item must be taken away.
However, with the jar being a meter high and half a meter in diameter, taking it away was indeed a challenge.
So, Han Xing tried to store it in his backpack, and in the next moment, the black wine jar disappeared from its original spot.
"Oh?
It really worked?" Han Xing was surprised.
Although the jar was large, it only occupied two slots in the space backpack.
Just then, a system notification appeared.
[Obtained Black Vine Wine (760 years), 230L.]
"Whoa!
760 years, did I read that right?" Han Xing rubbed his eyes.
When he confirmed the year on the item information, he was even more shocked.
He then looked at the note beneath the Black Vine Wine.
Note: The Dwarf Race has unique research in brewing, second only to forging, which is a talent that stands out in the Holy Spirit Realm.
Black Vine Wine is one of the Dwarf Race’s best brews.

Its ingredients include black vine from the Mysterious Forest, magic leaves from the Elf Forest, egg whites from the Giant Roc Egg, Ghost Soul Spring Water... combined with the Dwarf Race’s unique brewing skill, it results in a jar of original liquid.
The older the vintage, the more mellow the taste, beloved by Dwarf Nobility.
The brewing technology of the Dwarf Race is as outstanding as their forging technology.
The fragrance of the wine was intoxicating, even with the seal unbroken.
Moreover, this was a 760-year-old Black Vine Wine.
If it were on Blue Star, one can’t imagine how many drink enthusiasts would go crazy over it!
If it weren’t for the imminent battle, Han Xing might have wanted to take a sip right then and there.
At this moment, Coal Ball was wagging its tail in front of Han Xing, as if asking for credit.
Han Xing patted its head and praised, "Not bad, your dog nose is really sharp."
By now, five minutes of the ten-minute preparation time given by the system had passed.
Han Xing quickly walked over to the remains of the six spiritual puppet carcasses and disassembled each one to prevent them from being destroyed by the impending battle’s aftermath.

From these six puppet remains, Han Xing recovered a large number of fine iron arrows, then added a lot of special magic clay to his backpack, along with six damaged spiritual cores and some mithril and refined iron.
After doing all this, Han Xing took a piece of dried beast meat from his backpack, chewed it for a while, and swallowed it.
He had to hurry and return to his best state.
Time flew by, and the ten-minute time quickly passed.
[The third-stage challenge has begun, Survivor, good luck...]
As the prompt ended, Han Xing suddenly felt an unprecedented trembling beneath the palace!
Rumble~
Not only did the palace tremble, but Han Xing even felt the entire valley start to shake.
Then, a terrifying giant hand emerged from the center of the ruins, shaking off countless stone blocks and bricks.
A half-body slowly sat up from the rubble, like a giant who had been asleep for many years, awakened by some will today.
When it stood up, a colossal dark yellow being over six meters tall appeared before Han Xing.
The attribute panel of this monster also appeared in front of him.
[Enhanced Spiritual Puppet (Elite Level)]
[Level: lv7]
[Power: 64, Agility: 48, Spirit: 49, Constitution: 67]
[Remaining Spiritual Energy: 80]
[Remaining Defense Value of Spiritual Core: 300]

[Skills: Energy Bombardment, Rock Body (Passive Skill, reduces 30% of physical attack damage when attacked), Earthquake Shock (The spiritual puppet leaps high into the air and slams heavily onto the ground, causing a huge ground shock, dealing massive damage to enemies within range).]
Seeing the puppet’s attributes, Han Xing actually breathed a sigh of relief.
"Good, just an elite level."
He was really afraid that the system would suddenly toss out a leader-level monster, which would complicate things.
But thinking about it, the first two rounds of battles were already so tough, if a leader level appeared now, it wouldn’t even be worth fighting.
Because, even he doesn’t have confidence in soloing a leader-level creature.
If he couldn’t pass, how many people could complete this hidden task?
However, even though it’s an elite-level puppet, it can’t be underestimated.
Because even ordinary spiritual puppets have defense comparable to elite monsters, so this enhanced puppet’s flesh defensive ability nearing leader monsters isn’t surprising!
The battle began, and Han Xing immediately entered a state of full concentration.
The familiar Wind Chasing Arrow started it off.
Ding!
This arrow bounced off the spiritual puppet upon impact.
Han Xing’s eyes narrowed, as he expected.
This guy’s defense was beyond that of stone, comparable to refined iron.
Without Coal Ball’s defense reduction buff, this arrow didn’t cause any damage.
The elite puppet, enraged by Han Xing’s arrow, was about to launch an attack.
At this moment, Han Xing suddenly saw many purple lines appearing on Coal Ball’s body, extending out as if connecting to another space.
This was the newly activated fifth skill of Coal Ball, Void Absorption.
The next moment, the black light on Coal Ball surged, and the entire wolf dashed forward, instantly appearing beside the Elite Puppet.
With the enhancement of the Power of the Void, all attributes of Coal Ball increased by 50%, coupled with the 200% speed boost from Void Flashes.
At this moment, Coal Ball’s movement speed even faintly surpassed the limit of a One-Star Monster.
Swish!
Swish swish!
The Elite Puppet didn’t have time to react, and more than a dozen claw marks appeared on its body.
Although it seemed not to cause much damage, each claw mark was emitting purple mist.
In an instant, Coal Ball stacked the armor reduction state to the limit, directly reducing its defense by 30%.
Compared to before reaching Level 6, wasn’t this speed more than doubled!
At the same time, Han Xing also saw that Coal Ball’s figure constantly flickered, often appearing beside the Spiritual Puppet’s core.
Every time it appeared, it took away seven or eight defense values from its core.
The Elite Puppet seemed angered by this annoying little creature, uttering a dull mechanical sound.
"Those who disobey Lord Kaelon’s orders, die!"

chapters.title: Chapter 59: Spiritual Puppet Blueprint
paragraphs: "Coal Ball, run quickly!" Han Xing shouted as he ran.
However, Coal Ball, already in battle mode, glanced at Han Xing, then looked up at the Spiritual Puppet in the air.
The next moment, the black light on its body surged, and it suddenly leaped into the air, catching up with the Spiritual Puppet that was casting Skills.
Han Xing caught a glimpse out of the corner of his eye; at this moment, Coal Ball looked like a monster, actually chasing the enemy in mid-air!
Moreover, taking advantage of the moment when the Spiritual Puppet was casting Skills and unable to defend its Spiritual Core, it extended its wolf claws and began a frenzied attack.
At this moment, the rate at which the core defense value of the Spiritual Puppet was dropping was even faster than the stock market.
One second later, the core defense value was directly cleared to zero.
Coal Ball directly extended its wolf claw, frantically clawing inside.
A cloud of smoke rose up, and the Secret Pattern lines on the Spiritual Puppet’s body suddenly dimmed, as if the energy supply had been cut off, and it was forced to shut down.
Then, a massive body fell from the sky.
Rumble~
The massive body fell, stirring up a huge cloud of dust, the violent impact almost making Han Xing unable to stand steadily.
As the dust settled.
Han Xing saw Coal Ball standing atop the corpse of the Spiritual Puppet, head held high, emanating a kingly majesty.
He gulped and, after a while, said, "Brother Qiu, you’re fierce..."
At the same time, the system prompt appeared.
[You have completed the Lost Palace hidden task, Kaelon’s experiment report.]
[You received challenge rewards: Strong Fragment*8, Rune Crystal*370, Experience Value 18000, Pet Coal Ball received Experience Value 14400.]
[Task item obtained: Kaelon’s experiment report]
points of Experience Value, truly massive, directly pushed his experience bar to 100%.
The next moment, a flash of white light appeared on Han Xing, and his Level increased again.
Aside from the massive amount of experience, Han Xing also found a document in his backpack, which was the task item given by the system this time.
Han Xing took it out and glanced at it.

[Kaelon’s experiment report]: Task item, holding this report data allows you to go to Kaelon’s kingdom laboratory to extract Spiritual Puppet experimental data (scene not open, task temporarily unavailable).
There was also a segment of plot below.

"July 21st, the 13153rd experiment, achieved exciting results. I finally created a powerful puppet that can be mass-produced. I must quickly inform the King and have the puppets deployed in the war as soon as possible."

"July 25th, Monet came to the palace to find me. She is still so beautiful and captivating. I heard she has many admirers among the Elf Race. She is so exquisite, like a fairy fallen to the mortal realm, while I am just a dwarf who only dares to secretly look at her from the side..."

"July 26th, Monet heard about my experimental results and thought they were amazing. She praised my talent, saying even among the Elf Race, there’s no man as smart as me. This was the first time I saw a hint of appreciation on her normally cool face, and at that moment, my heart almost melted!"

"July 27th, Monet stayed in my palace as a guest. We researched together, traveled together, and enjoyed the moon together. I was so happy, I even brought out my treasured Black Vine Wine. We both got drunk..."
"July 28th, Monet and I woke up together in the sleeping palace. I know last night we did something against racial morals, a dwarf and an elf, how could we... However, Monet’s chest is so big!"
"July 29th, we did it again... Monet is so big, I threw all morals aside."
"July 30th, Monet and I did it..."
"August 1st, did it with Monet... (Learned some new positions)"
"August 2nd, elves are amazing!"
"August 3rd, oh no, another whole day didn’t get out of bed..."
Seeing this, Han Xing couldn’t help but cover his eyes.
What the heck is this shitty task item, filled with this kind of lewd diary.
And it seems more like a dwarf being played by an Elf Race woman.
Han Xing continued reading.

"August 17th, Monet called me Dr. Kaelon and hoped I could tell her the puppet-making method, but the palace’s experimental data had long been uploaded, and the King ordered a prohibition. Facing her disappointed gaze, my heart was torn, but I had no choice."
"August 20th, Monet finally left the palace, and I felt a bit empty inside..."
"August 25th, the Puppet Palace suddenly suffered a mysterious attack, the palace was turned to ruins, luckily I was visiting my uncle that day!"

"August 26th, the kingdom sent Dwarf Knights to investigate, they concluded it was likely the work of the Shadow Race, those Demon Race minions must have wanted to steal my experimental data! But they surely didn’t expect I had already set up a self-destruction protocol in the palace, at the moment of attack, all data was automatically destroyed!"
"September 1st, I moved to the main city of the kingdom, successfully transferred all experimental data."
"September 7th, I suddenly remembered something important, there are some hand-drawn blueprints and data in the Puppet Palace that haven’t been cleared, oh no oh no!"
After reading the task introduction, Han Xing roughly had a judgment in mind.
This Kaelon’s experiment report is likely a chain task. He has completed the first part, which is equivalent to having received the task item for the second part.
"But where is this Kaelon’s kingdom laboratory? The system also says the map is not open, so I can’t take on this task?"
Han Xing had to temporarily put this task item into his backpack.
Then, he walked over to the giant puppet wreckage and clicked dismantle.
[Successfully dismantled Enhanced Spiritual Puppet (Elite Level), acquired Special Clay*9182, acquired Mithril*681, acquired Rare Earth*16455, acquired Enhanced Spiritual Core*1...]
After the remains of the Elite Puppet disappeared, a system prompt appeared.
[You have completed the Cloud Secret Realm, Lost Palace Tier Three challenge, you will be automatically transported out in ten minutes, and the Cloud Secret Realm will disappear.]
"In ten minutes, I can leave here?"
From when he came in until now, he had stayed for about two and a half hours, and the gains were considerable, the greatest reward being a massive amount of experience.
Not only did he level up to level 7, but Brother Qiu also leveled up to level 6.
Then there were the 11 Strong Fragments, and a large amount of materials dismantled from these puppets.
As Han Xing quietly waited to be transported away, he suddenly caught sight of something different from the corner of his eye.
Where the Elite Puppet had originally awakened, there was a large shallow pit.
At the bottom of the shallow pit, there seemed to be some hand-drawn patterns.
"Huh?
He quickly walked over, at the bottom of the shallow pit was a floor paved with bluestone.

Han Xing immediately saw that several puppet sketches were carved on the floor, beside the patterns, there were clearly annotations on the construction path of Mithril, the ratio of Rare Earth and Magic Clay, etc...
Connecting it to the last sentence of the task item.
That Kaelon said he still had some hand-drawn manuscripts and data in the laboratory.
Han Xing said with a face full of surprise, "These patterns, could they be..."
Sure enough, the next moment, a system prompt appeared.
[You have discovered Kaelon’s Spiritual Puppet Blueprint, the related blueprint has been automatically recorded.]
"What the heck?"
Upon hearing the system prompt, Han Xing was so surprised his mouth dropped open.
He didn’t know what the production blueprint was, but he knew that his system interface indeed had an extra blueprint!
Does this mean he can use the blueprint to make such puppets?
Thinking of this, Han Xing suppressed his excited heart and quickly checked the blueprint introduction.

[Spiritual Puppet Blueprint]: Based on this blueprint, different level Spiritual Puppets can be made, the grade of the Spiritual Puppet is determined by the number of Spirit Cores added during production, producing a Level 1 Spiritual Puppet requires adding 1000 Spirit Cores, Level 2 requires 2000, and so on. (Note, the highest level Spiritual Puppet made cannot exceed the Survivor’s level.)
[Materials required for production]: Spiritual Core*1, Special Clay*8000 (can be replaced with Refined Iron), Mithril*1000, Rare Earth*12000, Ether*20000.
[Production Success Rate: 20%, with Divine-level Craftsman Talent bonus, success rate has reached 100%.]
After reading the blueprint introduction, Han Xing was once again stunned, this unexpectedly was a blueprint that could create puppets of different levels.
Moreover, the materials for making Spiritual Puppets are not complicated, they are all common materials.
Does this mean that as long as he has enough materials, he can even rely on this blueprint to raise a massive puppet army?
"Does this mean that in the future, I won’t need to take action when encountering monsters, I can just drown them with a puppet army?"
Thinking of this, Han Xing’s breathing became a bit rapid.
Because this plan is likely feasible!
Though the materials needed for making Spiritual Puppets are many, with his Divine-level Talent, coupled with players’ collection ability, why worry about not getting a huge amount of materials?
Of course, Han Xing was still thinking too optimistically.
Although the materials for making Spiritual Puppets are not complex, the most critical part is the Spiritual Core.
Even though he has the Spiritual Puppet Blueprint, he does not have the method to create Spiritual Cores.
Furthermore, he currently only has a few Damaged Spiritual Cores on hand.
Han Xing counted, a total of seven, even if all were repaired, he could only make 7 Spiritual Puppets.
The dream of a puppet army was thus shattered.
Han Xing angrily said, "This Kaelon, why only record the Spiritual Puppet blueprint and not the Spiritual Core production blueprint? What a foolish romantic!"
It was fortunate Kaelon wasn’t here if he heard, he would probably retort furiously, "How did being a romantic brain offend you? Did being a romantic brain eat your family’s rice?"
However, Han Xing was satisfied, after all, with the materials he currently had, he could make 7 Spiritual Puppets.
Even though they were only of ordinary level, their toughness even surpassed that of general Elite Creatures, just this defensive feature alone was enough to drive people crazy.
This trip to the secret realm was worth it!
At this moment, Han Xing noticed a corner in the deep pit, there seemed to be some patterns covered by ruins...

At the bottom of the shallow pit, there seemed to be some hand-drawn patterns.
"Huh?
He quickly walked over, at the bottom of the shallow pit was a floor paved with bluestone.

Han Xing immediately saw that several puppet sketches were carved on the floor, beside the patterns, there were clearly annotations on the construction path of Mithril, the ratio of Rare Earth and Magic Clay, etc...
Connecting it to the last sentence of the task item.
That Kaelon said he still had some hand-drawn manuscripts and data in the laboratory.
Han Xing said with a face full of surprise, "These patterns, could they be..."
Sure enough, the next moment, a system prompt appeared.
[You have discovered Kaelon’s Spiritual Puppet Blueprint, the related blueprint has been automatically recorded.]
"What the heck?"
Upon hearing the system prompt, Han Xing was so surprised his mouth dropped open.
He didn’t know what the production blueprint was, but he knew that his system interface indeed had an extra blueprint!
Does this mean he can use the blueprint to make such puppets?
Thinking of this, Han Xing suppressed his excited heart and quickly checked the blueprint introduction.

[Spiritual Puppet Blueprint]: Based on this blueprint, different level Spiritual Puppets can be made, the grade of the Spiritual Puppet is determined by the number of Spirit Cores added during production, producing a Level 1 Spiritual Puppet requires adding 1000 Spirit Cores, Level 2 requires 2000, and so on. (Note, the highest level Spiritual Puppet made cannot exceed the Survivor’s level.)
[Materials required for production]: Spiritual Core*1, Special Clay*8000 (can be replaced with Refined Iron), Mithril*1000, Rare Earth*12000, Ether*20000.
[Production Success Rate: 20%, with Divine-level Craftsman Talent bonus, success rate has reached 100%.]
After reading the blueprint introduction, Han Xing was once again stunned, this unexpectedly was a blueprint that could create puppets of different levels.
Moreover, the materials for making Spiritual Puppets are not complicated, they are all common materials.
Does this mean that as long as he has enough materials, he can even rely on this blueprint to raise a massive puppet army?
"Does this mean that in the future, I won’t need to take action when encountering monsters, I can just drown them with a puppet army?"
Thinking of this, Han Xing’s breathing became a bit rapid.
Because this plan is likely feasible!
Though the materials needed for making Spiritual Puppets are many, with his Divine-level Talent, coupled with players’ collection ability, why worry about not getting a huge amount of materials?
Of course, Han Xing was still thinking too optimistically.
Although the materials for making Spiritual Puppets are not complex, the most critical part is the Spiritual Core.
Even though he has the Spiritual Puppet Blueprint, he does not have the method to create Spiritual Cores.
Furthermore, he currently only has a few Damaged Spiritual Cores on hand.
Han Xing counted, a total of seven, even if all were repaired, he could only make 7 Spiritual Puppets.
The dream of a puppet army was thus shattered.
Han Xing angrily said, "This Kaelon, why only record the Spiritual Puppet blueprint and not the Spiritual Core production blueprint?
What a foolish romantic!"
It was fortunate Kaelon wasn’t here if he heard, he would probably retort furiously, "How did being a romantic brain offend you?
Did being a romantic brain eat your family’s rice?"
However, Han Xing was satisfied, after all, with the materials he currently had, he could make 7 Spiritual Puppets.
Even though they were only of ordinary level, their toughness even surpassed that of general Elite Creatures, just this defensive feature alone was enough to drive people crazy.
This trip to the secret realm was worth it!
At this moment, Han Xing noticed a corner in the deep pit, there seemed to be some patterns covered by ruins...

chapters.title: Chapter 60: Crafting a Spiritual Puppet
paragraphs: Han Xing noticed a corner in the deep pit, seemingly with some patterns still covered by the ruins.
"Hmm? There’s more?"
He quickly jumped down and tried to move the debris to see what these patterns were.
After equipping the Barbarian Gauntlet, Han Xing’s power reached 45 points, plus a 30% increase from the Barbarian Bear Power Secret Elixir, totaling nearly 60 points of power!
His current strength attribute was enough to move these heavy boulders.
One by one, the giant stones were moved aside, and after gritting his teeth and pushing away a stone pillar, a larger puppet pattern emerged beneath Han Xing’s feet.
A system prompt appeared.
[You’ve discovered Kaelon’s blueprint, Enhanced Spiritual Puppet (Elite Level), blueprint recorded)]
"What the hell!!!"
A loud shout echoed throughout the entire palace.
Just then, the secret realm time ended.
Han Xing suddenly felt his body become illusory, and the next moment, he was teleported to his territory.
Above him, the blue sky appeared once more.
Even so, Han Xing was still unable to recover from the shock for a long time.
This secret realm journey had completely exceeded his expectations.
Not only did he acquire the method to create Spiritual Puppets, but at the very last moment, he actually discovered the method to create Elite Level Spiritual Puppets!
It was truly an incredible surprise!
Suppressing his excitement, Han Xing began to check the Elite Level Spiritual Puppet blueprint.

[Enhanced Spiritual Puppet Blueprint]: According to this blueprint, different levels of Enhanced Spiritual Puppets can be made based on the number of Spirit Cores added during production; 5000 Spirit Cores are required to make Level 1 Spiritual Puppet, 10000 for Level 2, and so on. (Please note, the level of crafted Enhanced Spiritual Puppets cannot exceed the Survivor Level)
[Materials Required for Production]: Enhanced Spiritual Core*1, Special Clay*20000 (can be replaced with Refined Iron), Mithril*5000, Rare Earth*50000, Ether*40000.
[Production Success Rate 5% (boosted by Divine-level Craftsman Talent, success rate now 100%)]
The Elite Level Spiritual Puppets require a multiplier increase in materials, but compared to their powerful attributes, it’s all worth it.
He only had one Enhanced Spiritual Core in hand, meaning he could only produce one Elite Puppet.
After using some materials to repair the damaged Spiritual Core, Han Xing eagerly clicked on produce.
[Would you like to produce Enhanced Spiritual Puppet (Elite Level)*1? Production time: 4 hours]
"Yes."
[Producing Enhanced Spiritual Puppet, remaining time 3 hours 59 minutes 59 seconds...]
Han Xing glanced at the construction time of his Basic Lord’s Castle, it was less than 9 hours away from being completely built.
At this time, the castle was already more than halfway completed, the bottom two floors had begun to take shape, leaving only the central tower unfinished.
"Great, once I produce a few puppets, the castle will almost be done. By then, my territory will have preliminary defense power."
Han Xing eagerly imagined the completed castle.
Just then, Han Xing received a message from the discussion group, sent by Cheng Jianyong. He clicked to take a look.
As soon as he entered the discussion group, he heard Cheng Jianyong speaking with hidden anger: "Damn it, what bad luck!"
Both Han Xing and Shen Yun sensed his unusual tone and quickly asked, "What’s wrong?"

Cheng Jianyong said angrily: "Just ran into two little punks on the way, they came towards me saying their territory was invaded by monsters and they were seriously injured, hoping I could save them."
"I thought since we’re all from Blue Star, we are peers, so I felt a bit of sympathy. But to my surprise, after these two punks finished treating their injuries at my area, they eyed my equipment!"
"These two guys suddenly attacked me, almost got me killed!"
Han Xing realized the gravity of the situation and quickly asked: "How are you now? Want us to come over?"
Shen Yun also hurriedly said: "Quick, send coordinates, I’ll go deal with those two punks right away!"
Cheng Jianyong spoke with a somewhat heavy tone in the discussion group: "No need to come over, I’ve already handled it."
Upon hearing this, the two understood what Cheng Jianyong meant by handling.
In such a critical moment, if the sides started fighting, it was hard to stop.
In other words, those two guys with malicious intent were likely already taken out by Cheng Jianyong.
Unlike previous battles with monsters, this time Cheng Jianyong had really killed people.
However, the two didn’t say much, because in such a world, without legal constraints, self-preservation is a priority.
Moreover, when someone’s trying to kill you, if you don’t take them out, then what are you waiting for?
The discussion group atmosphere was somewhat heavy at this point.
Then, Cheng Jianyong sighed again, "Thanks to your help, giving me so much Blue Armor and Skills, I managed to counterattack those two guys, otherwise..."
He spoke earnestly: "Brother Xing, Brother Yun, I realize in this world, we must protect ourselves!"
"If it’s someone unfamiliar, definitely don’t let them land on your territory!"
The two knew Cheng Jianyong’s reminder was very sensible.
After confirming Cheng Jianyong was alright, Han Xing closed the discussion group.
Moments later, he pondered: "Indeed, just as I thought, despite survivors having shared survival challenges, surely there are a few with ulterior motives among them."
"I must quickly enhance my strength, at least set up defense structures for the territory. That way, anyone intending to attack me will think twice about whether they have the ability!"
With this in mind, Han Xing brought Coal Ball to continue leveling up.
With his current strength, along with the transformed Coal Ball, normal Sky Island Monsters pose no threat to him at all.
As long as he doesn’t act recklessly by approaching those monster Sky Islands that are a thousand square meters in size, he basically won’t encounter enemies stronger than himself.
As afternoon turned into sunset.
Han Xing had just wiped out a group of goblins, and his level increased to 80% of Level 7.
Through a day of exploration, his territory area expanded from over 1,200 square meters to over 2,000 square meters, nearly doubling.
However, Han Xing did not continue to expand the usable area of his territory.
Instead, he folded more than a thousand pieces of territory and placed them under the Sky Island, making it stacked.
His Sky Island Territory area shrank back to a thousand square meters. If he acquires other building blueprints in the future, it can still be transformed into a single layer at any time.
But currently, with no buildings to construct, expanding the territory too wide is not beneficial.
At the same time, a system prompt appeared.
[Enhanced Spiritual Puppet (Elite Level) production is complete.]
The system prompt ended.
Han Xing saw a steel giant about five meters tall suddenly appear at the center of the territory.
This was the Elite-level Spiritual Puppet just created.
It seemed that due to the main material ’Special Magic Clay’ being replaced with Refined Iron, the appearance of this Spiritual Puppet became like a steel giant.
In front of his eyes, the attributes of the puppet also appeared.
[Enhanced Spiritual Puppet (One-star Elite Level)]
[Level: lv7]
[Power: 68, Agility: 37, Spirit: 49, Constitution: 71]
[Remaining Spiritual Energy: 0]
[Remaining Defense Value of Spiritual Core: 300]

[Skills: Energy Storage Cannon Attack, Steel Body (Passive Skill, reduces 40% of the damage effect when receiving physical attacks), Earthquake Shock (The Spiritual Puppet leaps high and crashes heavily onto the ground, causing a large ground shock and dealing massive damage to enemies within range).]
Compared to the Elite-level Puppet he challenged in the Secret Realm, this puppet’s Agility Attribute was slightly lower, but other attributes had slight improvements.
Han Xing estimated that this was caused by the main material for making the Spiritual Puppet being replaced with Refined Iron.
However, its second skill, Rock Body, turned into Steel Body, with a partial improvement in damage reduction effect.
Just for defense, the attributes of this Spiritual Puppet are qualified.
At this time, this Spiritual Puppet remained motionless, as if it had crashed.
Han Xing knew the reason, it was because the Spiritual Core was out of energy.
So he walked to the side of the Spiritual Puppet and began to replenish its energy, and the system prompt appeared.
[Do you want to insert Spirit Cores into the Enhanced Spiritual Puppet to replenish its Spiritual Energy Value?]
[Note: 100 Spirit Cores can replenish 1 point of Spiritual Energy Value, each 1 point of Spiritual Energy Value allows the Enhanced Spiritual Puppet to enter combat state for 1 hour.]
"Oh? So, 10,000 Spirit Cores can only allow this Spiritual Puppet to fight for 100 hours?"
"This consumption is quite large..."
Han Xing realized that the Spiritual Puppet truly lives up to its name; it needs Spirit Cores for everything.

He was even thinking of creating a puppet army in the future. If every puppet consumed like this, a single battle would require him to consume tens of thousands, or even hundreds of thousands of Spirit Cores.
Even with his reserves, it’s a bit too much.
But for now, he can still bear the consumption of just a few puppets.
Han Xing waved his hand grandly, directly inserting 5,000 Spirit Cores to replenish its Spiritual Energy Value to 50 points.
The next moment, the Energy Core on the chest of the Spiritual Puppet emitted a dazzling green light, regaining its ability to move.
Inspired, Han Xing suddenly wanted to test the Spiritual Puppet’s responsiveness to his commands, so he said, "Advance."
The Spiritual Puppet began to take large strides forward with heavy steps.
Thud! Thud!
The territory trembled constantly, and furniture and sofas shifted a few centimeters.
"Stop!"
The Spiritual Puppet’s movements halted instantly.
"Attack mode."
As soon as the words fell, the Spiritual Puppet condensed a terrifying mass of energy in its hand.
One second, two seconds.
The energy mass in the Spiritual Puppet’s hand surged more intensely.
And Han Xing also noticed that its Spiritual Energy Value decreased by one point in just a few seconds.
Han Xing quickly had the Spiritual Puppet cease charging energy.
The next moment, a green energy mass emitting a strong aura of destruction blasted into the sky.
Boom!
A dull explosion sounded.

chapters.title: Chapter 61: Lord’s Castle Completed
paragraphs: A muffled explosion suddenly echoed from a thousand or two meters above Han Xing’s head.
It was the psionic puppet’s energy-charging attack.
In the Cloud Secret Realm, Han Xing had witnessed the powerful attack power of the elite puppet.
But at that time, it was completely suppressed by the Coal Ball, without any chance to charge.
Now, the psionic puppet was demonstrating its powerful destructive power.
Han Xing was quite satisfied with this.
Besides these simple commands, Han Xing discovered that he could also issue more complex instructions, such as guarding the territory’s safety and fully attacking when encountering intruders.
When no battle was happening, it could still be on alert and patrol 24 hours a day.
After all, it’s a puppet creature, and fatigue isn’t an issue.
At this time, Han Xing stroked his chin and pondered: "The psionic puppet is strong, but its size is too conspicuous. If I don’t need it, is there any way to hide this big guy?"
As it stands, unless this big guy could be put into the storage space like other items.
Otherwise, it would have to stay in the territory, and other survivors would see its huge figure at a glance when they approached.
Although, in his heart, Han Xing also felt that the idea of putting the puppet into storage space was a bit unrealistic. However, he decided to give it a try.
When he tried to put the enhanced psionic puppet into the storage box.
The next moment, this gigantic giant suddenly disappeared from the territory.
At the same time, a miniaturized puppet model appeared in his storage box, occupying a full 10 slots of storage space.
Han Xing’s eyes were baffled, followed by an uncontrollable joy.
"Damn! It actually worked!" He was utterly shocked.
Then Han Xing thought again: "Since it can be stored in the storage box space, does that mean it can also be stored in my backpack space?"
Han Xing immediately released the psionic puppet from the storage space.
Then, he cleared 10 slots in his backpack and began trying to store it.
The next moment, the silhouette of the psionic puppet disappeared once again.
And in Han Xing’s backpack, the silhouette of a steel giant appeared.
Han Xing’s shock at this moment was indescribable.
A huge figure over 6 meters tall and weighing over ten tons being carried on him—what sort of concept is this?
But thinking about it, it’s explainable.
After all, the psionic puppet isn’t a living creature; it’s classified as a tool, like the equipment and secret elixirs Han Xing created. Being stored in space is normal.
Han Xing suddenly had a sneaky idea.
He still had 7 damaged spiritual cores on hand. Although he couldn’t continue to create elite-level puppets, the attributes of normal puppets weren’t bad either.
Moreover, 7 ordinary psionic puppets are actually more dangerous than one elite puppet.
If he creates them all and then stores them in the storage space.
When other creatures invade his territory, what would their reaction be if they suddenly saw seven or eight steel giants surrounding them?
Thinking of this, he couldn’t help but let out a sinister laugh.
Then, he eagerly started to repair the damaged spiritual cores in his backpack, directly clicking on create.
System prompt appeared.
[Create psionic puppet, required time: 2 hours.]
Han Xing clicked ’Yes’ without hesitation and clicked 7 times in total.
He wanted to create all these puppets at once, greatly strengthening the territory’s defense.
At this time, the sky had gradually darkened.
Han Xing didn’t continue exploring but instead lit the torch stand in the territory and began to rest.
At this moment, Han Xing had begun scanning the consignment channel information.
The equipment on him still had a lot of room for improvement.
His current pants and boots were still the beast hide green armor made at the start. If replaced with blue leather armor, both attributes and defense would be greatly enhanced.
Also, the necklace and hat could be replaced with blue equipment.
After two days of exploration, the survivors’ levels had also risen, and the consignment channel information was increasingly abundant.
Including the previously scarce blue equipment, now there were many listings available.
Han Xing started searching one part after another.
He adjusted the equipment grade to blue.
Soon, many pieces of equipment appeared before him.
Han Xing wanted to prioritize obtaining blueprints since the attributes of self-crafted items are higher than those found in treasure chests.
But unfortunately, after obtaining blueprints, most survivors chose to learn them themselves, and only a tiny fraction would enter the market.
Thinking of this, Han Xing directly listed several consignment details.
[Consigned Item]: Life Secret Elixir *10.
[Required Items]: Blue leather armor bottoms blueprint, blue leather boots blueprint, blue helmet blueprint, blue necklace blueprint.
[Consignor]: Star River.
The formidable effect of the Life Secret Elixir has been deeply experienced by everyone through the battles over the past few days.
In a previous round of trading, Han Xing only sold over seven thousand bottles, leaving a significant gap in the entire 107 zone.
Therefore, when Han Xing restocked the Life Secret Elixir, it caused a sensation.
Before long, he managed to exchange for the things he desired.
They were:
[Night Travel Boots Blueprint (Blue), Equipment Level: lv7]
[Pale Leather Pants (Blue), Equipment Level: lv6]
[Jungle Warrior Helmet (Blue), Equipment Level: lv7]
[Forest Pendant (Blue), Equipment Level: lv7]
The material requirements for these blue equipment blueprints were similar, mainly needing Mithril and Spirit Core, which Han Xing had in abundance.
He directly crafted over a dozen sets, selecting those that reached the upper limit of the blue equipment’s quality, which is Treasure.
The attributes are as follows.
[Night Travel Boots (Blue) lv7, Quality - Treasure, Defense: 4~6, agility +12, Attached Effect - Night Shadow Assault (Evasion Rate increased by 15%)]
[Pale Leather Pants (Blue) lv6, Quality - Treasure, Defense 12~16, agility +8, Spirit +5, Attached Effect - White Pattern (Improves Magic Resistance Effect by 20%)]

[Jungle Warrior Helmet (Blue) lv7, Quality - Treasure, Defense: 4~5, Power +5, Constitution +5, agility +5, Attached Effect - Hunting Instinct (Upon killing enemies, gains 3 points Power bonus, stacks up to 5 layers, Effect lasts for 60 seconds.)]
[Forest Pendant (Blue) lv7, Quality - Treasure, Spirit +15, agility +10, Attached Effect - Forest Will (Upon activating Skills, has a 10% chance to trigger a 5-second cooldown reduction effect.)]
Han Xing looked at these four pieces of treasure equipment with satisfaction and equipped them all.
His attributes underwent a dramatic change!
All Attributes at least doubled, comparable to the attributes of a level 10 human Survivor!
"Great, now I have a full set of Blue Armor, along with a Purple Armor weapon!"
"Same-level Survivors typically can hardly break through my Defense."
After putting any extra crafted equipment up for consignment to exchange for materials, Han Xing planned to rest.
He summoned his Elite Level Spiritual Puppet.
A six-meter tall figure suddenly appeared, just standing there bringing an intangible sense of security.
Han Xing issued the command to guard, then entered a resting state himself.
In the depths of night.
Han Xing suddenly felt a strong vibration and sat up abruptly on the sofa.
Seeing the Spiritual Puppet standing firmly by his side brought a sigh of relief.
He thought it might be other Survivors, or Sky Island Monsters attacking the territory.
Simultaneously, a system notification appeared.
[Territory Building: Basic Castle construction completed, your territory’s Defense has been enhanced.]
[Basic Castle (Territory Core Building)]
[Remaining Defense Value]: 1000.

[Castle Effect]: Enhances all defensive buildings within the territory by 20% Defense Value, boosts all attacking buildings by 10% Attack Power, increases all friendly units’ All Attributes by 10%, enhances Sky Island Territory movement speed by 10%.
(Note, when constructing multiple castles, only one will provide the amplification effect at most.)
Looking at the massive structure before him, Han Xing’s drowsiness disappeared instantly, and he was thrilled.
At the same time, he noticed a new 10% enhancement effect on his Attribute Panel, including that of his Spiritual Puppet.
Don’t underestimate the 10% gain, as quantitative changes lead to qualitative shifts.
When Han Xing’s summons or puppets increase in number, the bonuses gained can far exceed 10%!
Nonetheless, the enhancements are secondary, the main draw is that this castle’s appearance fits his aesthetic perfectly.

The castle sits at the territory’s center, resembling a towering beast, the high and thick walls built from sturdy Stone Blocks, a steel gate emanating soft light at its center, subtly adorned with traces of Secret Patterns, delivering a sense of unassailable security.
"Excellent, starting today, I’m a person with my own castle!"
Eagerly, he pushed open the steel gate at the castle center, revealing a spacious scene.
Upon entering, he found a hall with a seven-meter-high ceiling, the wall materials seemingly synthetic, predominantly gray-white, suggesting robust Defense Strength just from its appearance.

The floor was laid with a layer of blue-gray stone tiles, exuding substance when stepped upon. In the hall, four corners housed pillars over a meter thick, adorned with numerous white Moonlight Stones and red Dark Fire Stones.
Moonlight Stones and Dark Fire Stones not only provide lighting but can also regulate temperature throughout the hall at any time.
Adding a large Mithril chandelier hanging in the center, the hall appeared bright and grand!
However, the hall seemed somewhat empty at the moment, as it lacked any furnishings.
Han Xing decided to construct some furniture later, to imbue it with a touch of living atmosphere.
The hall’s four corners each had large doors leading to separate passageways connected to other towers.
Han Xing opened the left door, entering one of the towers.
Below the tower was a room with windows that could serve as a bedroom or be used for storing resources.
At the second level of the tower was a walkway encircling the castle, taking a lap around it equivalent to patrolling the entire territory.
Having toured the castle, Han Xing headed straight for the central tower area.

sentences.text: A muffled explosion suddenly echoed from a thousand or two meters above Han Xing’s head.
It was the psionic puppet’s energy-charging attack.
In the Cloud Secret Realm, Han Xing had witnessed the powerful attack power of the elite puppet.
But at that time, it was completely suppressed by the Coal Ball, without any chance to charge.
Now, the psionic puppet was demonstrating its powerful destructive power.
Han Xing was quite satisfied with this.
Besides these simple commands, Han Xing discovered that he could also issue more complex instructions, such as guarding the territory’s safety and fully attacking when encountering intruders.
When no battle was happening, it could still be on alert and patrol 24 hours a day.
After all, it’s a puppet creature, and fatigue isn’t an issue.
At this time, Han Xing stroked his chin and pondered: "The psionic puppet is strong, but its size is too conspicuous.
If I don’t need it, is there any way to hide this big guy?"
As it stands, unless this big guy could be put into the storage space like other items.
Otherwise, it would have to stay in the territory, and other survivors would see its huge figure at a glance when they approached.
Although, in his heart, Han Xing also felt that the idea of putting the puppet into storage space was a bit unrealistic.
However, he decided to give it a try.
When he tried to put the enhanced psionic puppet into the storage box.
The next moment, this gigantic giant suddenly disappeared from the territory.
At the same time, a miniaturized puppet model appeared in his storage box, occupying a full 10 slots of storage space.
Han Xing’s eyes were baffled, followed by an uncontrollable joy.
"Damn!
It actually worked!" He was utterly shocked.
Then Han Xing thought again: "Since it can be stored in the storage box space, does that mean it can also be stored in my backpack space?"
Han Xing immediately released the psionic puppet from the storage space.
Then, he cleared 10 slots in his backpack and began trying to store it.
The next moment, the silhouette of the psionic puppet disappeared once again.
And in Han Xing’s backpack, the silhouette of a steel giant appeared.
Han Xing’s shock at this moment was indescribable.
A huge figure over 6 meters tall and weighing over ten tons being carried on him—what sort of concept is this?
But thinking about it, it’s explainable.
After all, the psionic puppet isn’t a living creature; it’s classified as a tool, like the equipment and secret elixirs Han Xing created.
Being stored in space is normal.
Han Xing suddenly had a sneaky idea.
He still had 7 damaged spiritual cores on hand.
Although he couldn’t continue to create elite-level puppets, the attributes of normal puppets weren’t bad either.
Moreover, 7 ordinary psionic puppets are actually more dangerous than one elite puppet.
If he creates them all and then stores them in the storage space.
When other creatures invade his territory, what would their reaction be if they suddenly saw seven or eight steel giants surrounding them?
Thinking of this, he couldn’t help but let out a sinister laugh.
Then, he eagerly started to repair the damaged spiritual cores in his backpack, directly clicking on create.
System prompt appeared.
[Create psionic puppet, required time: 2 hours.]
Han Xing clicked ’Yes’ without hesitation and clicked 7 times in total.
He wanted to create all these puppets at once, greatly strengthening the territory’s defense.
At this time, the sky had gradually darkened.
Han Xing didn’t continue exploring but instead lit the torch stand in the territory and began to rest.
At this moment, Han Xing had begun scanning the consignment channel information.
The equipment on him still had a lot of room for improvement.
His current pants and boots were still the beast hide green armor made at the start.
If replaced with blue leather armor, both attributes and defense would be greatly enhanced.
Also, the necklace and hat could be replaced with blue equipment.
After two days of exploration, the survivors’ levels had also risen, and the consignment channel information was increasingly abundant.
Including the previously scarce blue equipment, now there were many listings available.
Han Xing started searching one part after another.
He adjusted the equipment grade to blue.
Soon, many pieces of equipment appeared before him.
Han Xing wanted to prioritize obtaining blueprints since the attributes of self-crafted items are higher than those found in treasure chests.
But unfortunately, after obtaining blueprints, most survivors chose to learn them themselves, and only a tiny fraction would enter the market.
Thinking of this, Han Xing directly listed several consignment details.
[Consigned Item]: Life Secret Elixir *10.
[Required Items]: Blue leather armor bottoms blueprint, blue leather boots blueprint, blue helmet blueprint, blue necklace blueprint.
[Consignor]: Star River.
The formidable effect of the Life Secret Elixir has been deeply experienced by everyone through the battles over the past few days.
In a previous round of trading, Han Xing only sold over seven thousand bottles, leaving a significant gap in the entire 107 zone.
Therefore, when Han Xing restocked the Life Secret Elixir, it caused a sensation.
Before long, he managed to exchange for the things he desired.
They were:

[Pale Leather Pants (Blue), Equipment Level: lv6]
[Jungle Warrior Helmet (Blue), Equipment Level: lv7]
[Forest Pendant (Blue), Equipment Level: lv7]
The material requirements for these blue equipment blueprints were similar, mainly needing Mithril and Spirit Core, which Han Xing had in abundance.
He directly crafted over a dozen sets, selecting those that reached the upper limit of the blue equipment’s quality, which is Treasure.
The attributes are as follows.
[Night Travel Boots (Blue) lv7, Quality - Treasure, Defense: 4~6, agility +12, Attached Effect - Night Shadow Assault (Evasion Rate increased by 15%)]
[Pale Leather Pants (Blue) lv6, Quality - Treasure, Defense 12~16, agility +8, Spirit +5, Attached Effect - White Pattern (Improves Magic Resistance Effect by 20%)]

[Jungle Warrior Helmet (Blue) lv7, Quality - Treasure, Defense: 4~5, Power +5, Constitution +5, agility +5, Attached Effect - Hunting Instinct (Upon killing enemies, gains 3 points Power bonus, stacks up to 5 layers, Effect lasts for 60 seconds.)]
[Forest Pendant (Blue) lv7, Quality - Treasure, Spirit +15, agility +10, Attached Effect - Forest Will (Upon activating Skills, has a 10% chance to trigger a 5-second cooldown reduction effect.)]
Han Xing looked at these four pieces of treasure equipment with satisfaction and equipped them all.
His attributes underwent a dramatic change!
All Attributes at least doubled, comparable to the attributes of a level 10 human Survivor!
"Great, now I have a full set of Blue Armor, along with a Purple Armor weapon!"
"Same-level Survivors typically can hardly break through my Defense."
After putting any extra crafted equipment up for consignment to exchange for materials, Han Xing planned to rest.
He summoned his Elite Level Spiritual Puppet.
A six-meter tall figure suddenly appeared, just standing there bringing an intangible sense of security.
Han Xing issued the command to guard, then entered a resting state himself.

chapters.title: Chapter 64: Ancient Weapon: Gold Melting Cannon Shards
paragraphs: Han Xing was confirming if this woman was worth rescuing.
However, the female mage across from him was not surprised and instead was moved to tears of joy.
She hurriedly took out a piece of metal from her pouch, with a golden luster on the surface, appearing to be of extraordinary quality.
"This is the item!"
"What is this?" Han Xing continued to ask.

The female mage, while casting the Air Burst Technique, replied haltingly, "I... I don’t know... The system says it’s a shard of some ancient weapon, with coordinates inscribed on it that can open some door!"
After she finished speaking, Han Xing already believed about eighty percent of what she said.
After all, judging by this woman’s performance, it was impossible for her to fabricate such a relatively coherent lie in such a short time.
So, he nodded and said, "I can save you, but under the condition that this quest item belongs to me, okay?"
He needed to confirm, in case he saved someone only for them to go back on their word, leading to a bunch of trouble.
The female mage nodded repeatedly but because her movements were too vigorous, her impressively large assets trembled.
Just moments ago, being far away, Han Xing hadn’t seen clearly.
Now, he took notice that this woman’s figure was indeed a bit exaggerated.
Previously, he just thought her figure was good, with ample front and back.
But now, he realized it was not just ample but remarkably explosive, with meat where it should be and slender where it should be.
Even more exaggerated, beneath this woman’s voluptuous physique was a slender waist that could be gripped with ease.
Below the waistline, there were her round, generously curved hips, and two sensually long legs, whose muscles were tensed at that moment, making them appear even more taut.
Han Xing thought strangely to himself that there really were such cartoonish figures in this world...
At this moment, the beautiful female mage seemed unable to hold on any longer and urged softly, "Hey, young man... can you hurry up a bit?"
"I’m... I’m about to run out of strength..."
She was struggling hard against the kobold attack.
"Don’t worry."
Han Xing leisurely drew an arrow and nocked it onto the bowstring.
The next moment, an arrow imbued with the aura of the wind was shot out at high speed.
"Whoosh!"
In the surprised gaze of the female mage, the Wind Chasing Arrow hit a kobold’s head accurately, drilling through.
Moreover, after taking down this kobold, the arrow continued smoothly towards the next target.
Swish! Swish!
Two more kobolds were directly pierced through by this arrow.
One arrow took down three Level 6 monsters.
Such terrifying attack power almost refreshed the female mage’s understanding.
However, before she could recover from her shock,
Han Xing had already used his burst skill.
Multi-Shot.
Thunk! Thunk-thunk!
The fine iron arrows hit each kobold with precision, nearly one per arrow.
The two skills directly took down 6 powerful monsters, leaving not only the female mage but even the remaining kobolds dumbstruck.
Upon seeing their companions die, the kobolds howled and charged towards Han Xing, their enmity now redirected.
However, even if they outnumbered him, being monsters of lower level than himself, Han Xing did not see them as a threat.
With just a few more arrows, the Dogman Tribe was completely annihilated.
At this moment, the female mage was stunned, feeling somewhat surreal.
She remembered her fiancé once said that Level 6 monsters had strong attributes that could easily kill those ordinary survivors.
Yet under this young man’s arrows, how did these monsters feel as fragile as children?
What she didn’t know was that Han Xing was deliberately hiding the legendary effects of the Moon Crown Longbow by using a rare-quality longbow; otherwise, the battle would have ended even sooner.
After the battle ended,
Han Xing connected his territory with the female mage’s territory.
Then he slowly walked to her side.
At this point, the female mage was still feeling the fear of narrowly escaping death, her chest rising and falling rapidly.
Seeing Han Xing approach, she seemed to gather her wits and quickly thanked him, "Tha... thank you for rescuing me, young man. I’m Zhang Lianmeng, you can call me Lian’er or Sister Lian..."
After speaking, she cautiously lifted her head, sneaking a glance at Han Xing with her watery eyes.
However, Han Xing didn’t care what she was called; he only cared if he could get the hidden quest item quickly.
Han Xing extended his hand, his tone indifferent, "Hand it over."
Upon hearing this, Zhang Lianmeng bit her lip lightly, seeming hesitant, as this quest item was not easy for her to obtain.
She also knew the importance of a hidden quest at the current stage.
But thinking of her previous promise and Han Xing’s formidable combat prowess, she had no choice but to compromise.
Zhang Lianmeng gently bit her lip and took out the metal shard from her pouch again, slowly walking towards Han Xing.
However, she didn’t notice that during the battle just now, a hole had been torn in the abdominal area of her magic robe by a kobold’s attack.
At this moment, above her abdomen, a large area of skin was exposed.
Han Xing seemed to see two snow-white spheres, swaying towards him.
It wasn’t until Zhang Lianmeng handed him the metal shard, the chilling sensation reaching him, that Han Xing snapped back to reality.
Then, a system notification appeared.
[You have obtained the ancient weapon, Gold Melting Cannon Shards.]
Han Xing also saw a string of numbers on the shard, 66487, 69876, 21346, which should be the coordinates.
Zhang Lianmeng quietly asked, "Is it okay now?"
Han Xing responded, "Uh... it’s really big."
"What?" Zhang Lianmeng seemed confused.
Han Xing shook his head and said, "No, a pleasure working with you."
Zhang Lianmeng seemed to realize something, looked down at her damaged magic robe, and next moment, her fair face suddenly changed color.
She instinctively crossed her arms, her face turning scarlet with embarrassment.
Han Xing cleared his throat twice, saying, "You’re safe now, so, goodbye."
After saying this, Han Xing turned and left directly.
Zhang Lianmeng reached out her hand, wanting to say something but hesitating.
As she watched Han Xing’s figure retreat without looking back, she seemed to muster the courage to say, "Then, um... could you help me find my fiancé?"
"My fiancé is Liu Zeqi, he was previously the boss of Hengyu Company in Xinyang City, now he’s in charge at the Divine Whisper Team."
"He has many people under him; if you could take me to him, he’d surely reward you greatly!"
Zhang Lianmeng said excitedly, seeming to look up to Liu Zeqi she spoke of.
However, Han Xing waved his hand and said, "Not interested, and no time, go find your man yourself."
Zhang Lianmeng looked disappointedly down, but thinking of this mysterious young man’s agile skills and extraordinary attack power, she couldn’t help but be curious about Han Xing.

chapters.title: Chapter 65: The Massive Floating Island
paragraphs: At this moment, Zhang Lianmeng continued, "Young man, please wait a moment."
Han Xing slowly stopped his steps, frowning, "What’s the matter now?"
Seemingly hearing the impatience in Han Xing’s tone, Zhang Lianmeng said nervously, "Well, can I join you in doing this hidden mission?"
Han Xing frowned.
Seeing this, Zhang Lianmeng quickly explained, "Don’t... don’t misunderstand, it’s not that I’m suddenly backing out, but I remembered something related to the mission..."
"What is it? Speak." Han Xing’s tone was somewhat impatient.
Zhang Lianmeng cautiously said, "This fragment, I discovered it by chance while exploring a Sky Island."
"Inside, there was a goblin camp. After defeating that group of goblins, I found an iron cage in the camp, and inside was a very terrifying person..."
"That person was huddled on the ground, with blood holes all over their body, yet not a drop of blood was coming out, skinnier than a bag of bones!"

As she spoke, Zhang Lianmeng seemed to recall something terrifying, her delicate body shuddering slightly, "I... I originally wanted to save them, but as soon as I opened the iron cage, that person suddenly grabbed my arm!"
"Their hand was colder than ice, and I was terrified."
"Then, without a word, they used their own blood to draw a mark on my wrist!"
"They said that there is a hidden location here, and only with this mark and that weapon fragment can the Giant Stone Gate be opened, and the mission started."
"After saying that, the person died..."
"So, I feel that if I’m not involved in this mission, it might not be completed."
After hearing Zhang Lianmeng’s account, Han Xing widened his eyes, "Damn, why didn’t you say so earlier?"
Han Xing’s questioning caused Zhang Lianmeng to shiver in fright, lowering her head, not daring to speak.
Realizing he was being a bit harsh, Han Xing softened his tone, "Let me see the mark on your arm."
Zhang Lianmeng obediently rolled up her sleeve, revealing her fair arm, bringing it closer to Han Xing’s face.
On the wrist, Han Xing indeed saw a blood-colored mark, resembling a symbol, or some strange script.
Han Xing nodded, and after pondering for a moment, he said, "Alright, you’ll join me in this mission, but let me be clear, all the rewards from this mission belong to me."
"And as compensation, once the mission is completed, I can escort you to your man. What do you think?"
Upon hearing this, Zhang Lianmeng couldn’t contain her joy, nodding vigorously like a pecking chick.
"Okay, okay!"
Han Xing nodded, then returned to his Sky Island Territory and slowly departed.
Seeing Zhang Lianmeng still standing there in a daze, he said, "Keep up."
Zhang Lianmeng hastily maneuvered her Sky Island Territory to follow.
Han Xing was decisive in action, and once he decided to do this mission, he immediately started.

Meanwhile, standing on the territory, he fiddled with a piece of fragment in his hand, emitting a golden hue, mumbling, "Gold Melting Cannon? Sounds like a long-range weapon, its power should not be weak."
"If I can get it, placing it on the territory could greatly enhance the attack capacity."
The two Sky Islands continued moving one after the other.
After Han Xing rescued Zhang Lianmeng, time had reached night.
However, shortly after proceeding, Zhang Lianmeng suddenly noticed her territory distancing further from Han Xing’s, her territory’s speed seemingly much slower than Han Xing’s.

This was because her Level was two levels lower than Han Xing’s, and her territory’s advancement speed was naturally slower, combined with Han Xing having a 10% speed bonus from the Lord’s Castle, which quickly left this woman behind.
"Please, please wait for me..."
From afar, Han Xing heard Zhang Lianmeng’s shouting.
Helplessly, he had to temporarily stop his Sky Island, waiting for her for a moment.
Han Xing turned back, seeing Zhang Lianmeng gritting her teeth, striving to catch up to him.
Han Xing shook his head, then adjusted the speed of his Sky Island to nearly match Zhang Lianmeng’s Sky Island.
Now, Zhang Lianmeng finally felt much more at ease.
They continued advancing for four hours.
It was now deep night.
According to Han Xing’s habit, it was time to prepare for rest.
Thus, he stopped progressing.
Behind, Zhang Lianmeng cautiously maneuvered her Sky Island Territory to merge with Han Xing’s territory.
Zhang Lianmeng asked nervously, "Why have we stopped?"
Han Xing shook his head, "It’s not early, and the coordinates on this metal fragment are quite distant. At a conservative estimate, it will take five to six hours to reach it, so we’ll rest for now."
"Traveling at night is not very safe, let’s continue tomorrow."
Hearing Han Xing’s words, Zhang Lianmeng also breathed a sigh of relief.
She indeed was exhausted.
First escaping death from that group of Kobolds, then continuously traveling for over four hours, both her spirit and body were at their limits.
At this moment, Han Xing noticed Zhang Lianmeng’s exceptionally pale complexion.
He looked at her body and saw that the wounds on her abdomen and shoulder were still oozing blood.
At this point, an odd feeling arose in Han Xing’s heart.
This woman, dragging such an injured body, had been striving to keep up with him, he had to admit it was quite impressive.
No matter how stone-hearted Han Xing was, he couldn’t help feeling a twinge of sympathy.
So, Han Xing asked, "Why aren’t you using the Life Secret Elixir to heal your wounds?"
Hearing this, Zhang Lianmeng appeared confused at first, then a bit too embarrassed to speak, "I... I don’t have any Life Secret Elixir..."

sentences.text: At this moment, Zhang Lianmeng continued, "Young man, please wait a moment."
Han Xing slowly stopped his steps, frowning, "What’s the matter now?"
Seemingly hearing the impatience in Han Xing’s tone, Zhang Lianmeng said nervously, "Well, can I join you in doing this hidden mission?"
Han Xing frowned.
Seeing this, Zhang Lianmeng quickly explained, "Don’t... don’t misunderstand, it’s not that I’m suddenly backing out, but I remembered something related to the mission..."
"What is it?
Speak." Han Xing’s tone was somewhat impatient.
Zhang Lianmeng cautiously said, "This fragment, I discovered it by chance while exploring a Sky Island."
"Inside, there was a goblin camp.
After defeating that group of goblins, I found an iron cage in the camp, and inside was a very terrifying person..."
"That person was huddled on the ground, with blood holes all over their body, yet not a drop of blood was coming out, skinnier than a bag of bones!"
As she spoke, Zhang Lianmeng seemed to recall something terrifying, her delicate body shuddering slightly, "I...
I originally wanted to save them, but as soon as I opened the iron cage, that person suddenly grabbed my arm!"
"Their hand was colder than ice, and I was terrified."
"Then, without a word, they used their own blood to draw a mark on my wrist!"
"They said that there is a hidden location here, and only with this mark and that weapon fragment can the Giant Stone Gate be opened, and the mission started."
"After saying that, the person died..."
"So, I feel that if I’m not involved in this mission, it might not be completed."
After hearing Zhang Lianmeng’s account, Han Xing widened his eyes, "Damn, why didn’t you say so earlier?"
Han Xing’s questioning caused Zhang Lianmeng to shiver in fright, lowering her head, not daring to speak.
Realizing he was being a bit harsh, Han Xing softened his tone, "Let me see the mark on your arm."
Zhang Lianmeng obediently rolled up her sleeve, revealing her fair arm, bringing it closer to Han Xing’s face.
On the wrist, Han Xing indeed saw a blood-colored mark, resembling a symbol, or some strange script.
Han Xing nodded, and after pondering for a moment, he said, "Alright, you’ll join me in this mission, but let me be clear, all the rewards from this mission belong to me."
"And as compensation, once the mission is completed, I can escort you to your man.
What do you think?"
Upon hearing this, Zhang Lianmeng couldn’t contain her joy, nodding vigorously like a pecking chick.
"Okay, okay!"
Han Xing nodded, then returned to his Sky Island Territory and slowly departed.
Seeing Zhang Lianmeng still standing there in a daze, he said, "Keep up."
Zhang Lianmeng hastily maneuvered her Sky Island Territory to follow.
Han Xing was decisive in action, and once he decided to do this mission, he immediately started.
Meanwhile, standing on the territory, he fiddled with a piece of fragment in his hand, emitting a golden hue, mumbling, "Gold Melting Cannon?
Sounds like a long-range weapon, its power should not be weak."
"If I can get it, placing it on the territory could greatly enhance the attack capacity."
The two Sky Islands continued moving one after the other.
After Han Xing rescued Zhang Lianmeng, time had reached night.
However, shortly after proceeding, Zhang Lianmeng suddenly noticed her territory distancing further from Han Xing’s, her territory’s speed seemingly much slower than Han Xing’s.

This was because her Level was two levels lower than Han Xing’s, and her territory’s advancement speed was naturally slower, combined with Han Xing having a 10% speed bonus from the Lord’s Castle, which quickly left this woman behind.
"Please, please wait for me..."
From afar, Han Xing heard Zhang Lianmeng’s shouting.
Helplessly, he had to temporarily stop his Sky Island, waiting for her for a moment.
Han Xing turned back, seeing Zhang Lianmeng gritting her teeth, striving to catch up to him.
Han Xing shook his head, then adjusted the speed of his Sky Island to nearly match Zhang Lianmeng’s Sky Island.
Now, Zhang Lianmeng finally felt much more at ease.
They continued advancing for four hours.
It was now deep night.
According to Han Xing’s habit, it was time to prepare for rest.
Thus, he stopped progressing.
Behind, Zhang Lianmeng cautiously maneuvered her Sky Island Territory to merge with Han Xing’s territory.
Zhang Lianmeng asked nervously, "Why have we stopped?"
Han Xing shook his head, "It’s not early, and the coordinates on this metal fragment are quite distant.
At a conservative estimate, it will take five to six hours to reach it, so we’ll rest for now."
"Traveling at night is not very safe, let’s continue tomorrow."
Hearing Han Xing’s words, Zhang Lianmeng also breathed a sigh of relief.
She indeed was exhausted.
First escaping death from that group of Kobolds, then continuously traveling for over four hours, both her spirit and body were at their limits.
At this moment, Han Xing noticed Zhang Lianmeng’s exceptionally pale complexion.
