I don’t have any Life Secret Elixir..."

chapters.title: Chapter 66 - 65: The Massive Floating Island
paragraphs: "None?"
Han Xing was somewhat puzzled, "Didn’t you say your man is part of the management of Divine Whisper? It’s such a big team, and he can’t even get a single bottle of Life Secret Elixir?"
Zhang Lianmeng replied, "Well, he told me that the Life Secret Elixir is a rather rare item, and he doesn’t have many bottles on hand..."

"Recently, he just reunited with his team, saying they’re about to challenge a Two-Star Secret Realm. The team members are in need of elixirs right now, and my injury is just minor. A couple of days’ rest and I’ll be fine..."
Zhang Lianmeng lowered her head, not daring to look him in the eye.
Han Xing looked at her strangely and asked, "Is your relationship with your man not good? Your fiancée is hurt and he won’t even offer a bottle of Life Secret Elixir?"
This question was sharp, seemingly piercing Zhang Lianmeng’s heart. Her delicate figure trembled slightly, making it hard for her to speak.
Han Xing observed and said, "If you don’t want to talk, you don’t have to."
Zhang Lianmeng raised her pitiful face, bitterly smiled and shook her head, "It’s not that the relationship is bad, it’s just that we’re not familiar with each other..."
"He and I... we met through relatives and friends. Altogether, we’ve only seen each other less than twice. The engagement was to fulfill family duties..."
"After that, he’s been solely focused on his career and has never sought me out. I thought to myself, we don’t know each other well yet, we should take time to understand each other."
"But not long after, we ended up in this world..."
After hearing Zhang Lianmeng’s story, Han Xing suddenly asked with an odd expression, "Is your fiancé... incapable?"
"Huh?" Zhang Lianmeng seemed not to understand the meaning behind Han Xing’s words.
"Never mind, it’s nothing." Han Xing shook his head.
After speaking, Han Xing pulled out a bottle of Life Secret Elixir and casually tossed it to her.
Zhang Lianmeng instinctively reached out to catch it.
When she saw the attributes of the elixir on the system introduction, her little mouth formed an ’O’ shape in shock.
Han Xing gestured forward, "Drink it quickly and recover. We still need to carry out tasks, and I don’t want you dragging me down due to injury."
Zhang Lianmeng tightly gripped the elixir, nodding heavily, her eyes filled with gratitude.
Being a few years older than Han Xing, Zhang Lianmeng seemed to understand his character, knowing he wasn’t one to act coy.
Thus, she drank the elixir directly in front of him.
In the next moment, she felt a warm burst of energy spreading in her stomach, causing waves of warmth throughout her body.
Especially at the site of the injury, a tingling numbness made her almost cry out.
A suppressed voice mixed with some delight emerged from her back.
Huh? What’s that sound?
Han Xing suddenly turned around, eyes wide, staring at her.
Zhang Lianmeng realized her loss of composure, hurriedly covering her mouth, yet the feeling of heat continued to rise within her.
She tried hard not to make a sound, squeezing her legs together and rubbing them while pressing her mouth with one hand and her injury with the other.
This tender, pitiful appearance made Han Xing, a passionate young man, feel his blood rush, and his mouth went dry and tongue thick.
Han Xing quickly turned his head, coughing twice.
"Cough, cough, recover and rest early, we need to start traveling early tomorrow."
Zhang Lianmeng struggled to control her voice, but she didn’t realize that the more she suppressed it, the stranger it sounded.
Han Xing quickly fled into his castle.
Behind him.
After some restraint, Zhang Lianmeng finally felt the restorative effect of the Life Secret Elixir ending.
She slowly exhaled, sitting on the ground drenched in sweat, her tight magic robe soaked, even revealing her magnificent outline, her snow-white skin faintly visible.
At this moment, Zhang Lianmeng looked at the grand castle in Han Xing’s domain, wiped the sweat from her forehead, and blinked in curiosity.
But she didn’t ask more, returning obediently to her own domain.
In the center of Zhang Lianmeng’s domain, there was a simple tent made from sticks and fabric, where she usually rested.
Night deepened.
Zhang Lianmeng lay down on a grass mat and fell asleep, though she seemed to dream of a man’s figure.
Early the next day.
Zhang Lianmeng heard someone outside the tent calling her.
She poked her head out to see Han Xing sitting on a rock nearby, quietly waiting.
Since their territories had merged, Han Xing could freely visit her domain.
Blushing, Zhang Lianmeng seemed embarrassed by being seen waking up by a man.
However, Han Xing asked seriously, "Yesterday you mentioned your man is going to challenge a Two-Star Secret Realm soon?"
Waking up in the morning, Han Xing suddenly remembered the woman said last night that the Divine Whisper Team was preparing to challenge a Two-Star Secret Realm, catching Han Xing’s attention.
Even he had struggled through a One-Star Secret Realm.
Could the top tier of the Divine Whisper Team have reached such a level?
But he thought about it and decided it was unlikely.
One-Star Secret Realms already have high difficulty; Two-Star Secret Realms would be exceedingly difficult. At this stage, few teams could conquer them.
Even if attempted, they would likely face considerable casualties.
Hence, he approached the woman and said, "Friendly reminder, if you want to see your man again, tell him not to attempt the Two-Star Secret Realm."
"Huh? Why?" Zhang Lianmeng seemed quite puzzled.
"Because they’ll die." Han Xing said succinctly.
Upon hearing this, Zhang Lianmeng’s face immediately turned pale. She didn’t doubt the man before her; his powerful abilities had already proven the point.
He wouldn’t lie about such matters.
Zhang Lianmeng hurriedly sent a message to her fiancé.
A moment later, Han Xing noticed her face became extremely grim.
"What did he say?"

Zhang Lianmeng hesitated, stammering, "He... he said what does a woman like me know? The strength of the Divine Whisper Team is very strong, they won’t fail the challenge, and told me not to bother him these days."
Saying this, Zhang Lianmeng seemed immensely aggrieved, growing even more disappointed with her unknown fiancé.
Han Xing spread his hands, "Good intentions can’t persuade stubborn ghosts."
He only casually mentioned it, offering a kind reminder, whether they wanted to listen was up to them.
Zhang Lianmeng didn’t know what else to do.
Han Xing shook his head, "Since he doesn’t want to listen, let’s not bother. Get ready, we need to move on."
"Hope he survives..."
Zhang Lianmeng hesitated, sighed, and seemed lost in thought.
After waking the woman, Han Xing returned to his domain to continue heading to the destination.
Six hours later, the two traveled over 600 kilometers, continuously avoiding large clouds without pausing.
Finally, in the afternoon, they arrived at their destination.
A colossal floating island appeared before them.
This Sky Island was a true island, as large as a mountain.
It wasn’t obscured by clouds, allowing a clear view inside.
It was covered with flowers, trees, and various plants.
Occasionally, bird flocks flew out from the forest.
This was Han Xing’s first time seeing such a strange Sky Island; it seemed like a world from a fairy tale.
This place didn’t seem to be a monster’s domain, as even when Han Xing approached, there was no system warning.
Han Xing, puzzled, controlled his domain to approach, then fixed the island’s position, leading Zhang Lianmeng into the forest.
Just upon landing, Han Xing felt the ground was soft, likely due to years of fallen leaves. Walking on it produced a rustling sound.

chapters.title: Chapter 67 - 66: The Giant Stone Gate Slowly Opens...
paragraphs: After stepping into the mountain forest, Han Xing observed the nearby terrain.
He turned around and asked with confusion, "Is this mountain forest our destination?"
Zhang Lianmeng quickly shook her head, "I, I don’t know either..."
Han Xing nodded and didn’t say more, but continued to lead Zhang Lianmeng deeper into the forest.
Whether it is or not, only exploration will tell.
Moreover, he was indeed quite curious about this Sky Island.
However, as Han Xing advanced, his gaze occasionally glanced back.
A black shadow flashed instantly through the territory, then jumped onto a branch.
This black shadow was, of course, Coal Ball.
Ever since coming into contact with Zhang Lianmeng, in order not to expose Coal Ball’s existence, Han Xing had kept Coal Ball hidden in the castle.
This time, upon reaching the mission location, to prevent any unexpected events, Han Xing had Coal Ball follow at a distance.
The two walked for about five minutes, nearly deep into the forest.
Ahead, a long-abandoned path suddenly appeared.
Because it hadn’t been walked on for many years, weeds and vines grew along the road.
But the direction of the path was still barely recognizable.
Han Xing stepped onto the path first, and Zhang Lianmeng followed closely and fearfully behind him.
Since entering the forest, Zhang Lianmeng had been somewhat tense, breathing heavier than usual.
Beyond nervousness, there was also a hint of curiosity in her eyes.
After coming to this world, she had never seen such a massive Sky Island, always staying within her own territory.
Usually, when she saw some cloud-covered Sky Islands, she would carefully triple-check before engaging in any battles.
Yet even so, there were still a few times she encountered enemies she couldn’t defeat.
If there are monsters in this forest...
Zhang Lianmeng trembled lightly at the thought, seemingly unwilling to imagine further.
At this moment, she could only stick closely to the man in front, afraid he might leave her behind.
However, Han Xing had no such idea; he just wanted to find the mission site quickly.
Then, Han Xing suddenly stopped.
Zhang Lianmeng, unable to stop in time, bumped into Han Xing’s back.
A soft sensation from behind surprised Han Xing, who turned to look in wonder.
He saw Zhang Lianmeng with a flushed face, looking at the ground.
Han Xing knew what had happened, but didn’t care; he looked ahead, lost in thought.
"Do you think we should go left or right?" Han Xing asked.
Zhang Lianmeng seemed to just come back to her senses, "Huh? What?"
"I said, left or right."
She glanced at the fork in the road ahead, realizing that the path had indeed split into a crossroads.
One path led to the left, the other to the right.
Zhang Lianmeng blinked her beautiful eyes and tentatively said, "Why don’t we check out the right side?"
"Alright." Han Xing agreed decisively.
He took strides, leading the way down the right path.
After winding through the woods for another dozen minutes, a clearing finally appeared before them.
At the clearing’s edge stood dense trees.
Nothing else was there.
Han Xing thought for a moment, shook his head, and said, "It seems we took the wrong way."
Zhang Lianmeng quickly apologized, "Sorry, sorry, I shouldn’t have suggested going right..."
Han Xing glanced at her, a bit annoyed, saying, "What’s it to you? It was my decision to come this way; you just gave a suggestion."
"Besides, we only took a wrong turn; we’ll just go back and head left, no big deal."
After hearing this, Zhang Lianmeng softly uttered an "mm" and felt a hint of gratitude toward Han Xing.
Just as Han Xing was about to turn back, he suddenly noticed something different in the clearing ahead.
Upon closer inspection, it was actually a pond.
The surface was covered with fallen leaves; if not looked at closely, it was hard to discern.
At the same time, information about the pond appeared before Han Xing.
[Spiritual Spring Water: A type of pure drinking water, seemingly infused with a life aura, capable of slowly healing wounds when consumed.]
"What the...? It’s Spiritual Spring Water!"
Han Xing was surprised because the last time he encountered Spiritual Spring Water was at the Dark Elf Camp.
That time, he harvested over 1500 liters, allowing him to trade for a wealth of resources.
That very batch of Spiritual Spring Water was what led him to wealth and prosperity.
But how much Spiritual Spring Water was in this pond?
It was unimaginable.
As long as he controlled this location, he would never run out of Spiritual Spring Water, he could even bathe in it.

Looking at the pool of Spiritual Spring Water, Han Xing murmured in thought, "The main ingredient needed to make Life Secret Elixir is Spiritual Spring Water. Last time, trading stopped because the materials ran out, and many Survivors didn’t get a chance to exchange."
"Currently, there is likely a significant demand for recovery items in District 107, so Life Secret Elixirs could be sold again for profit."
With this thought, Han Xing decided to take a batch of Spiritual Spring Water first.
However, he glanced at his backpack, which had less than 5 slots left.
This was after clearing many Life Secret Elixirs and Wild Bear Power Secret Elixirs; otherwise, space would have been tighter.
No way around it; after all, the Elite Level Spiritual Puppet alone took up 10 slots.
With the remaining storage, he could only carry away about 50 liters of water at most.
But that didn’t matter; Han Xing could make a few more Space Backpacks on the spot.
While each Survivor could only equip two Space Backpacks...
There was another person here, after all.

At the same time, information about the pond appeared before Han Xing.
[Spiritual Spring Water: A type of pure drinking water, seemingly infused with a life aura, capable of slowly healing wounds when consumed.]
"What the...?
It’s Spiritual Spring Water!"
Han Xing was surprised because the last time he encountered Spiritual Spring Water was at the Dark Elf Camp.
That time, he harvested over 1500 liters, allowing him to trade for a wealth of resources.
That very batch of Spiritual Spring Water was what led him to wealth and prosperity.
But how much Spiritual Spring Water was in this pond?
It was unimaginable.
As long as he controlled this location, he would never run out of Spiritual Spring Water, he could even bathe in it.
Looking at the pool of Spiritual Spring Water, Han Xing murmured in thought, "The main ingredient needed to make Life Secret Elixir is Spiritual Spring Water.
Last time, trading stopped because the materials ran out, and many Survivors didn’t get a chance to exchange."
"Currently, there is likely a significant demand for recovery items in District 107, so Life Secret Elixirs could be sold again for profit."
With this thought, Han Xing decided to take a batch of Spiritual Spring Water first.
However, he glanced at his backpack, which had less than 5 slots left.
This was after clearing many Life Secret Elixirs and Wild Bear Power Secret Elixirs; otherwise, space would have been tighter.
No way around it; after all, the Elite Level Spiritual Puppet alone took up 10 slots.
With the remaining storage, he could only carry away about 50 liters of water at most.
But that didn’t matter; Han Xing could make a few more Space Backpacks on the spot.
While each Survivor could only equip two Space Backpacks...
There was another person here, after all.

chapters.title: Chapter 68 - 66: The Giant Stone Gate Slowly Opens...
paragraphs: Han Xing looked at Zhang Lianmeng and asked, "Do you have any storage space tools on you?"
Zhang Lianmeng seemed to hear about storage space tools for the first time and shook her head blankly.
Then, Han Xing made two Space Backpacks on the spot, one added 4 points of Spirit, the other added 4 points of agility, and casually threw them to her.
Upon seeing the item attributes of the two Space Backpacks in her hand.
Her eyes first showed a look of confusion, then her mouth opened into an O shape in surprise.
"This... this..."
Zhang Lianmeng stammered, "Is this a Space Backpack?"
Han Xing rolled his eyes at her, "Isn’t the item information clearly written? A storage backpack with 30 slots, it can hold quite a lot of stuff."
"Come here, first fill 50 slots with this pond of Spiritual Spring Water for me, I need it."
"Huh? Oh, okay!" Zhang Lianmeng obediently walked over.
Then, following Han Xing’s instructions, she began to collect the Spiritual Spring Water from the pond.
slots, which means 500 liters, enough to make 5,000 bottles of Life Secret Elixir and make a big profit in the trading market again.
After collecting the Spiritual Spring Water, Zhang Lianmeng tentatively asked, "Is this... enough?"
"Of course not, but our space is limited, so we can only take this much for now. We’ll come back for more next time."
"Oh! Okay." Zhang Lianmeng replied obediently.
Han Xing nodded.
At this moment, he couldn’t help but think.
A mature woman is truly understanding, doing whatever she’s asked without questioning why.
Then, Han Xing led Zhang Lianmeng back to the fork in the road.
This time, they chose the left path.
The left path was winding and difficult to navigate.
Han Xing cleared away various thorns and obstacles along the way one by one.
From afar, the Coal Ball still hung behind him, ready to appear whenever Han Xing needed it.
After about half an hour, Han Xing realized they seemed to have reached their destination.
They appeared to be in a valley, surrounded by jagged rocks.
The stones here were large, with a black boulder every few meters.
Han Xing asked at this time, "When you were doing the first quest, what did it say to open what gate?"
Zhang Lianmeng thought for a moment, then replied, "Uh, I think it’s called the Giant Stone Gate."
"Giant Stone Gate, Giant Stone..."
Han Xing’s eyes showed a thoughtful look.
"Could it be that behind these stones, there’s something more?"
Then, he began searching the valley.
But in this valley, there were giant stones one or two meters high everywhere, making it hard to tell which was the key clue.
Seeing Han Xing in thought, Zhang Lianmeng seemed to know what his dilemma was.
Although her brain wasn’t very sharp, she was capable of taking action.
So Zhang Lianmeng started using her own method, touching each stone one by one.
Han Xing didn’t say much.
Everyone has their own way of taking action, and he also appreciated women with such insight.
Knowing her strengths, but not being just a vase, she tried to make a contribution in her own way.
About ten minutes later.
Zhang Lianmeng suddenly touched a black boulder, and the whole valley shook for a moment.
"Hmm?" Noticing the commotion from her side, Han Xing immediately walked over.
The surface of the stone was extremely smooth, and in the center, there seemed to be a one-centimeter-deep groove.
At the same time, a system prompt appeared in front of them.
[Giant Stone Gate: It appears that someone has put a restriction on this stone, requiring the combination of Gold Melting Cannon Fragment and Blood Mark to unlock it.]
The two exchanged a glance.
Han Xing took out the Metal Fragment from his backpack.
Zhang Lianmeng also rolled up her sleeve, revealing a blood-colored mark.
Placing the Metal Fragment into the groove on the stone, in the next moment, a red glow suddenly appeared in the center of the stone.
Han Xing glanced at Zhang Lianmeng, conveying his meaning, and she aligned the mark on her wrist with the red ray.
This seemed to be some kind of identity verification device.
After verifying Zhang Lianmeng’s wrist mark, the red light suddenly turned green.
The next moment, the valley began to shake violently.
To be precise, it was the stone in front of Han Xing that was trembling.
The system prompt appeared.
[The Giant Stone Gate is slowly opening...]
Rumble!
After the trembling ended, the stone before them moved aside.
A two-meter-high entrance appeared before Han Xing, revealing a deep passage inside.
Inside the passage, it was pitch black, with not a single ray of light.
Just looking at it gave off a terrifying atmosphere.
However, this was not a problem for Han Xing.
He took out a Dark Fire Stone Torch from his backpack.
With a light flick, the Dark Fire Stone began to emit a bright red light, immediately dispelling the darkness at the entrance.
Seeing Zhang Lianmeng’s frightened look, Han Xing said, "If you’re scared, you don’t have to go in. After all, the door is open, and your quest is completed."
After speaking, without waiting for Zhang Lianmeng to respond, Han Xing took the lead and stepped into the passage.
Behind him, Zhang Lianmeng became a bit tense upon seeing Han Xing’s figure disappear.
She looked around blankly, suddenly realizing, what if she encountered monsters after that man entered the cavern?
A huge fear surged up inside her.
Thinking of this, Zhang Lianmeng gathered her courage and walked in, shaking slightly.
This dark tunnel seemed unexpectedly long.
Han Xing walked for about two minutes and still hadn’t reached the end.
At this point, he heard some strange noises and footsteps behind him and asked promptly, "Who?"
A familiar female voice echoed from the back, "It’s... it’s me..."
Han Xing stopped walking and, using the glow from the Dark Fire Stone, saw Zhang Lianmeng behind him.
She seemed very scared, hugging her arms tightly, her body trembling uncontrollably.
"Why did you come in?"
Zhang Lianmeng looked down, reluctant to speak, and said, "I don’t know either."
"I just feel like, compared to the darkness inside here, I’m more afraid you might leave me behind..."
For a moment, Han Xing was stunned.
Does this woman even realize what she just said?
Do you know how powerful a statement like that is to a guy?
Damn, using this method to test a guy who’s never even been in love?
Han Xing gave her a deep look.
Then, he took out another Dark Fire Stone Torch from his backpack and tossed it to Zhang Lianmeng.
Zhang Lianmeng instinctively caught it, her body shaking.
This woman, who knows if it’s intentional or not, didn’t even change to a new Magic Robe after it got damaged yesterday in battle, and her fair skin was still visible through the damaged parts.
Coupled with this deep forest and pitch-dark cave interior, it’s hard not to let one’s mind wander.
Han Xing quickly shifted his gaze, silently recited the Heart Clarity Spell, and then looked forward again.
After a few more minutes of progress, they finally seemed to have reached the end of the passage.
They emerged into a wide-open area that looked like a cavern, with a lot of space inside.
However, just like before, it was equally dark, with no light at all.
As soon as they entered, Han Xing smelled a peculiar scent, like the kind of smell that comes from rotting animals.
But because the air in the cavern didn’t circulate, the smell lingered over a long period.
Zhang Lianmeng also caught a whiff of this scent.
But she was still in a state of high alert, unable to think about anything else.
At that moment, she unexpectedly kicked something.
Holding the Dark Fire Stone Torch, Zhang Lianmeng looked down.
A near-decayed humanoid skeleton came into view.
That glance instantly drained the color from her face in fright.
Originally about to scream, she hurriedly covered her mouth, trying her best not to make a sound.
After a while, her fear subsided.
Zhang Lianmeng quivering, spoke, "There... there’s something here!"
Han Xing could hear the immense fear in her tone.
Quickly, he turned to take a look.
Han Xing saw the skeletal remains on the ground at once, but it seemed a bit unusual compared to a regular skeleton.
It was smaller in size, resembling a young human child, and seemed to have died not too long ago.
In the darkness of the cave, to find a fresh corpse was indeed quite eerie...

chapters.title: Chapter 69 - 67: Bounty Mission: The Butcher of the City
paragraphs: Han Xing observed the corpse on the ground and came to a conclusion.
This is likely not a child’s corpse, but rather another race of this world, the Dwarf Race.
"Dwarves?"
Han Xing’s tone was somewhat puzzled.
Beside him, Zhang Lianmeng looked at him with curious eyes.
Han Xing did not explain, but continued to inspect the surrounding ground.
Upon looking, he gasped in shock.

The cave floor was littered with bones of various beasts and humanoid creatures, each with distinct features: some had horns on their foreheads, others had wings on their backs, with skeletons ranging in height from two to three meters to one to two meters.
There was no doubt, these corpses were special beings of this world.
Among them, Han Xing also saw a few corpses that hadn’t been dead for long; their death looked eerie, the surface skin intact, without a trace of blood.
However, their flesh seemed drained, leaving only a thin human skin covering the skeleton.
Han Xing turned around and asked, "Is the person you found last time at the goblin camp in this state?"
Zhang Lianmeng nodded like a pecking chick; though she was still very scared, for some reason, Han Xing’s presence gave her a faint sense of security.
Han Xing clearly felt something eerie about this cave.
Moreover, up to this point, there was neither the next clue for the hidden quest nor any trace of ancient weapons.
Han Xing continued searching the cave.
Half an hour later, they had wandered almost a full circle inside, finding nothing except the skeletons of hundreds of corpses.
However, he did gather some information about the cave’s large area size.
Conservatively estimated, the diameter was over two kilometers.
Just then, Zhang Lianmeng suddenly pointed ahead, saying, "There seems to be something drawn on the wall."
"Hmm?"
Han Xing immediately looked in the direction she pointed, indeed seeing patterns resembling graffiti.
Upon closer inspection, Han Xing found the style of these patterns inclined towards realism, resembling frescoes.
Han Xing approached the beginning of the frescoes, where an Elf Man was depicted, with pointed ears and slender limbs.
He sat on high branches, smiling as he gazed down at a village below.
In the second fresco, the style abruptly changed, as if this Elf Man was being bullied by several other Elf Race people, depicted being stomped on and beaten.
In the third fresco, the Elf Man retreated to his small room, silently shedding tears, with a terrifying middle-aged elf standing by the bed, gazing at him with a sinister smile.
Especially the piercing eyes of that middle-aged elf, drawn extremely vividly, making Han Xing feel a chilling sense of eeriness from the fresco.
The fifth, sixth, and even dozens of subsequent frescoes depicted the bullying of the young Elf.
From youth to young adulthood, the Elf Man persistently suffered from other elves’ harassment, his demeanor becoming increasingly gloomy.
Strangely, each image included a terrifying middle-aged man lurking in the shadows, watching silently.
Until the thirtieth fresco, the Elf Man knelt by his bed, where lay the middle-aged elf often seen in the images.
Observing the dying middle-aged elf, the Elf Man felt no sadness, but rather a sense of relief.
Yet even after this elf’s death, his situation did not improve.
He continued to endure insults and beatings from other elves.
What was more terrifying was that the Elf still felt those dreadful eyes watching him.
Wasn’t that guy already dead?
He wondered.
Until the fifty-third fresco, a gentle-smiling elf maiden appeared, like a ray of light piercing the darkness, illuminating the Elf Man’s life.
She became his friend briefly for two days, then swiftly departed.
Whenever the Elf Man felt he couldn’t hold on, he would recall the maiden’s smile, unconsciously producing a similar smile.
However, seeing the elf maiden again, she was walking next to an elf who frequently bullied him, breaking the Elf Man’s hard-built psychological defense.
He ran to confront the elf maiden, but was met with mockery and assault.
Covered in blood, the Elf Man lay on the ground, vaguely seeing the middle-aged man’s Black Shadow appear again, whispering in his ear.
Driven mad, the Elf Man returned to his room, drawing a mysterious array before slicing his wrist, letting the blood flow freely.
In the array appeared a terrifying figure’s phantom, to which the Elf Man in his dying moments bowed respectfully, gaining immense power.
The Elf Man, grinning from ear to ear, went to find the maiden, thinking his newfound power would earn her recognition.
However, upon seeing him, the maiden backed away in fright, her gaze akin to seeing a monster.
Only then did the Elf Man see his current appearance.
His deep brown hair started shedding in clumps, followed by his eyebrows, falling off at a mere touch, until even his body hair was gone, leaving none.
He stood bare, receiving strange glances from those around him.
Yet, the transformation was far from over.
With his hair gone, his nails also fell off, replaced by sharp claws, while his nose swelled like a Gululu Beast’s.
Moreover, his arms melded with his body, sprouting large flesh wings.
At this moment, he transformed from a noble elf into a grotesque monstrous bird.
The Elf Race quickly summoned guards to hunt down this monster.
When a sharp spear pierced his chest, the elite elf man widened his eyes, and the fear of death instinctively made him flap his flesh wings.
It was then that he discovered, unbelievably, that he had taken flight.
The elf man began to fly wildly, his eyes filled with hatred and fury.
He rushed to a secret place in the center of the town and carried out a giant golden cannon, starting a frenzied bombardment on the town.
Countless elves perished under his cannon fire, and the town turned into a sea of flames.
After doing all this, the elf man turned and fled.
And he was naturally wanted by the Elf Race.
In the desperate escape, at a loss, the elf man found an ancient array.
And the place the array led to was called the Land of the Abandoned Gods.
That place seemed to instill fear in the monstrous bird.
However, to survive, he eventually activated the teleportation array.
The final scene shows the elf man finding a floating Sky Island and vanishing into the woodland.
But he didn’t notice that another black shadow seemed to have followed him to this island.
After reading this, Han Xing seemed to understand something, a sense of unease rising in his heart.
He said in a serious tone, "It looks like... there’s a problem."
Zhang Lianmeng’s expression was tense, her body trembling slightly, "What’s the problem?"
Han Xing furrowed his brows, "Until now, we haven’t found any clues about the hidden task."
"Speaking of which, when I touched that metal fragment, the system also didn’t mention anything about a hidden task, it just said that the metal fragment can be used to open the Giant Stone Gate."
"In other words, what the NPC told you might be false, we’ve been deceived!"
"What?" Zhang Lianmeng shuddered, her face full of disbelief.
Just then, a pair of blood-red eyes suddenly appeared deep in the dark cave.
From behind, occasionally came the terrifying sound of wind.
Han Xing immediately sensed something was wrong and hurriedly said, "There’s a monster, run!"
But by now, it was too late.
A terrifying monster, accompanied by the howling wind, rapidly attacked from behind.
Han Xing quickly drew his Legendary Quality Moon Crown Longbow, instantly entering combat state.
However, at that moment, a fierce hurricane came head-on.
Whoosh—
Han Xing and Zhang Lianmeng were swept backward by this gust of wind, flying over ten meters away.
The Dark Fire Stone Torch slipped from his hand.
By the fiery glow, Han Xing finally saw the creature that attacked them.
It was a terrifying monstrous bird with a body over two meters tall, boasting a pair of massive flesh wings, entirely hairless.
It looked exactly like the creature depicted on the mural.
Just then, a system notification appeared.
[You have found the hideout of the Elf Race traitor Jiale. The bounty mission "City Annihilator" is automatically triggered, and you can choose how to complete the task.]
[Option 1: Kill the monstrous bird Jiale, bring its head to the Elf Royal Capital to claim the bounty.]
[Option 2: Go to the Elf Royal Capital, inform the Elf Race Guard of Jiale’s hideout, and assist them in capturing Jiale.]
Please note: Since you are in the "Land of the Abandoned Gods," the "Elf Royal Capital" map is not yet open, and the task cannot be completed at this time.
"Damn, so this is the real hidden task!"
Han Xing swiftly turned, meeting the bloodthirsty eyes of the monster.
Without thinking, he immediately shot out a Wind Chasing Arrow.
Ding!
Seeing the arrow coming, the monstrous bird flapped its flesh wings, a hurricane rose, blowing the arrow aside.
This arrow had no effect, and Han Xing’s heart sank.
Just then, he finally saw the monster’s attributes.
[Monstrous Bird Jiale (One-Star Leader-level Creature)]
[Level: lv10]
[Attributes]: Power 94, Agility 132, Spirit 105 (-30), Constitution 76 (-30).
[Skills]: Wind of Wailing, Flesh Wings Protection, Giant Claw Bite, Shadow Assault, Furious Wind Dance.
"It’s actually a level 10 Leader-level creature!"
Han Xing’s face changed dramatically!

However, seeing the elf maiden again, she was walking next to an elf who frequently bullied him, breaking the Elf Man’s hard-built psychological defense.
He ran to confront the elf maiden, but was met with mockery and assault.
Covered in blood, the Elf Man lay on the ground, vaguely seeing the middle-aged man’s Black Shadow appear again, whispering in his ear.
Driven mad, the Elf Man returned to his room, drawing a mysterious array before slicing his wrist, letting the blood flow freely.
In the array appeared a terrifying figure’s phantom, to which the Elf Man in his dying moments bowed respectfully, gaining immense power.
The Elf Man, grinning from ear to ear, went to find the maiden, thinking his newfound power would earn her recognition.
However, upon seeing him, the maiden backed away in fright, her gaze akin to seeing a monster.
Only then did the Elf Man see his current appearance.
His deep brown hair started shedding in clumps, followed by his eyebrows, falling off at a mere touch, until even his body hair was gone, leaving none.
He stood bare, receiving strange glances from those around him.
Yet, the transformation was far from over.
With his hair gone, his nails also fell off, replaced by sharp claws, while his nose swelled like a Gululu Beast’s.
Moreover, his arms melded with his body, sprouting large flesh wings.
At this moment, he transformed from a noble elf into a grotesque monstrous bird.
The Elf Race quickly summoned guards to hunt down this monster.
When a sharp spear pierced his chest, the elite elf man widened his eyes, and the fear of death instinctively made him flap his flesh wings.
It was then that he discovered, unbelievably, that he had taken flight.
The elf man began to fly wildly, his eyes filled with hatred and fury.
He rushed to a secret place in the center of the town and carried out a giant golden cannon, starting a frenzied bombardment on the town.
Countless elves perished under his cannon fire, and the town turned into a sea of flames.
After doing all this, the elf man turned and fled.
And he was naturally wanted by the Elf Race.
In the desperate escape, at a loss, the elf man found an ancient array.
And the place the array led to was called the Land of the Abandoned Gods.
That place seemed to instill fear in the monstrous bird.
However, to survive, he eventually activated the teleportation array.
The final scene shows the elf man finding a floating Sky Island and vanishing into the woodland.
But he didn’t notice that another black shadow seemed to have followed him to this island.
After reading this, Han Xing seemed to understand something, a sense of unease rising in his heart.
He said in a serious tone, "It looks like... there’s a problem."
Zhang Lianmeng’s expression was tense, her body trembling slightly, "What’s the problem?"
Han Xing furrowed his brows, "Until now, we haven’t found any clues about the hidden task."
"Speaking of which, when I touched that metal fragment, the system also didn’t mention anything about a hidden task, it just said that the metal fragment can be used to open the Giant Stone Gate."
"In other words, what the NPC told you might be false, we’ve been deceived!"
"What?" Zhang Lianmeng shuddered, her face full of disbelief.
Just then, a pair of blood-red eyes suddenly appeared deep in the dark cave.
From behind, occasionally came the terrifying sound of wind.
Han Xing immediately sensed something was wrong and hurriedly said, "There’s a monster, run!"
But by now, it was too late.
A terrifying monster, accompanied by the howling wind, rapidly attacked from behind.
Han Xing quickly drew his Legendary Quality Moon Crown Longbow, instantly entering combat state.
However, at that moment, a fierce hurricane came head-on.
Whoosh—
Han Xing and Zhang Lianmeng were swept backward by this gust of wind, flying over ten meters away.
The Dark Fire Stone Torch slipped from his hand.
By the fiery glow, Han Xing finally saw the creature that attacked them.
It was a terrifying monstrous bird with a body over two meters tall, boasting a pair of massive flesh wings, entirely hairless.
It looked exactly like the creature depicted on the mural.
Just then, a system notification appeared.
[You have found the hideout of the Elf Race traitor Jiale.
The bounty mission "City Annihilator" is automatically triggered, and you can choose how to complete the task.]
[Option 1: Kill the monstrous bird Jiale, bring its head to the Elf Royal Capital to claim the bounty.]
[Option 2: Go to the Elf Royal Capital, inform the Elf Race Guard of Jiale’s hideout, and assist them in capturing Jiale.]
Please note: Since you are in the "Land of the Abandoned Gods," the "Elf Royal Capital" map is not yet open, and the task cannot be completed at this time.
"Damn, so this is the real hidden task!"
Han Xing swiftly turned, meeting the bloodthirsty eyes of the monster.
Without thinking, he immediately shot out a Wind Chasing Arrow.
Ding!
Seeing the arrow coming, the monstrous bird flapped its flesh wings, a hurricane rose, blowing the arrow aside.
This arrow had no effect, and Han Xing’s heart sank.
Just then, he finally saw the monster’s attributes.
[Monstrous Bird Jiale (One-Star Leader-level Creature)]
[Level: lv10]
[Attributes]: Power 94, Agility 132, Spirit 105 (-30), Constitution 76 (-30).
[Skills]: Wind of Wailing, Flesh Wings Protection, Giant Claw Bite, Shadow Assault, Furious Wind Dance.
"It’s actually a level 10 Leader-level creature!"
Han Xing’s face changed dramatically!

chapters.title: Chapter 70 - 68: Leader Level Monster Appears
paragraphs: Han Xing gritted his teeth and cursed, "Damn it, this mission was a trap from the start!"
"That metal fragment, it was deliberately dropped by this monster bird, using this method to lure many people in!"
"Those corpses on the ground, all unlucky ones fooled by the monster bird."
Beside him, Zhang Lianmeng’s face turned ashen with fear after hearing this, even having trouble holding onto her magic staff.
With a trembling voice she said, "I...I’m sorry, I didn’t know this mission was a trap!"
"I...I’m sorry...sob sob sob..."
Han Xing was just about to speak.
The next moment, the monster bird’s captivating red eyes had already locked onto him.
A terrifying figure lunged towards him swiftly.
The monster bird leader activated the skill, Shadow Assault.
At the same time.
Han Xing immediately crouched, downed a bottle of Wild Bear Power Secret Elixir, and then without hesitation unleashed his strongest burst skill.
Multiple Arrows!
Thud thud thud!
The arrows were fired continuously.
This attack simultaneously triggered several special effects.
Moonlight Flow, Barbarian Power, Armor-piercing Arrow.
Under multiple blessings, the attack power of this arrow unleashed by Han Xing had reached a formidable level.
Thud! Thud thud!
Among them, three arrows accurately hit the charging monster bird, piercing deeply into its skin.
With a hoarse cry, the monster bird’s sprinting figure halted and then suddenly crashed to the ground.
The monster bird seemed surprised that this seemingly weak human race could actually injure it.
Even Zhang Lianmeng beside him stared at him in shock.
This was a level 10 leader-level creature, ordinary level 6 survivors couldn’t even breach its defense!
In her heart, Han Xing’s formidable attack power once again refreshed her understanding.
But just at this moment, the monster bird activated another skill, ’Wind of Wailing.’
A mighty hurricane came barreling forth, carrying pebbles, blowing both Han Xing and Zhang Lianmeng far away.
The two fell heavily to the ground, their bodies carved with numerous bloody marks by the pebbles.
At this moment, the magic robe on Zhang Lianmeng was torn into strips by the howling attack, exposing large areas of snow-white skin, the scene becoming somewhat suggestive.
However, Han Xing didn’t have the mood to look at these things.
The hurricane stirred by the monster bird had blown several bloody holes in his body.
At this moment he suddenly tasted something sweet in his throat, and a mouthful of fresh blood surged out.
"Damn, is this a leader-level monster? Its attack power is terrifying..."
Han Xing said while wiping the blood from the corner of his mouth.
He seemed unable to contend with the monster before him, the situation had reached an unfavorable point for them.
Seeing his state, Zhang Lianmeng seemed to make some kind of decision.
She gripped the magic staff tightly in her hand, standing in front of Han Xing.
"What are you doing?" Han Xing asked with a face full of confusion.

Zhang Lianmeng gritted her teeth, seemed to muster all her strength, and said courageously, "I’m sorry, it was my fault you came here, I... though I’m very weak, I should be able to hold this monster for a while, you... you should go first!"
Her voice was weak yet held a hint of firmness.
At this moment the monster bird had once again rushed over, but seemed a bit apprehensive of Han Xing’s attack power, not attacking immediately.
Instead it chose to hover nearby, seemingly searching for an appropriate angle to attack.
"Gah! Gah!"
The ear-piercing monster cries kept echoing.
Han Xing froze for a moment, then suddenly asked, "You want to hold this monster? How?"
Zhang Lianmeng’s face was pale, she shook her head, "I, I don’t know..."
Han Xing chuckled, "Seems possible, this monster bird likes sucking blood, with so much flesh on you, there should be plenty of blood for it to suck for a while."
Zhang Lianmeng knew Han Xing was teasing her upon hearing this.
She gritted her teeth and softly retorted, "I... I’m not fat! I’m not even 120 pounds, I just look a bit fleshy..."
Han Xing shook his head, not intending to tease her further, and said, "Alright, come back here, it’s just a level 10 leader monster, no need to risk life and death over it."
Zhang Lianmeng stared at him in confusion, just then, the monster bird rushed over once more.
Han Xing pulled Zhang Lianmeng behind him, looking at the monster bird coldly and said, "Ugly thing, today, let me show you my true power!"
Zhang Lianmeng looked doubtful, thinking Han Xing was about to unleash some big move.
Suddenly, Han Xing shouted, "Coal Ball! Save me!"
Zhang Lianmeng was filled with question marks.
However, just as Han Xing’s words fell.
A black shadow sped through the passage behind him.
With speed surpassing the monster bird, it instantly appeared above its bald head.
Coal Ball extended its wolf claws, cold light flashed in the dim cavern.
Swish! Swish swish!
The next moment, the monster bird cried out miserably, new blood marks appearing on its body.
And this, was only the beginning.

Coal Ball once again exhibited its mighty mobility shown during the battle with the elite puppet, in the blink of an eye, before the monster bird could react, it had carved a dozen or so wounds on its body.
The defense reduction state instantly stacked to full.
The monster bird was enraged to the extreme, howling at the sky, beginning to madly flap its fleshy wings, attempting to attack Coal Ball.
However, with Coal Ball’s terrifying evasion rate and speed, even a Level 10 leader couldn’t harm it.
It barely dodged or avoided, brazenly facing the attacks of the monster bird and continuously inflicting damage on it.
This form is Coal Ball’s true combat power. Just after leveling up, it could contend with spiritual puppets with leader-level power, and completely suppress them.
As for this monster bird, in terms of threat level, it wasn’t even as dangerous as an elite-level spiritual puppet.
Its constitution and spirit attributes seemed to be affected by some negative state, dropping significantly.
Its flesh body was incredibly weak, with none of the defense power of a lord-level creature.
Its only advantages were agility and power, but even these were suppressed by Coal Ball.
At this moment, Zhang Lianmeng couldn’t see the battle in the darkness clearly, only vaguely noticing what seemed to be a black shadow maniacally attacking the monster bird.
And it looked as if the monster bird was on the losing side?
The monster bird kept shrieking miserably.
She was completely bewildered, unsure of what that black shadow was, but presumed it must have something to do with Han Xing.
This man had taken on a few more layers of mystery and power in her mind.
At that moment, the monster bird’s attacks not only failed to so much as touch a feather of Coal Ball, but its body was also covered in dozens of claw marks.
The monster bird felt utterly exasperated at this moment.
It took a deep breath, its skeletal chest slowly swelling, as if brewing some sort of powerful move.
At this moment, Han Xing suddenly remembered the monster bird’s fifth skill.
Furious Wind Dance.
It seemed to be a range damage burst move.
Han Xing then said with a serious expression, "Damn, using a big move in front of me, are you completely ignoring me?"
The monster bird heard the voice and glanced at Han Xing with its bloodshot eyes.
In the next instant, it suddenly saw five arrows shooting towards its head.
By the time the monster bird wanted to dodge, it was too late.
At the critical moment, it was forced to interrupt the charging of its big move, raising its fleshy wing to desperately block the vital area.
Pfft! Pfft pfft!
All five arrows hit, causing streams of blood to spurt up.
"Gah!"
The monster bird let out a tragic cry, seemingly sustaining severe wounds.
It was within Han Xing’s expectations to be able to injure the monster bird.
After all, his attack power was even more formidable than Coal Ball’s. When the monster bird leader first appeared, Han Xing was already able to deal damage to it.
Now, after Coal Ball’s multiple weakenings, his arrow attacks had become even more deadly.
At that moment, knowing it was no match, the monster bird flapped its wings, and the gust it kicked up forced Coal Ball back.
Then, without turning its head, it rushed into the depths of the cave at an even faster speed.
The monster bird actually fled directly.
Han Xing was stunned for a moment, just about to pursue the victory.
But as if thinking of something, his expression suddenly changed, and he directly abandoned the idea.
Coal Ball’s shadow flickered, preparing to give chase.
Han Xing quickly shouted, "Coal Ball, come back."
Coal Ball halted its pursuit.
The battle came to an abrupt end.
At this moment.
In the deep cave, only the sounds of the two people and one wolf’s breathing remained.
Han Xing took a deep breath, gazing in the direction where the monster bird had fled, and after a moment said, "Let’s go."
Zhang Lianmeng seemed to have just snapped out of it, "Huh? Where to?"
Han Xing glanced at her: "Where else? That monster bird was driven away, not killed, it could come back at any moment."
"This is its territory; who knows if it has other tricks up its sleeve? It’s best to leave now."
At this point, Han Xing suddenly looked at her with a sinister smile and said, "Or do you prefer the atmosphere here and want to stay?"
Hearing this, Zhang Lianmeng’s delicate body trembled, and she hurriedly said, "No! I don’t want to stay here alone!"
"Then let’s go quickly."
Han Xing chuckled and took the lead towards the passage entrance.
Zhang Lianmeng followed closely behind him, almost not leaving his side.
At this time, she anxiously asked, "Just now, what was the black shadow that helped us fight?"
Han Xing knew she was referring to Coal Ball and casually said, "My pet. Don’t ask more than that."
Even though Zhang Lianmeng was very curious, she vaguely grasped Han Xing’s personality and didn’t say more.
Han Xing walked towards the passage entrance at a leisurely pace, vaguely sensing an evil pair of eyes watching him from the depths of the cave.
Ever since viewing those wall paintings, he had been cloaked in a sense of unease.
Even after the monster bird was driven back, the feeling of unease did not diminish in the slightest.
At this moment, Han Xing recalled the contents of the paintings.
This monster bird was evidently the form taken by that Elf Man, while the paintings recorded that a terrifying black shadow always followed him, even escaping here together with him.
In other words, it was entirely possible that this cave contained more than just the monster bird as an enemy.
This place was too sinister.
Without enough power, Han Xing didn’t want to come back to this damn place.
This was also why Han Xing stopped Coal Ball.
At this point, Coal Ball followed them too.
Only after entering the passage did Han Xing finally let out a sigh of relief.
In just this few hundred meters of road, he felt as if his back was almost soaked with sweat, akin to a big battle.

chapters.title: Chapter 71 - 69: Han Xing’s Killing Intent!
paragraphs: After a dozen minutes, they returned to the familiar entrance, a patch of light appeared before them.
Without a word, Han Xing grabbed Zhang Lianmeng’s wrist and quickened his pace.
Suddenly being pulled by Han Xing, Zhang Lianmeng’s body tightened instantly, almost instinctively wanting to shake off.
But thinking about this man, she had some strange feelings again.
That feeling was indescribable, as if when he held her, there was an inexplicable sense of safety in her heart.
Zhang Lianmeng felt the strength from the wrist, her face blushing.
His hand is so strong...
Being held by this man, unexpectedly brought a sense of security she had never felt before.
Not even her fiancé or her family had given her this feeling.
Just then, the front became bright, they stepped out of the valley, and their vision opened up.
Han Xing immediately released his hand, Zhang Lianmeng’s fantasies were suddenly interrupted, and for a moment, a slight sense of loss arose in her heart.
Han Xing sensed her slightly off color and asked, "What’s wrong with you?"
Zhang Lianmeng quickly replied, "Nothing, nothing."
Her voice carried a hint of guilt and shyness.
Han Xing glanced at her, then asked no more.
Han Xing continued, "Let’s go, let’s return to the territory first."
Zhang Lianmeng lowered her head, agreeing softly.
Twenty minutes later, they returned to their territory one after another.
This cave trip had no gains, and they had fought a Leader Monster,
No, it can’t be said there was no gain at all, at least he brought back hundreds of liters of Spiritual Spring Water.
Also, Han Xing obtained two pieces of key information through the task introduction.
The place these survivors reside in is called the Land of the Abandoned Gods, and the native residents of this world seem to shun it like the plague.
To the extent that after this strange bird committed heinous crimes, even the elves dared not rush into the Land of the Abandoned Gods to chase it.
The second piece of information was that the Elf Royal Capital map might be opened subsequently, though exactly when, Han Xing had no clue.
These two pieces of information seemed useless but greatly helped Han Xing understand this unfamiliar world.
At this moment, Zhang Lianmeng still kept her head down, daring not look up at him.
Han Xing didn’t know what this woman was thinking, so he said, "Ask your man to send over the coordinates, I’ll take you there."
"Huh?"
Zhang Lianmeng seemed a bit dazed.
Han Xing continued, "As per the agreement, you finish the task with me and I’ll send you to find him."
After listening, Zhang Lianmeng doubted, "But... wasn’t the task incomplete?"
Han Xing nodded, "Yes, it was incomplete, but this time there were some changes; these unforeseen events were beyond our control, and can’t be blamed on you."
"I’m not a good person, but I do stick to what I say."
Zhang Lianmeng still stood blankly on the spot.
Han Xing urged somewhat speechlessly, "Hurry up."
In Zhang Lianmeng’s heart, there was suddenly a slight feeling of loss.
After a struggle in her thoughts, she said softly, "Alright, I’ll contact him."
Han Xing nodded slightly and waited quietly.
After two minutes, Zhang Lianmeng nervously glanced at Han Xing, "I seem to be unable to reach him..."
Her expression changed, as if she had realized something.
In the morning, Han Xing had already alerted.
That the Divine Whisper, the Two-Star Secret Realm they were challenging, was very difficult, and injuries or deaths were certain.
Zhang Lianmeng’s heart sank, she suddenly had a bad premonition.
She trembled and said, "He... he couldn’t be really in trouble, could he?"
Han Xing rolled his eyes at her, "You’re asking me, how would I know?"
Zhang Lianmeng was now thoroughly confused, even her eyes began to mist.
Looking at Han Xing, she felt so wronged that she was almost going to cry.
Han Xing hurriedly said, "Don’t cry."
"Maybe your man is just fighting in the Secret Realm and doesn’t have time to reply, wait a while and see."
Han Xing tried to say, though he knew this possibility was very slim.
Zhang Lianmeng softly sobbed and then nodded heavily, seemingly stifling her inner grievance.
Han Xing continued, "What are you going to do now? Or should I just leave you behind here? I don’t have time to slowly wait for your man’s reply."
Zhang Lianmeng raised her head, a strange idea suddenly arose in her heart.
With tear-filled eyes, she looked at Han Xing and tentatively asked, "Can I... can I follow you?"
Han Xing was stunned for a moment, then directly shook his head and said, "Wishful thinking, following me and wanting me to be your free babysitter?"
Building courage, Zhang Lianmeng continued to plead, "I... I am very understanding, I can do chores, cook, and when encountering monsters, I can help fight, I won’t drag you down..."
Saying this, her voice again carried a hint of sobbing.
Hearing the conditions this woman offered, Han Xing thought for a bit, but still shook his head.
"No."
Han Xing’s clear refusal made Zhang Lianmeng feel her last hope was erased, her whole self almost unable to stand steadily.
"I’m leaving now, take care of yourself, so farewell."
Ignoring Zhang Lianmeng who was feeling lost behind him, Han Xing returned to his Sky Island Territory.
Just as he was about to maneuver the Sky Island to leave.
Suddenly, from a distance, a shadow swiftly rushed in the sky.
It was incredibly fast, almost crossing several kilometers in just a few seconds, appearing above Han Xing’s territory.
A terrible wind sound suddenly came from the sky overhead.

Without a word, Han Xing grabbed Zhang Lianmeng’s wrist and quickened his pace.
Suddenly being pulled by Han Xing, Zhang Lianmeng’s body tightened instantly, almost instinctively wanting to shake off.
But thinking about this man, she had some strange feelings again.
That feeling was indescribable, as if when he held her, there was an inexplicable sense of safety in her heart.
Zhang Lianmeng felt the strength from the wrist, her face blushing.
His hand is so strong...
Being held by this man, unexpectedly brought a sense of security she had never felt before.
Not even her fiancé or her family had given her this feeling.
Just then, the front became bright, they stepped out of the valley, and their vision opened up.
Han Xing immediately released his hand, Zhang Lianmeng’s fantasies were suddenly interrupted, and for a moment, a slight sense of loss arose in her heart.

Zhang Lianmeng quickly replied, "Nothing, nothing."
Her voice carried a hint of guilt and shyness.
Han Xing glanced at her, then asked no more.
Han Xing continued, "Let’s go, let’s return to the territory first."
Zhang Lianmeng lowered her head, agreeing softly.

No, it can’t be said there was no gain at all, at least he brought back hundreds of liters of Spiritual Spring Water.

The place these survivors reside in is called the Land of the Abandoned Gods, and the native residents of this world seem to shun it like the plague.
To the extent that after this strange bird committed heinous crimes, even the elves dared not rush into the Land of the Abandoned Gods to chase it.
The second piece of information was that the Elf Royal Capital map might be opened subsequently, though exactly when, Han Xing had no clue.
These two pieces of information seemed useless but greatly helped Han Xing understand this unfamiliar world.
At this moment, Zhang Lianmeng still kept her head down, daring not look up at him.

chapters.title: Chapter 72 - 69: Han Xing’s Killing Intent!
paragraphs: Before Han Xing could react.
In the sky.
A fireball the size of a washbasin, carrying a devastating power, suddenly bombarded Han Xing’s territory.
Noticing this aura, the Coal Ball almost instantly dashed out of the castle.
However, even with its speed, it was too late.
The next moment, the fireball slammed onto Han Xing’s territory’s surface and exploded directly!
Boom!!!
Huge shockwaves blasted Han Xing ten meters away.
Even the approaching Coal Ball was knocked back by the shockwave.
And Han Xing’s three-story territory was blasted with a pit over twenty meters in diameter by this cannon.
The system notification came through.
[Your territory is under bombardment, territory area loss 423 square...]
Bombardment? Who?
Han Xing dazedly raised his head to look at the sky.
He suddenly saw a giant, bald bird flying mid-air.
At this moment, this monstrous bird had a massive cannon on its shoulder, gilded in color, with a barrel diameter exceeding 40 centimeters.
However, the cannon was covered with dense cracks.
The monstrous bird’s eyes were blood-red as it screeched at the sky, filled with a sense of revenge.
"Gah! Gah!"
"It’s it..."
At this moment, Han Xing remembered.
He saw in a mural that after this monstrous bird gained power, it slaughtered an entire town of elves.
In other words, this creature was actually a presence with a strong sense of vengeance.
Previously, after suffering at the hands of the Coal Ball and Han Xing, it was already thinking of revenge.
"Bastard!"
Han Xing gritted his teeth, wishing he could cut this monstrous bird into pieces on the spot!
At this moment, Coal Ball was also showing its teeth, eyes fierce, ready to rush into the sky to knock the monstrous bird down.
However, the monstrous bird was equipped with heavy weaponry and also knew the horror of the Coal Ball.
The next moment, the cannon barrel shifted, aiming directly at the approaching Coal Ball.
"Coal Ball, come back!"
Han Xing was horrified.
With the terrifying destructive force of this cannon, just one shot could probably take it out directly, perhaps instantly kill it.
Although Coal Ball had a 50% dodge probability, what if it didn’t trigger this time?
Han Xing was truly panicked, the sudden change caught him off guard.
However, the monstrous bird wouldn’t give him time to think.
It pressed a red button on the gilded cannon.
This shot not only targeted Coal Ball but also aimed at Han Xing below.
The next moment.
Another shell carrying a destructive aura descended again.
In this critical moment.
Han Xing suddenly saw the sky above him darken.
An area of over a thousand square meters of Sky Island Territory shielded above his head.
Territory? Whose?
Before he could think about it, the descending shell already made contact with the territory above his head.
Next moment.
The terrifying explosion hit again.
Boom!
The entire territory was blasted from the middle, with a pit over twenty meters wide.
This shot seemed to have shattered the core of that territory, and the entire territory of over a thousand square meters disintegrated at this moment.
A familiar silhouette fell from above.
Then heavily crashed in front of Han Xing.
Meanwhile, the Coal Ball had already let out a furious roar, rushing into the sky to fight with the monstrous bird.
The monstrous bird no longer had a chance to press the button to bombard.
Below, Han Xing softly spoke the name of the silhouette.
"Zhang Lianmeng, why?"
His eyes were filled with confusion as he hurried to this woman’s side, squatting down.
Zhang Lianmeng stared blankly, looking somewhat dazed at Han Xing.
However, Han Xing felt no hint of aura from her body.
"Dead...Dead?"
Han Xing was bewildered for a moment, feeling as if he were in a dream.
He had never experienced a scene like this.
A living life extinguishing before him.
And it was to protect him.
He stood there dumbfounded.
Suddenly, a tremendous surge of rage burst uncontrollably deep from within.
This rage engulfed him wholly; his eyes turned blood-red as he instantly lifted his head to look at the monstrous bird in the sky, an immense killing intent erupted from him.
At this moment, Han Xing’s hand holding the Moon Crown Longbow bulged with veins uncontrollably.
Han Xing had never been this angry in his life.
He gritted his teeth, speaking with an icy voice, "Damn it, I swear I’ll tear you to pieces!"
However, at this moment, Zhang Lianmeng’s once breathless body suddenly trembled slightly.
The next moment, a hint of crimson blood appeared at the corner of her mouth.
Han Xing felt a faint trace of aura returning to this woman’s nose.
In that moment, the rage in Han Xing’s heart suddenly vanished, rekindling hope within.
He instinctively dropped the bow and arrow, hurriedly checking Zhang Lianmeng’s injuries.
A moment later, Han Xing breathed a heavy sigh of relief.
"Thankfully... it was just her internal organs shaken by the shell’s shockwave, she didn’t die on the spot."
At this moment, Han Xing felt as if the thousand pounds of burden on his shoulders had suddenly fallen off, leaving him feeling liberated.
Internal organ shock injuries like these, perhaps difficult to save in Blue Star’s modern society, might even be considered a death sentence.
But here, in this scientific-explanation-defying fantasy world.
Anything is possible.
Just one bottle of Life Secret Elixir could rescue her injuries.
Han Xing propped Zhang Lianmeng up in his arms, and quickly poured a bottle of Life Secret Elixir into her mouth.
A few seconds later, a slight flush returned to Zhang Lianmeng’s pale face, and the focus gradually returned to her once-whitened pupils.
She seemed to have walked through the gates of hell, taking a sudden deep breath the instant consciousness returned.
"Huff..."
She instinctively grasped Han Xing’s arm, gripping tightly, her nails nearly digging into the flesh.
Even so, her body was still uncontrollably trembling violently.
The arm sent waves of stabbing pain, but Han Xing didn’t pull away, allowing the woman to hold him tightly.
He knew Zhang Lianmeng was frightened.
Almost blasted to death, anyone would have been scared silly.
If someone with a fragile mind survived, they might carry a lifelong shadow.
Han Xing gently patted her shoulder, softly saying, "It’s alright now."
It’s alright now.
The three words seemed to carry a special magic, freeing Zhang Lianmeng instantly from the immense fear between life and death.
She looked at Han Xing with a pale face, then suddenly buried her head in his chest, uncontrollably crying.
"Woo... woo..."
Zhang Lianmeng burrowed into Han Xing’s embrace.
This time he didn’t stop her, allowing her to vent her inner fear and grief until his chest was soaked with tears.
In the sky, the Coal Ball was still battling the monstrous bird.
The monstrous bird, realizing it was losing, was preparing to escape again.
However, Han Xing had long set his mind on its inevitable death.
After Zhang Lianmeng cried for a while, she fell into a deep sleep.
Han Xing stood up, staring icy daggers at the monstrous bird, "In the cave, I intended to spare your life. Now, you have the audacity to come seeking death, so be it!"
The next moment, Han Xing waved his hand single-handedly.
A steel giant over 6 meters tall, radiating a metallic sheen, abruptly appeared on the territory.
The next moment, the Spiritual Puppet soared into the sky.
Skill, Earthquake Shock, activated!
The monstrous bird seemed momentarily dazed, but instantly realized the danger upon the Elite Puppet’s appearance.
Flapping its fleshy wings, it attempted escape.
However, Han Xing couldn’t let it have its way, directly shooting a Wind Chasing Arrow, targeting the monstrous bird’s vital heart area.
The Coal Ball followed closely, attacking.
To avoid the attack, the monstrous bird’s flight was hindered; it struggled to flap its wings, trying to soar skyward.
At this moment, the Spiritual Puppet had already reached over ten meters high in the air.
Following Han Xing’s order, the Spiritual Puppet extended its two giant steel hands, clutching the monstrous bird’s wings.
In the monstrous bird’s despairing gaze, the Spiritual Puppet grasped it fiercely, then yanked it down forcefully from the sky!
