chapters.title: Chapter 73 - 70: First Kill Reward, Involvement in a Major Event!
paragraphs: The Spiritual Puppet extended its two giant iron hands, grabbing the wings of the giant bird and pulling down fiercely!
The immense sense of falling made the giant bird let out a series of intense screams.
At this moment, a hint of despair appeared in the bird’s eyes.
It knew that once it lost the ability to fly, what awaited it was a dead end.
"Gah! Gah!"
The giant bird kept screeching, seemingly calling for help.
Han Xing sensed that from the distant Sky Island forest, a strange aura was rapidly approaching, seemingly trying to stop him from killing the giant bird.
The aura wasn’t strong, appearing somewhat weak.
However, at this moment, Han Xing was already resolute in his determination to kill the giant bird.
"Today, no matter who you call, they won’t be able to save you!"
In the next moment, Han Xing waved his hand again, and 7 more Spiritual Puppets suddenly appeared.
Eight iron giants over 4 meters tall occupied all the space in sight.
Just looking at them was a complete visual shock.
The aura continued to rush in swiftly, getting closer and closer.
Just then, Han Xing suddenly spoke coldly to the forest, "If you want to reveal yourself now, then come out!"
As soon as the words fell, the forceful rush of the strange aura in the forest suddenly halted.
At this moment, the Leader-level giant bird had already been slammed into the ground by the Elite Puppet.
Bang!
The ground erupted with a powerful impact.
This fall directly made the giant bird cough up a mouthful of blood, feeling as if its internal organs were shattered.
After landing, it tried to struggle again.
At this time, the eight Spiritual Puppets surrounded the giant bird, giving it no chance to escape.
And within the encirclement, Coal Ball continued to inflict damage on it.
The giant bird emitted piercing cries, but what awaited it were basin-sized metal fists and streaks of black light.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
The Spiritual Puppets punched out one after another, each punch landing squarely, causing the giant bird to scream in agony.
In no time, the bird was covered in many wounds, its blood and flesh flying.
Its aura grew weaker and weaker, clinging its last hope onto the aura in the forest.
However.
Whether it was fear of the puppets’ combat strength, or fear of Han Xing’s recent words.
The terrifying aura in the forest gradually retreated...
At this moment, the giant bird was utterly desperate.
In its final moments of life, it only saw a few terrifying giant metal feet, filling its vision.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
After a series of screams.
This level 10 giant bird leader was stomped to death by the Spiritual Puppets.
Looking at the misshapen, bloodied corpse on the ground.
Han Xing took a deep breath, his inner rage gradually easing.
Just then, a prompt sounded in his ear.
[Successfully killed giant bird Jiale (One-star Leader-level Creature), you gained experience value*18000, pet Coal Ball gained experience value*14400]

System announcement: "Since you are the first Survivor in the entire server to kill a Leader-level monster, you receive a first-kill reward: Spirit Core*5000, Space Backpack Blueprint (Blue)*1, you receive an additional reward: Blood Curse Antidote Formula*1."
"Another first-kill reward!?"
Han Xing was immediately astonished, "And a blue backpack blueprint!"
Previously, Han Xing felt his backpack space was somewhat insufficient. This first-kill reward unexpectedly gave him a blue Space Backpack Blueprint.
Han Xing even wanted to check the reward immediately, but when he thought of the terrifying presence in that forest.
He temporarily stored these items in his backpack, immediately maneuvering the Sky Island away from there.
A dozen minutes later, he was tens of kilometers away from the forest.
Only then did Han Xing slowly say, "This should be far enough, luckily that thing didn’t follow."
He let out a sigh of relief.
Although he didn’t know what was in that cave, nor its strength.
Just by the horrifying aura that continuously made one’s heart palpitate, it at the very least possessed strength greater than the giant bird leader.
Luckily, Han Xing deduced from details in murals that the aura likely didn’t want to expose itself before others, otherwise, it wouldn’t have hidden behind the giant bird.
His threat truly had an effect.
After escaping danger, Han Xing began examining the attributes of the backpack blueprint.
[Space Backpack (Blue)]: Can create a backpack with 100-200 slots of storage space, with slight attribute amplification effects.
[Required materials for crafting]: Spirit Core*200, High-quality Beast Hide*3, Ether*2000.
[Crafting success rate 25%, (with Divine-level Craftsman Talent bonus, crafting success rate is now 100%)]
[Equipment requirement]: LV10.
Han Xing nodded in satisfaction, "Not bad, the blue backpack has at least 100 slots of space, much larger than my current Space Backpack!"
"However, there’s a requirement to equip it at level 10, which isn’t much of a challenge for me."
Just killing that level 10 Leader monster made his experience bar soar to 95%, soon to reach level 9.
At his current leveling speed, reaching Level 10 isn’t that far off.
At this moment, Han Xing took out another reward item from his backpack.
[Blood Curse Antidote Formula]: According to this formula, a potion that can lift the Blood Curse can be made.
"Antidote formula? What is the Blood Curse?"
Han Xing became interested. Compared to the two formulas he obtained before, this one was quite different.
Below it, there was even a lengthy introduction text.
Before the Great Collapse Era, the Witch Race, as one of the hundred tribes in the Holy Spirit Realm, possessed formidable power.
One day, during a tribal ritual, the Witch Race leader heard whispers in his ear, believing it to be the souls of ancestors communicating and guiding him to a higher, sacred place.
He asked the voice how to lead the Witch Race to prosperity.
The voice remained silent briefly before uttering a few words.
Faith, sacrifice, blood...
Upon hearing the instruction, the Witch Race leader was overjoyed. With the ancestors responding, the revival of the Witch Race seemed hopeful!
Since then, he continuously communicated and conversed with that voice.
Until one day, he finally received the complete sacrificial information.
Only then did the Witch Race leader realize the enormity of the sacrifice, which required the full might of the tribe to complete.
Thus, Witch Races from around the world were summoned back, and a grand, vast ritual was underway.
However, it was precisely this ritual that drew four terrifying entities from the alternate space.
The names, pasts, and abilities of those four entities were unknown...
The only common trait was their ability to spread curses, with a speed and intensity unprecedented!
When the four terrifying curses spread across the entire Witch Race Territory like wildfire.
That night, the Witch Race was nearly exterminated.
Recognizing the severity, the Elf King and Giant King, at their peak, brought their tribe’s holy artifacts to curb the curses.
Yet despite this, they only managed to arduously slay two of the bizarre entities.
The other two bizarre entities retreated back into the alternate space.
With the crisis averted, the surviving Witch Race began to recuperate.
However, what the Elf King and Giant King failed to notice was that at the place where they slew the bizarre entities, a drop of crimson blood seeped into the soil.
This drop of blood was one of the curse’s sources.
Years later, a fearsome entity reawakened.
He prepared to unleash another terrible calamity.
But having experienced failure, this entity became more cautious, preparing slowly and methodically.
Moreover, he had already identified a suitable target.
Under his subtle manipulations, this entity’s remnant soul successfully arrived at the Land of the Abandoned Gods.
He intended to complete his scheme in this Holy Spirit Realm location where no living creature dared to enter.
Now, his plan is nearing completion.
By then, the entire sky over the Land of the Abandoned Gods will be stained with blood, a spectacle known as the Blood Tide.
Under the Blood Tide, all creatures will uncontrollably become distorted, terrifying beings.
Only those who consume the Blood Curse Antidote can be immune to this curse.
After reading this lengthy formula introduction, Han Xing inhaled sharply.
He had thought this was merely a simple potion formula, but unexpectedly, it was tied to a tremendous event!
Who is this entity making the arrangements?
Does it have any connection with the presence in the nearby woods?
When will the Blood Tide burst forth?
Han Xing knew none of this.
All he knew was if no one stopped it, this disaster would eventually occur!
Han Xing took a deep breath, contemplating, "Currently, among all surviving humans, I’m probably the only one with this information!"
"The native inhabitants of this world may or may not know, but I cannot contact them nor inform them of the situation..."
"Moreover, the item info above seems to mention that the Land of the Abandoned Gods where I’m located is a place even the natives dare not tread lightly."
"In other words, if this disaster unfolds, the tens of billions of humans on Blue Star will be the first to bear the brunt!"
"This is troublesome..."
Han Xing furrowed his brows, "Under the Blood Tide, all creatures will mutate."
"And must possess the Blood Curse Antidote to resist the curse?"
Han Xing seemed to have caught onto some key information and suddenly realized the importance of the potion formula in his hand.
In the future, if the Blood Tide breaks out, then this potion formula could potentially be the key to changing the course of the event!
With this in mind, Han Xing directly clicked to learn the formula and checked the materials needed for crafting.
[Blood Curse Antidote]: Consuming it can remove the Blood Curse.
[Materials required for crafting]: Cursed Blood*1, Divine Aurora*1, Witch Root Grass*1, Spirit Core*100.
The potion crafting formula wasn’t complex, but the three key materials were ones Han Xing had never heard of.
"It seems these materials aren’t obtainable at the current stage; I’ll have to check the trading channel when there’s an opportunity."
After reading the information on this formula, it felt as if a shadow loomed over Han Xing’s heart.

sentences.text: The Spiritual Puppet extended its two giant iron hands, grabbing the wings of the giant bird and pulling down fiercely!
The immense sense of falling made the giant bird let out a series of intense screams.
At this moment, a hint of despair appeared in the bird’s eyes.
It knew that once it lost the ability to fly, what awaited it was a dead end.
"Gah!
Gah!"
The giant bird kept screeching, seemingly calling for help.
Han Xing sensed that from the distant Sky Island forest, a strange aura was rapidly approaching, seemingly trying to stop him from killing the giant bird.
The aura wasn’t strong, appearing somewhat weak.
However, at this moment, Han Xing was already resolute in his determination to kill the giant bird.
"Today, no matter who you call, they won’t be able to save you!"
In the next moment, Han Xing waved his hand again, and 7 more Spiritual Puppets suddenly appeared.
Eight iron giants over 4 meters tall occupied all the space in sight.
Just looking at them was a complete visual shock.
The aura continued to rush in swiftly, getting closer and closer.
Just then, Han Xing suddenly spoke coldly to the forest, "If you want to reveal yourself now, then come out!"
As soon as the words fell, the forceful rush of the strange aura in the forest suddenly halted.
At this moment, the Leader-level giant bird had already been slammed into the ground by the Elite Puppet.
Bang!
The ground erupted with a powerful impact.
This fall directly made the giant bird cough up a mouthful of blood, feeling as if its internal organs were shattered.
After landing, it tried to struggle again.
At this time, the eight Spiritual Puppets surrounded the giant bird, giving it no chance to escape.
And within the encirclement, Coal Ball continued to inflict damage on it.
The giant bird emitted piercing cries, but what awaited it were basin-sized metal fists and streaks of black light.
Bang!
Bang!
Bang!
The Spiritual Puppets punched out one after another, each punch landing squarely, causing the giant bird to scream in agony.
In no time, the bird was covered in many wounds, its blood and flesh flying.
Its aura grew weaker and weaker, clinging its last hope onto the aura in the forest.
However.
Whether it was fear of the puppets’ combat strength, or fear of Han Xing’s recent words.
The terrifying aura in the forest gradually retreated...
At this moment, the giant bird was utterly desperate.
In its final moments of life, it only saw a few terrifying giant metal feet, filling its vision.
Bang!
Bang!
Bang!
After a series of screams.
This level 10 giant bird leader was stomped to death by the Spiritual Puppets.
Looking at the misshapen, bloodied corpse on the ground.
Han Xing took a deep breath, his inner rage gradually easing.
Just then, a prompt sounded in his ear.
[Successfully killed giant bird Jiale (One-star Leader-level Creature), you gained experience value*18000, pet Coal Ball gained experience value*14400]

System announcement: "Since you are the first Survivor in the entire server to kill a Leader-level monster, you receive a first-kill reward: Spirit Core*5000, Space Backpack Blueprint (Blue)*1, you receive an additional reward: Blood Curse Antidote Formula*1."
"Another first-kill reward!?"
Han Xing was immediately astonished, "And a blue backpack blueprint!"
Previously, Han Xing felt his backpack space was somewhat insufficient.
This first-kill reward unexpectedly gave him a blue Space Backpack Blueprint.
Han Xing even wanted to check the reward immediately, but when he thought of the terrifying presence in that forest.
He temporarily stored these items in his backpack, immediately maneuvering the Sky Island away from there.
A dozen minutes later, he was tens of kilometers away from the forest.
Only then did Han Xing slowly say, "This should be far enough, luckily that thing didn’t follow."
He let out a sigh of relief.
Although he didn’t know what was in that cave, nor its strength.
Just by the horrifying aura that continuously made one’s heart palpitate, it at the very least possessed strength greater than the giant bird leader.
Luckily, Han Xing deduced from details in murals that the aura likely didn’t want to expose itself before others, otherwise, it wouldn’t have hidden behind the giant bird.
His threat truly had an effect.
After escaping danger, Han Xing began examining the attributes of the backpack blueprint.
[Space Backpack (Blue)]: Can create a backpack with 100-200 slots of storage space, with slight attribute amplification effects.
[Required materials for crafting]: Spirit Core*200, High-quality Beast Hide*3, Ether*2000.
[Crafting success rate 25%, (with Divine-level Craftsman Talent bonus, crafting success rate is now 100%)]
[Equipment requirement]: LV10.
Han Xing nodded in satisfaction, "Not bad, the blue backpack has at least 100 slots of space, much larger than my current Space Backpack!"
"However, there’s a requirement to equip it at level 10, which isn’t much of a challenge for me."
Just killing that level 10 Leader monster made his experience bar soar to 95%, soon to reach level 9.
At his current leveling speed, reaching Level 10 isn’t that far off.
At this moment, Han Xing took out another reward item from his backpack.
[Blood Curse Antidote Formula]: According to this formula, a potion that can lift the Blood Curse can be made.
"Antidote formula?
What is the Blood Curse?"
Han Xing became interested.
Compared to the two formulas he obtained before, this one was quite different.
Below it, there was even a lengthy introduction text.
Before the Great Collapse Era, the Witch Race, as one of the hundred tribes in the Holy Spirit Realm, possessed formidable power.
One day, during a tribal ritual, the Witch Race leader heard whispers in his ear, believing it to be the souls of ancestors communicating and guiding him to a higher, sacred place.
He asked the voice how to lead the Witch Race to prosperity.
The voice remained silent briefly before uttering a few words.
Faith, sacrifice, blood...
Upon hearing the instruction, the Witch Race leader was overjoyed.
With the ancestors responding, the revival of the Witch Race seemed hopeful!
Since then, he continuously communicated and conversed with that voice.
Until one day, he finally received the complete sacrificial information.
Only then did the Witch Race leader realize the enormity of the sacrifice, which required the full might of the tribe to complete.
Thus, Witch Races from around the world were summoned back, and a grand, vast ritual was underway.
However, it was precisely this ritual that drew four terrifying entities from the alternate space.
The names, pasts, and abilities of those four entities were unknown...
The only common trait was their ability to spread curses, with a speed and intensity unprecedented!
When the four terrifying curses spread across the entire Witch Race Territory like wildfire.
That night, the Witch Race was nearly exterminated.
Recognizing the severity, the Elf King and Giant King, at their peak, brought their tribe’s holy artifacts to curb the curses.
Yet despite this, they only managed to arduously slay two of the bizarre entities.
The other two bizarre entities retreated back into the alternate space.
With the crisis averted, the surviving Witch Race began to recuperate.
However, what the Elf King and Giant King failed to notice was that at the place where they slew the bizarre entities, a drop of crimson blood seeped into the soil.
This drop of blood was one of the curse’s sources.
Years later, a fearsome entity reawakened.
He prepared to unleash another terrible calamity.
But having experienced failure, this entity became more cautious, preparing slowly and methodically.
Moreover, he had already identified a suitable target.
Under his subtle manipulations, this entity’s remnant soul successfully arrived at the Land of the Abandoned Gods.

chapters.title: Chapter 75 - 72: New Member of the Territory
paragraphs: Han Xing slowly began to speak: "Zhang Lianmeng, you can stay."
Zhang Lianmeng lifted her head, looking at Han Xing in a daze, seemingly unable to believe it.
Han Xing continued: "Your core territory was destroyed because you saved me. I am not the kind of person who doesn’t repay a favor."
"Next, if you have nowhere else to go, you can stay here for now. I will also look for ways to help you restore your territory."
"What do you think?"
After Han Xing finished speaking, Zhang Lianmeng only heard the last part, stay here for now.
She lifted her head and tentatively asked: "Can I... really stay here?"
Han Xing nodded, "You can stay here until you have your own territory. Of course, if you have other plans, you can tell me."
Upon hearing this, Zhang Lianmeng immediately exclaimed excitedly, "I..."
She was about to say she was willing but felt it was inappropriate, so she changed her phrasing.
She sincerely said, "Thank you."
After she finished speaking, her face blossomed into a brilliant smile, one of genuine happiness and joy.
Zhang Lianmeng was already very beautiful, and with that smile, she was like a blossoming crabapple flower.
For a moment, Han Xing was somewhat taken aback.
After a few seconds, Han Xing recovered, awkwardly coughed twice, and changed the topic: "By the way, are you hungry? If you are, come and eat, I’m preparing to roast some meat."
At the mention of food, Zhang Lianmeng’s stomach rumbled, and she lowered her head in embarrassment.
Han Xing did not mind and instead himself lit a campfire, then took out a fine iron arrow to roast the meat.
The cut pieces of beast meat crackled under the charcoal fire.
The surface exuded a golden oily sheen.
Han Xing occasionally turned the meat over, sprinkling some seasoning on top, and soon, the aroma filled the entire camp.
Zhang Lianmeng squatted nearby, watching Han Xing’s actions with a smile, saying, "You’re quite skilled. Do you often roast meat yourself?"
Zhang Lianmeng didn’t know that her squatting posture not only accentuated her ample chest but also perfectly outlined the curves of her rounded hips.
Han Xing glanced at it and quickly turned away.
Demon! Do not corrupt my path!
Han Xing nodded and replied, "There’s no other food in this world, basically, it’s all meat every day. I do have some vegetable seeds here, but I don’t want to farm, it’s troublesome."
Upon hearing about vegetable seeds, Zhang Lianmeng’s eyes lit up, "Can you give me the seeds?"
Han Xing understood her intent and asked: "Do you want to farm?"
"Yes!"
Zhang Lianmeng nodded earnestly, resting her chin on her hands, "My dream since childhood has been to have a garden of my own, to plant many fruits and vegetables, and all kinds of flowers in it!"
Seeing her excited expression, Han Xing casually tossed her a few packs of vegetable seeds, "Here, take these. As for tools, I’ll make some for you in a while."
Zhang Lianmeng gratefully glanced at Han Xing.
Both of them tactfully avoided mentioning Liu Zeqi.
Zhang Lianmeng carefully packed the seeds into her backpack, then looked at Han Xing, hesitating to speak.
Han Xing said, "If you want to ask something, just ask, no need to be so restrained."
Zhang Lianmeng hesitated, "Um... it’s just, I still don’t know your name."
Upon hearing this, Han Xing seemed to remember that until now, although Zhang Lianmeng had introduced herself, he had not mentioned his name.
He felt a bit speechless.
"I say, Miss Zhang, you didn’t even know my name, yet you risked your life to save me? May I ask, what were you thinking at that time?"
Zhang Lianmeng appeared quite embarrassed, "I... I didn’t really think about it, I just felt that since you saved me once, I should save you too..."
"Besides, you’re so powerful, I believed you wouldn’t let me die."
Zhang Lianmeng smiled foolishly, looking at Han Xing with a hint of admiration in her eyes.
Han Xing quietly stared at her, and as if feeling a little self-conscious from being watched, Zhang Lianmeng lowered her head shyly.
A moment later, Han Xing said, "I am Han Xing."
Then, Han Xing turned and walked toward the castle.
Zhang Lianmeng softly murmured the name, "Han Xing..."
Just then, Han Xing’s voice came from the front.
"Zhang Lianmeng, come here."
"Ah? Oh!" Zhang Lianmeng stood up and obediently walked over to Han Xing’s side.
When she looked up at the nearly twenty-meter-tall castle, her eyes were filled with intense curiosity.
Zhang Lianmeng exclaimed in awe, "What a huge castle!"
"Brother Xing, is this your home?"
Han Xing was surprised by her last words, his eyes widened, and he asked, "What did you just call me?"
"Uh, Brother Xing, don’t you like me calling you that?"
Zhang Lianmeng blinked her innocent big eyes, looking at him in confusion.
This woman was a few years older than himself, but she still looked very young, with a mature yet slightly naive demeanor.
Calling himself Brother Xing didn’t seem inappropriate.
Han Xing helplessly shook his head; it’s just a nickname, she can call him whatever she wants.
Leading Zhang Lianmeng into the castle.
Han Xing turned back and said, "This castle is big, and there are rooms under every tower. You can choose any room you like to live in."
Zhang Lianmeng, hearing this, asked with somewhat bewildered eyes, "Brother Xing, do you mean I can live in the castle too?"
"Yes, is there a problem?" Han Xing replied.
Zhang Lianmeng quickly shook her head, feeling like she was in a dream.
She had been in this world for nearly half a month, always using the sky as her quilt, the earth as her bed, and setting up a tent as her temporary home.

chapters.title: Chapter 76 - 72: New Member of the Territory (Part 2)
paragraphs: This is also the current situation for the vast majority of survivors.
The fact that Han Xing could take her in already filled Zhang Lianmeng with immense gratitude.
Even if she still had to sleep in a tent outside the territory like before, she would feel very satisfied.
She never thought that Han Xing would actually let her live in the castle. For a moment, feelings of deep gratitude toward Han Xing surged in Zhang Lianmeng’s heart.
She sincerely thanked him, "Brother Xing, thank you."
Han Xing was speechless, wasn’t it just giving her a room, was there really a need for this?
Han Xing continued, "The room at the very top of the central tower is mine, the rest, you can choose as you wish."
"Once you’ve chosen, take a look at what furniture you need, and I’ll make it for you."
Zhang Lianmeng softly replied with an "mm," looking somewhat lost as she eyed the vast space in the castle, not knowing which room to choose.
A moment later, she seemed to gather some courage and quietly asked, "Brother Xing, may I, may I live in the room below yours?"
After saying this, Zhang Lianmeng felt her face burning hot, like a ripe apple, making one want to take a gentle bite.
Han Xing glanced at her.
Although he wanted to refuse, he recalled that this woman had saved his life, so he reconsidered and let it go.
Han Xing nodded.
Zhang Lianmeng breathed lightly, whispering, "That’s great!"
Upon reaching the middle room of the tower.
Han Xing crafted a new set of furniture for Zhang Lianmeng, including a bed, table, mirror, and moonlight lamp.
Time quietly crept into deep night.
Then, Han Xing also made several sets of clothes for her, all in simple pajama styles.
In this world, this aspect is convenient.
As long as you have blueprints and materials, you can make things anytime, anywhere.
And these basic items can all be found in the comprehensive furniture, daily essentials, and basic tools blueprint collections.
After a busy day, Han Xing was also tired, returning to his room and collapsing onto his bed, falling asleep immediately.
Coal Ball lay at Han Xing’s feet, and without his orders for the past two days, it stayed in the room without stepping out.
The night deepened.
Han Xing’s castle had changed in subtle ways, for tonight, it welcomed a new resident.
At this moment, Zhang Lianmeng laid on her bed, tightly clutching the pillow between her legs, tossing and turning in a side-lying position, unable to sleep no matter what.
"Mm... so comfortable..."
"It’s been so long since I felt what it’s like to sleep on a bed."
She couldn’t help but recall the events of the past few days.
Ever since meeting Han Xing, her life had undergone a monumental change.
Not only had he saved her from the kobolds, but he also provided her with a warm place to stay.
At this moment, Zhang Lianmeng felt like this man was the light from heaven sent to save her life.
In this perilous world, she experienced a sense of safety she had never felt before.
At this time, she couldn’t help but feel fortunate for her actions back then, secretly rejoicing, "Thankfully, I had the courage to seek your help, hehe..."
Just then, Zhang Lianmeng suddenly sniffed, twitching her nose.
"Sniff... sniff..."
She tentatively sniffed the pillow, and when she found no scent of Han Xing, her expression fell with disappointment.
At this moment, she seemed to realize that her recent actions were somewhat infatuated.
She bashfully buried her face deeply into the pillow...
Early the next morning.
Han Xing got up from bed on time.
However, as soon as he opened the door, he saw a grand... no, a beautiful woman standing at the door, wearing only thin pajamas with a white apron tied in front.
This beauty, naturally, was Zhang Lianmeng.
In her hands, she held two bowls of steaming hot porridge.
However, Han Xing realized that the pajamas he made were obviously a bit small, fitting tightly on Zhang Lianmeng, highlighting her curves almost completely.
Seeing her in this outfit made Han Xing feel an uncontrollable rush of heat.
Damn it, waking up to an apron and pajamas, which hot-blooded young man could withstand such a test?
Han Xing quickly turned his gaze aside, coughed twice, and asked, "Up so early?"
Zhang Lianmeng chuckled, nodding, "I heard you say you eat meat every day, that’s not good for your health, so I got up early to cook two bowls of porridge for you, see what flavor you like?"
She held two bowls of steaming porridge, and Han Xing noticed there were millet, red dates, and some vegetable seeds inside.
"Either will do."
Han Xing nodded, "Come in, I have a table on the balcony, let’s eat there."
Zhang Lianmeng carefully moved her steps, following Han Xing into the room.
Her eyes were full of curiosity as she looked around Han Xing’s room.
Then, she seemed to notice Coal Ball lying on the bed, exclaiming, "Ah! Such a cute little dog!"
She quickly put the porridge aside, just about to reach out and pet Coal Ball.
But she then saw Coal Ball immediately stand up from the bed, baring its teeth, looking fiercely at her.
Zhang Lianmeng felt a bit at a loss.
Han Xing reminded her, "Coal Ball is a wolf, it doesn’t like strangers touching it, so you’d best not get close."
Upon hearing Han Xing’s words, Zhang Lianmeng gave up the idea of petting Coal Ball, although her gaze remained fixed on the little wolf cub, with a face full of doting expression.
Zhang Lianmeng picked up the hot porridge again, sitting across from Han Xing.
On the top floor’s small balcony, Zhang Lianmeng looked at the scenery outside, marveling, "Ah! What a view from here."
"I never thought in this world, one could have such living conditions. I thought everyone was like me, sleeping in tents."
Han Xing didn’t respond to this topic but tasted a spoonful of millet porridge, finding it warm with a delicate taste.
He praised, "Great taste."
"Hehe, as long as you like it."
Zhang Lianmeng giggled, "I know many ways to cook porridge and make different breakfasts. I’m quite good at cooking since there are ingredients, I can make a variety of dishes for you every day."
Han Xing nodded. He had indeed heard Zhang Lianmeng mention before that she was quite skilled in the kitchen.
In such a crisis-ridden world, having someone to cook for him was good.
Thinking it over, it seemed nice indeed.
After breakfast, Zhang Lianmeng swiftly cleared the tableware and then went downstairs.
Just then, in the discussion group, Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun sent messages.
Cheng Jianyong: "Brother Xing, Shen Yun and I are about to meet up, when will you come over?"
Han Xing suddenly remembered that he had indeed said to gather at the same coordinates.
But because of Zhang Lianmeng’s task fragment, he forgot about it.
Not only did he not approach them, but he got even further away.
At this moment, Han Xing thought for a while and said, "I did a task over here and ran a bit far, I might not be able to make it there soon, it’ll take a few days."
Shen Yun then said, "Brother Xing, should the two of us come find you?"
Han Xing thought for a moment, shook his head, "No need for now—since you two are about to meet up, focus on leveling up as a team, and get the ranking rewards first."
"Once you’ve built the teleportation array, you can come over anytime."
Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun seemed to realize this too.
The rewards for this leaderboard included a Basic Teleportation Array blueprint for the top hundred.
With their skills, and the help Han Xing had provided, getting the ranking rewards wouldn’t be too hard.
Then Han Xing thought for a moment and continued, "By the way, Cheng Jianyong, Shen Yun, I have something important to tell you."
Both of them immediately grew serious.
Even Han Xing mentioned it’s important, so this matter must be quite serious.

sentences.text: This is also the current situation for the vast majority of survivors.
The fact that Han Xing could take her in already filled Zhang Lianmeng with immense gratitude.
Even if she still had to sleep in a tent outside the territory like before, she would feel very satisfied.
She never thought that Han Xing would actually let her live in the castle.
For a moment, feelings of deep gratitude toward Han Xing surged in Zhang Lianmeng’s heart.
She sincerely thanked him, "Brother Xing, thank you."
Han Xing was speechless, wasn’t it just giving her a room, was there really a need for this?
Han Xing continued, "The room at the very top of the central tower is mine, the rest, you can choose as you wish."
"Once you’ve chosen, take a look at what furniture you need, and I’ll make it for you."
Zhang Lianmeng softly replied with an "mm," looking somewhat lost as she eyed the vast space in the castle, not knowing which room to choose.
A moment later, she seemed to gather some courage and quietly asked, "Brother Xing, may I, may I live in the room below yours?"
After saying this, Zhang Lianmeng felt her face burning hot, like a ripe apple, making one want to take a gentle bite.
Han Xing glanced at her.
Although he wanted to refuse, he recalled that this woman had saved his life, so he reconsidered and let it go.
Han Xing nodded.
Zhang Lianmeng breathed lightly, whispering, "That’s great!"
Upon reaching the middle room of the tower.
Han Xing crafted a new set of furniture for Zhang Lianmeng, including a bed, table, mirror, and moonlight lamp.
Time quietly crept into deep night.
Then, Han Xing also made several sets of clothes for her, all in simple pajama styles.
In this world, this aspect is convenient.
As long as you have blueprints and materials, you can make things anytime, anywhere.
And these basic items can all be found in the comprehensive furniture, daily essentials, and basic tools blueprint collections.
After a busy day, Han Xing was also tired, returning to his room and collapsing onto his bed, falling asleep immediately.
Coal Ball lay at Han Xing’s feet, and without his orders for the past two days, it stayed in the room without stepping out.
The night deepened.
Han Xing’s castle had changed in subtle ways, for tonight, it welcomed a new resident.
At this moment, Zhang Lianmeng laid on her bed, tightly clutching the pillow between her legs, tossing and turning in a side-lying position, unable to sleep no matter what.
"Mm... so comfortable..."
"It’s been so long since I felt what it’s like to sleep on a bed."
She couldn’t help but recall the events of the past few days.
Ever since meeting Han Xing, her life had undergone a monumental change.
Not only had he saved her from the kobolds, but he also provided her with a warm place to stay.
At this moment, Zhang Lianmeng felt like this man was the light from heaven sent to save her life.
In this perilous world, she experienced a sense of safety she had never felt before.
At this time, she couldn’t help but feel fortunate for her actions back then, secretly rejoicing, "Thankfully, I had the courage to seek your help, hehe..."
Just then, Zhang Lianmeng suddenly sniffed, twitching her nose.
"Sniff... sniff..."
She tentatively sniffed the pillow, and when she found no scent of Han Xing, her expression fell with disappointment.
At this moment, she seemed to realize that her recent actions were somewhat infatuated.
She bashfully buried her face deeply into the pillow...
Early the next morning.
Han Xing got up from bed on time.
However, as soon as he opened the door, he saw a grand... no, a beautiful woman standing at the door, wearing only thin pajamas with a white apron tied in front.
This beauty, naturally, was Zhang Lianmeng.
In her hands, she held two bowls of steaming hot porridge.
However, Han Xing realized that the pajamas he made were obviously a bit small, fitting tightly on Zhang Lianmeng, highlighting her curves almost completely.
Seeing her in this outfit made Han Xing feel an uncontrollable rush of heat.
Damn it, waking up to an apron and pajamas, which hot-blooded young man could withstand such a test?
Han Xing quickly turned his gaze aside, coughed twice, and asked, "Up so early?"
Zhang Lianmeng chuckled, nodding, "I heard you say you eat meat every day, that’s not good for your health, so I got up early to cook two bowls of porridge for you, see what flavor you like?"
She held two bowls of steaming porridge, and Han Xing noticed there were millet, red dates, and some vegetable seeds inside.
"Either will do."
Han Xing nodded, "Come in, I have a table on the balcony, let’s eat there."
Zhang Lianmeng carefully moved her steps, following Han Xing into the room.
Her eyes were full of curiosity as she looked around Han Xing’s room.
Then, she seemed to notice Coal Ball lying on the bed, exclaiming, "Ah!
Such a cute little dog!"
She quickly put the porridge aside, just about to reach out and pet Coal Ball.
But she then saw Coal Ball immediately stand up from the bed, baring its teeth, looking fiercely at her.
Zhang Lianmeng felt a bit at a loss.
Han Xing reminded her, "Coal Ball is a wolf, it doesn’t like strangers touching it, so you’d best not get close."
Upon hearing Han Xing’s words, Zhang Lianmeng gave up the idea of petting Coal Ball, although her gaze remained fixed on the little wolf cub, with a face full of doting expression.
Zhang Lianmeng picked up the hot porridge again, sitting across from Han Xing.
On the top floor’s small balcony, Zhang Lianmeng looked at the scenery outside, marveling, "Ah!
What a view from here."
"I never thought in this world, one could have such living conditions.
I thought everyone was like me, sleeping in tents."
Han Xing didn’t respond to this topic but tasted a spoonful of millet porridge, finding it warm with a delicate taste.
He praised, "Great taste."
"Hehe, as long as you like it."
Zhang Lianmeng giggled, "I know many ways to cook porridge and make different breakfasts.
I’m quite good at cooking since there are ingredients, I can make a variety of dishes for you every day."
Han Xing nodded.
He had indeed heard Zhang Lianmeng mention before that she was quite skilled in the kitchen.
In such a crisis-ridden world, having someone to cook for him was good.
Thinking it over, it seemed nice indeed.
After breakfast, Zhang Lianmeng swiftly cleared the tableware and then went downstairs.
Just then, in the discussion group, Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun sent messages.
Cheng Jianyong: "Brother Xing, Shen Yun and I are about to meet up, when will you come over?"
Han Xing suddenly remembered that he had indeed said to gather at the same coordinates.
But because of Zhang Lianmeng’s task fragment, he forgot about it.
Not only did he not approach them, but he got even further away.

chapters.title: Chapter 77 - 73: Skill Book: Weakness Perception
paragraphs: Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun waited for Han Xing to speak.
After a moment, Han Xing slowly said, "While carrying out this hidden mission, I received some terrifying information."
"Next, I’m afraid there will be a disaster outbreak, and all humans from Blue Star will be victims of this disaster!"
"The timing of this disaster is still unclear, but it shouldn’t be too long from now."
"Therefore, before that, we must quickly enhance our strength and at least become a First Transformation Professional, otherwise we’ll have no power to protect ourselves."
Han Xing directly shared the information he obtained, combined with his personal inference.
In the chat channel, both of them detected the seriousness in Han Xing’s tone.
They also knew that Han Xing wouldn’t joke about something like this.
Shen Yun then asked solemnly, "Brother Xing, will this disaster be very serious?"
"Hmm, it will probably be unimaginably terrifying!"
Han Xing thought of the introduction in the formula, nearly leading to an extinction-level disaster, the severity of which would exceed everyone’s imagination.
Upon hearing this, Shen Yun gravely said, "Alright, we’ll follow your lead, quickly level up to 10, and then complete the advancement!"
After finishing the conversation, the two promptly closed the discussion group and began leveling up.
Meanwhile, Han Xing also felt a sense of urgency.
He too needed to hurry up with leveling!
Just as Han Xing was about to go downstairs, he received a private message from a friend.
The sender was Clever Xiaoyang, that is, Su Xiaoyang.
Su Xiaoyang: "Star...Star God, are you there?"
Han Xing: "I am. What’s up?"

"No...nothing much, I just wanted to ask if you need a teammate for grouping. Everyone seems to have small groups now, and they say... having a teammate makes it much safer, and there can be someone to look out for you during danger..."
"If you need one, I can come find you..."
Han Xing was speechless, thinking about the situation today, why everyone seemed to be looking for him?
He thought for a moment and still refused Su Xiaoyang’s team invitation, explaining the situation he had just shared with Shen Yun to Su Xiaoyang too.
Su Xiaoyang listened in surprise, and after a while, she asked incredulously, "Will there really be such a terrifying disaster outbreak?"
"Yes, very frightening!"
Han Xing replied, "So, our primary objective now is to level up to 10 and complete profession advancement."
After hearing this, Su Xiaoyang responded earnestly, "Yes, yes, I will. Thank you for the reminder!"
After speaking, Han Xing, after thinking for a moment, initiated a trade request with Su Xiaoyang.
Su Xiaoyang accepted, though puzzled.
Seeing that purple Longbow in the trade panel, she cried out in surprise.
"Wha...such a high-level weapon, aren’t you going to use it yourself?"
Han Xing smiled and said, "What are you thinking? Of course, I have a better one, that’s why I’m giving it to you."

Previously, when Han Xing crafted the Moon Crown Longbow, he made several Rare Quality Longbows. They were just collecting dust in the warehouse, and he didn’t want to exchange the purple weapon on the trade channel for now.
Seeing Su Xiaoyang hesitating and not daring to click confirm transaction.
Han Xing urged, "Take it and focus on leveling up. It’s just a weapon to me, it doesn’t mean much."
Su Xiaoyang took a deep breath and then placed a book in the trade panel.
Skill Book: Weakness Perception.
Seeing this skill book, Han Xing’s eyes lit up.
Every profession has five basic skills in the early stages. Han Xing had learned the other four skills but hadn’t found the last skill, ’Weakness Perception.’
At that moment, Han Xing remembered Su Xiaoyang was also a Hunter Profession.
So he asked, "You’re also a Hunter Profession, this skill book might be useful to you too, right?"
Su Xiaoyang chuckled: "It’s fine, I’ve already learned the other four skills; missing one doesn’t matter much."
"Plus, you gave me such an awesome weapon, which is much more valuable than this skill book. I can’t just take your stuff for free."
Su Xiaoyang seemed to be a person with strong principles.
Han Xing thought for a moment and then clicked accept.
[Trade Successful. You have acquired Skill Book: Weakness Perception (Hunter Exclusive), and lost Moon Crown Longbow (Purple).]
[Weakness Perception]: After activating the skill, enter a ten-second Weakness Perception state, increasing hit rate by 50%, and critical strike rate by 50%.
Han Xing directly clicked to learn.
Now, he had learned all five skills in the early stages for the Hunter profession!
Next, it’s time to start leveling up.
When Han Xing descended the castle, he saw Zhang Lianmeng, already dressed in a Mage’s Robe, standing nearby with a smile, waiting for him.
Zhang Lianmeng softly asked, "Next, are we going to start leveling up?"
Han Xing nodded.
Zhang Lianmeng took a deep breath, waved her Magic Staff, seemingly encouraging herself, "Alright, I definitely won’t hold you back!"
Han Xing glanced at her, thinking how wonderful a considerate woman was.
Then, Han Xing scanned the surroundings.
He discovered not far away, there was a cloud of over a hundred square meters.
As he approached, a system prompt appeared, "A group of low intelligence creatures is active inside, would you like to enter?"
Han Xing clicked yes immediately.
As the cloud dissipated, a group of Dogmen figures appeared once again.
They raised Beast Bone Mallets, shouting loudly.
"Candles! Give me candles!"
"It’s humans, kill them!"
Looking at this familiar group of monsters, Zhang Lianmeng couldn’t help but feel a tightness in her heart. She instinctively raised her Magic Staff, ready to launch a magical attack.
However, a Black Shadow rushed forward faster than she could.
This Black Shadow was Coal Ball.
Coal Ball charged into the Dogman Tribe, like a tiger entering a flock of sheep, beginning a great slaughter.
Swish! Swish swish!
In an instant, many bloody marks appeared on these few Dogmen.
Then, black light constantly flashed, and these Dogmen howled miserably.
Even more terrifying, ten seconds after entering the battle.
Coal Ball suddenly burst out with ten terrifying spikes, directly piercing through the bodies of the Dogmen, putting them into a severely injured State.
At this moment, Zhang Lianmeng was still standing dumbfounded.
Han Xing reminded her, "Don’t stare blankly, throw a Skill to get some damage, or you won’t get Experience."
The team system in this world is like this, you must deal damage to the enemies to gain shared Experience.
Zhang Lianmeng seemed to react at this time. She quickly raised her Magic Staff, softly murmuring a Spell.
"Burning Flames, consume everything!"
As her words fell, a face-sized Fireball erupted from her Magic Staff, landing in the Dogman crowd, creating explosive damage.
Han Xing even noticed that when this woman wielded her Magic Staff, the magnificent scale trembled up and down once again.
Han Xing laughed and said, "How come it feels like you should choose a Holy Profession kind of Profession."
Zhang Lianmeng looked puzzled, "Huh? Why?"
"Because you can nurse others."
Zhang Lianmeng seemed to understand the meaning in Han Xing’s words, her face instantly turned extremely red.
But she didn’t lower her head like before, instead, she tightly gripped her Magic Staff, holding her head high.
Although still very shy, and even feeling a bit ashamed inside, she no longer shunned Han Xing’s gaze, but rather liked this feeling.
At this moment, the Coal Ball had already finished combat there.
System prompts appeared.
[Dogman Wizard lv9, Dogman Warrior lv8, Dogman... killed, gained Experience Value 810, pet Coal Ball gained Experience Value 648.]
Compared to before, Han Xing felt the Experience Value gained was a bit less, but not by much, about 20% less.
This is because another team member shares the Experience.
However, Zhang Lianmeng also gained 810 Experience Value.
Overall, teaming is faster for Experience gain than soloing, 20% less Experience but the speed of monster killing is greatly increased.
The premise being the strength of the two teammates is somewhat similar.
But for Han Xing, having the energetic little boss Coal Ball ahead, losing 20% Experience is nothing.
Next, he continued leveling up.
After an hour, Han Xing directly reached Level 9.
He was only one level away from reaching Level 10 and gaining the first-place reward.
On the leaderboard now, the fastest was only the Whisperer who had just reached Level 8, with a huge gap between them, making almost everyone lose the desire to chase.
From morning till evening, Han Xing had explored over twenty Sky Islands, gathering a large amount of resources and Experience Value.
His Experience bar had reached 50% of Level 9, without accident, he should reach Level 10 tomorrow.
And Zhang Lianmeng’s Level had also reached Level 7 after a whole day of piggybacking.
For this, Zhang Lianmeng felt very embarrassed, feeling she hadn’t contributed at all, just leaching off Han Xing’s Experience.
However, Han Xing said, "You don’t need to act on these low-level small monsters now, leveling up now means you’ll provide more help when we encounter stronger bosses in the future."
Zhang Lianmeng listened, seriously nodded.
At this time, the Sun had already set, and Han Xing was preparing to explore one last Sky Island and then take a rest.
But in this Sky Island Territory, he heard a different prompt.
"There is a piece of fertile land inside, growing some crops, do you want to enter?"
"Fertile land?"
Han Xing heard the different prompt and directly clicked to enter.
After the clouds dispersed, Han Xing suddenly saw a patch of green on the hundred-plus square Sky Island.
"What’s this thing?"
However, beside him, when Zhang Lianmeng saw the green leaves on the ground, her eyes immediately lit up.
"Oh my god, so many potatoes!"
Zhang Lianmeng excitedly rushed over, then dug one after another fist-sized, soil-yellow potatoes from the soil.
At this moment, Han Xing, who had never farmed before, felt like an idiot.
He unexpectedly didn’t recognize potatoes.
Zhang Lianmeng held up two potatoes, excitedly said to Han Xing, "Brother Xing, we have potatoes to eat now!"
Her face radiated a pure smile, like a little girl who struck treasure.
Han Xing seemed to be infected by this, also laughed along.
With the system prompt, Han Xing merged this hundred-plus square Sky Island.

chapters.title: Chapter 78 - 74: Midnight Ambush
paragraphs: [You have obtained fertile land *121, you have obtained ’potato’ crops weighing 45 kilograms, and your territory area has expanded.]
In the outer area of Han Xing’s territory, a patch of deep black land appeared, on which many fully grown potatoes were planted.
At this moment, Zhang Lianmeng’s eyes lit up, "Brother Xing, can I use this piece of land for growing vegetables?"
"During today’s exploration, I discovered a lot of vegetable seeds, including eggplant, cabbage, radish, morning glory..."
Han Xing glanced at her, "So, you’ve been squatting on those Sky Islands all day to find these seeds?"
"Yes, yes!"
Zhang Lianmeng nodded excitedly, "I’m thinking of growing a lot of vegetables for you in the future, keeping your nutrition balanced."
Han Xing nodded, "Sure, this piece of land will be your little vegetable garden. I’ll rely on you for vegetables from now on."
"Yes, yes, thank you, Brother Xing!" Zhang Lianmeng nodded excitedly.
Zhang Lianmeng immediately ran into the castle, took out a few small hoes, and started farming.
Han Xing discovered that Zhang Lianmeng was indeed a farming fanatic, showing 100% enthusiasm for such matters.
Moreover, in some aspects, she even understood this world’s mechanics better than Han Xing.
And now, she’s asking Han Xing for some bones.
"Brother Xing, grinding the bones to powder and sprinkling them on the land can increase its nutrients and speed up the growth of these crops."
Han Xing nodded and said, "I have plenty of beast bones stocked up in the storage box, you can take them yourself."
Han Xing granted Zhang Lianmeng access to the storage box.
Generally, if the territory owner is alive or hasn’t given permission, other survivors cannot open the storage box within the territory.
Zhang Lianmeng ran again to the warehouse area in the castle, opened one of the storage boxes, and was immediately stunned by the vast array of materials inside, like a sea of treasures.
"Oh my god..."
Zhang Lianmeng exclaimed but didn’t think much, picking up a few arm-thick large bones and heading back outside the castle.
Under Han Xing’s intrigued gaze.
Zhang Lianmeng placed the bones on a grinding table made of stone, then picked up a stone hammer and diligently tried to crush the bones.
But it seemed that these beast bones were too hard, and her strength was insufficient, unable to break them apart even after many attempts.
At this moment, Han Xing was watching her as she lifted the stone hammer, putting in a tremendous effort to smash the bones.
Bang! Bang! Bang!
Seeing this, Han Xing swallowed and stepped forward, saying, "Let me do it, your strength is too low to break these bones."
Zhang Lianmeng wiped the sweat off her forehead, her face flushed as if from exertion, looking at Han Xing with dreamy eyes.
At this time, Zhang Lianmeng’s Mage’s Robe was soaked with sweat, her slender clothes accentuating her devilish figure, along with that unique aroma of hers.
Even the air seemed to emit an alluring scent.
This appearance could almost instantly stir a certain desire deep in a man’s heart.
Han Xing took several deep breaths to barely control himself.
He walked up next to Zhang Lianmeng and picked up the bones.
Of course, Han Xing wouldn’t foolishly continue smashing the bones like that, as it was too inefficient.
So, he directly summoned a Spiritual Puppet.
Under Zhang Lianmeng’s astonished gaze, the Spiritual Puppet grabbed the bones, placed them in its palm, and then a steel hand slammed down.
Crack!
The bones were directly crushed into powder.
"So...so amazing..." Zhang Lianmeng exclaimed.
Han Xing looked at her worshipful gaze, silently reciting the Heart Clarity Spell in his heart.
Then he controlled the puppet to sprinkle the bone meal on the territory, and the system prompt appeared.
[Bone meal fertilization succeeded, this land will provide more nutrients for crops, accelerating the crop growth cycle.]
Zhang Lianmeng wiped the sweat off her forehead and said, "Brother Xing, you take a break, I’ll go cook."
And as she spoke, she lifted the corner of her Mage’s Robe, stepped lightly, swaying her hips as she walked away.
Watching her busy herself back and forth, Han Xing thought to himself, "This woman is really virtuous."
"And, her hips are quite large..."
Having someone like this to handle logistics for him seems not bad.
With these thoughts, Zhang Lianmeng had already prepared a table full of delicious dishes.
Since coming to this world, Han Xing hadn’t tasted such delicious meals in a long time and immediately began to devour them ravenously.
Zhang Lianmeng, holding her cheeks in her hands with a full-face silly smile, watched Han Xing, her face beaming with a happy smile.
This scene seemed to be what she had always dreamed of.
Han Xing noticed her oddness and asked, "What’s up?"
"Nothing, nothing."
Zhang Lianmeng shook her head, and after a moment, she said a bit bashfully, "Um... um, I’ve sweated a lot today, could I use some water to take a bath?"
Han Xing was a bit stunned and nodded, "Sure, use as much as you need, there’s plenty of water resources in the storage box."
The last time it rained, Han Xing stored up two storage box spaces full of water for daily needs.
Zhang Lianmeng nodded, her face flushed as she returned to the castle.
Under Han Xing’s guidance, he specially allocated a room for her to wash up.
After all, there were plenty of rooms, plenty to choose from.
As Han Xing passed by, he heard the sound of rushing water, leading to endless daydreams...
In the middle of the night.
Han Xing continued to sit on his balcony, watching the stars.
At this moment, he suddenly noticed something unusual in the distance.
In the moonlight, it seemed like two territories of survivors were moving toward him.
"Hmm? Have I encountered other survivors again?"
Han Xing took out his weapon, preparing to watch the situation unfold.
Strangely, these two survivors stopped about a kilometer away from Han Xing,
They did not intend to approach, and after observing for a while, they turned around and left.
"Left?"
Han Xing put his weapon back into his backpack, thought for a moment, and decided not to dwell on it.
However, shortly after these two survivors left,
one of the human hunters was excitedly making a call to report the situation!
"Boss, we found the territory you mentioned!"
"There’s a castle over twenty meters high on that territory, and this territory has three or four levels, at least four or five thousand cubic meters, it should be the one you’re looking for."
At this moment, a middle-aged man with a grim expression heard the news, and finally, a change appeared on his ashen face.
This middle-aged man was the Whisperer.
Listening to his subordinate’s report, he hurriedly said, "Did you record a video? Send it to me."
"Okay, boss!"
A video file was sent over.
After viewing the video footage, the Whisperer finally confirmed that this was the person he was looking for, a rare smile appeared on his face.
"Good, good, good, well done, you two can immediately go to Huang Wen to receive your reward."
The two survivors thanked him excitedly.
After hanging up the call, the Whisperer clenched his fist, excitedly saying, "Star River, finally, I’ve found you!"
Thinking of this, the Whisperer called for the previous Huang Wen, as one of the few trusted confidants under him, the Whisperer regarded him with great trust.
In the night, a warrior clad in light armor quietly arrived at the Whisperer’s territory.
The Whisperer whispered a few words into Huang Wen’s ear.
"Star River has already reached level 9, and will reach level 10 tomorrow, securing the first-place reward."
"Huang Wen, tonight is the time to act."
This seemingly small man had a trace of solemnity in his eyes.
The Whisperer solemnly instructed, "Remember, find trustworthy brothers, this matter must not be exposed..."
After a moment, he nodded and said, "Understood, boss, I’ll arrange it right away."
As Huang Wen silently retreated, a hint of murderous intent flashed across the Whisperer’s face.
"Star River, don’t blame me, I originally didn’t want to make a move against you."
"But last time in the Secret Realm, we lost too many brothers, even I barely managed to come back alive."
"The Divine Whisper Team is critically injured, and urgently needs a large amount of resources to regain strength."
"Although there is no deep hatred between you and me, you have gathered too many resources. These resources can only realize their value when they’re in the hands of us large teams."
"So, don’t blame me for being ruthless..."
That night, several survivors simultaneously received a secret message, their hearts stirred as they received identical coordinates.
Simultaneously, under intentional arrangement, eight survivors’ Sky Islands began their operation in the deep of night.
Their target was none other than the location of Han Xing’s Sky Island.
Deep into the night.
Han Xing was in a deep sleep.
In the room below him, Zhang Lianmeng was also peacefully asleep.
At this moment, eight Sky Island territories were slowly approaching him.
As the eight Sky Islands gathered together.
The Coal Ball at his feet was the first to wake up, as a Void Ghost Wolf, it had an innate sense of danger and malice.
In a flash of black light, Coal Ball jumped onto the balcony.
Upon seeing the unusual situation at the boundary of the territory, Coal Ball instantly darted back to Han Xing’s bedside, gently nudging his shoulder with its paw.
Han Xing sensed Coal Ball’s anomaly, and immediately woke up.
The moment he opened his eyes, he noticed something was off with Coal Ball’s expression, and it was also glancing outside the window from time to time.
Han Xing realized something was amiss.
Following Coal Ball’s guidance, he moved to the window.
Then, Han Xing immediately noticed eight sneaky figures entering his territory.
In the dead of night, these survivors united and quietly infiltrated someone else’s territory.
Saying they had no scheme, not even ghosts would believe it.
Han Xing’s face turned cold, and he silently took out the Legendary Longbow.
At this moment, these guys still didn’t know Han Xing was awake and had already discovered their traces.
These survivors looked at the enormous castle in front of them, eyes filled with greed.
Then, these survivors exchanged glances, one after another taking out palm-sized bamboo tubes from their backpacks...

chapters.title: Chapter 79 - 75: Annihilation
paragraphs: Han Xing also noticed their movements.
The bamboo tubes they brought out seemed unusual, with fuses set on the front end.
These are actually homemade makeshift explosives!
They came with ill-intentions...
Han Xing furrowed his brows.
These people were fully equipped, thoroughly prepared, and their lineup composition was quite reasonable.
Two Stalkers, two Warriors, two Mages, a Hunter, and a Holy Profession.
For ordinary Survivors, facing such an array, there would be no chance to resist.
This was also the first time Han Xing encountered an invasion by other Survivors.
But he wasn’t panicking.
Han Xing slowly drew the bowstring, a hint of killing intent flashing in his eyes.
Eight intruders, each holding several makeshift explosive tubes.
Just then, the leading Human Warrior spoke softly, "Ignite the flame, throw them out together, blast open the castle gate, and then launch a direct assault!"
The others nodded repeatedly.
When one Human Hunter was about to light the fuse.
An arrow shot from the top of the castle with lightning speed.
Shoo!
In the next moment, the arrow hit the hunter’s brow, piercing through the brain.
Puff!
A blood hole appeared on the Human Hunter’s forehead, and his body collapsed limply.
An information alert came: "You have caused damage to the Survivor ’Dragon Tamer’, successfully executing the kill."
It turned out the Survivor was called Dragon Tamer. Han Xing recalled in his mind but found no previous acquaintance or interaction with this person.
The remaining seven intruders watched in horror as their teammate’s body fell, faces full of shock.
"Little Dragon!"
"Damn it! We’ve been discovered!"
"Everyone, direct assault!"
With the leading Human Warrior’s command, they ignited the fuses on their explosive tubes.
"Throw!"
With those words, the remaining seven intruders simultaneously threw their explosive tubes out.
However, Han Xing merely glanced and didn’t care at all.
He scornfully said, "A bunch of fools, my castle has 1000 Defense Value points, if your small firecrackers can peel off a layer, I’ll admit defeat!"
Sure enough, seven explosive tubes were thrown to the entrance of the iron gate of the castle.
After a series of intense explosions, the gate stood firm.
Han Xing checked the castle’s state.
Remaining Defense Value: 963.
A wave of explosions had only reduced the Defense Value by 37 points.
The intruders were bewildered, as their proud self-made explosive tubes with powerful might proved ineffective.
And at that moment, taking advantage of their confusion, Han Xing poked his head out again and shot an arrow.
Shoo!
This arrow pierced through a Human Mage’s chest.
Faced with team battles, always kill the squishy ones first.
Han Xing also believed in this truth.
The Human Mage stared blankly at his chest, then spit out a mouthful of blood and fell.
[You have caused damage to the Survivor ’Amber Flowing Light’, successfully executing the kill.]
The remaining Survivors were in a state of panic.
"Damn it, that guy is in the tower. Mages and other long-range units, aim at that window and attack with full force!"
"Others, follow me over the wall and finish him!"
However, with Han Xing having killed two ranged units, only the Mage and Holy Profession had some ranged attack capabilities left.
These people had decent combat awareness; after Han Xing killed the second person, the Mage immediately attacked.
A Large Fireball surged forward.
Han Xing slightly shifted to dodge.
Bang!
With an explosive sound, the balcony area outside the wall was scorched black.
Meanwhile, the Holy Profession also threw a Holy Light Ball at him.
Han Xing was forced temporarily back into the room, eyes flickering, and in the next moment, a dark silhouette sprang out.
The Coal Ball flashed, directly rushing to the top of the Mage’s head.
The leading Warrior quickly warned, "Old Xu, something is flying towards you, be careful!"
The Mage’s face turned pale instantly as he hurriedly raised his Magic Staff.
However, at his speed, he was no match for the Coal Ball.
Swish! Swish!
A flash of cold light, wolf claws swiped, and the Mage screamed, two deep blood marks appearing on his face.
And that was just the beginning.
Against enemies, Coal Ball displayed the same ferocity it showed against monsters, its body beginning to flash with dark light.
Given the Mage’s equipment strength, only a Green Quality Magic Robe, it was as fragile as paper against Coal Ball’s attack.
Chunks of flesh flew, and each swipe of the wolf claw cut deep, exposing bone.
"Ahhh!!!"
The scream of the Human Mage was spine-chilling.
"Old Xu, what’s happening over there?"
"What the hell is that thing?"
Coal Ball’s power and unthinkable speed terrified them.
The Human Holy Profession stood still, holding the Bronze Holy Hammer, seemingly bewildered.
Just then, Han Xing poked his head out once more.
Double Arrow shot forth.
The target was the Holy Profession.
In the critical moment, the Human Holy Profession hurriedly wrapped himself in a Holy Light Shield.
This gave him a sense of security.
Usually, in times of danger, the Holy Light Shield provided strong defense, capable of blocking several attacks.
However, what he didn’t know was that against Han Xing’s attack, the Holy Light Shield was negligible.
The next moment, a crisp sound of shattering was heard.
Crack!
The Holy Light Shield shattered.
The Human Holy Profession watched as two arrows penetrated the chest armor’s defense, burying entirely into his chest.
"Such... terrifying Attack Power..."
Upon finishing his sentence, his body slumped, slowly falling down.
On the other side, Coal Ball also finished off the Mage.

chapters.title: Chapter 81 - 76: Night Burns Like Fire
paragraphs: Looking at the corpses on the ground, Han Xing pondered.
"There’s no clue, but from their conversation, I can deduce that these people must have planned this."
"And it sounds like this is not the first time they’ve done this, they seem pretty skilled."
"It’s just unfortunate for them that they ran into me."
After obtaining this information, Han Xing continued to search these people.
[Acquired Bronze Staff*1, homemade explosive canisters*3, gunpowder*17...]
The loot was fairly average, apart from some green equipment, just a bit of materials.
Han Xing then began to search the second corpse, which seemed to be the Warrior who issued orders.
On him, Han Xing found a blue Great Sword, along with some fairly average materials.
After finishing searching all eight corpses, Han Xing couldn’t help but curse.
"Penniless bastards."
The equipment on these Survivors were a mix of ordinary green and blue, and the quality was very low.
Han Xing was completely uninterested.
At this moment, Han Xing suddenly noticed the boundary of the territory, those eight Survivor Sky Islands, each not less than a thousand square meters, making his eyes light up.
This was his first time encountering already-deceased Survivor Sky Islands.
"These guys are all dead, so their territories should be able to merge with mine, right?" Han Xing pondered.
The next moment.
System notifications appeared.

[You have merged with unclaimed Sky Island, acquired territory pieces 1433, acquired core lands*2, acquired territory resources: Spirit Core*4512, homemade explosive canisters*12, acquired Refined Iron*3213, acquired...]

[You have merged with unclaimed Sky Island, acquired territory pieces 1012, acquired core lands*1, acquired territory resources, Dark Fire Stone*775, Mithril*93, acquired Bronze Battleaxe*1, acquired...]
[You have merged with unclaimed Sky Island...]
Eight notifications came in succession, and Han Xing’s territory expanded nearly 10,000 square meters in just a few seconds!
The total area directly doubled.
"Damn!"
This terrifying speed of expansion put Han Xing in a bewildered state.
A moment later, looking at his colossal territory, which suddenly reached over 15,000 square meters, Han Xing’s face showed an uncontrollable smile.
"Very good, is this how it goes?"
"No wonder these guys like to commit murder and robbery, damn, this bounty is more than terrifying."
Han Xing gained over 10,000 square meters of land by killing eight people, more than what he had painstakingly explored for over ten days.
Moreover, aside from the territory, there were also a large amount of materials.
The gains these eight people collected over nearly half a month were all taken by Han Xing.
With such a large territory, he could use it for many things.
At this time, Han Xing also noticed a different notification in the system.
In addition to these territories, he also obtained nine core lands.
Han Xing remembered, when first entering this world, the system mentioned that everyone has a core land under their feet, which serves as the foundation for future development...
Could it be?
He looked at the status bar, the territory column, his core lands had increased from 1 to 10, leaving him astonished.
"Wow, it really is!"
Han Xing tried to manipulate these newly acquired 9 core lands, finding they all flew towards him and hovered in front of him.
At this moment, Han Xing more or less understood the function of core lands.
This is equivalent to a new territory keystone, which can be used to create a few more Sky Islands.
On a day in the future, if your Sky Island reaches a large scale and becomes inconvenient to move, you can choose to settle down somewhere.
Then control the new core lands to create another Sky Island.
At this point, Han Xing suddenly thought of something, "Can these core lands be given to other Survivors?"
He thought of Zhang Lianmeng.
Last time, to protect Han Xing, Zhang Lianmeng’s core land was blown up, causing the collapse of her territory.
Han Xing had previously thought, if Survivors lose their territory, could they never make a comeback?
But now, these 9 core lands before him gave him the answer.
There is a way, and that is to eliminate other Survivors and seize their core lands, akin to stealing their nests.
"Previously, I promised that woman I would help her restore her territory, never thought it could be achieved so quickly."
Han Xing’s lips curved into a relaxed smile, he planned to talk to Zhang Lianmeng about this matter tomorrow.
At this time, Han Xing looked at the corpses on the ground again, already having some deductions in his heart.
"This group should be related to the two Survivors I saw during the day."
"Did they see my castle within the territory and get greedy?"
At this stage, no Survivor could build such a large territory and structure like Han Xing.
Even if there were architectural blueprints, the required materials would be enough to keep them collecting for a long time.
And Han Xing’s castle should be unique.
Therefore, Han Xing deduced that this group likely became greedy at the sight of his wealth, planning to kill him and plunder his territory.
Otherwise, he couldn’t think of another reason why these guys came to attack his Sky Island in the middle of the night.
Fearing these guys had accomplices, Han Xing controlled his Sky Island Territory to travel hundreds of kilometers overnight.
Seeing that there was still some time before morning, Han Xing decided to go back and take a nap.
To be safe, he instructed the Coal Ball to patrol outside the territory temporarily.
Meanwhile.
Whisperer received a report from his subordinate Huang Wen.
"Did the action fail?"
He pondered, his face showing not a trace of frustration after the failure, but instead a hint of a successful smile.
"Very good, in that case, let’s proceed with the next step of the plan tomorrow."
After Han Xing returned to the room on the top floor of the tower, he reflected on the gains from this battle.
This was also his first time clashing with other survivors.
The strength of these people couldn’t be called strong, but it wasn’t too bad either.
With the advantage of terrain and equipment, Han Xing could thoroughly suppress them.
But if it were in an open area, Han Xing couldn’t guarantee that he could handle it as easily.
"I still need to quickly enhance my own strength and then promptly build up the territory’s defense system."
"At the very least, I need to make sure others can’t just land on my territory freely."
"I remember, among the rewards for first place, there’s a blueprint for a Spiritual Shield Tower and a leader-level Golden Armor Puppet."
"After taking first place tomorrow, just build the defense tower immediately, then the territory’s defense should be significantly enhanced!"
Han Xing decided to level up as soon as dawn breaks, aiming to reach level 10 within the day!
Just as he was about to fall asleep, a knock suddenly sounded at the door.
Han Xing looked puzzled, as only he and Zhang Lianmeng were in this castle.
What is this woman up to in the middle of the night without sleeping?
Recalling the impulsive action he took downstairs earlier, the alluring figure reappeared in Han Xing’s mind.
Han Xing opened the door and immediately saw Zhang Lianmeng standing outside, wearing thin pajamas and looking nervous.
She was slightly panting, her cheeks flushed red.
Han Xing asked in confusion, "Is there something you need?"
Zhang Lianmeng hesitated as she heard Han Xing speak, seemingly at a loss for words.
Moments later, she seemed to muster her courage, taking a deep breath and asking, "Well, I’m a bit scared and can’t sleep alone in that room."
"Can I, can I sleep in your room?"
Han Xing was taken aback.
At this moment, he remembered.
In Zhang Lianmeng’s room, someone had indeed just died, so feeling scared was normal.
He thought Zhang Lianmeng wanted to swap rooms with him, so he nodded and said, "Sure, I’ll gather my things, you sleep up here tonight, I’ll go downstairs."
Han Xing wasn’t too superstitious about these things.
Zhang Lianmeng hurriedly replied, "No, don’t!"
"I... I didn’t mean that."
"I want to be in the same room with you, I’m scared..."
After saying this, she seemed to have used all her courage, lowering her head deeply.
She was waiting for Han Xing’s answer.
In the moonlight, Zhang Lianmeng stood barefoot, her legs as white as jade tightly together, looking uneasy and anxious.
Han Xing could even see her ample form rising and falling with her breathing.
At this moment, Zhang Lianmeng seemed to be so shy that her entire skin radiated a reddish tinge, and even from a distance, it seemed possible to feel the rising warmth from her body.
If Han Xing still didn’t understand what she meant, he would be a fool.
Recalling what had happened downstairs, Han Xing’s heart was also filled with warmth.
He suddenly grabbed Zhang Lianmeng’s wrist and pulled her into his arms.
Zhang Lianmeng apparently hadn’t expected Han Xing to take such a bold action, letting out a soft sound.
However, the next moment, she found her legs off the ground, her entire being was lifted by Han Xing.
Zhang Lianmeng’s delicate body trembled, instinctively wrapping her arms tightly around Han Xing’s neck.
At this moment, Zhang Lianmeng felt as if the world was spinning, as if in a dream.
She heard the heavy and powerful breath of the man, even beneath his solid chest, she could hear the intense beating of his heart.
"Brother Xing..." Zhang Lianmeng murmured softly, then buried her head in Han Xing’s chest.
Han Xing gently placed the beauty in his arms onto the bed, turning his back.
Rustle...
The sound of clothes being removed.
Lying on the bed, Zhang Lianmeng bit her lip, her heart instinctively tightened upon hearing the sound.
Yet along with the tension came a little tingling and anticipation...
Her beautiful eyes shimmering, she stared at the young man’s back. Thinking about what was about to happen made her nervously clamp her legs together even tighter.
Han Xing turned around, looking at the beauty on the bed.
Moonlight spilled across the pillow, under its glow, her fair skin appeared blushing with a shy pink.
As Han Xing’s face drew closer to Zhang Lianmeng, she felt her heart skip a beat.
"Have you made up your mind?" Han Xing asked solemnly.
Zhang Lianmeng knew what he meant, blushing all over, and gently nodded.
Han Xing no longer hesitated.
The night was enchanting, and soon the room in the castle was filled with suppressed murmurs.
"Brother Xing..."
"Brother Xing..."
After a sweet moan, the beauty’s rapid breaths gradually calmed down.
