chapters.title: Chapter 82 - 77: Securing First Place!
paragraphs: The next day.
At dawn, Han Xing opened his eyes.
At this time, Han Xing usually stands up and goes to the balcony to see the scenery outside.
But today was different.
Because in his arms, there was a beautiful woman with a slightly flushed face, looking radiant.
Zhang Lianmeng was still asleep with her eyes closed.
Han Xing didn’t wake her up.
He knew Zhang Lianmeng was exhausted from last night.
He prepared to withdraw his arm from beneath her neck.
It was then that Han Xing’s movement seemed to awaken the sleeping Zhang Lianmeng.
She half-opened her drowsy eyes and softly said, "Brother Xing, you’re awake?"
After the first taste of passion, Zhang Lianmeng’s demeanor had become more mature and alluring.
"Hmm." Han Xing responded.
Then, there was a long silence.
Both seemed awkward and out of words at that moment.
After a while, Zhang Lianmeng took the initiative to break the silence saying:
She seemed to have remembered something, a bit frightened, said, "Bro... Brother Xing..."
"I was the one who initiated last night. If... if you didn’t like it, we can pretend it never happened."
After saying this, she struggled to put on a forced smile towards Han Xing.
However, to Han Xing, that smile was somewhat heart-wrenching.
Moments later, Han Xing shook his head and said, "What are you talking about? Do you think I, Han Xing, am the kind of person to disregard after taking advantage?"
Zhang Lianmeng desperately shook her head, "I-I didn’t mean that."
Han Xing gently pulled her into his arms and slowly said, "When you selflessly saved me last time, I actually thought you were a great woman."
"After coming to this world, human social order has long collapsed. For survival, people inevitably become selfish."
Moments later, Han Xing solemnly said, "Zhang Lianmeng, if no one cares for you in this world from now on, let me take care of you."
Listening to Han Xing’s words, akin to a confession, Zhang Lianmeng paused momentarily, her eyes gradually moistening.
Han Xing feared he might have scared her. As someone who never interacted with girls, he couldn’t think of comforting words in that moment.
However, just then, Zhang Lianmeng suddenly lifted her fringed forehead and moved closer.
In this instant, Han Xing seemed to abandon thinking, only feeling warmth and sweetness.
Soft panting noises continuously came from Zhang Lianmeng’s mouth.
Minutes later, she became increasingly proactive, even pressed up against him.
Feeling the heat from his embrace, it seemed to reignite Han Xing’s heart.
Minutes later, the room echoed with the gentle gasps of a woman once more.
"Brother Xing, I’m almost out of breath..."
"Brother Xing..."
The sound gradually faded, turning into soft whispers amidst the passion.
When the day fully brightened.
Zhang Lianmeng was already up from the bed.
Han Xing lay on the bed, staring at the breathtaking silhouette of Zhang Lianmeng, feeling somewhat dazed...
After experiencing so much last night, Zhang Lianmeng truly transformed from a girl into a woman, becoming more charming overall.
Coupled with her devilish figure, every move seemed to captivate all of Han Xing’s attention.
Zhang Lianmeng turned slightly, seeing Han Xing half-naked, her face flushed as she said, "I’ll go make you breakfast. You’ll need energy to fight monsters."
After speaking, she hastily fled the room.
Han Xing chuckled, got up from the bed, dressed his equipment, and headed out.
Meanwhile, Coal Ball continued to leisurely roam within the territory, and upon seeing Han Xing emerge, it excitedly kicked all four legs and darted towards him.
Han Xing knelt down with a smile, gently petting its head.
But today, Coal Ball seemed different; it sniffed Han Xing’s hand, then his legs.
It seemed to smell something different on Han Xing.
Coal Ball curiously glanced at Han Xing, then at Zhang Lianmeng who was cooking nearby.
Han Xing felt a bit embarrassed, quickly taking out a Spirit Core from his backpack to feed Coal Ball.
With food available, Coal Ball no longer fixated on Han Xing’s scent.
As it consumed Spirit Cores one after another, system prompts followed in succession.
[Feeding successful, pet ’Coal Ball’ Potential Value +1.]
[Feeding successful, pet ’Coal Ball’ Potential Value +1.]
With over thirty Spirit Cores consumed, Coal Ball’s satiety returned to 100.
Han Xing noticed the Potential Value of Coal Ball’s Growth.
[Growth: S+ (Pet growth can be enhanced through Potential Value; for every 10,000 Potential Value, enhancement occurs once. Current Potential Value: 215)]
After several days of feeding, Coal Ball’s growth had made considerable progress, but there’s still a long way to reach 10,000 Potential Value.
After breakfast.
Han Xing took Zhang Lianmeng to continue leveling up.
However, the atmosphere between the two felt strange.
Zhang Lianmeng became even shyer and often zoned out, staring at Han Xing’s back. Several times Han Xing had to remind her to cast spells.
Fortunately, with Han Xing and the Coal Ball by her side, Zhang Lianmeng wouldn’t be in any danger.
Moreover, Zhang Lianmeng noticed today that Han Xing had become much more patient with her.
This warmed her heart.
After a whole day of leveling up, Han Xing’s experience bar was steadily rising, while his territory was rapidly expanding.
By evening.
Han Xing put away his arrows, and a Level 10 Elite Level Fierce Tiger lay dead at his feet.
At this moment, a system prompt came.
[Successfully killed Striped Fierce Tiger (One-star Elite Level) lv10, gained 7320 Experience Value, pet Coal Ball gained 5856 Experience Value]
[Your level has increased, current level is LV10.]
As a white light flashed across Han Xing, he finally reached Level 10.
At the same time, a system prompt appeared.
[You have successfully reached Level 10, meeting the leveling ranking requirements, current rank 1.]

[You have received ranking rewards: [Spiritual Energy Shield Pyramid Construction Plan]*1, [Golden Armor Puppet]*1, [Basic Teleportation Array Construction Plan]*1 [Basic Lord’s House Construction Plan]*1, [Golden Weapon Selection Blueprint]*1, [Golden Treasure Chest]*1, Spirit Core*10000.]
A pile of rewards was bestowed upon Han Xing.
Soon after Han Xing received the first-place reward, an intense discussion erupted in the chat channel of District 107.
"As expected, Star God claimed the first place, and this time with a crushing advantage!"
"Indeed, this leveling speed is unparalleled."
"Truly terrifying, I just reached Level 7, no idea how Star God achieves it."
Han Xing’s leveling speed once again shattered their understanding.
At this time, other Survivors said.
"But from now on, those people will also start exerting efforts, right? Although the first-place reward has an owner, the subsequent rewards aren’t bad either."
"Who do you think will be second? That’s 5 Elite Level Puppet Guards and a Golden Treasure Chest!"
"It’s hard to say, the first tier has all reached Level 8, Whisperer and Black Eagle are the most promising."

"However, that Lone Brave and Yun Tianming also have great potential, I heard they seem to have a relationship with Star God, with Star God’s help, these two are strong contenders for second place too!"
"Friends of Star God? Indeed, they have great potential!"
While the other Survivors were discussing the rankings.
Han Xing had already started checking the rewards he just received.
He first picked up a blueprint, and the blueprint information surfaced.

[Spiritual Energy Shield Pyramid Construction Plan (Basic)]: Territorial Building, constructs a pyramid capable of generating a Spiritual Shield, the Spiritual Shield can resist physical and magic attacks, Pyramid Defense Value is 500, Shield Defense Value is: 200.
Han Xing directly clicked to learn, as he had always yearned for a defensive building, and now he finally got it.
Then, he checked the construction requirements in the blueprint section.
[Spiritual Shield Crystal Tower (Basic)]: Based on the territory size, a corresponding number of Spirit Cores are required to generate a circular Spiritual Shield.
The Spiritual Shield can defend against physical and magic attacks with a Defense Value of 200.
[Construction Materials Required]: Refined Iron*30000, Mithril*1000, Magic Crystal*10000, Rare Earth*50000, Ether*50000, Spirit Core*20000.
Note: Survivors can adjust the shield size according to territory area, from a diameter of 10 meters to 200 meters, requiring corresponding Spirit Cores to provide Energy.
"This is it!"
Han Xing exclaimed excitedly.
With this pyramid, he could construct a shield with a defense value of 200, and with the castle’s bonus, it’s 240 defense value.
Other survivors or monsters wanting to invade his territory would first have to break through this shield.
Security was greatly assured!
"Great, great, now those little brats can’t launch a surprise attack on me at night anymore!"
No time to delay, Han Xing decided to start construction immediately.
Although building the Spiritual Energy Shield Pyramid required a lot of materials, his material reserves were more than enough.
Han Xing found a vacant spot, not far from the castle, about thirty square meters.
He directly clicked build!
A system prompt came.
[Would you like to expend materials to construct the Basic Spiritual Energy Shield Pyramid, this build will take 20 hours.]
"Yes."
[Building in progress, time remaining 19 hours 59 minutes 59 seconds...]
"Still manageable, takes much less time than building a castle."
After dealing with the pyramid reward.
He eyed another reward with burning enthusiasm, the Golden Armor Puppet!
[Golden Armor Puppet (Leader Level)]: Special reinforced puppet, can only operate within the territory.
[Level]: lv10.
[Attributes]: Power 108, Agility 74, Spirit 86, Constitution 109.
[Skills]: Steel Bones, Flame Spray, Blood Cutting, Heavy Hammer Strike, Metal Burst.
This thing was over 10 meters tall, even larger than his Elite Level Spiritual Puppet, and accordingly, its attributes were in a whole different league.
Han Xing stroked his chin and said, "If that Elite Level Spiritual Puppet were to fight the Golden Armor Puppet one-on-one, it could very likely be overpowered by the Golden Armor Puppet!"
However, compared to the Spiritual Puppet, the Golden Armor Puppet has a major downside, it can only operate within the territory.
In other words, it only serves a defensive role and cannot assist Han Xing in fighting monsters like the Spiritual Puppet.

Moments later, Han Xing solemnly said, "Zhang Lianmeng, if no one cares for you in this world from now on, let me take care of you."
Listening to Han Xing’s words, akin to a confession, Zhang Lianmeng paused momentarily, her eyes gradually moistening.
Han Xing feared he might have scared her.
As someone who never interacted with girls, he couldn’t think of comforting words in that moment.
However, just then, Zhang Lianmeng suddenly lifted her fringed forehead and moved closer.
In this instant, Han Xing seemed to abandon thinking, only feeling warmth and sweetness.
Soft panting noises continuously came from Zhang Lianmeng’s mouth.
Minutes later, she became increasingly proactive, even pressed up against him.
Feeling the heat from his embrace, it seemed to reignite Han Xing’s heart.
Minutes later, the room echoed with the gentle gasps of a woman once more.
"Brother Xing, I’m almost out of breath..."
"Brother Xing..."
The sound gradually faded, turning into soft whispers amidst the passion.
When the day fully brightened.
Zhang Lianmeng was already up from the bed.
Han Xing lay on the bed, staring at the breathtaking silhouette of Zhang Lianmeng, feeling somewhat dazed...
After experiencing so much last night, Zhang Lianmeng truly transformed from a girl into a woman, becoming more charming overall.
Coupled with her devilish figure, every move seemed to captivate all of Han Xing’s attention.
Zhang Lianmeng turned slightly, seeing Han Xing half-naked, her face flushed as she said, "I’ll go make you breakfast.
You’ll need energy to fight monsters."
After speaking, she hastily fled the room.
Han Xing chuckled, got up from the bed, dressed his equipment, and headed out.
Meanwhile, Coal Ball continued to leisurely roam within the territory, and upon seeing Han Xing emerge, it excitedly kicked all four legs and darted towards him.
Han Xing knelt down with a smile, gently petting its head.
But today, Coal Ball seemed different; it sniffed Han Xing’s hand, then his legs.
It seemed to smell something different on Han Xing.
Coal Ball curiously glanced at Han Xing, then at Zhang Lianmeng who was cooking nearby.
Han Xing felt a bit embarrassed, quickly taking out a Spirit Core from his backpack to feed Coal Ball.
With food available, Coal Ball no longer fixated on Han Xing’s scent.
As it consumed Spirit Cores one after another, system prompts followed in succession.
[Feeding successful, pet ’Coal Ball’ Potential Value +1.]
[Feeding successful, pet ’Coal Ball’ Potential Value +1.]
With over thirty Spirit Cores consumed, Coal Ball’s satiety returned to 100.
Han Xing noticed the Potential Value of Coal Ball’s Growth.
[Growth: S+ (Pet growth can be enhanced through Potential Value; for every 10,000 Potential Value, enhancement occurs once.
Current Potential Value: 215)]
After several days of feeding, Coal Ball’s growth had made considerable progress, but there’s still a long way to reach 10,000 Potential Value.
After breakfast.
Han Xing took Zhang Lianmeng to continue leveling up.
However, the atmosphere between the two felt strange.
Zhang Lianmeng became even shyer and often zoned out, staring at Han Xing’s back.
Several times Han Xing had to remind her to cast spells.
Fortunately, with Han Xing and the Coal Ball by her side, Zhang Lianmeng wouldn’t be in any danger.
Moreover, Zhang Lianmeng noticed today that Han Xing had become much more patient with her.
This warmed her heart.
After a whole day of leveling up, Han Xing’s experience bar was steadily rising, while his territory was rapidly expanding.
By evening.
Han Xing put away his arrows, and a Level 10 Elite Level Fierce Tiger lay dead at his feet.
At this moment, a system prompt came.
[Successfully killed Striped Fierce Tiger (One-star Elite Level) lv10, gained 7320 Experience Value, pet Coal Ball gained 5856 Experience Value]
[Your level has increased, current level is LV10.]
As a white light flashed across Han Xing, he finally reached Level 10.
At the same time, a system prompt appeared.
[You have successfully reached Level 10, meeting the leveling ranking requirements, current rank 1.]

[You have received ranking rewards: [Spiritual Energy Shield Pyramid Construction Plan]*1, [Golden Armor Puppet]*1, [Basic Teleportation Array Construction Plan]*1 [Basic Lord’s House Construction Plan]*1, [Golden Weapon Selection Blueprint]*1, [Golden Treasure Chest]*1, Spirit Core*10000.]
A pile of rewards was bestowed upon Han Xing.
Soon after Han Xing received the first-place reward, an intense discussion erupted in the chat channel of District 107.
"As expected, Star God claimed the first place, and this time with a crushing advantage!"
"Indeed, this leveling speed is unparalleled."
"Truly terrifying, I just reached Level 7, no idea how Star God achieves it."
Han Xing’s leveling speed once again shattered their understanding.
At this time, other Survivors said.
"But from now on, those people will also start exerting efforts, right?
Although the first-place reward has an owner, the subsequent rewards aren’t bad either."
"Who do you think will be second?
That’s 5 Elite Level Puppet Guards and a Golden Treasure Chest!"
"It’s hard to say, the first tier has all reached Level 8, Whisperer and Black Eagle are the most promising."

"However, that Lone Brave and Yun Tianming also have great potential, I heard they seem to have a relationship with Star God, with Star God’s help, these two are strong contenders for second place too!"
"Friends of Star God?
Indeed, they have great potential!"
While the other Survivors were discussing the rankings.
Han Xing had already started checking the rewards he just received.
He first picked up a blueprint, and the blueprint information surfaced.

[Spiritual Energy Shield Pyramid Construction Plan (Basic)]: Territorial Building, constructs a pyramid capable of generating a Spiritual Shield, the Spiritual Shield can resist physical and magic attacks, Pyramid Defense Value is 500, Shield Defense Value is: 200.
Han Xing directly clicked to learn, as he had always yearned for a defensive building, and now he finally got it.
Then, he checked the construction requirements in the blueprint section.
[Spiritual Shield Crystal Tower (Basic)]: Based on the territory size, a corresponding number of Spirit Cores are required to generate a circular Spiritual Shield.
The Spiritual Shield can defend against physical and magic attacks with a Defense Value of 200.
[Construction Materials Required]: Refined Iron*30000, Mithril*1000, Magic Crystal*10000, Rare Earth*50000, Ether*50000, Spirit Core*20000.
Note: Survivors can adjust the shield size according to territory area, from a diameter of 10 meters to 200 meters, requiring corresponding Spirit Cores to provide Energy.
"This is it!"
Han Xing exclaimed excitedly.
With this pyramid, he could construct a shield with a defense value of 200, and with the castle’s bonus, it’s 240 defense value.
Other survivors or monsters wanting to invade his territory would first have to break through this shield.
Security was greatly assured!
"Great, great, now those little brats can’t launch a surprise attack on me at night anymore!"
No time to delay, Han Xing decided to start construction immediately.
Although building the Spiritual Energy Shield Pyramid required a lot of materials, his material reserves were more than enough.
Han Xing found a vacant spot, not far from the castle, about thirty square meters.
He directly clicked build!
A system prompt came.
[Would you like to expend materials to construct the Basic Spiritual Energy Shield Pyramid, this build will take 20 hours.]
"Yes."
[Building in progress, time remaining 19 hours 59 minutes 59 seconds...]
"Still manageable, takes much less time than building a castle."
After dealing with the pyramid reward.
He eyed another reward with burning enthusiasm, the Golden Armor Puppet!
[Golden Armor Puppet (Leader Level)]: Special reinforced puppet, can only operate within the territory.
[Level]: lv10.
[Attributes]: Power 108, Agility 74, Spirit 86, Constitution 109.
[Skills]: Steel Bones, Flame Spray, Blood Cutting, Heavy Hammer Strike, Metal Burst.
This thing was over 10 meters tall, even larger than his Elite Level Spiritual Puppet, and accordingly, its attributes were in a whole different league.
Han Xing stroked his chin and said, "If that Elite Level Spiritual Puppet were to fight the Golden Armor Puppet one-on-one, it could very likely be overpowered by the Golden Armor Puppet!"
However, compared to the Spiritual Puppet, the Golden Armor Puppet has a major downside, it can only operate within the territory.
In other words, it only serves a defensive role and cannot assist Han Xing in fighting monsters like the Spiritual Puppet.

chapters.title: Chapter 83 - 78: Targeted
paragraphs: Looking at the golden giant on the territory.
Beside him, Zhang Lianmeng slightly opened her mouth in amazement, "Wow... such a big puppet..."
Han Xing laughed, "This thing is great. Next time those little brats dare run into my territory, I’ll stomp them to death with it."
However, upon hearing Han Xing’s somewhat brutal remarks, this woman was not afraid but instead full of admiration.
It seemed she had been completely conquered by Han Xing.
Then, Han Xing began to check the third reward.
[Basic Lord’s House Construction Plan.]
This blueprint was useless to him.
Because in the territory of each Survivor, only one main city-type building can take effect.
He now had a more advanced castle, so even if it were constructed, it would have no additional effect.
Moreover, this house was really just a small house.
Han Xing glanced at the blueprint, it was about a hundred or so square meters, two stories, similar to old rural self-built houses.
In terms of appearance, compared to the Lord’s Castle, it was not on the same level at all.
After casually putting the blueprint into his backpack, Han Xing began to check the fourth reward item.
[Basic Teleportation Array Construction Plan]: Construct a teleportation array in the territory for Survivors to travel between.
When teleporting, the other party must also have a teleportation array. Single teleport amount is 1 person, with a 1-hour interval.
[Construction Materials Needed]: Refined Iron*20000, Mithril*5000, Magic Crystal*50000, Ether*50000, Spirit Core*50000.
Do you want to build it?
"Yes."
Han Xing directly established the teleportation array next to the Spiritual Shield Tower.
[Currently under construction, estimated remaining time 17:59:59...]
Han Xing excitedly rubbed his hands together and began to review the fifth reward.
[Golden Weapon Selection Blueprint]
He said with some excitement, "This is the first golden equipment I’ve ever obtained."
"Uh, wrong... it seems the Gold Melting Cannon was first, but that was special equipment."
"Never mind, it’s golden equipment anyway, it must be more powerful than my Moon Crown Longbow!"
As usual, Han Xing chose his main weapon, the longbow.
A system prompt appeared.
[Soul Shattering Longbow Blueprint (Gold) acquired, do you want to learn it?]
"Learn."
Han Xing excitedly rubbed his hands together, quickly checking the crafting conditions of the Soul Shattering Longbow.
[Materials required for making the Soul Shattering Longbow: Permanent Gold Ingot*10, Mithril*50, Soul Crystal Stone*10, Spirit Core*5000, Rare Earth*10000, Two-Star Leader-Level Beast Tendon*1.]
[Wearing Requirement]: LV11.
"Again with the Permanent Gold Ingot, and it requires a Two-Star Leader’s Beast Tendon. None of these materials seem obtainable at this stage?"
Han Xing also noted the wearing requirement at this point, requiring Level 11 to equip.
Feeling enlightened in his heart.
It seems this weapon is intended for after he breaks through to the First Transformation.
Before advancing, a Survivor’s level cap is Level 10.
Only by using scrolls or other methods for class transfer can the level cap be opened.
This golden weapon is certainly not something to consider at this stage.
Now, Han Xing set his sights on the last reward.
Golden Treasure Chest.
This was also the first Golden Treasure Chest he had encountered since entering this world, and he was very eager to know what it might contain.
A streak of golden light flashed, and a system prompt appeared.
[Successfully opened Golden Treasure Chest, you have obtained Permanent Gold Ingot*3, Strong Beast Hide*4, Spirit Core*1024, Shield of Immortality (Gold)...]
"Another piece of golden equipment!"
In Han Xing’s hand appeared a triangular shield about one and a half meters high, with a surface tinged with deep yellow luster, imprinted with some typical medieval patterns.
Plus its ground-like color, just by looking at it, it gave a sense of weight and indestructibility.
Meanwhile, the attributes of the shield also appeared in front of Han Xing.

[Shield of Immortality (Gold) lv11, Quality - Legend, Defense 54~57, Spirit +20, Constitution +20, Attached Effect - Force Discharge (Reduces the damage caused by 20 points of the opponent’s Power when receiving physical attack), Attached Effect - Intermediate Magic Resistance (Reduces 20% of the damage effect when receiving magic attack), Attached Effect - Unyielding Will.]
[Unyielding Will]: Legendary Effect.
When receiving damage, can enter a 10-second unyielding state, during which all damage received is reduced by 50%, and cannot be knocked back by any attack.
Cooldown time: 30 minutes.
[Wearing Requirement]: lv11 (Holy Profession Exclusive)
"This shield has such strong attributes!"
"Shen Yun is of the Holy Profession, seems like I can give him this shield."
Han Xing thought while stroking his chin. "But, I remember he said he would transfer to a Priest, which focuses on support, not great at tanking. Is it useful for him?"
"Forget it, I’ll see then."
At this point, Han Xing had opened all the first-tier rewards.
When the Pyramid is successfully constructed, combined with the leader-level Golden Armor Puppet, the defense of Han Xing’s territory will be greatly enhanced.
Beside him, Zhang Lianmeng was also happy for Han Xing taking first place.
At this moment, Shen Yun and Cheng Jianyong also saw the information on the leaderboard and sent congratulations to Han Xing.
"Brother Xing, awesome! You reached Level 10 so quickly!"
Han Xing smiled, "Not too bad. With the strength of my equipment, it would be strange not to get first place."
Both of them agreed.
Shen Yun then smiled and asked, "By the way Brother Xing, you’re already at Level 10, your next step is profession advancement, right?"
"I remember when you last took first place, you opened a Hidden Profession Scroll, what was it?"
Shen Yun was very curious.
Han Xing replied, "Elf Shooter, seems the attributes are quite good."

Han Xing replied, "Elf Shooter, seems the attributes are quite good."

chapters.title: Chapter 84 - 78: Targeted_2
paragraphs: "Elf Shooter?"
Shen Yun pondered for a moment and continued to ask, "Brother Xing, are you sure you want to change to this profession?"
However, this question was also something Han Xing was considering,
the hidden profession scroll he opened last time was indeed quite strong.
But Han Xing always had Wild Ranger on his mind.
This is because, while playing Sky Island Paradise on his phone, he heard the NPCs mention it.
In that primordial era, when life first gained intelligence, a group of terrifying creatures inhabited the world, dominating it entirely.
These creatures were as large as stars, opening their giant mouths brought about catastrophic disasters, killing countless lives.

To grow, these creatures would devour large amounts of life, turning the world into their breeding ground, harvesting waves of life for meat, livestock, and breeding tools, enduring an endless life of darkness.
The living beings of the world referred to these creatures as: Beasts.
Until five hundred years later.
In the vastness of the world, a man draped in feathered clothes, with a wild figure, appeared.
This man knew neither race, nor name, nor past.
His gaze was piercing, flickering with the flame of wildness and courage.
His voice flowed from the fountain of the soul, echoing across the land, resonating with the barriers of heaven and earth.
His arrows, like a wolf pack running in the cold wind of the night, unstoppable!
And it was this man who resolutely fired the first arrow at the Beast!
He shattered the notion in all beings’ hearts that the Beast was invincible.
From then on, the wise beings of the Holy Spirit Realm embarked on their path of resistance against the Beast.
He was the first Hunter of the world, the embodiment of free will, the Wild Ranger!
At that time, just hearing this background story, Han Xing felt that Wild Ranger had an unparalleled sense of prestige.
Compared to the other hidden profession, ’Elf Shooter’, Wild Ranger was clearly stronger.
But to trigger the conditions for changing to Wild Ranger, it was both simple and complex.
One simply needed to hold the Chapter of Freedom and perform a certain ritual under the full moon to summon the Wild Ranger Spirit and inherit its will.
The key to this profession change condition lay in the ’Chapter of Freedom’.
Han Xing speculated that the Chapter of Freedom was a kind of quest item, but he currently had no leads.
He decided to try his luck in the transaction channel shortly.
However, before he could enter the transaction channel, he suddenly heard Cheng Jianyong exclaim in the discussion group.
"Quick, look at the chat channel, someone’s causing trouble for Brother Xing!"
"Causing trouble for Brother Xing? Who is it?" Shen Yun hurriedly asked.
Han Xing also frowned slightly when he heard this.
He clicked into the chat channel and immediately saw the overwhelming messages.
"@Star River, come out and talk!"
"@Star River, Star God come out and respond, what’s really going on, is what Divine Whisper said true?"
"@Star River, I didn’t expect you to be this kind of person!"
Han Xing frowned, confused about what was happening.
He didn’t seem to have done anything, so why were so many people in the local network denouncing him?
At this time, Han Xing noticed that most of the people talking were from the team of Divine Whisper.
What tricks are these guys up to again?
At this point, another big team from area 107, the Plane Boy Group, came forward to ask.
"Brothers of Divine Whisper, what’s going on, what did Star River do to you?"
With someone leading, other onlookers also began to ask.
"Yeah, what’s going on, you’re not being clear, Divine Whisper."
"Eating melon eating melon, selling melon seeds, cola, and mineral water in the front row."
"Explosive news, the grudges and love affairs between the number one team and number one person in area 107!"
Everyone was very curious about why Divine Whisper, as the largest group in area 107, suddenly targeted Star River, the number one figure in area 107, and it seemed quite serious.
At this time, someone named Bright Moon from Divine Whisper spoke up, he seemed to be an important figure in Divine Whisper.
Bright Moon: "Let me explain what happened."
"Last night, we suddenly received news that several brothers in our team lost contact."
"Then soon after, the names of these brothers all turned black."
"You should all know what this means."
Names turning black signifies that a Survivor has died.
The crowd realized the seriousness of the matter.
Bright Moon continued: "We initially thought they had encountered some monster, but later, after investigating, we found out that someone had secretly attacked them!"
Bright Moon’s tone was very cold, shocking the onlookers in the 107 channel.
They seemed to draw some connection.
Could it be...
At this moment, Bright Moon continued: "Presumably, everyone has guessed, the person who attacked our brothers, was Star River!"
"Last night, at least seven or eight brothers were victimized by Star River!"
"What!?"
After Bright Moon finished speaking, other Survivors in the chat channel were extremely shocked.
"Is this true?"
"Star River actually killed so many people?"
Before this, everyone still maintained their civilized society habits, relatively restrained.
Even those with ill intentions dared not publicly bring such matters to the table.
Otherwise, they would face everyone’s targeting and ostracism, or worse, everyone’s pursuit.
But today, it was the first time they heard someone openly accuse another of killing other Survivors!
The atmosphere suddenly became serious.
At this time, other Survivors began to ask: "Brothers of Divine Whisper, such words cannot be carelessly said, all claims must be backed by evidence."
"You say Star River killed your Divine Whisper people, do you have any proof?"
At this moment, the people from Divine Whisper suddenly paused for a moment.
Then, the Survivor named Bright Moon sneered and said, "Of course we have evidence."
"If you have evidence, then show it, don’t just rely on words." Someone asked.
"Yes, yes," other Survivors echoed.
Bright Moon continued: "Please be patient, our leader will personally provide you with the evidence."
Not long after Bright Moon finished speaking.
The Whisperer directly appeared: "Hello, fellow Blue Stars, I am the leader of Divine Whisper, Whisperer."
"My brothers just said some overly strong words, I apologize here."
"But also, please understand their feelings, our Divine Whisper is a united family, everyone who comes in is a brother or sister."
"Now, seeing their brothers being persecuted by other villains, the pain in their hearts, I believe you can also feel."
The Whisperer’s tone was very sad, and also carried a hint of anger.
"I, Whisperer, can by my persona swear, it was Star River who killed our brothers!"
"As for why, follow me to watch a video."
The Whisperer shared a video file in the chat channel.
Everyone opened it to watch.
It revealed Han Xing standing on the roof of a castle building, shooting arrows, headshotting the first Mage.
But this video seemed to have been edited, almost no footage of those people’s attacks was included.
From the video, they could only see Han Xing shooting and killing these people, scene by scene.
After the video played, the crowd remained silent for a long time.
At this time, someone cautiously asked, "Leader Whisperer, are you sure that person is Star River?"

The Whisperer did not respond directly, instead said: "Presumably everyone recognized that castle, it was the blueprint Star River exchanged from my hands, at the current stage, it should be the only one, coupled with everyone knows Star River is a Hunter profession."
"With this information, I can confirm, without a doubt, the person is Star River!"
After listening to the Whisperer’s analysis, the crowd began to harbor suspicion that the person in the video was indeed Star River.
Could it be... Star River really killed so many from Divine Whisper?

"Brothers of Divine Whisper, what’s going on, what did Star River do to you?"
With someone leading, other onlookers also began to ask.
"Yeah, what’s going on, you’re not being clear, Divine Whisper."
"Eating melon eating melon, selling melon seeds, cola, and mineral water in the front row."
"Explosive news, the grudges and love affairs between the number one team and number one person in area 107!"
Everyone was very curious about why Divine Whisper, as the largest group in area 107, suddenly targeted Star River, the number one figure in area 107, and it seemed quite serious.
At this time, someone named Bright Moon from Divine Whisper spoke up, he seemed to be an important figure in Divine Whisper.
Bright Moon: "Let me explain what happened."
"Last night, we suddenly received news that several brothers in our team lost contact."
"Then soon after, the names of these brothers all turned black."
"You should all know what this means."
Names turning black signifies that a Survivor has died.
The crowd realized the seriousness of the matter.
Bright Moon continued: "We initially thought they had encountered some monster, but later, after investigating, we found out that someone had secretly attacked them!"
Bright Moon’s tone was very cold, shocking the onlookers in the 107 channel.
They seemed to draw some connection.
Could it be...
At this moment, Bright Moon continued: "Presumably, everyone has guessed, the person who attacked our brothers, was Star River!"
"Last night, at least seven or eight brothers were victimized by Star River!"
"What!?"
After Bright Moon finished speaking, other Survivors in the chat channel were extremely shocked.
"Is this true?"
"Star River actually killed so many people?"
Before this, everyone still maintained their civilized society habits, relatively restrained.
Even those with ill intentions dared not publicly bring such matters to the table.
Otherwise, they would face everyone’s targeting and ostracism, or worse, everyone’s pursuit.
But today, it was the first time they heard someone openly accuse another of killing other Survivors!
The atmosphere suddenly became serious.
At this time, other Survivors began to ask: "Brothers of Divine Whisper, such words cannot be carelessly said, all claims must be backed by evidence."
"You say Star River killed your Divine Whisper people, do you have any proof?"
At this moment, the people from Divine Whisper suddenly paused for a moment.
Then, the Survivor named Bright Moon sneered and said, "Of course we have evidence."
"If you have evidence, then show it, don’t just rely on words." Someone asked.
"Yes, yes," other Survivors echoed.
Bright Moon continued: "Please be patient, our leader will personally provide you with the evidence."
Not long after Bright Moon finished speaking.
The Whisperer directly appeared: "Hello, fellow Blue Stars, I am the leader of Divine Whisper, Whisperer."
"My brothers just said some overly strong words, I apologize here."
"But also, please understand their feelings, our Divine Whisper is a united family, everyone who comes in is a brother or sister."
"Now, seeing their brothers being persecuted by other villains, the pain in their hearts, I believe you can also feel."
The Whisperer’s tone was very sad, and also carried a hint of anger.
"I, Whisperer, can by my persona swear, it was Star River who killed our brothers!"
"As for why, follow me to watch a video."
The Whisperer shared a video file in the chat channel.
Everyone opened it to watch.
It revealed Han Xing standing on the roof of a castle building, shooting arrows, headshotting the first Mage.
But this video seemed to have been edited, almost no footage of those people’s attacks was included.
From the video, they could only see Han Xing shooting and killing these people, scene by scene.
After the video played, the crowd remained silent for a long time.
At this time, someone cautiously asked, "Leader Whisperer, are you sure that person is Star River?"

The Whisperer did not respond directly, instead said: "Presumably everyone recognized that castle, it was the blueprint Star River exchanged from my hands, at the current stage, it should be the only one, coupled with everyone knows Star River is a Hunter profession."
"With this information, I can confirm, without a doubt, the person is Star River!"
After listening to the Whisperer’s analysis, the crowd began to harbor suspicion that the person in the video was indeed Star River.
Could it be...
Star River really killed so many from Divine Whisper?

chapters.title: Chapter 85 - 79: Counterattack
paragraphs: The Whisperer continued at this moment, "I believe everyone has formed a judgment in their hearts."
"Although Star River is powerful, it cannot act recklessly and slaughter our human comrades!"
"Now, all members of Divine Whisper demand that Star River come out and give us an explanation, an account to our brothers!"
"Otherwise, even if it costs me, the Whisperer, a great price, I will make Star River pay for this blood debt!"
The Whisperer’s rousing speech stirred an enthusiastic response from other members of Divine Whisper.
"Right, Star River must give us an explanation!"
"We, Divine Whisper, will not spare such indiscriminate murderers!"
"Divine Whisper, unite!"
"@Star River, hurry up and come out to give us an explanation."
At this moment, Han Xing watched their angry expressions, recalling the attack from last night, and almost understood the ins and outs of the incident.
This Whisperer may have intended to deal with him from the start.
Those eight attackers were also arranged by him!
And the Whisperer seemed to have anticipated the failure of these people.
So much so that after those people failed to assassinate Han Xing, he immediately took the next step, devising the current situation.
Han Xing sneered inwardly, harboring a bit of murderous intent for this Whisperer he had never met.
Just then, Cheng Jianyong couldn’t hold back first and jumped out to curse: "You idiots, being fooled by the Whisperer like fools."
"You’re just believing whatever people say, where are your brains?"
The crowd saw Cheng Jianyong’s name, Lone Brave.
Before this, many people speculated that Lone Brave had a connection with Star River.
Now, seeing him speak for Han Xing, the crowd tacitly accepted this saying in their hearts.

The Whisperer said calmly, "Lone Brave, we know about your relationship with Star River, but in this matter, being biased doesn’t help, he indeed killed our Divine Whisper members, this fact you cannot deny."
"And this is also the most intolerable thing for everyone, I hope you can understand the seriousness,"
Cheng Jianyong just wanted to refute when Shen Yun interrupted and said.
"So far, it’s just been your Divine Whisper members talking to themselves."
"I want to ask, why were your Divine Whisper members all running to Star River’s territory in the middle of the night?"
"Regarding this, what explanation does Commander Whisperer have?"
Shen Yun’s words were quite reasoned and insightful.
This made everyone think of some possibilities.
Other Survivors started questioning in the chat channel.
"Yeah, why would these people join forces in the middle of the night to go to Han Xing’s territory?"
"Could it be that they intended to target Star River from the start, but their strength was insufficient, and they were killed by Star River instead?"
Facing the crowd’s doubts, the members of Divine Whisper changed their expressions.
However, the Whisperer also had a plan to deal with this scenario.
The Whisperer responded calmly, "Brother Yun Tianming, your perspective is quite sharp and reasonable."
"But I can tell you, the reason my brothers were on Star River’s territory was that Star River invited them over."
"Under the guise of forming a team, Star River invited them to the territory. At that time, my members were excited to tell me they had met a renowned figure from District 107."
"However, they never imagined that the one they admired would actually turn on them, the invitation was a trap set by Star River from the beginning!"
This explanation can be said to be only half credible.
But the Whisperer understood in his heart that he did not need everyone to fully believe; he only needed a reason to act against Han Xing.
Everyone was just watching the spectacle, who would care about small details?
Divine Whisper’s people shared a common enemy.
The Whisperer slowly spoke at this moment, "Lone Brave, Yun Tianming, you two should know Star River."
"Please convey to him that regarding this matter, Star River must provide us with an explanation!"
Shen Yun, of course, did not believe the Whisperer’s nonsense and sneered, "Explanation, what kind of explanation do you want?"
The Whisperer paused and finally stated his terms.
"Compensate our dead brothers, at least 100,000 Spirit Cores each, and 100 bottles of Life Secret Elixir, including Star River’s latest leaderboard rewards, he must hand over."
Hearing this extortionate demand, Shen Yun sneered, "You have the nerve to ask, and if we don’t give it to you?"
The Whisperer replied slowly, "If you don’t..."
"Then Divine Whisper has its own ways of handling it."
The Whisperer’s tone changed to serious, "Henceforth, Star River will face unending pursuit from Divine Whisper!"
"No matter where he escapes, once encountered by our Divine Whisper members, he will surely be killed!"
"If you intend to protect him, then you will also face the same consequence!"
After the Whisperer finished speaking, Bright Moon was the first to respond.
"Support Commander Whisperer, blood for blood!"
"Bring Star River out, blood for blood!"
Divine Whisper’s people were agitated.
In the territory, Han Xing finished reading their statements and a sneer flickered across his face.
Beside him, Zhang Lianmeng looked at him worriedly.
Han Xing waved his hand, "It’s nothing."
At this moment, he finally sent his first message in the chat channel.
Star River: "I hear many people are looking for me? Wanting to hunt me down?"
The protagonist appeared.
The chat channel fell silent for a moment, then erupted into a tsunami of messages.
The onlookers crazily tagged Han Xing.
"Star God, are they telling the truth? Did you really kill so many people from Divine Whisper?"
"Star God, please explain why you killed our companions!"
"Star River..."
Han Xing ignored all these questions.
He just casually said, "Killed them, so what can you do?"
Upon hearing Han Xing’s admission, a smile appeared at the corner of the Whisperer’s mouth.
The local network fell silent again, all were shocked by Han Xing’s arrogance.
"Madman!"
"Damn Star River, you’ll pay for this!"
The Divine Whisper members began to rail against Han Xing.
However, Han Xing fearlessly countered, "A bunch of idiots, led by an old fox and still clueless, even in the new world, content to be someone’s dog, you have no ambition."
The faces of those who were scolded by Han Xing changed.
The Whisperer then said, "Star River, you’ve made a huge mistake, yet still so arrogant. If you remain headstrong, not just Divine Whisper, but all of District 107 will not tolerate you then!"
Faced with the Whisperer’s threat, Han Xing was unfazed and replied, "Whisperer, I know your plans and your motives."
"But I can assure you, this will be the biggest mistake of your life."

chapters.title: Chapter 86 - 79: Seeking Death
paragraphs: Han Xing said in an icy voice, "I can assure you, this will be the worst decision you make in your life."
The Whisperer was startled inside, hearing the killing intent in Han Xing’s tone.
Before the Whisperer could speak.
Han Xing continued in the local network, "And those of you who are following suit, whether you’re just here for the drama or being led astray by the Whisperer."
"Now, I’m giving you one last chance."
"Apologize and withdraw from the Divine Whisper right now."
"I’ll give you ten seconds to consider, or bear the consequences."
Han Xing did not bother to prove his innocence but directly issued an ultimatum to them.
These nearly arrogant words stunned thousands in the chat channel.
Moments later, there was unrestrained laughter.
"Is this guy scared silly by us?"
"Does he even know what he’s saying?"
"He’s threatening so many of us, is there something wrong with his brain?"
Ignoring their ridicule.
Han Xing counted silently in his heart.
Ten seconds later, Han Xing spoke again, "Very well, don’t blame me for not giving you a chance."
In the chat channel, the members of Divine Whisper were still mocking.
However, Han Xing silently posted two pieces of equipment information.
One was Space Backpack (White)
Another was Space Backpack (Blue)
Seeing the attributes of these two pieces of equipment, the entire chat channel fell silent again.
Then came a strong uproar!
At the current stage, they were well aware of what space-related storage items meant.
If one could carry ample supplies, challenging high-difficulty dungeons like the Cloud Secret Realm would have a higher clearance rate, and even in the wild, survival chances would increase.
Faced with these two pieces of equipment, a craving arose in many of their hearts!
They didn’t care anymore about the deaths of those unlucky ones in Divine Whisper.
Just as Han Xing said, this is a new world, so what if a few people die?
At this moment, someone tentatively asked, "Star God, what’s your intention in posting these two pieces of equipment?"
Han Xing did not answer, but said in a calm tone, "Since you, Divine Whisper, issued a kill order on me, I’ll issue a bounty kill on you."
"From now on, anyone who kills anyone on the listed names above can claim a Space Backpack (Blue) from me with the kill information."
Han Xing directly listed all those who were stirring things in the chat channel earlier, most of whom were from Divine Whisper.
When the crowd saw the list of over a hundred names, they were shocked.
Han Xing continued, "Anyone who kills a senior member of Divine Whisper can claim two Space Backpacks (Blue) from me, plus 50 bottles of Life Secret Elixir."
At this point, all of Divine Whisper had a bad feeling rising in their hearts.
The Whisperer’s face turned extremely ugly.
However, Han Xing continued to speak coldly.

"Anyone who kills the leader of Divine Whisper, the Whisperer, besides getting five Space Backpacks (Blue) from me, can also get an additional 100 bottles of Wild Bear Power Secret Elixir and 100 bottles of Life Secret Elixir."
"This bounty is valid long-term!"
Han Xing’s words were resolute, and the entire chat channel of thousands inhaled sharply.
"Hiss..."
When they saw Han Xing post the two pieces of equipment attributes, they still didn’t understand what he was about to do.
But now they understood, it turned out Han Xing was planning to use these top-notch items to mobilize everyone’s power against Divine Whisper.
And the key was, because of the special nature of these two pieces of equipment, they couldn’t refuse!
Han Xing offered a blue backpack with 300 slots, and killing the senior members of Divine Whisper could even get them 50 bottles of Life Secret Elixir!
Such a high bounty had already tempted many.
This was the first time they saw an individual declare war on the largest group in the district and issue a bounty kill!
It sounded dreamy, but thinking of this person as Star River made it seem reasonable again.
The atmosphere in the chat channel was very strange, with everyone maintaining silence.
Han Xing originally wanted to make a batch of backpacks first and reveal them when they were to be sold uniformly.
But now that the people of Divine Whisper caused this mess, Han Xing wouldn’t spare them.
However, openly placing a bounty on people’s lives was something that obviously violated human social morals, and even though everyone was tempted, they didn’t dare speak openly about it.
At this moment, the Whisperer seemed to want to use his rhetoric to make a blockade.
"Everyone, don’t listen to this Star River and be led astray. We are all fellow citizens from Blue Star. If he dares to kill us today, he will dare to kill others tomorrow!"
"We must unite and expel such evil-minded people from the group."
Yet the chat channel was silent, with no one responding.
But just then, a familiar name stood up and spoke.
"Star River, do you really mean this?"
"As long as we take out someone from Divine Whisper, you’ll directly give out the bounty?"
The person speaking was Black Eagle, the leader of the second largest group in District 107.
Han Xing chuckled, "Of course it’s true, I can still afford to take out this little thing."
Black Eagle fell silent for a moment after hearing this.
A moment later, he spoke directly in the chat channel, "Alright, we’ll take this bounty, the Twilight Mercenary Corps will handle it!"
As soon as he finished speaking, the chat channel erupted again.
The Whisperer’s face changed drastically.
As the second team in District 107, the Dusk Mercenaries.
Their members were mostly Stalkers and Hunters, rarely speaking in the chat channel, but no one dared to ignore their presence.
The core members of the Twilight Mercenary Corps were fewer than fifty, but each possessed formidable power, and this time, nearly twenty of them were on the ranking leaderboard.
Especially their leader, Black Eagle, who, with the Stalker’s profession, was not slower in leveling up than the Whisperer.
Moreover, the Whisperer also knew some other secrets about this Black Eagle.

Before descending into this world, the Whisperer had vaguely heard from a big shot about a group of people with special identities in Xinyang City, who shouldn’t generally be provoked or even contacted.
The leader of this group went by the codename Black Eagle.
Black Eagle taking on Han Xing’s bounty was a direct warning sign for the Whisperer!
Meanwhile, all the survivors from the Divine Whisper Team started having bad premonitions.
The Divine Whisper Team had a total of only seven to eight hundred people, which sounded like a lot.
But in the entire District 107, excluding them, there were still nearly eight thousand people.
Facing so many greedy eyes, anyone would feel pressured.
At this time, the Whisperer was still trying to calm the team members in the group discussion.
"Don’t worry everyone, that Star River is just bluffing, his bounty won’t have any effect."
However, the Whisperer’s reassurance was no use.
In just a few minutes, over a hundred people quit the Divine Whisper Team.
Seeing so many exit notifications, the Whisperer’s face turned to iron.
But he still tried his best to control his emotions.
However, most of the Divine Whisper members joined initially to take advantage of the large team benefits; they wouldn’t foolishly share hardships with the Whisperer.
Therefore, facing Han Xing’s bounty, fleeing was the optimal choice.
After all, Han Xing only targeted the members of Divine Whisper, as long as they quit, they would be fine.
But those who had previously insulted Han Xing were now filled with regrets.
Even if they quit Divine Whisper now, it would be useless.
Because Han Xing had already noted down their names and listed them separately as a bounty target.
After posting the bounty, Han Xing closed the chat channel.
At that moment, Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun were excited in the discussion group.
Cheng Jianyong laughed heartily, "Hahaha, Brother Xing’s move is brilliant, the bounty was released and that Whisperer didn’t make a sound out of fear!"
"And those fools from Divine Whisper will regret this now!"

Shen Yun also laughed, "Indeed, now even if Divine Whisper doesn’t dissolve, they’ll suffer a severe blow to their vitality. The hard-earned title of the largest team in District 107 will be lost today."
Han Xing smiled; he didn’t take the Whisperer’s threat seriously at all. Now, as long as the bounty incident escalated, it would be enough to make the Whisperer lose his mind.
Even if he really called people to hunt him down, Han Xing wasn’t the least bit worried.
Next, as long as the Spiritual Shield was built, other survivors who wanted to attack him wouldn’t be able to get in.
Even at the worst, if they somehow broke the Defense Shield, reaching his territory,
they would have to face the pressure of one Leader Level, one Elite Level, and seven Ordinary Level Puppet Giants!
At this stage, there was no survivor team that could handle such a lineup.
Now, as long as Han Xing got some blueprints for attack-type buildings, he could completely finish the initial defense plan for his territory.
By that time, even if the Whisperer brought a group to siege him, they would only end up with total annihilation.
However, the Whisperer probably wouldn’t have the chance.
This wouldn’t take long.
At this moment, Han Xing continued, "Ignore them, they’re just a bunch of clowns. You two, keep leveling up fast, and get the Teleportation Array blueprints first."
"That way, we can travel back and forth anytime."
The two seemed to remember this, their eyes lighting up.
"Alright, Brother Xing, we’ll go level up immediately."
The matters with Divine Whisper were just a small episode for Han Xing.
Though the Whisperer had planned for so long, believing his plan was flawless.
He never expected Han Xing to respond like this, directly taking out a bounty.
Not only did this not force him to pay compensation, it also brought endless trouble to the entire Divine Whisper, and even he himself had to face the chase from professional assassins!
Han Xing turned his attention back to the territory.
At this moment, Zhang Lianmeng was looking at him with concern. She had also seen what happened in the chat channel just now.
Han Xing waved his hand, "It’s nothing."
"Mm-hmm!" Zhang Lianmeng looked at him with admiration, then gently took Han Xing’s arm.

"Anyone who kills the leader of Divine Whisper, the Whisperer, besides getting five Space Backpacks (Blue) from me, can also get an additional 100 bottles of Wild Bear Power Secret Elixir and 100 bottles of Life Secret Elixir."
"This bounty is valid long-term!"
Han Xing’s words were resolute, and the entire chat channel of thousands inhaled sharply.
"Hiss..."
When they saw Han Xing post the two pieces of equipment attributes, they still didn’t understand what he was about to do.
But now they understood, it turned out Han Xing was planning to use these top-notch items to mobilize everyone’s power against Divine Whisper.
And the key was, because of the special nature of these two pieces of equipment, they couldn’t refuse!
Han Xing offered a blue backpack with 300 slots, and killing the senior members of Divine Whisper could even get them 50 bottles of Life Secret Elixir!
Such a high bounty had already tempted many.
This was the first time they saw an individual declare war on the largest group in the district and issue a bounty kill!
It sounded dreamy, but thinking of this person as Star River made it seem reasonable again.
The atmosphere in the chat channel was very strange, with everyone maintaining silence.
Han Xing originally wanted to make a batch of backpacks first and reveal them when they were to be sold uniformly.
But now that the people of Divine Whisper caused this mess, Han Xing wouldn’t spare them.
However, openly placing a bounty on people’s lives was something that obviously violated human social morals, and even though everyone was tempted, they didn’t dare speak openly about it.
At this moment, the Whisperer seemed to want to use his rhetoric to make a blockade.
"Everyone, don’t listen to this Star River and be led astray.
We are all fellow citizens from Blue Star.
If he dares to kill us today, he will dare to kill others tomorrow!"
"We must unite and expel such evil-minded people from the group."
Yet the chat channel was silent, with no one responding.
But just then, a familiar name stood up and spoke.
"Star River, do you really mean this?"
"As long as we take out someone from Divine Whisper, you’ll directly give out the bounty?"
The person speaking was Black Eagle, the leader of the second largest group in District 107.
Han Xing chuckled, "Of course it’s true, I can still afford to take out this little thing."
Black Eagle fell silent for a moment after hearing this.
A moment later, he spoke directly in the chat channel, "Alright, we’ll take this bounty, the Twilight Mercenary Corps will handle it!"
As soon as he finished speaking, the chat channel erupted again.
The Whisperer’s face changed drastically.
As the second team in District 107, the Dusk Mercenaries.
Their members were mostly Stalkers and Hunters, rarely speaking in the chat channel, but no one dared to ignore their presence.
The core members of the Twilight Mercenary Corps were fewer than fifty, but each possessed formidable power, and this time, nearly twenty of them were on the ranking leaderboard.
Especially their leader, Black Eagle, who, with the Stalker’s profession, was not slower in leveling up than the Whisperer.
Moreover, the Whisperer also knew some other secrets about this Black Eagle.

Before descending into this world, the Whisperer had vaguely heard from a big shot about a group of people with special identities in Xinyang City, who shouldn’t generally be provoked or even contacted.
The leader of this group went by the codename Black Eagle.
Black Eagle taking on Han Xing’s bounty was a direct warning sign for the Whisperer!
Meanwhile, all the survivors from the Divine Whisper Team started having bad premonitions.
The Divine Whisper Team had a total of only seven to eight hundred people, which sounded like a lot.
But in the entire District 107, excluding them, there were still nearly eight thousand people.
Facing so many greedy eyes, anyone would feel pressured.
At this time, the Whisperer was still trying to calm the team members in the group discussion.
"Don’t worry everyone, that Star River is just bluffing, his bounty won’t have any effect."
However, the Whisperer’s reassurance was no use.
In just a few minutes, over a hundred people quit the Divine Whisper Team.
Seeing so many exit notifications, the Whisperer’s face turned to iron.
But he still tried his best to control his emotions.
However, most of the Divine Whisper members joined initially to take advantage of the large team benefits; they wouldn’t foolishly share hardships with the Whisperer.
Therefore, facing Han Xing’s bounty, fleeing was the optimal choice.
After all, Han Xing only targeted the members of Divine Whisper, as long as they quit, they would be fine.
But those who had previously insulted Han Xing were now filled with regrets.
Even if they quit Divine Whisper now, it would be useless.
Because Han Xing had already noted down their names and listed them separately as a bounty target.
After posting the bounty, Han Xing closed the chat channel.
At that moment, Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun were excited in the discussion group.
Cheng Jianyong laughed heartily, "Hahaha, Brother Xing’s move is brilliant, the bounty was released and that Whisperer didn’t make a sound out of fear!"
"And those fools from Divine Whisper will regret this now!"
Shen Yun also laughed, "Indeed, now even if Divine Whisper doesn’t dissolve, they’ll suffer a severe blow to their vitality.
The hard-earned title of the largest team in District 107 will be lost today."
Han Xing smiled; he didn’t take the Whisperer’s threat seriously at all.
Now, as long as the bounty incident escalated, it would be enough to make the Whisperer lose his mind.
Even if he really called people to hunt him down, Han Xing wasn’t the least bit worried.
Next, as long as the Spiritual Shield was built, other survivors who wanted to attack him wouldn’t be able to get in.
Even at the worst, if they somehow broke the Defense Shield, reaching his territory,
they would have to face the pressure of one Leader Level, one Elite Level, and seven Ordinary Level Puppet Giants!
At this stage, there was no survivor team that could handle such a lineup.
Now, as long as Han Xing got some blueprints for attack-type buildings, he could completely finish the initial defense plan for his territory.
By that time, even if the Whisperer brought a group to siege him, they would only end up with total annihilation.
However, the Whisperer probably wouldn’t have the chance.
This wouldn’t take long.
At this moment, Han Xing continued, "Ignore them, they’re just a bunch of clowns.
You two, keep leveling up fast, and get the Teleportation Array blueprints first."
"That way, we can travel back and forth anytime."
The two seemed to remember this, their eyes lighting up.
"Alright, Brother Xing, we’ll go level up immediately."
The matters with Divine Whisper were just a small episode for Han Xing.
Though the Whisperer had planned for so long, believing his plan was flawless.
He never expected Han Xing to respond like this, directly taking out a bounty.
Not only did this not force him to pay compensation, it also brought endless trouble to the entire Divine Whisper, and even he himself had to face the chase from professional assassins!
Han Xing turned his attention back to the territory.
At this moment, Zhang Lianmeng was looking at him with concern.
She had also seen what happened in the chat channel just now.
Han Xing waved his hand, "It’s nothing."
"Mm-hmm!" Zhang Lianmeng looked at him with admiration, then gently took Han Xing’s arm.

chapters.title: Chapter 87 - 80 - of Freedom
paragraphs: Nighttime.
After having dinner made by Lian Meng, Han Xing quietly pondered his next plan.
He’s already reached level 10, and it’s urgent for him to choose a profession.
Though he has the ’Elf Shooter’ Hidden Profession Scroll, he’s also very interested in the ’Wild Ranger’ profession.
However, so far, he hasn’t encountered the key item, which is the Chapter of Freedom.
With a try-it-out attitude, Han Xing searched for the term [Chapter of Freedom] in the trading channel.
The next moment, a consignment message appeared in front of him.
Han Xing’s eyes suddenly lit up.
"Holy crap, there really is one!!!"
Han Xing was so excited he almost jumped up.
But thinking about it, it seemed normal.
After all, there are still over 9,000 people left in the 107th district, among which there are surely some lucky individuals, commonly known as Emperors of Luck.
Even if the chance of the Chapter of Freedom appearing is small, with so many people, the chance becomes larger.
Han Xing quickly checked the consignment information.
He found that the consignor was a Survivor named Tangxin Mumu, and the name sounded like a girl’s; what she needed was an Advanced Profession Scroll for a Mage.
"Advanced Profession Scroll?"
Han Xing was somewhat puzzled.
This thing, he really didn’t have on hand.
Oh, no, perhaps he had one, but it was for the Hunter hidden profession, while she was a Mage, so it wouldn’t be useful to her.
Currently, in the whole 107th district, not many Advanced Profession Scrolls should have been produced.
Aside from the 100 given as leaderboard rewards last time, others could only obtain Advanced Profession Scrolls through opening treasure chests.
And at the minimum, a Silver Level chest is required to open a Profession Scroll.
So, in the entire 107th district, the number of Advanced Profession Scrolls should not exceed 1,000.
No wonder this Tangxin Mumu is trading for this; she’s preparing early for when she levels up to 10.
Although Han Xing didn’t have Profession Scrolls, he still had many valuable items, so he tried to contact this Survivor.
Han Xing directly sent a private message.
"Hello, can the Chapter of Freedom in your possession be exchanged for other items?"
At this time, on a Sky Island Territory.
A beautiful, tall woman was battling a group of goblins.
Her facial features were regular, her long black hair flowing down her waist, giving her quite the look of a charming lady.
In front of her, three other Survivors were engaged in combat with the monsters.
They seemed to be a temporary team.
Two melee professions were holding back the monsters, and this Female Mage stood at the back of the team, calmly dealing damage.
Just then, the Female Mage had a sudden movement in expression as she saw a private message.
She initially thought of finishing off this group of Sky Island Monsters and then replying.
However, when she saw the ID of the private message sender, she blinked in disbelief.
"Oh my... it’s him?"
After confirming she was not mistaken, her breath became a bit rapid.
She quickly said to her teammates, "You guys hold on, I have something urgent, need to reply to a message!"
The teammates were somewhat surprised but still eagerly said, "Alright, Mumu, if you’re tired, go take a break."
"Yes, leave this to us."
Tangxin Mumu nodded, then excitedly opened the chat window.
Upon seeing the message from Han Xing, her eyebrows moved slightly, and after thinking for a moment, she replied, "Hello Star God, this ’Chapter of Freedom’ can be exchanged with me for other items."
Her voice was clear and her pronunciation seemed well trained.
Han Xing breathed a sigh of relief at this; thankfully, this person was open to negotiation.
"Alright, let me know what you need, I want to trade with you."
Tangxin Mumu did not immediately answer but paused for a moment before asking, "Is this stamp... very important to you?"
Listening to Tangxin Mumu’s voice message, Han Xing fell into deep thought.
Right off the bat with this kind of question?
This woman, could she be probing how important the Chapter of Freedom is to him, intending to extort a high price?
Now, all the Survivors in the 107th district knew he had many great items on hand.
After a moment, Han Xing did not answer her question but instead asked back, "Isn’t its function written in the item introduction?"
Tangxin Mumu quickly replied, "No, the introduction only says that this stamp contains the aura of freedom, and all other functions are not included."
The aura of freedom, why does that sound a bit strange?
This item introduction made Han Xing involuntarily twitch his mouth.
Luckily, the item didn’t reveal its true purpose, which is to summon the remaining will of the Wild Ranger from the world.
Currently, even if other Survivors obtained it, they wouldn’t know what this seal is for.
So, it’s normal for Tangxin Mumu to bring it out for exchange.
Thinking of this, Han Xing replied, "It’s pretty important to me, I’m on a mission and need this Chapter of Freedom for a key part."
He didn’t purposely downplay its importance because nobody would believe that.
Tangxin Mumu hesitated for a moment and cautiously asked, "Can you tell me a little bit about what the mission is?"
After speaking, she quickly explained, "Star God, don’t misunderstand, I’m just curious because the way I got this seal was also very strange."
"Strange?"
"Yes."
Tangxin Mumu began to explain in detail.
"It was by chance that my companions and I discovered a massive Sky Island."
"There was no cloud cover over this Sky Island, and its size rivaled that of a mountain range!"
Han Xing considered for a moment, and listening to her description, it seemed similar to the Sky Island where he encountered monstrous birds last time.
Tangxin Mumu continued.
"We ventured deeper into that Sky Island, and to our surprise, found that there lived a native tribe with strange tattoos. The natives told me these were Witch Patterns."
"We started to explore the tribe and found their customs very strange. Every night, they gather all the tribespeople and hold a peculiar ceremony, worshipping a White Wolf statue."
"Recently, the tribe has been plagued by a monster, a jungle serpent over ten meters long, a Level 10 Elite Monster."
"The serpent continuously attacked the tribe, with its people repeatedly falling victim and being swallowed alive."
"At this point, the system issued a mission asking us to help eliminate the serpent threat."

"My companions and I accepted the mission, and after a tough battle, we finally killed the serpent. As a token of gratitude, the tribe’s Clan Leader took this seal from the eye of the White Wolf statue for us."
"I heard from him something about a Legendary Profession, something about the title of Demigod..."
"But up to now, I still don’t know the seal’s purpose, so I’m really curious."
After hearing her story, Han Xing also felt quite puzzled.
His understanding of the Wild Ranger wasn’t much more than Tangxin Mumu’s either.
Han Xing thought for a moment and replied, "You’re right, it is indeed a mission item related to the Hidden Profession of Hunters."
On the other side, Tangxin Mumu exhaled slightly, showing an expression of ’I knew it.’
To prevent her from asking for too much, Han Xing continued, "But you should know, I was also the first on the last leaderboard, and I already have a Hidden Profession Scroll."
"So, this Chapter of Freedom isn’t as important to me as one might think."
Then, Han Xing said directly, "Just name your price, as long as it’s not too outrageous, I can accept it."
Hearing this, Tangxin Mumu recalled that it was Star River who ranked first last time as well.
With that reckoning, Star River was a dual champion.
There, Tangxin Mumu lightly bit her lip and softly said, "Star God, how about this."
"I’ll give you this seal for free, but you need to agree to one request of mine."
"Request?" Han Xing asked in a peculiar tone.
He wouldn’t feel happy just because someone offered something for free; he knew very well that in this world, free things are usually the most costly.
"Let’s hear it, what’s your condition," Han Xing asked.
Tangxin Mumu took a deep breath, "It’s nothing serious, I just hope that you’ll agree to an interview with me afterward."
"An interview?"
Han Xing was very surprised; this was the first time in his life someone wanted to interview him.
Tangxin Mumu affirmed, "Yes, but not right now. I know the Star God must be very busy at the moment."
Not long ago, Han Xing had issued a bounty against the largest team in Zone 107.
Even she knew just how significant this was among the Survivors.
Tangxin Mumu continued, "I won’t take up much of the Star God’s time. Once my Level is up and I’ve built a Teleportation Array, I’ll schedule a time for the interview."
"However, I prefer for this interview to be face-to-face."
"In other words, I hope the Star God can allow me to visit your territory for the interview, what do you think?"
This condition made Han Xing contemplate.
He wasn’t afraid of this woman having any bad intentions.
Han Xing just didn’t understand why she wanted to interview him.
Tangxin Mumu seemed to sense Han Xing’s doubts and explained, "Star God, you should also be from Xinyang City, right? I’m not sure if you’ve heard my name on short video platforms."
As she mentioned it, Han Xing was lost in thought.
After a while, Han Xing suddenly recalled something and exclaimed, "Are you the internet celebrity with millions of followers on short video sites?"
Tangxin Mumu smiled back, "Yes, Star God, I’m honored you know of me."
Han Xing was taken aback; as a modern person, almost everyone is exposed to these short videos.
Even though Han Xing rarely engaged with them, in the age of big data, it’s hard to completely avoid them once you’re online.
And he had seen Tangxin Mumu’s works before, which explained why her name felt somewhat familiar.

She wasn’t the kind of borderline internet celebrity he had in mind; her content leaned more towards easy-going store visits and daily sharing, with a humorous tone and her outstanding looks, she attracted quite a following.
But in this world, the so-called internet celebrity status had no real usefulness; it wouldn’t bring her any advantages.

chapters.title: Chapter 88 - 81: Hunters from Two Eras
paragraphs: Tangxin Mumu said directly, "Star God, I’ll be honest, I want to leverage Star God’s traffic to create another column and gather popularity for myself."
"Then, by doing this, I will expand the column and develop from there."
"The last time the area opened up, it made me realize one thing: we humans from Blue Star will eventually merge together, equivalent to billions of people living in a new world."
"And as long as there are people, there are resources. Although everyone can contact each other, so far, I haven’t seen anyone with the same idea as mine."
"This is a perfect opportunity!"
At this point, Han Xing understood the woman’s intention.
One must say, she’s a very smart woman, able to keenly identify points with inherent traffic and profit from them.
And as a prominent figure in Zone 107, Han Xing naturally brings huge traffic.
While everyone else is troubled by survival, she already thinks about the future development of human circumstances, using her advantage to plan ahead.
If she indeed succeeds, in terms of the world, it’s uncertain, but in Zone 107, she would be unique.
For the first time, Han Xing updates his impression of these internet celebrities in his mind.
After pondering for a moment, Han Xing feels he can agree to her terms.
Because, in this transaction, Han Xing won’t lose either.
Han Xing replied directly, "I can accept your interview, just tell me a day in advance when you have time."
Upon hearing this, Tangxin Mumu finally breathed a sigh of relief, "Okay, thank you, Star God, wishing us a pleasant collaboration."
After speaking, Tangxin Mumu immediately sent Han Xing a transaction request.
Then, she placed a green stamp in the transaction window.
Han Xing clicked to confirm the transaction.
[Transaction successful, you have obtained the Chapter of Freedom...]
After closing the private chat window, Han Xing touched the cool special material stamp in his hand, his face filling with joy.
"Very good. Now, just wait until midnight, and then verify whether the method learned from the NPC to summon the Wild Ranger Spirit is true!"
At this moment, there are still a few hours until midnight.
Han Xing didn’t continue leveling up; instead, he began mass-producing Space Backpacks and Life Secret Elixirs.
This was partly to pay for the bounty and partly to prepare for upcoming transactions.
[Consume Spirit Core *10000, One-star Beast Hide *1000, to produce Space Backpack (White) *1000]
[Production time required, 10s *1000]
[Consume Spirit Core *100000, High-quality Beast Hide *1500, Ether *1000000, to produce Space Backpack (Blue) *500]
[Production time required, 60s *500]
Making 1500 backpacks requires more than 11 hours of production time.
Han Xing clicked ’yes’ for all, directly consuming 110,000 Spirit Cores, along with 1 million Ether and a large amount of Beast Hide, significantly depleting about half of his Spirit Core reserves.
But it didn’t matter; these Space Backpacks would allow him to completely break even and even profit several times over on this basis!
Hours passed, Han Xing found a bench and sat outside his territory to wait.
At this time, Zhang Lianmeng was holding a kettle, watering the flowers within the territory, occasionally glancing at Han Xing with a gentle smile at the corner of her mouth.
Then, a system prompt arrived.
[Successfully produced Space Backpack (White) *1000.]
His 1000 white backpacks were already complete.
The attributes are more or less the same, all with a 30-slot Storage Space and random Four-dimensional Attributes.
Han Xing stored them all in the warehouse.
Ever since he issued the bounty, the chat channel’s information hadn’t stopped.
"Star God actually has equipment like Space Backpacks, it’s really surprising!"

"Indeed, I was wondering earlier, everyone is challenging Secret Realms now with very few items to carry, didn’t know when bigger storage items would be available, and unexpectedly Star God has such powerful items!"
"I remember, Star God had Space Backpacks a long time ago, I saw him put them up in the trading channel once, but he delisted them shortly after, although those were White equipment."
"Wonder when Star God will put Space Backpacks up again, I’m getting impatient."
Now, everyone in Zone 107 knows that Han Xing has a large number of Space Backpacks, making them covetous.
And just then, Han Xing finally received the first private message.
The private message was from Razor, who is a member of the Dusk Mercenaries.
Razor’s speaking style is also very concise and efficient.
"Bounty completed, killed Divine Whisper member, Summer of Glaze."
He sent Han Xing the kill information.
Han Xing smiled, promptly clicked the transaction.
Then, he directly posted the kill information screenshot in the chat channel.
The entire chat channel erupted once again.
"Oh my God! Someone actually completed the bounty, killed a Divine Whisper member!"
"So fast, it’s only been a few hours, who did it so quickly?"
"And Star God actually rewarded them!"
"Terrifying! Now the Divine Whisper members must be sweating..."
Seeing the bright red kill information in the chat channel, those who originally thought Han Xing was just bluffing them suddenly broke out in a cold sweat.
With the first, there soon was the second.
Han Xing also continuously received kill information; from dusk till now, in just three hours, he has traded away over twenty Space Backpacks.
This means at least over twenty Divine Whisper members lost their lives.
So many people completed the bounty and successfully received the promised Space Backpacks from Han Xing, which also stirred the killing desires in others.
