chapters.title: Chapter 89 - 81: Hunters from Two Eras
paragraphs: At this moment, in the eyes of the members of Divine Whisper, they were no less than walking cakes, top-grade equipment that everyone who saw them wanted to take a bite of!
Ethical standards?
In the face of great temptation, they don’t exist.
Everyone in Divine Whisper was on edge.
Many people, unable to withstand the pressure, finally began to voluntarily leave the team.
Half an hour passed, and over two hundred more people had left Divine Whisper.
At this time, Whisperer’s face was ashen as he watched his painstakingly built team have its numbers cut in half in just a few hours.
If he couldn’t withstand this wave of pressure, even more people would leave.
For the first time, Whisperer felt a sense of regret in his heart.
He was frantically sending private messages to Han Xing, hoping he would withdraw the bounty order.
However, he discovered that Han Xing had long since blocked him, and the messages couldn’t be sent through at all.
Whisperer’s heart was filled with despair.
But what he didn’t know was.
In Han Xing’s mind, he had long been placed on a must-kill list.
A guy who was scheming to deal with him, Han Xing would definitely kill him at the first opportunity, giving him no chance to negotiate.
Meanwhile, Black Eagle of the Twilight Mercenary Corps was searching everywhere for Whisperer’s whereabouts.
Han Xing’s bounty order had effectively torn apart the moral standards of everyone in District 107.
At this moment, they would find that, in this world, killing was indeed a very simple matter.
They didn’t even have to face any punishment for it.
In the dead of night.
A bright moon hung high overhead.
A large Sky Island, covering tens of thousands of square meters, floated mid-air.
Han Xing told Zhang Lianmeng to return to the castle first, while he stood up.
Then, a longbow appeared in his hand.
"The prompt said to hang the Chapter of Freedom on the arrowhead, then inject all the belief in the heart into the arrow."
"Focus, exert all your strength, and shoot the strongest shot at the moon to summon the remaining will of the Wild Ranger."
Han Xing took a deep breath and whispered, "The strongest shot, huh?"
He pulled out a bottle of Wild Bear Power Secret Elixir from his backpack and drank it directly, causing his strength to surge!
Then he pulled out an arrow, nocked it on the bowstring, and tied the Chapter of Freedom to the arrowhead.
The bowstring slowly drew back.
Creek! Creek!
The taut sound of tension kept coming.
Even after pulling the bowstring, as thick as a pinky, to its limit, Han Xing still held it tightly without releasing.
Then, he aimed the arrow at the moon in the sky.
The next moment, the arrow shot forth.
Whoosh!
The arrowhead carried a hint of green as it shot straight towards the moon.
At this moment, Han Xing was also anxious; he didn’t know if what the NPC said was reliable.
If it had no effect, he would have wasted the Chapter of Freedom for nothing.
Han Xing stared intently at the arrow, watching it soar into the sky, shooting up until it turned into a point barely visible to the naked eye.
However, this arrow seemed to have disappeared into the night sky.
Several seconds passed, and there was no response.
Han Xing couldn’t help but let his arm droop in disappointment.
"Did it fail?"
"Looks like I’ll have to change to the Elf Shooter profession..."
Han Xing shook his head, intending to turn around and leave.
Just then, a cool breeze blew across the entire territory.
The wind seemed to have come from ancient times, carrying a desolate aura.
In the next moment, the whole sky seemed to be infected with some peculiar aura, as a gentle breeze passed by, stars in the sky twinkled.
Han Xing suddenly turned around and looked up at the sky!
He faintly saw it.
In the cold night sky, a man wearing a crown of grass and dressed in a thin beast hide cloak appeared strikingly.
His skin was bronze, and his disheveled yellow hair was as wild as a lion’s mane.
Beneath him, a giant white wolf with fur like silver-woven silk walked on air.
At this moment, this man and wolf seemed to merge with the bright moon in the sky.
Meanwhile, Coal Ball seemed to sense the anomaly and immediately flickered to Han Xing’s feet.
The two Hunters stared at each other in the air.
They both had wolves; both wielded a massive longbow.
Hunters from different eras both felt a stirring in their hearts.
In the air, the man spoke in a deep voice.
"It has been over a thousand years; no one could awaken the will of the Ranger. Unexpectedly, this time, it was in the Land of the Abandoned Gods."
He looked at Han Xing and asked, "Human, was it you who summoned me here?"
This man, like a wild lion, opened his mouth, and it seemed like his voice echoed throughout the world.
Han Xing’s throat moved.
Just by looking at this ethereal man, one would feel an unmatched oppressive sense.
He had never seen such a formidable existence; it was as if he was facing a Divine Spirit!
At this moment, Han Xing couldn’t help but throw a reconnaissance message at him.
[Wild Ranger Spirit]
[Level]: ???
[Attributes]: ???
[Skills]: ???
Alright, aside from the name, nothing could be detected.
This man seemed aware that Han Xing used the Reconnaissance Skill on him, but he wasn’t angry. Instead, he continued to ask with a steady face.
"Human, since you summoned me here, you must know what this means."
"I ask you, are you willing to inherit the will of the Wild Ranger and become a new generation Wild Ranger?"
Han Xing pondered for a moment and suddenly asked, "Is the Wild Ranger the strongest Hunter profession?"
Hearing this, a slight smile appeared on the man’s lips.
"You are the third one to ask me this question in almost ten thousand years."
"Before this, my answer to them was, there is no strongest profession, only the strongest heart."
"But today, I can tell you, among those legendary Hunters, the Wild Ranger may not be the strongest but is certainly the profession with the highest accomplishments!"
"The highest accomplishments?" Han Xing asked in confusion.
In the air, the lion-like man nodded, "Do you know that every Wild Ranger throughout history, their lowest achievement is Five-star Legend, and there are quite a few Six-star Demigods."
"And even, Seven Stars Peak."
Han Xing listened, filled with excitement, his face full of admiration.
At this moment, the Wild Ranger Spirit in the air, seeing Han Xing’s admiring eyes, smiled slightly.
However, the next moment, Han Xing asked, "What is a Demigod? What is a Peak?"
Wild Ranger Spirit: "..."
The other party was silent for a moment; the Wild Ranger Spirit seemed quite speechless.
But he still patiently explained.
"Very well, you beings born in the Land of the Abandoned Gods have weak strength and are indeed unfamiliar with these things. Today, I will explain the power hierarchy of this world to you."
"First, beings strengthen themselves by absorbing the Spiritual Qi in the world."

"But during the process of strengthening, beings will encounter bottlenecks. Due to talent or bloodline reasons, some beings may find themselves stuck at a bottleneck, possibly unable to break through in their lifetime."
"But once they break through, not only will they master new powers, but their power will also see significant growth, which we call a First Transformation."
"After the First Transformation, reaching a certain realm will present a second bottleneck, the Second Transformation. Upon breaking through, their power will once again see significant growth."
"After reaching the fourth transformation, many beings reach a limit at this stage, which is also the limit for most lives."
"Beyond the Fourth Transformation are the true power levels: Legendary, then Six-star Demigod, and even further beyond, the Seven Stars Demigod, which possesses actual Divine Spirit power."
After hearing this, a look of understanding appeared on Han Xing’s face.
He almost understood what the other party meant.
What they referred to as the First Transformation should be what we Blue Star Survivors undergo.
It’s very simple and very clear as well.
And when this man mentioned the Legendary Level, it probably refers to a level above 50 for Professionals.

chapters.title: Chapter 90 - 82: What Does It Mean to Strike Down Stars with a Wave of the Hand!
paragraphs: Legend, Demigod, Peak.
Every realm holds destructive power.
It’s also the realm countless beings dream of reaching.
The Wild Ranger Spirit explained the power system of this world to Han Xing and then asked, "Human Race, do you have any more questions?"
This legendary entity seems to be approachable.
Han Xing was intrigued, asking expectantly, "Yes! Can you show me how strong the Wild Ranger is?"
Upon hearing this request, the other seemed unsurprised, and a smile curled at the corner of his mouth.
He directly agreed, saying, "Yes."
In the next moment, the man riding the White Wolf suddenly raised his silvery-white Longbow and shot an arrow into the sky.
Then, he turned back to Han Xing and said.
"Watch closely, Human Race, this is the power of the Wild Ranger!"
The arrow carried a dazzling stream of light.
While Han Xing was in a dazed state.
He suddenly saw all the stars in the entire sky enlarge at this moment.
No, that’s wrong!
They aren’t enlarging; instead, all the stars in the sky are falling at this moment!
"Wow, this is so exaggerated!!!"
Han Xing’s eyes widened, he only felt the sky trembling.
Rumble~
Then, a shower of meteors covering his entire view suddenly fell down.
Han Xing saw, in the distance, Sky Islands covered by clouds violently explode when hit by the meteors.
Each Sky Island Monster was blown to smithereens without even a scream.
Including those floating Sky Islands, all turned into fragments falling from the sky.
Meanwhile, the sound of explosions never ceased.
When Han Xing came to his senses, he was horrified to discover that within a hundred-mile radius, all the clouds had vanished.
This included some clouds thousands or even tens of thousands of square miles in size.
Encompassing countless hidden monsters and mighty beings.
But even so, they all turned to ashes under the Wild Ranger’s attack.
One strike cleared the field, terrifyingly powerful!
The Wild Ranger Spirit seemed able to control the attack’s location, not hitting his Sky Island.
Otherwise, Han Xing suspected that any random meteor would be enough to blow his territory to bits.
"What terrifying skills..." Han Xing swallowed hard.
At this moment, Han Xing admitted he was still too naive.
This profession isn’t just strong; it’s insanely powerful beyond compare.
Look, what does it mean to wave hand and bring down stars, to summon the power of heaven and earth?
Just this one skill made Han Xing eager to change profession to become a Wild Ranger!

At this time, the Wild Ranger Spirit looked at Han Xing’s shocked expression and chuckled lightly, "Human Race, this is just the basic skill of the Wild Ranger, Fallen Star Arrow Rain. Once you complete your Second and Third Transformation, you can learn more advanced skills."
"Now, I ask you again, are you willing to inherit the will of the Wild Ranger?"
This time, Han Xing didn’t hesitate, and immediately exclaimed excitedly, "I am willing!"
The rugged-looking man’s face showed a smile of relief.
In the next moment, a system prompt came.
[The Wild Ranger Spirit is injecting Inheritance Power into you; once completed, you will automatically change profession to the hidden profession, ’Wild Ranger’, do you accept?]
"Yes!" Han Xing didn’t hesitate to click accept.
[Your body has been injected with Inheritance Power, All Attributes increased by 200%, automatically changed profession to the Hunter hidden profession, Wild Ranger.]
[You have automatically learned new skills of the Wild Ranger, Frenzy Burst, Wild Instinct, Fallen Star Arrow Rain.]
[Frenzy Burst]: When entering battle state, Hit Rate increased by 100%, Attack Speed increased by 50%.
[Wild Instinct]: Activates the innate power of the Wild Ranger within, lasts ten seconds, during which Movement Speed is increased by 500, cooldown: 15 minutes.

[Fallen Star Arrow Rain]: Summons Power of Stars to deal area damage to enemies in the agility*0.2 meters range in front, each meteor can deal 150% damage, each 1 point of agility can summon 1 meteor, cooldown: 30 minutes.
At this moment, Han Xing was directly shocked by the strength of this profession.
These three skills, how are they not awesome, they’re explosively awesome!
The first skill, Frenzy Burst, maximizes his Hit Rate, making it almost impossible for any high-level Lord Monster to dodge his attacks.
The second skill, Wild Instinct, is a life-saving skill, increases Movement Speed by 500%, faster than a Coal Ball when running!
The third skill, Fallen Star Arrow Rain, should be the skill that the Wild Ranger Spirit just used, a range skill.
Not only does it fill the shortfall of the Hunter profession lacking group skills, it will also continuously increase the number and damage of meteors as Han Xing’s attributes grow.
Damage is secondary; the main thing is how stylish it is!
While Han Xing still immersed in the strength of the Wild Ranger profession, a second system prompt came.
[Because you have changed profession to the Legendary Level hidden profession, the Legendary Skill Bar is opened.]
[Legendary Skill Bar]: Consume corresponding Legendary Points to draw a random hidden skill from the Wild Ranger profession.
Upon hearing the prompt, Han Xing was somewhat bewildered.
Legendary Points?
He remembered that when he drove the Great Demon Monarch back to the Abyss Realm, the system had rewarded him with 10 Legendary Points.
To this day, he still hadn’t figured out the use of Legendary Points.
But now, the system told him that they could be used to extract skills!
Thus, Han Xing extended his trembling fingers and opened the Legendary Skill Bar.
There were a total of ten slots, and he found them completely empty, without a single skill.
Han Xing tried to click the + sign on the first skill slot, and the system prompt came.
[Would you like to spend Legendary Points to extract a Wild Ranger exclusive Legendary Skill?]
[Extracting the first Legendary Skill requires consuming 10 Legendary Points, the second one requires 50 Legendary Points.]
Is there even a question? Of course, extract it!
Han Xing directly clicked yes.
[Successfully extracted Wild Ranger exclusive Legendary Skill: Broken Moon]

[Broken Moon (Legendary Skill)]: Summon a virtual image of the moon, forcibly sealing the target for 5 seconds (this sealed state ignores level and resistance). After 5 seconds, the moon’s image explodes, causing 1200% damage to the enemy (cooldown time 1 hour)
Upon seeing this skill, Han Xing’s face displayed an uncontainable shock.
This is actually a skill that combines control and burst.
Moreover, the control time reached an astonishing five seconds!
If he were to engage in a duel with other survivors, this one skill would make Han Xing invincible among the survivors!
A five-second strong control combined with his terrifying attack power, even the most defensive Heavy Armor Knight couldn’t withstand a single round.
If in a team status, the effect of this skill would be even more terrifying; what damage could teammates deal in 5 seconds?
The final burst can cause a 12-fold damage, terrifyingly powerful!
At this time, the Wild Ranger Spirit in the sky looked at Han Xing’s shocked appearance and smiled.
"Alright, the will of the Wild Ranger has been inherited, I’m about to leave."

"Human Race, throughout history, the lowest achievement of the Wild Ranger was a Five-star Legend. I hope you can grow higher. With hard work, reaching Six-star Demigod, even Seven Stars Peak, is not just wishful thinking."
"I hope one day you can have a place in the Supreme Hall."

The Wild Ranger spoke with a bit of regret, shaking his head, "But unfortunately, I haven’t encountered a genius with a Legendary Talent for thousands of years. A Wild Ranger with Legendary Skills is its most powerful form."
Hearing the term Legendary Skills, Han Xing’s eyes immediately lit up.
"The Legendary Skills you mentioned, is it this one?"
Saying so, Han Xing aimed forward.
A bright moon suddenly appeared.
The Wild Ranger Spirit turned around abruptly, a look of shock on his face.
He exclaimed, "Legendary Skill, Broken Moon, the signature skill of the seventh generation Wild Ranger!"
"Human Race, you truly exceeded my expectations."
Han Xing heard the shock in the Wild Ranger Spirit’s voice and felt a bit proud inside.
At this moment, a system prompt appeared.
[You have received the approval of the Wild Ranger Spirit, Affinity +25.]
At this time, the Wild Ranger Spirit’s attitude towards Han Xing visibly softened.
He said, "Human Race, your talent surpasses my expectations, and since so, I can give you a special privilege."
"If you have any questions you don’t understand, you can ask me, but only one."
Han Xing did have many questions he wanted to ask.
After a moment, he asked the question he wanted to know the most, "Do you know about the Blood Curse?"
Upon hearing the words Blood Curse, the face of the Wild Ranger Spirit changed slightly.
In his eyes, there seemed to be a hint of reminiscence, as if flipping through the memory in his mind.
He frowned and slowly began, "Blood Curse, it’s been thousands of years since anyone’s heard those words."

"After that disaster, the Elf King and the Giant King joined forces to destroy all information about the Blood Curse, fearing that someone might hold a Witch Race ceremony again to summon those terrifying beings."
"This matter is of great significance, where did you hear about the Blood Curse?"
Han Xing thought for a moment, then laid out the clues he had obtained and the imminent eruption of the Blood Curse.
The Wild Ranger Spirit frowned deeply upon hearing this.
Han Xing noticed something wasn’t right with his state.
Even he felt the gravity of the situation, indicating the significant impact of the Blood Curse.

At this time, the Wild Ranger Spirit pondered, "I didn’t expect that after thousands of years, the Blood Curse hasn’t been completely eradicated, and this time it’s going to erupt in the Land of the Abandoned Gods."
He took a deep look at Han Xing, "You all really are quite unlucky."
Han Xing was also quite helpless.
He already knew that a disaster capable of destroying a race, with the current power of the Blue Star People, couldn’t possibly be resisted.
At that time, he had thought of finding the native inhabitants of this world to help resolve the Blood Curse issue.
Because if it wasn’t resolved, he too would be affected.
However, Han Xing had no idea how to contact the original inhabitants of this world, let alone how to reach the powerful Elf King and Giant King.

sentences.text: Legend, Demigod, Peak.
Every realm holds destructive power.
It’s also the realm countless beings dream of reaching.
The Wild Ranger Spirit explained the power system of this world to Han Xing and then asked, "Human Race, do you have any more questions?"
This legendary entity seems to be approachable.
Han Xing was intrigued, asking expectantly, "Yes!
Can you show me how strong the Wild Ranger is?"
Upon hearing this request, the other seemed unsurprised, and a smile curled at the corner of his mouth.
He directly agreed, saying, "Yes."
In the next moment, the man riding the White Wolf suddenly raised his silvery-white Longbow and shot an arrow into the sky.
Then, he turned back to Han Xing and said.
"Watch closely, Human Race, this is the power of the Wild Ranger!"
The arrow carried a dazzling stream of light.
While Han Xing was in a dazed state.
He suddenly saw all the stars in the entire sky enlarge at this moment.
No, that’s wrong!
They aren’t enlarging; instead, all the stars in the sky are falling at this moment!
"Wow, this is so exaggerated!!!"
Han Xing’s eyes widened, he only felt the sky trembling.
Rumble~
Then, a shower of meteors covering his entire view suddenly fell down.
Han Xing saw, in the distance, Sky Islands covered by clouds violently explode when hit by the meteors.
Each Sky Island Monster was blown to smithereens without even a scream.
Including those floating Sky Islands, all turned into fragments falling from the sky.
Meanwhile, the sound of explosions never ceased.
When Han Xing came to his senses, he was horrified to discover that within a hundred-mile radius, all the clouds had vanished.
This included some clouds thousands or even tens of thousands of square miles in size.
Encompassing countless hidden monsters and mighty beings.
But even so, they all turned to ashes under the Wild Ranger’s attack.
One strike cleared the field, terrifyingly powerful!
The Wild Ranger Spirit seemed able to control the attack’s location, not hitting his Sky Island.
Otherwise, Han Xing suspected that any random meteor would be enough to blow his territory to bits.
"What terrifying skills..." Han Xing swallowed hard.
At this moment, Han Xing admitted he was still too naive.
This profession isn’t just strong; it’s insanely powerful beyond compare.
Look, what does it mean to wave hand and bring down stars, to summon the power of heaven and earth?
Just this one skill made Han Xing eager to change profession to become a Wild Ranger!
At this time, the Wild Ranger Spirit looked at Han Xing’s shocked expression and chuckled lightly, "Human Race, this is just the basic skill of the Wild Ranger, Fallen Star Arrow Rain.
Once you complete your Second and Third Transformation, you can learn more advanced skills."
"Now, I ask you again, are you willing to inherit the will of the Wild Ranger?"
This time, Han Xing didn’t hesitate, and immediately exclaimed excitedly, "I am willing!"
The rugged-looking man’s face showed a smile of relief.
In the next moment, a system prompt came.
[The Wild Ranger Spirit is injecting Inheritance Power into you; once completed, you will automatically change profession to the hidden profession, ’Wild Ranger’, do you accept?]
"Yes!" Han Xing didn’t hesitate to click accept.
[Your body has been injected with Inheritance Power, All Attributes increased by 200%, automatically changed profession to the Hunter hidden profession, Wild Ranger.]
[You have automatically learned new skills of the Wild Ranger, Frenzy Burst, Wild Instinct, Fallen Star Arrow Rain.]
[Frenzy Burst]: When entering battle state, Hit Rate increased by 100%, Attack Speed increased by 50%.
[Wild Instinct]: Activates the innate power of the Wild Ranger within, lasts ten seconds, during which Movement Speed is increased by 500, cooldown: 15 minutes.

[Fallen Star Arrow Rain]: Summons Power of Stars to deal area damage to enemies in the agility*0.2 meters range in front, each meteor can deal 150% damage, each 1 point of agility can summon 1 meteor, cooldown: 30 minutes.
At this moment, Han Xing was directly shocked by the strength of this profession.
These three skills, how are they not awesome, they’re explosively awesome!
The first skill, Frenzy Burst, maximizes his Hit Rate, making it almost impossible for any high-level Lord Monster to dodge his attacks.
The second skill, Wild Instinct, is a life-saving skill, increases Movement Speed by 500%, faster than a Coal Ball when running!
The third skill, Fallen Star Arrow Rain, should be the skill that the Wild Ranger Spirit just used, a range skill.
Not only does it fill the shortfall of the Hunter profession lacking group skills, it will also continuously increase the number and damage of meteors as Han Xing’s attributes grow.
Damage is secondary; the main thing is how stylish it is!
While Han Xing still immersed in the strength of the Wild Ranger profession, a second system prompt came.
[Because you have changed profession to the Legendary Level hidden profession, the Legendary Skill Bar is opened.]
[Legendary Skill Bar]: Consume corresponding Legendary Points to draw a random hidden skill from the Wild Ranger profession.
Upon hearing the prompt, Han Xing was somewhat bewildered.
Legendary Points?
He remembered that when he drove the Great Demon Monarch back to the Abyss Realm, the system had rewarded him with 10 Legendary Points.
To this day, he still hadn’t figured out the use of Legendary Points.
But now, the system told him that they could be used to extract skills!
Thus, Han Xing extended his trembling fingers and opened the Legendary Skill Bar.
There were a total of ten slots, and he found them completely empty, without a single skill.
Han Xing tried to click the + sign on the first skill slot, and the system prompt came.
[Would you like to spend Legendary Points to extract a Wild Ranger exclusive Legendary Skill?]
[Extracting the first Legendary Skill requires consuming 10 Legendary Points, the second one requires 50 Legendary Points.]
Is there even a question?
Of course, extract it!
Han Xing directly clicked yes.
[Successfully extracted Wild Ranger exclusive Legendary Skill: Broken Moon]
[Broken Moon (Legendary Skill)]: Summon a virtual image of the moon, forcibly sealing the target for 5 seconds (this sealed state ignores level and resistance).
After 5 seconds, the moon’s image explodes, causing 1200% damage to the enemy (cooldown time 1 hour)
Upon seeing this skill, Han Xing’s face displayed an uncontainable shock.
This is actually a skill that combines control and burst.
Moreover, the control time reached an astonishing five seconds!
If he were to engage in a duel with other survivors, this one skill would make Han Xing invincible among the survivors!
A five-second strong control combined with his terrifying attack power, even the most defensive Heavy Armor Knight couldn’t withstand a single round.
If in a team status, the effect of this skill would be even more terrifying; what damage could teammates deal in 5 seconds?
The final burst can cause a 12-fold damage, terrifyingly powerful!
At this time, the Wild Ranger Spirit in the sky looked at Han Xing’s shocked appearance and smiled.
"Alright, the will of the Wild Ranger has been inherited, I’m about to leave."
"Human Race, throughout history, the lowest achievement of the Wild Ranger was a Five-star Legend.
I hope you can grow higher.
With hard work, reaching Six-star Demigod, even Seven Stars Peak, is not just wishful thinking."
"I hope one day you can have a place in the Supreme Hall."
The Wild Ranger spoke with a bit of regret, shaking his head, "But unfortunately, I haven’t encountered a genius with a Legendary Talent for thousands of years.
A Wild Ranger with Legendary Skills is its most powerful form."
Hearing the term Legendary Skills, Han Xing’s eyes immediately lit up.
"The Legendary Skills you mentioned, is it this one?"
Saying so, Han Xing aimed forward.
A bright moon suddenly appeared.
The Wild Ranger Spirit turned around abruptly, a look of shock on his face.
He exclaimed, "Legendary Skill, Broken Moon, the signature skill of the seventh generation Wild Ranger!"
"Human Race, you truly exceeded my expectations."
Han Xing heard the shock in the Wild Ranger Spirit’s voice and felt a bit proud inside.

chapters.title: Chapter 91 - 83: The Fall of Divine Whisper
paragraphs: Just now, the Wild Ranger Spirit displayed the might of the Fallen Star Arrow Rain, allowing Han Xing to witness his fearsome strength.
So a spark struck in his mind, and he thought to try to convey this situation to the other party.
After pondering for a moment, the Wild Ranger Spirit said, "I understand this matter now."
"I will go to the island you mentioned to take a look."
After speaking, the Wild Ranger Spirit turned and left, disappearing between heaven and earth.
Han Xing let out a heavy sigh of relief, as if a huge weight in his heart had been partially lifted.
However, what he didn’t see was that as the Wild Ranger Spirit was leaving, a layer of gloom also shrouded his brows.
In the sky, the Wild Ranger Spirit sighed.
"The Otherworldly Evil God has resurrected, but unfortunately, my original form perished in the last battle, and who knows if this remnant power can be its opponent..."
After the Wild Ranger Spirit left,
the solemn expression on Han Xing’s face gradually disappeared, replaced by a look of delight.
"Finally, I’ve transitioned to become a Wild Ranger!"
"If I break through to level 50, I can reach the Five-star Legend realm?"
"Then it’s the Six-star Demigod, and the Peak of Seven-star."
"Interesting... so this world divides power like this."
"But they definitely don’t know that I, along with billions of humans on Blue Star, all possess systems, so there are no bottlenecks."
"Given time to develop slowly, perhaps in the future we could build a peak-level legion to overthrow any Abyss Realm, Alternate Space, all for you!"
Han Xing thought about these things, his heart exhilarated.
But the premise is that they could withstand this Blood Tide disaster.
Just then, the castle’s gate suddenly opened, and a graceful figure appeared.
At this time, Zhang Lianmeng was fully armed, holding a Secret Silver Staff, walking out under the moonlight.
She said in a somewhat flustered tone, "Just now there was such a loud noise, like an earthquake."
"I was worried about you so I was about to come out, and then I saw you talking to the air, I thought you were possessed, scared me to death..."
Han Xing couldn’t help but twitch his mouth, what do you mean possessed.
However, he did glean a bit of information.
The just-summoned Wild Ranger Spirit could not be seen by others besides himself.
Han Xing slowly walked towards Zhang Lianmeng.
"Phew, good thing you’re okay." Zhang Lianmeng patted her own proud chest.
"Otherwise I..."
Before she finished speaking, she saw Han Xing already standing in front of her.
The next moment, her vision spun as Zhang Lianmeng found her feet no longer on the ground.
Han Xing directly scooped up her legs, carried her in a princess carry, and then strode into the castle.
Instantly, Zhang Lianmeng’s face turned a shy red, her head buried deep into Han Xing’s chest, arms tightly wrapped around his neck, refusing to let go.
Although this wasn’t the first time for the two of them, every time Zhang Lianmeng thought about it, her heart would pound.
After arriving at the room, Han Xing placed the beauty in his arms onto the bed, then leaned down for a kiss.
"Star... Brother Xing..."
The alluring night, in the high castle, once again echoed with long, ethereal sighs.
The next day.
Han Xing woke up as usual.
As soon as he opened his eyes, he saw a system message.
[Your Space Backpack (Blue) *500, has been completed.]
Besides that, he had dozens of private messages.
Most of them were about bounties being completed.
Last night, at least thirty more members of the Divine Whisper lost their lives.
To Han Xing’s surprise, even one of the Divine Whisper’s management was found and killed by the survivors.
Han Xing readily traded out over thirty backpacks.
To him, such items were nothing,
but to Divine Whisper, it was a heavy blow.
Last night, Divine Whisper retreated over two hundred members again.
From the peak of seven to eight hundred people, today only just over a hundred remained.
The battle situation was extremely tragic.
The ups and downs within were only clear to Whisperer themselves.
At this moment, Whisperer was still doing psychological work for other members in the team chat channel.
"Everyone, don’t panic. As long as we work together, we can surely get through this difficult time!"
"Star River has committed many evil deeds. So many of our brothers died because of him, this enmity cannot go unavenged."
"Everyone must believe that good will be rewarded with good, evil with evil, Star River will definitely get his comeuppance."
However, by this point, everyone was no fool.
When Whisperer, faced with a threat, could only say "good will be rewarded with good, evil with evil,"
they knew that Whisperer had completely run out of solutions for Star River.
The reason why the remaining hundred or so people have not quit Divine Whisper at this time.
Is because most of them have received benefits from Whisperer, and some are on Han Xing’s wanted list.
Earlier, seeing Han Xing was alone and there were benefits, they dared to verbally attack him.
But they never expected Han Xing’s counterattack to be so fierce, a slight mistake could cost them their lives!
At this moment, a survivor named Wang Xian said, "Leader, we can’t continue to make trouble with you."
"Now, with the situation as it is, everyone can see that Star River won’t rest until Divine Whisper is collapsed."
"We don’t need to stubbornly persist; Star River’s energy is too great, from the beginning, provoking him was a wrong decision!"
However, the Whisperer said urgently at this time: "Wang Xian, what nonsense are you saying, Star River has some skills but hasn’t reached the point of collapsing us."
"Believe me, I’ve already contacted the third largest team in the zone, the Plane Boy Group, they will definitely help us deal with Star River!"
The Whisperer was still being stubborn.
But by this time, few were willing to listen to his nonsense.
Then Wang Xian continued, "Leader, stop deceiving everyone, actually everyone knows, the Plane Boy Group can’t help us now."
"This bounty from Star River has cornered us, if we still refuse to bow down, our end will be a dead end!"
Upon hearing this, Whisperer’s face changed, "Wang Xian, stop talking nonsense here!"
"Don’t forget, you’re also on Star River’s bounty list, even if you bow down, will others spare you?"
Yet Wang Xian said: "You’re wrong, leader, actually, the person Star River most wants to eliminate is you, and though we also cursed him, he knows we were influenced by you."
"At worst, I’ll go to the chat channel and plead with him, it’s better to lose some face than to lose my life."
After Wang Xian finished, the group in the discussion channel was moved.
This does seem like a way out...
At this moment, discussion group information arrived.
[Wang Xian exited the discussion group...]
Following Wang Xian’s exit, more people quickly followed suit.
In the end, only Whisperer and a few core members were left looking at each other.
The largest team in 107 region was now on the brink of disbandment.
Whisperer looked ashen.
He tightly clenched his fists, unable to fathom how he reached this point.
Whisperer looked to his confidant and asked, "Have we still not found Star River’s territory location?"
The middle-aged man beside him also looked grim, shaking his head.
"Can’t find it; Star River’s territory has never been fixed in one spot, this world is too big, plus there’s fewer people we can mobilize..."
After listening, Whisperer gritted his teeth, his face became so dark it seemed to drip water.
Just then, he suddenly saw several Sky Islands slowly approaching from a distance.
On those Sky Islands stood several survivors with cold expressions, showing no signs of external energy leakage.
However, the faint killing intent emanating from them distinguished them from other survivors.
"It’s the Dusk Mercenaries!"
Whisperer’s face changed wildly, exclaiming, "Damn it! We’ve been discovered, run!"
Saying this, Whisperer maneuvered his Sky Island to flee at high speed.
But at that moment, Sky Islands appeared to surround him from all directions.
This was a planned and prepared encirclement and killing.
Whisperer now knew his position was exposed, someone in the team had betrayed him...
At this time, Han Xing was unaware of what was happening over at Divine Whisper.
After waking up, Han Xing again made 1000 normal backpacks, 500 blue backpacks.
Then he set out on a joyful leveling time with Zhang Lianmeng.
Now, they were challenging clouds several hundred to a thousand square meters, the monsters within weren’t too strong, posing no threat to Han Xing.
He only needed to send out Coal Ball to take care of these monsters.
Zhang Lianmeng was quite diligent in using the Mage’s various skills to assist Coal Ball in battle.
The top of Zhang Lianmeng’s Magic Staff brewed a cluster of electric light, followed by a light shout.
"Smash the darkness with thunder!"
In the next instant, a bolt of lightning descended from the sky, falling with a crack into the midst of the monster group.
Watching Zhang Lianmeng’s battle scene was indeed quite pleasing.
He also enjoyed the leisure.
A whole day passed, Coal Ball’s Experience Value reached 80% of level 9, and Zhang Lianmeng’s level soared from level 7 to 70% of level 8, nearing level 9.
Meanwhile, significant events were continuously unfolding in channel 107.
First, Divine Whisper’s management team was tracked down by the Twilight Mercenary Corps, with many core members killed.
Then, a mass exit of Divine Whisper members directly announced its disbandment.
After today, this so-called largest group in region 107 ceased to exist directly.
And as Divine Whisper’s other management Bright Moon, also known as Huang Wen, was located, in the midst of being desperately hunted.
Huang Wen tried to privately message Han Xing but found he was already blocked.
Thus, he began to crazily tag Han Xing in the chat channel, pleading for Han Xing’s forgiveness.
Moreover, he revealed Whisperer’s entire plan in the chat channel, confirming that Han Xing was framed, hoping Han Xing would spare his life.
Only then did the gossipers on channel 107 realize.
Turns out from the beginning, Whisperer had set a trap to implicate Star River.

In the next instant, a bolt of lightning descended from the sky, falling with a crack into the midst of the monster group.
Watching Zhang Lianmeng’s battle scene was indeed quite pleasing.
He also enjoyed the leisure.
A whole day passed, Coal Ball’s Experience Value reached 80% of level 9, and Zhang Lianmeng’s level soared from level 7 to 70% of level 8, nearing level 9.
Meanwhile, significant events were continuously unfolding in channel 107.
First, Divine Whisper’s management team was tracked down by the Twilight Mercenary Corps, with many core members killed.
Then, a mass exit of Divine Whisper members directly announced its disbandment.
After today, this so-called largest group in region 107 ceased to exist directly.
And as Divine Whisper’s other management Bright Moon, also known as Huang Wen, was located, in the midst of being desperately hunted.
Huang Wen tried to privately message Han Xing but found he was already blocked.
Thus, he began to crazily tag Han Xing in the chat channel, pleading for Han Xing’s forgiveness.
Moreover, he revealed Whisperer’s entire plan in the chat channel, confirming that Han Xing was framed, hoping Han Xing would spare his life.
Only then did the gossipers on channel 107 realize.
Turns out from the beginning, Whisperer had set a trap to implicate Star River.

chapters.title: Chapter 92 - 84: Time of Harvest!
paragraphs: At the beginning, the Whisperer wanted to frame Star River, but ended up almost losing his life instead.
No one felt any sympathy for the Whisperer.
Facing Bright Moon’s desperate pleas in the chat channel, she was almost begging to become Han Xing’s dog.
But Han Xing remained unmoved and simply ignored it.
Bright Moon felt utterly desperate, and was eventually found and killed on the spot by members of the Dusk Mercenaries.
Divine Whisper announced its disbandment, and the title of the number one group in the new Area 107 changed hands.
That would be the ’Dusk Mercenaries’.
Now, only the Whisperer from Divine Whisper was left fleeing outside.
However, at this time, the Whisperer was already being targeted by Black Eagle.
This man, truly like a vicious hawk, brought an impending sense of death to the Whisperer.
No matter where he ran, there was a shadowy figure closely following him.
In this bounty operation, everyone witnessed the execution ability of that group of assassins.
It was then discovered that most of the members in this team were actually of the Stalker profession.
Moreover, this time, it was also them who killed the most, worthy of being called a team of complete villains!
Another day passed.
Today marks the seventeenth day since the survivors came to this world.
As soon as Han Xing opened his eyes, he saw the system’s notification.
[Your territory building, the Spiritual Shield Defense Tower, has been constructed.]
[Your territory building, the Basic Teleportation Array, has been constructed.]
Upon receiving the information about the completion of two buildings, Han Xing jumped out of bed.
"Great, it’s finally completed!"
He quickly ran to his territory, then to the place where he had chosen to build the Spiritual Shield Pyramid yesterday. A peculiar-shaped building had appeared there.
A ten-meter-high, spire-shaped tower with a two-meter by two-meter square base prominently appeared.
At the top of the pyramid, a transparent crystal ball slowly rotated.
It has a style somewhat combining magic and modern technology.
This building is the Spiritual Shield Pyramid.
And not far from the Defense Tower, there was another platform similar to an altar that appeared.
This is another territory building, the Basic Teleportation Array.
Han Xing quickly checked the attributes of these two buildings.
[Spiritual Shield Defense Tower (Basic)]
[Spiritual Shield]: Not generated (requires input of Spirit Cores to generate the shield)

After taking a look at the information, Han Xing whispered, "Generating a Spiritual Shield requires input of Spirit Cores. Input 1,000 Spirit Cores for a 10-meter shield, input 10,000 Spirit Cores for a 100-meter shield, and so on."
"With my territory area now nearly twenty thousand square meters, it translates to needing at least a 150-meter diameter shield."
"This consumption is manageable..."
After all, before the Defense Shield is broken, once the Spirit Cores are input, the defense effect will always exist.
Moreover, 15,000 Spirit Cores are nothing to Han Xing.
So, he directly clicked to input them.
[Do you want to consume 15,000 Spirit Cores to create a 150-meter diameter Spiritual Shield?]
"Yes."
In his backpack, 15,000 Spirit Cores disappeared.
Meanwhile, at the top of the pyramid, the transparent crystal ball began to emit an emerald green light and spun rapidly.
After a moment, a green light shot up into the sky.
Then it transformed into a thin, transparent shield that completely encircled Han Xing’s territory.
[Remaining Defense Value of Spiritual Shield]: 200+40 (extra 40 added by the Lord’s Castle).
"Great, now it’s much safer!"
Then, Han Xing turned his attention to the One-Star Teleportation Array nearby.
There’s not much to introduce here. He simply opened his territory information, recorded other territory’s teleportation arrays, and it could achieve two-way teleportation.
However, the cooldown time was as long as one hour, meaning it could be used a maximum of 24 times a day.
At this moment, Han Xing looked at his territory behind him.
After these days of exploration, his territory area had already expanded to over 20,000 square meters, even if overlaid into two layers, it still had more than 10,000 square meters.
On the vast territory, it seemed a bit empty.
However, Zhang Lianmeng had been diligently managing the territory for him during this time, keeping herself busy.
She followed Han Xing during the day to fight monsters, and at night, she began to work under the moonlight.
She scattered large patches of grass seeds on the territory, then planted many flower seedlings around the castle, showing great diligence.
After nurturing for several days, the grass seeds sprouted, covering the entire territory with a thin layer of turf, full of vitality.
In view of her hard work, Han Xing would always reward her well in the evening.
A few days passed, and Zhang Lianmeng’s demeanor became more enchanting and alluring, seemingly able to captivate one’s soul with just a glance.
Next day.
Today marks the eighteenth day since the Blue Star people arrived in this world.
Han Xing continued to inspect his territory.
There was no need to wake up early to fight monsters today because Zhang Lianmeng and Coal Ball’s levels both reached level 10 yesterday.
And Han Xing’s level had already reached 11.
Zhang Lianmeng took the reward for sixth place.

Among the rewards, Zhang Lianmeng chose the ’Staff of Daylight’, a Purple Weapon of Choice, Rare Quality, which added a lot of magic attack and included a 20 magic resistance reduction effect, very good indeed.
As for her profession direction, under Han Xing’s recommendation, she became an Elemental Master of a pure output system.
At this moment, an absolutely beautiful woman with a crown and a stunning figure gracefully walked towards Han Xing.
Today, Zhang Lianmeng was dressed in a vibrant blue Mage’s Robe, yet it still couldn’t conceal her explosive figure underneath the robe.

chapters.title: Chapter 95 - 86: Siege Crossbow Arrow Launcher Platform Blueprint
paragraphs: Han Xing’s generosity made Black Eagle feel a surge of joy.
He even wished for a few more reckless guys to provoke Han Xing.
Then he could continue taking bounties, ensuring that other brothers in the team also get better equipment.
After the transaction was completed, Black Eagle seemed to have something more to say.
But he wasn’t someone who liked to beat around the bush, so he spoke directly.
"I have something here that you might be interested in."
Through their previous two interactions, Han Xing already knew that Black Eagle was a decisive person, with a straightforward style in both speech and action.
Han Xing nodded and directly replied, "Send it over for a look."
In the next moment, the private chat window displayed the information of a blueprint.

[Siege Crossbow Arrow Emitter Construction Plan]: Can construct a Crossbow Arrow Launcher Platform in the territory, launching a Giant Siege Crossbow Arrow every 10 seconds, with attack power ranging from 500 to 550 and a maximum attack range of 5000 meters.
Note: The Crossbow Arrow Launcher Platform has a Defense Value of 80 points.
Upon seeing this blueprint, Han Xing’s pupils suddenly contracted.
This was precisely the attack structure blueprint he had been searching for!
And it was for the extremely powerful Siege Crossbow Arrow.
With a minimum attack power of 500, it could nearly instantly kill any current survivor, including Han Xing himself.
Only someone fully equipped in heavy armor, having completed the profession advancement to Knight, might withstand one crossbow arrow attack.
But at most, they could only block one attack; the second shot would be certain death.
If Han Xing acquired this blueprint, he would certainly not just make one Crossbow Arrow Launcher.
He could even imagine, once he directly produced hundreds of Siege Crossbow Arrows, a volley could easily kill even Leader Level monsters in an instant.
At this moment, seeing Han Xing silent, Black Eagle seemed to notice his inner thoughts.
Black Eagle said, "It seems you’re very interested."
Han Xing didn’t deny it, "Yes, you brought out this blueprint, wanting to trade with me?"
"That’s right." Black Eagle replied.
Han Xing took a deep breath and said directly, "Name your price, I’ll take this blueprint."
Black Eagle discerned the longing in Han Xing’s tone, contemplating for a moment.
"How about exchanging this blueprint for two hundred blue-grade backpacks?"
"Two hundred?"
Hearing the surprise in Han Xing’s voice, Black Eagle thought the other party found his asking price too high.
After a brief silence, Black Eagle replied, "Yes, I’m not good at bargaining, two hundred is my lowest baseline, if you don’t agree, we can forget about it."
"After all, I need to be responsible for my brothers..."
However, Han Xing didn’t think his price was high; on the contrary, it was quite cheap.
At the current stage, everyone knew the value of a Siege Crossbow Arrow Launcher blueprint.
With it, it truly meant having both offense and defense.
The security of the territory would undergo a qualitative change.
Forget two hundred backpacks, even if it were a thousand, Han Xing would acquire it!
On one hand, it was to strengthen his territory’s defense, and on the other, to prepare for potential upcoming disasters.
Han Xing said directly, "I’ll give you three hundred!"
"The value of this blueprint already exceeds this amount, I don’t want to shortchange you."
Black Eagle paused for a moment, then said, "Alright, let’s trade."
Black Eagle initiated a trade request with Han Xing.

But Han Xing said, "Hold on, I also have a Rune Blueprint here. Your batch of backpacks still has room for enhancement, let me enchant them for free to increase the attributes a bit—this could enhance survival chances."
Black Eagle was silent for a long time, and then said with a raspy voice, "Thanks."
For people like them who lick blood from the edge of a sword, they rarely show emotions.
Yet now, Black Eagle’s gratefulness towards Han Xing was a sign that he remembered this kindness in his heart.
Han Xing casually replied, no problem, after all, it was just a trivial task to him.
Then, he opened the blueprint section to review the requirements for making runes.
[Materials needed to craft Weak Chaos Rune]: Rune Crystal *100, Spirit Core *10, Ether *200.
The main material is Rune Crystal, currently only obtainable by conquering Secret Realms.
But Han Xing had already accumulated thousands of Rune Crystals, more than enough to craft hundreds.
He clicked on craft, and the system prompt appeared.
[Do you want to consume materials, Rune Crystal *30000, Spirit Core *3000, Ether *60000, to craft Weak Chaos Rune *300?]
Han Xing directly clicked yes.
This basic rune takes very little time to craft.
Each rune only takes 1 second to produce.
Five minutes later.
Han Xing’s backpack was filled with 300 runes with varying attributes.
[Weak Chaos Rune]: Can add rune effects to equipment, randomly enhancing one of the four-dimensional attributes by 3-6 points.
Han Xing enchanted each of the three hundred backpacks with one rune. Although the attributes were random and might not align with the backpacks’ existing attributes.
But that was not his concern.
After trading a batch to Black Eagle, a system prompt appeared.
[Transaction successful, you have received ’Siege Crossbow Arrow Emitter Construction Plan,’ you have received ’Giant Crossbow Arrow Blueprint,’ you lost ’Space Backpack (Blue) *300’]
Transaction completed, Han Xing looked at himself with two blueprints in his backpack, slightly stunned.
Because the initial trade was only supposed to involve the Siege Crossbow Arrow Emitter.
Now, Black Eagle had unexpectedly given him an additional Giant Crossbow Arrow Blueprint.

At this time, Black Eagle said, "These two blueprints are a set. Without the Giant Crossbow Arrow Blueprint, creating a Crossbow Arrow Launcher Platform is useless. Consider this blueprint as my token of gratitude to you."
Upon hearing Black Eagle’s response, Han Xing couldn’t help but shake his head with a bitter smile.
Indeed, there are no fools in this world; everyone keeps a trick up their sleeve.
However, he really hit the jackpot this time.
With a little bit of generosity, he exchanged for the complete Siege Crossbow Arrow blueprints.
After completing the transaction, Han Xing couldn’t wait to check the construction requirements for these two blueprints.
[Materials needed to construct the Siege Crossbow Arrow Launcher Platform]: Refined Iron*10000, Mithril*300, Spirit Core*5000, Rare Earth*100000, Power Crystal*50000.
"Fortunately, these are all conventional materials!" Han Xing couldn’t help clenching his fist.
With his current material reserves, he could directly construct a thousand Siege Crossbow Arrows with plenty to spare!
Of course, in reality, there’s no need for so many, as the launcher platform can adjust the shooting angle 360 degrees.
Building just a couple of hundred would suffice.
Then, he looked at the Giant Crossbow Arrow Blueprint beside him.
[Materials needed to make a Giant Crossbow Arrow]: Refined Iron*100, Mithril*1.
"Not bad, the main materials are Refined Iron and Mithril, which can be mass-produced."
With this transaction, so far, Han Xing has gained a considerable amount.
He still had half of his space backpack reserves left.
Han Xing continued trading.
Another two or three hours later.
When the last blue space backpack was traded away, the frenzied trading market finally calmed down.
Though it seemed like a lot with over ten thousand backpacks,
considering each Survivor could equip two backpacks, when distributed to nearly ten thousand people, only half of them could be equipped.
Currently, there are still many people who haven’t traded for a Space Backpack item.
But Han Xing could only wait until the next time to make more.
There was no choice, because the main material on the market, High-quality Beast Hide, had already been swept clean by him.
Others who still want it can only wait until Han Xing collects more High-quality Beast Hide.
Meanwhile.
Han Xing looked at the mountains of materials piled up in his territory, and his breath paused momentarily.
Because now, it was the moment he loved the most—inventory time!
"Hahaha! This time, I really hit the mother lode!!"
"Lian’er, come over and help me count the materials!"
Han Xing’s joyful laughter echoed from the pile of materials.
Meanwhile, Zhang Lianmeng, who was squeezed outside the mountain of materials, suddenly heard Han Xing calling her and froze for a moment.
"Xing... Brother Xing, what did you just call me?"
At this moment, Han Xing was in an excited state and replied nonchalantly, "I called you Lian’er. Why, don’t you like me calling you that?"
However, Zhang Lianmeng, after a brief pause, joyfully burst into tears and said, "I like it!"
"I like Brother Xing calling me that!"
This woman, for one simple address by Han Xing, suddenly felt filled with enthusiasm.
She rolled up her sleeves and energetically began moving storage boxes out one by one, then started sorting the materials.
Because Han Xing had also given her access to the storage boxes,
Zhang Lianmeng began categorizing and filing the piles of materials into the storage boxes.
The two of them worked from dusk till night.
Finally.
When the last pile of materials was packed into the storage boxes, Han Xing and Zhang Lianmeng heaved a deep sigh.
Standing in the castle, looking at this room dedicated to storing storage boxes, the number of storage boxes nearly filled it.
Except for leaving some passageways.
It’s completely full!
The two of them tallied up this time’s harvest, and together, they arrived at some astonishing numbers!
Of course, the biggest gain was the Spirit Core.
This number amounted to 44.61 million! A number so staggering it could scare someone to death.
Next was Refined Iron, with 27.64 million, Mithril, with 326,424 blocks, Strong Fragment, with 24,122 pieces, and Rune Crystal, with 1.61 million.
Besides these, what excited Han Xing the most from this transaction was the nearly thousand Permanent Gold Ingots!
At the current stage, the value of a single Permanent Gold Ingot is self-evident, as it is the main material for making Golden Equipment.
Apart from being able to consistently acquire them from a Golden Treasure Chest, other Survivors can only stumble upon them by chance when exploring Sky Islands.
Of course, that probability is equivalent to winning the lottery.

And yet, he managed to gather nearly a thousand pieces. If it weren’t for the lack of the other material needed to make the Soul-breaking Longbow, the Soul Crystal Stone, he could have made dozens of Golden Artifacts on the spot!
"Hahahaha!" Han Xing couldn’t help but burst into joyful laughter again.
"Now, both my territory strength and personal strength are about to undergo a transformation!"
Beside him, Zhang Lianmeng looked at him with complete admiration.
As someone who personally experienced it, Zhang Lianmeng knew very well how big Han Xing’s harvest was this time.
Even just a small portion of it would be enough to drive other Survivors crazy!
Zhang Lianmeng’s perception of Han Xing’s abilities was once again refreshed.
At this moment, Zhang Lianmeng gently said, "Brother Xing, you must be tired from a whole day’s work. How about I heat some water for you to take a bath and rest?"

This time, I really hit the mother lode!!"
"Lian’er, come over and help me count the materials!"
Han Xing’s joyful laughter echoed from the pile of materials.
Meanwhile, Zhang Lianmeng, who was squeezed outside the mountain of materials, suddenly heard Han Xing calling her and froze for a moment.
"Xing...
Brother Xing, what did you just call me?"
At this moment, Han Xing was in an excited state and replied nonchalantly, "I called you Lian’er.
Why, don’t you like me calling you that?"
However, Zhang Lianmeng, after a brief pause, joyfully burst into tears and said, "I like it!"
"I like Brother Xing calling me that!"
This woman, for one simple address by Han Xing, suddenly felt filled with enthusiasm.
She rolled up her sleeves and energetically began moving storage boxes out one by one, then started sorting the materials.
Because Han Xing had also given her access to the storage boxes,
Zhang Lianmeng began categorizing and filing the piles of materials into the storage boxes.
The two of them worked from dusk till night.
Finally.
When the last pile of materials was packed into the storage boxes, Han Xing and Zhang Lianmeng heaved a deep sigh.
Standing in the castle, looking at this room dedicated to storing storage boxes, the number of storage boxes nearly filled it.
Except for leaving some passageways.
It’s completely full!
The two of them tallied up this time’s harvest, and together, they arrived at some astonishing numbers!
Of course, the biggest gain was the Spirit Core.
This number amounted to 44.61 million!
A number so staggering it could scare someone to death.
Next was Refined Iron, with 27.64 million, Mithril, with 326,424 blocks, Strong Fragment, with 24,122 pieces, and Rune Crystal, with 1.61 million.
Besides these, what excited Han Xing the most from this transaction was the nearly thousand Permanent Gold Ingots!
At the current stage, the value of a single Permanent Gold Ingot is self-evident, as it is the main material for making Golden Equipment.
Apart from being able to consistently acquire them from a Golden Treasure Chest, other Survivors can only stumble upon them by chance when exploring Sky Islands.
Of course, that probability is equivalent to winning the lottery.
And yet, he managed to gather nearly a thousand pieces.
If it weren’t for the lack of the other material needed to make the Soul-breaking Longbow, the Soul Crystal Stone, he could have made dozens of Golden Artifacts on the spot!
"Hahahaha!" Han Xing couldn’t help but burst into joyful laughter again.
"Now, both my territory strength and personal strength are about to undergo a transformation!"
Beside him, Zhang Lianmeng looked at him with complete admiration.
As someone who personally experienced it, Zhang Lianmeng knew very well how big Han Xing’s harvest was this time.
Even just a small portion of it would be enough to drive other Survivors crazy!
Zhang Lianmeng’s perception of Han Xing’s abilities was once again refreshed.
At this moment, Zhang Lianmeng gently said, "Brother Xing, you must be tired from a whole day’s work.
How about I heat some water for you to take a bath and rest?"

chapters.title: Chapter 96 - 87: Soul Shattering Longbow (Gold)
paragraphs: Hearing Zhang Lianmeng wanted to take a bath.
Han Xing then remembered that he had just traded with the survivor named Pea Pod for a solar-powered water heater, called the Spiritual Energy Storage Device Blueprint.
This contraption, once set up, could not only automatically collect moisture but also steadily provide hot water.
Seeing Zhang Lianmeng ready to heat the water.
Han Xing called to her from behind, "Lian’Er, wait a moment."
Zhang Lianmeng looked at him in confusion.
Han Xing walked into the castle, then went to the shower room and directly opened the crafting interface.
The system prompt appeared.
[Do you want to craft the Spiritual Energy Storage Device? This craft will take 300 seconds...]
"Yes."
Five minutes later,
A round water bucket with a capacity of approximately 50L appeared in front of Han Xing.
Not wanting to wait for the storage device to slowly collect moisture from the air, Han Xing filled it up directly with water.
Then he placed a Spirit Core in the groove at its bottom.
Thin green lights began to flow.
The water temperature soon began to heat up.
Then, Han Xing also connected a water pipe to the storage device and made a bathtub beside it.
With that, a standard shower room was completed.
He felt as if he had returned to the modern world.
Then, Han Xing came out and said to Zhang Lianmeng, "The water temperature is ready, you can go take a bath first."
Zhang Lianmeng entered the bathroom, looked at the bathtub, and the water heater in surprise, "Wow, there’s actually such a thing, amazing!"
Han Xing chuckled lightly and turned to leave.
At this moment, Zhang Lianmeng called out to him.
Her face was flushed, seemingly a little embarrassed.
"Well, um... Brother Xing, can I take a bath with you?"
Han Xing looked at the hopeful eyes of the beauty, and that blushing face that tempted him to take a bite, and against his better judgment, nodded.
The sound of rushing water was constant in the shower room.
Steam continually rose from the surface of the bathtub.
In Han Xing’s round-eyed gaze,
Zhang Lianmeng undid her collar, and her nightgown slipped down her smooth body...
A devilish figure was revealed before Han Xing without reservation.
The sight made Han Xing’s eyes widen instantly.
"Lian’Er..."
Zhang Lianmeng, with a face full of bashfulness, walked to Han Xing’s side and helped him remove his equipment.
Then, the two of them stepped into the bathtub together.
The next day.
Han Xing got up early to digest the gains from last night.
After breakfast, Han Xing couldn’t wait to head to the territory’s perimeter to construct the siege crossbow arrow launcher platform blueprints traded from Black Eagle.
The system prompt appeared.
[Do you want to construct the Siege Crossbow Arrow Launcher Platform? This construction is estimated to take 2 hours...]
Han Xing immediately clicked yes.
Since the maximum range of a crossbow arrow is 5000 meters, about 5 kilometers.
To maximize damage, Han Xing built it near the edge of the territory.
Of course, this also posed a risk, which was that if enemies besieged and the defense shield was breached,
The first to suffer would be these siege crossbow arrow launcher platforms.
Han Xing pondered, "The launcher platform has 80 defense value, and with the territory castle’s bonus, it only has 96."
"However, the seeds of the Steel Essence Vine we acquired yesterday seem to provide an extra 40 defense points to buildings, making a total of 136 defense value, which is quite good!"
Thinking about this, Han Xing directly called Zhang Lianmeng over.
"Lian’Er, I have a batch of Steel Essence Vine seeds here. Help me plant them on the edge of the territory, next to the launcher platform, as I need them."
Zhang Lianmeng today wore a red dress, exuding a classic beauty.
She walked gracefully, "Leave it to me, Brother Xing. Lian’Er is very capable, you know~"
Han Xing gave Zhang Lianmeng a peculiar look.
This woman definitely understood the implication of his words, but she intentionally said it to stir his inner desires.
Han Xing found that this woman was becoming bolder recently, often subtly or overtly teasing him to stir his inner lust.
Especially complementing it with her innocent expression, it was hard not to have a certain impulse.
But thinking about last night’s madness, Han Xing suppressed his inner desire.
After turning over all the Steel Essence Vine seeds from his backpack to Zhang Lianmeng.
The two began to divide and cooperate.
[Do you want to consume materials to build a siege crossbow arrow launcher platform? This construction will take approximately 180 minutes...]
Han Xing clicked yes.
Then, every twenty meters, a crossbow arrow launcher platform was constructed, with a massive amount of materials being continually consumed.
The system prompts continued to appear.
[Building/Constructing Siege Crossbow Arrow Launcher Platform, remaining time 2 hours and 29 minutes and 59 seconds...]
Until the 296th platform was completed, Han Xing had constructed a wall of launcher platforms all around the territory.
Since the angle can be adjusted at any time, his coverage was effectively 360 degrees with no blind spots.
Han Xing clapped his hands and then started creating giant crossbow arrows.
The launcher platform had an automatic reloading feature, but crossbow arrows must be preloaded, with each platform storing up to 30 arrows.
So, he needed to make 9,000 giant crossbow arrows to fully load the platforms.
Creating one giant crossbow arrow took 10 seconds.
Han Xing decided to make 1,000 first.
As the ten-second countdown ended, a flash of white light added a two-meter-long large arrow with the thickness of a bottle neck to Han Xing’s backpack.
Han Xing checked its attributes.
[Giant Crossbow Arrow (Blue), Quality - Treasure, Attack Power: 55~60, Attached Effect - Siege (deals an additional 30% damage to buildings)]
"These attributes are quite impressive!"
Originally, he thought it was just an ordinary crossbow arrow, but it turned out to have this pleasant surprise.

chapters.title: Chapter 97 - 87: Soul Shattering Longbow (Gold)
paragraphs: With an inherent 55 Attack Power, combined with the launcher boost, a single shot has at least 600 Attack Power, and targeting buildings will cause even more damage.
No wonder this thing is called a siege crossbow arrow; the effect is truly impressive.
Han Xing was very satisfied.
After completing all this,
Han Xing didn’t idle. He wanted to continue enhancing his strength, converting the harvested resources into actual combat power.
And now, besides these territorial buildings,
The item that improved his strength the most was naturally that golden weapon.
Han Xing had coveted it for a long time.
Now he has finally completed his profession advancement, and his current level has reached level 12.
He was already capable of equipping that golden weapon, the Soul Shattering Longbow.
He checked the crafting conditions.
[Materials required to craft Soul Shattering Longbow: Permanent Gold Ingot*20, Mithril*50, Soul Crystal Stone*10, Spirit Core*5000, Rare Earth*10000, Two-Star Leader-Level Beast Tendon*1.]
[Wearing Requirement]: LV11.
Among these, the most difficult to gather, the Permanent Gold Ingot, he had already collected over a thousand pieces.
Mithril and Spirit Core, among other materials, were even more so, with plenty in reserve.
If there were no other requirements, he could even mass-produce golden weapons for sale.

At this time, Han Xing expressed some regret: "It’s a pity, the source of Soul Crystal Stones is too scarce, even though I specifically posted a trade request for them, ultimately, I only received over 20 pieces..."
"With the current materials, I can barely make two Soul Shattering Longbows."
Han Xing shook his head, "But it’s not bad, given the golden equipment, the quality cap is the same as purple equipment, with a maximum of Legendary Quality."
"But compared to purple equipment, the probability of golden equipment reaching Legendary Quality is much higher."
His current crafting interface was making giant crossbow arrows, needing to wait nearly three hours before crafting other items again.
Han Xing wasn’t in a hurry. He leisurely strolled around his territory for a while and then joined Zhang Lianmeng in gardening.
Zhang Lianmeng had changed into casual wear, a white T-shirt on top and shorts on the bottom.
This outfit was as ordinary as could be, but on her, her impressive figure couldn’t be hidden at all, with a flat belly and jade-like fair and plump legs that made one’s blood race.
At this moment, she was carrying a small shovel, vigorously digging pits in the territory and then planting the Steel Essence Vine seeds into them.
Especially when she bent down and squatted, the glimpse of white at the neckline made one’s mouth go dry.
Noticing Han Xing’s gaze, Zhang Lianmeng blushed, but instead of covering up, she deliberately bent her waist even lower, seemingly doing it intentionally for Han Xing to see.
"Brother Xing, does it look good?" The beauty looked up with charming eyes, gazing at Han Xing.
Han Xing swallowed and nodded.
Zhang Lianmeng blushed even more upon seeing this, but she seemed to enjoy being watched by Han Xing.
The time came to noon, and all 1000 crossbow arrows were completed.
At the same time, all 290 siege crossbow arrow launcher platforms were finished.
Han Xing looked at the outskirts of the territory, at those platforms about one meter high and three meters long, mostly made of refined iron.
A giant arrow emitting a cold light was already loaded, ready to unleash a lethal strike at any moment.
Just by looking at it, one could imagine the terrifying damage it could cause when launched.
With so many platforms protecting his territory, a strong sense of security surged in Han Xing’s heart.
Now, even if other survivors banded together to besiege him, he wouldn’t fear at all.
At this moment, Han Xing noticed that beside each giant crossbow arrow launcher platform, a purple plant sprout was breaking through the soil.
That was the Steel Essence Vine seed Zhang Lianmeng had planted not long ago.
The Steel Essence Vine takes ten days to fully grow, and even with bone meal to accelerate it, it’ll still take four to five days.
By then, it would add quite a bit of Defense to the platforms.
Everything was ready.
Now, he could finally craft the golden weapon he had long desired, the Soul Shattering Longbow.
Han Xing directly clicked to craft.
[Crafting Soul Shattering Longbow (Gold), time required 300 seconds...]
The time required for crafting golden equipment increased significantly.
Han Xing awaited patiently.
Minutes later, a burst of golden light as high as the sky appeared before Han Xing.
This golden light was no less than the commotion when the Moon Crown Longbow had a legendary effect.
Han Xing looked at the sky with delight.
After a few more seconds, as the progress bar reached its end,
Plop!
In front of him suddenly appeared a longbow with a dark golden luster.
The whole bow had a ring of intricately carved secret patterns, with several transparent Soul Crystal Stones embedded on either side of the bow arm.
The Mithril-constructed patterns channeled the power from the Soul Crystal Stones to the bow, occasionally emitting a deep light, appearing ancient and mysterious.
The shape of this bow was no less impressive than his Moon Crown Longbow.
"Awesome!" Han Xing immediately picked up the Soul Shattering Longbow.
In front of him appeared the weapon’s attributes.

[Soul Shattering Longbow (Gold) lv11, Quality - Legend, Attack 214~219, Agility +30, Spirit +20, Hit Rate +15, Attached Effect - Soul Chasing (30% chance when attacking to reduce the opponent’s Spirit by 30 points), Attached Effect - Life-taking (18% chance when attacking to inflict 200% damage), Attached Effect - Shattered Spirit (Legendary Effect)]

[Shattered Spirit]: Legendary Effect, when attacking, there’s a 12% chance to trigger Shattered Spirit State, in which all attacks will critically strike, and each hit reduces the opponent’s Attack Power by 2%, stackable up to 10 times. (Shattered Spirit State lasts ten seconds, with a minimum trigger interval of 120 seconds.)
"Another legendary effect!"
Han Xing was delighted.
"A guaranteed critical hit and reduced Attack Power, what a powerful effect!"
Although the Moon Crown Longbow’s group attack effect was gone, the overall attributes of this Soul Shattering Longbow far surpassed it.
Once equipped, Han Xing’s Attack Power significantly increased again.
At this point, he checked the remaining materials in his backpack.
With his current materials, he could craft another Soul Shattering Longbow.
With this in mind, Han Xing directly clicked to craft.
Five minutes later, a dazzling golden light flashed.
Before Han Xing appeared a weapon almost identical to the previous Soul Shattering Longbow.
Han Xing muttered, "Indeed, the highest quality golden equipment can be crafted up to is legendary. Crafting an epic quality requires an orange equipment blueprint."
"However, compared to purple equipment, the chance of crafting legendary quality with golden equipment is significantly higher. Just by crafting two, they’re already the highest quality."
Han Xing nodded in satisfaction.
Having finished crafting weapons, it was time to continue making other equipment.
Han Xing looked at the blueprint section, at the large number of purple equipment blueprints, smiling so widely his eyes became narrow slits.
Thanks to his relentless efforts, he finally exchanged a massive amount of purple equipment blueprints from other survivors.
He selected some blueprints that provided the greatest boost to the hunter profession.
They were the Profound Jade Ring (Ring), Simurgh Pendant (Necklace), War Iron Wrist (Wristguard), Spiritual Snake Robe (Top), Demon Scale Pants (Bottoms), Red Ridge Boots (Boots).
Apart from not having collected a helmet, he had almost gathered a complete set of purple equipment.
And if all these pieces of equipment were crafted, they could directly double his attributes!
With this thought, Han Xing took a deep breath, "System, craft for me!"
He clicked to craft each item.
Anyway, for purple-grade equipment, the main material required is Mithril, of which he had plenty.
Blinding lights rose in succession.
Compared to crafting the Golden Soul Shattering Longbow, there was much less commotion.
As the progress bar reached its end,
Plop! Plop!
One piece of equipment after another fell to the ground, and Han Xing picked them up one by one.
Before him appeared the attributes of these 6 pieces of equipment.

[Profound Jade Ring (Purple) lv10, Quality: Treasure, Power +10, Agility +15, Attached Effect - Jade Radiance (every 5s creates a shield with 10 Defense Value to ward off minor damage), Attached Effect - Eye of Profound Mystery (Hit Rate +30%, excess Hit Rate converts to Critical Strike Rate)]
