[Profound Jade Ring (Purple) lv10, Quality: Treasure, Power +10, Agility +15, Attached Effect - Jade Radiance (every 5s creates a shield with 10 Defense Value to ward off minor damage), Attached Effect - Eye of Profound Mystery (Hit Rate +30%, excess Hit Rate converts to Critical Strike Rate)]

chapters.title: Chapter 98 - 88: Clash Between Demigod and Evil God!
paragraphs: Besides the Profound Jade Ring, there were five other pieces of equipment.

[Simurgh Pendant (Purple) lv11, Quality: Rare, Agility +12, Spirit +10, Constitution +10, Attached Effect - Cyan Simurgh (when attacked, there’s a 30% chance to summon a Cyan Simurgh phantom to launch an attack on the enemy), Attached Effect - Sound of the Void Spirit (reduces psychic damage received by 25%)]

[War Iron Wrist (Purple) lv10, Quality: Rare, Defense 13~15, Power +20, Agility +10, Attached Effect - Iron Arm (increases attack power by 10% in close combat), Attached Effect - War Intent (when attacking, there’s a 50% chance to increase power by 50 points)]

[Spiritual Snake Robe (Purple) lv11, Quality: Rare, Defense 41~43, Agility +25, Constitution +15, Attached Effect - Agile (evasion rate +20%), Attached Effect - Intermediate Magic Resistance (reduces damage received by 20% when hit by a magic attack)]

[Demon Scale Pants (Purple) lv10, Quality: Rare, Defense 30~33, Agility +20, Constitution +10, Attached Effect - Scale Armor (reduces damage received by 20% when hit by a physical attack), Attached Effect - Demon Soul (when attacking, there’s a 30% chance to increase the spirit attribute by 30 points)]

[Red Ridge Boots (Purple) lv10, Quality: Rare, Defense 16~18, Agility +30, Constitution +5, Attached Effect - Soaring (increases jump height by 50% and causes minor damage to nearby enemies upon landing), Attached Effect - Fire Footprint (an active effect, upon activation, adds a layer of flame effect underfoot, leaving a burning flame with each step, though the flame causes no actual damage.)]
The attributes of each piece of equipment above were very formidable.
However, upon seeing the attributes of these pieces, Han Xing’s expression became somewhat peculiar.
Because, surprisingly, all six pieces were of Rare Quality, and none were of Legendary Quality.
Han Xing continued crafting, experimenting many times.
Ultimately, he came to a conclusion: these Purple Equipment Blueprints can only create rare quality as their highest, which seems to be their limit.
"Even among purple equipment, is there such a difference?"
Han Xing seemed to understand something, pondering: "Just like the Moon Crown Longbow, it was once wielded by a goddess, possessing legendary traits, thus enabling it to be of legendary quality."
"Whereas these few purple pieces are just ordinary purple equipment."
Shaking his head, Han Xing no longer lingered on it.
After all, even rare quality purple equipment offers attributes far superior to blue armor!
However, he noticed the effect of the last piece, the Red Ridge Boots: Fire Footprint.
It stated that upon activation, each step would leave a burning flame underfoot, yet the flame causes no damage.
In other words, this effect is purely for show, to look impressive.
Nonetheless, Han Xing quite liked it.
He happily equipped all these items, undergoing a complete makeover.
These rare quality purple equipment, in appearance alone, gave off a sense of depth and might, inherently enhancing Han Xing’s charisma.
Moreover, with the dark golden Soul Shattering Longbow on his back, he looked like a strong man through and through.
Han Xing took a few steps on the territory, admiringly exclaiming, "Truly damn handsome!"
The bonuses from the equipment caused Han Xing’s physical attributes to start soaring.
Now, he felt unprecedentedly powerful!
After completing the Hunter’s set, Han Xing began to browse through his blueprints again.
Then, he crafted a set of purple equipment for Zhang Lianmeng, focusing on enhancing magic damage and spirit attributes.
Upon advancing to become an Elemental Master, Zhang Lianmeng’s magic damage had already reached a terrifying level.
Now, through various equipment bonuses, her magic damage had increased to an astonishing 217 points.
Consider that a newly advanced Elemental Master usually only has magic damage just over a hundred.
Yet Zhang Lianmeng’s was directly more than double that.
If there were a profession ranking now, with Zhang Lianmeng’s equipment strength, she’d probably be the number one Mage in Area 107!
Han Xing continued selecting some blueprints and crafted several sets of equipment.
Both heavy and light armors were present.
These two sets were naturally prepared for Cheng Jianyong and Shen Yun.
While Han Xing was busily crafting equipment.
A powerful figure suddenly appeared above a massive floating island.
The figure carried a silver-white giant bow on his back, with a silver wolf standing proudly by his side.
This figure was the Wild Ranger Spirit.

The Wild Ranger Spirit gazed at the sky island before it, murmuring softly, "Luckily, having gone to the Path of the Giant Dragon these past few days, I can briefly resist the rejection from the Land of the Abandoned Gods."
Then, he looked at the island before him, finely sensing the aura within.
The next moment, his pupils contracted, his brows instantly knitting together.
The Wild Ranger Spirit solemnly said, "It seems that the human kid was right, there’s truly the aura of an Otherworldly Evil God here!"
"This evil god actually ran from the Witch Race Territory to the Land of the Abandoned Gods and hid quite deeply!"
The Wild Ranger Spirit locked onto a valley full of massive stones, a deep cavern within it.
However, he did not enter.
For a being like him, there’s no need to enter the cavern to explore slowly.
The silver giant bow was gripped in his hand, and the bowstring slowly drew back.
At that moment, a gentle breeze seemed to stir across hundreds of miles.
The invisible power of heaven and earth gathered on his bowstring.
Nothing seemed to be on his bowstring, yet it exuded a terrifying and oppressive sense of tearing.
At this moment, the mysterious cave sensed the anomaly outside.
A gloomy, sinister voice echoed.
"The aura of a demigod...Who is it?"
However, the Wild Ranger Spirit did not reply.
He released the bowstring, shooting an arrow.
Buzz!
Time seemed to freeze, and the entire world seemed to lose its color under this arrow.
The next moment.
This enormous floating island, spanning over hundreds of thousands of square meters, exploded!
Rumble!
The terrifying explosion was like a meteorite impact, with dirt flying everywhere.
Amidst the explosion, an angry roar was heard within.
"Damn it!"
The giant sky island was shattered by a single arrow from the Wild Ranger Spirit, leaving only a bizarre structure floating mid-air.
The structure looked like an altar, yet also like a massive pool.
Except inside, it was filled with bright red blood!
The blood pool continually bubbled.
Blub... blub...
Floating above the blood pool were various corpses, staring with pale eyes, some not yet at peace.
Meanwhile, a distorted figure slowly emerged halfway from the blood pool, gazing at the Wild Ranger Spirit in the sky.
The two exchanged glances.
The black shadow in the blood pool suddenly asked, "This aura, are you, Hunter?"
In the sky, the Wild Ranger Spirit didn’t answer but instead drew the bowstring, locking firmly onto the opponent.
"Hunter, are you going to attack me?"
In the battle state, the Wild Ranger Spirit appeared taciturn, answering the opponent’s question with action.
At the moment the black shadow finished speaking, a brilliant arrow shot swiftly.
Realizing the strength of this arrow, the blood pool suddenly erupted with a pillar of blood shooting skyward.
The two auras collided, creating a storm-like whirlwind at the spot.
Whoosh—
After the commotion calmed, the blood pool remained floating mid-air, almost unharmed.
The black shadow seemed to perceive something, letting out a gleeful laughter.
"Hehehe... Hunter, you seem to have grown much weaker..."
The Wild Ranger Spirit frowned, "No wonder the Holy Artifact of the Elf Race couldn’t kill you back then; it turns out you still have such means."
The black shadow in the blood pool chuckled lightly.
"Hehe... Hunter, you underestimate the power of the Alternate Space, don’t you? I am an Evil God... how could such low-level weapons from this realm kill me?"
The Wild Ranger Spirit still sneered, "Is that so? If the Power of the Evil God is so strong, then why do you only dare to hide in the Land of the Abandoned Gods and pick on these weak Humans?"
Unfazed, the black shadow continued with its eerie laughter.
"Precisely because they are weak, they’re easy to deal with... hehehe..."
"Hunter, no need to provoke me... Once I complete the layout in the Land of the Abandoned Gods, I will quickly return to peak state, no, even surpass my previous status."
"At that time, I will spread the Blood Curse throughout the Holy Spirit Realm, turning billions into my slaves..."
The Wild Ranger Spirit shook his head, "With me around, you won’t succeed."
The opponent chuckled coldly, "Hunter, you still love meddling in others’ affairs; haven’t you had enough of past lessons?"
"Think carefully, this is your last trace of divinity lingering in the world; if it’s eradicated, your presence will forever vanish, without any chance of resurrection."
Facing the threat, the Wild Ranger Spirit remained unmoved.
He slowly raised a silver longbow, accompanied by the silver-white giant wolf baring its fangs, ready for combat at any moment.
Just then, the entire Blood Altar suddenly spewed a blood pillar into the sky.
Meanwhile, the Wild Ranger Spirit noticed many other blood pillars rising from distant skies.
Suddenly having a bad premonition, his heart sank.
The next moment, that black shadow vanished abruptly.
The Wild Ranger Spirit instantly looked up, seeing a terrifying monster shrouding the sky.
"Is this your true form? It’s truly ugly indeed," said the Wild Ranger with disdain.
In the sky, the monstrous being did not respond but fiercely launched an attack at the Wild Ranger Spirit.
The two formidable beings clashed fiercely.
Han Xing had just finished making a few sets of equipment.
At this moment, the discussion group’s chat channel lit up.
Once clicked open, Cheng Jianyong’s excited voice could be heard saying, "Our teleportation gate is set up, awaiting command from headquarters!"
Han Xing understood his meaning upon hearing.
"The Teleportation Array is completed?" Han Xing asked.
Cheng Jianyong laughed heartily, "Yes, Brother Xing, but how do I use this? How do I come to you?"
Han Xing replied helplessly, "Didn’t the building information say it? Enter the opponent’s teleportation array number in, get the Lord’s consent, and you can teleport."

chapters.title: Chapter 99 - 89: Meeting
paragraphs: Cheng Jianyong listened, glanced at the teleportation array’s function interface.
"I see, Brother Xing, what’s your teleportation array number?"
Han Xing took a look and replied, "1377."

This number is randomly generated, not determined by the order in which survivors establish teleportation arrays, and it can be rerandomized later, equivalent to a login password but requires the lord’s approval.
"Got it! I’ll teleport over first, Xiaoyunzi will wait for the next batch."
Since the teleportation array can only send one person per hour, Shen Yun had to wait for the cooldown to end.
Shen Yun expressed that he had no objections.
A prompt appeared before Han Xing’s eyes.
[Survivor ’Cheng Jianyong’ is applying to enter your territory through the teleportation array number, do you agree?]
"Yes."
The next moment.
A white light shone in the middle of the teleportation array, and a human figure started to appear faintly.
Zhang Lianmeng stood behind Han Xing, poking her head nervously.
Before the light from the teleportation array dissipated, Cheng Jianyong’s loud laughter echoed.
"Hey hey hey! I’m coming, damn it!"
His voice arrived before he did.
Han Xing watched the teleportation array with a look of speechless exasperation.
The next moment, a tall, burly man, carrying a great sword and donned in a full set of blue light armor appeared.
This person was none other than Cheng Jianyong.
Cheng Jianyong’s eyes lit up the moment he saw Han Xing.
With excitement, he leapt forward and shouted, "Brother Xing! I’m here!"
However, midway through his charge, he suddenly noticed Zhang Lianmeng behind Han Xing.
His forward momentum halted abruptly, and Cheng Jianyong exclaimed in shock, "Oh my... such a beautiful woman..."
With a face full of terror, Cheng Jianyong saw Han Xing approaching with Zhang Lianmeng.
Yet Cheng Jianyong stepped back abruptly and shouted, "Stop! What kind of monster are you, halt!"
He raised his great sword, eyeing Han Xing and Zhang Lianmeng with caution.
"Cheng Jianyong, what craziness are you on?" Han Xing asked, puzzled.
Cheng Jianyong shouted, "Brother Xing, come over quickly, this woman beside you is a banshee, she has already bewitched you!"
Beside him, Zhang Lianmeng was flustered, glancing at Han Xing and then at Cheng Jianyong, nervously saying.
"Brother Xing... I’m not a monster..."
"I know."
Han Xing gently patted her shoulder, speechless, "Cheng Jianyong, stop acting crazy here."
Seeing the somewhat intimate actions between the two, Cheng Jianyong was bewildered.
But upon seeing Zhang Lianmeng’s survivor status, he breathed a sigh of relief, "Hey! She’s really not a monster!"
"I thought someone as solitary as Brother Xing would never have anything to do with women in his life..."
Han Xing rolled his eyes at him and said, "Cheng Jianyong, shut up."
Cheng Jianyong rubbed his head and laughed awkwardly two times.
After the three gathered.
Cheng Jianyong curiously looked at Zhang Lianmeng, and occasionally glanced at Han Xing, his face showing a strange expression.
Zhang Lianmeng lowered her head in nervousness.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong seemed to think of something, a mischievous smile appearing on his face.
However, Cheng Jianyong dragged Han Xing to the side, chuckled quietly, and asked, "Brother Xing, when did this happen?"
Han Xing was confused by the question, "When did what happen?"
"Hmm?" Cheng Jianyong widened his eyes, "Trying to hide it from this brother? Let me tell you, I’m a married man, I can tell at a glance that this woman has an unusual relationship with you."
Han Xing rolled his eyes at him, shrugged, which was a disguised acknowledgment.
Come to think of it, he didn’t have anything to hide.
Being a young guy, finding a woman is perfectly normal.
Seeing Han Xing’s reaction, Cheng Jianyong’s eyes lit up, and then he gave a thumbs up.
"Brother Xing, impressive!"
At this moment, he looked at Zhang Lianmeng beside him and praised, "Nice choice, sister-in-law is really beautiful!"
He made no attempt to hide his words, and Zhang Lianmeng not far away could clearly hear them.
Zhang Lianmeng blushed, quickly denying, "Not... not sister-in-law..."
However, Cheng Jianyong internally accepted it and continued chuckling non-stop.
Zhang Lianmeng was so embarrassed by his laughter that she lowered her head bashfully.
At this moment, Han Xing briefly introduced the two and explained how he met Zhang Lianmeng.
After listening, Cheng Jianyong nodded, his face displaying a smile, "I see, so Sister Lianmeng saved Brother Xing once... and then Brother Xing offered his life, right?"
"Hahaha, Brother Xing finally got it this time!"
Zhang Lianmeng was once again rendered red-faced by Cheng Jianyong’s teasing words.
Seeing that he wanted to say more, Han Xing directly ordered, "Cheng Jianyong, just shut up!"
"Any more nonsense, don’t you want the Black Vine Wine?"
Those words seemed to hit Cheng Jianyong’s weak spot, and he quickly covered his mouth, exclaiming, "Brother Xing, I won’t say it, I won’t say it!"
Then he looked on expectantly and said, "Give me some!"
Han Xing helplessly took out a 200ml bottle of Black Vine Wine from his backpack and tossed it over to him.
Cheng Jianyong caught it and immediately fell silent.
Han Xing, speechless, said, "Just stay put and wait for Shen Yun to come over."
Cheng Jianyong quickly replied, "Got it, Brother Xing!"
Then, Han Xing grabbed a stool and waited for Shen Yun to come over together with Cheng Jianyong.
A few dozen minutes later, the teleportation array finished cooling down.
After Shen Yun teleported over, he saw Zhang Lianmeng and also let out a stunning gasp of amazement.
Cheng Jianyong hastily pulled Shen Yun aside to explain the situation.
After listening, Shen Yun’s shock was no less than Cheng Jianyong’s.
It seemed he didn’t expect that Han Xing, who had never interacted much with other girls, could suddenly bring out such a stunning beauty.
Speaking of which, Zhang Lianmeng practically outshone most of the women they had met before in terms of both figure and looks.
Although she was a bit older, that mature charm added a distinct flavor.
However, Shen Yun’s reaction wasn’t as exaggerated as Cheng Jianyong’s; he just patted Han Xing on the shoulder and nodded.
On the lawn of the territory outside the castle.
A round table was set up.
Han Xing, Cheng Jianyong, Shen Yun.
The three of them each sat in a corner.
Zhang Lianmeng stood prettily beside Han Xing, quite pleasing to the eye.
At this point, Cheng Jianyong looked around and sighed, "I have to say, Brother Xing, this territory is really beautiful!"
"With your own castle, lawn, and private vegetable garden, if you raise a bunch of cattle and sheep in the future, it’ll be a truly heavenly life!"
Indeed, Han Xing’s territory looked much more beautiful now than it did before.
Before, it was just a barren piece of land, and with the different land resources merged from various clouds, the whole place looked somewhat colorful.
After being tended to by Zhang Lianmeng, it was all replaced with tender green lawns.
Ah, that touch of sophistication instantly came through!
Unlike Cheng Jianyong, Shen Yun kept his eyes on the few hundred siege crossbow arrow launcher platforms in Han Xing’s territory; he was more interested in these.
Shen Yun asked curiously, "Brother Xing, are these things attack-type structures?"
Han Xing nodded, "Yeah, siege crossbow arrow launcher platforms. A single volley can instantly kill even leader-level monsters!"
After hearing Han Xing’s description, the two of them gasped in amazement.
Then they both gave Han Xing a thumbs-up.
"Impressive!"
"With these, even if we encounter hordes of enemies, a single volley, and they’d be wiped out!"
Han Xing nodded, "It’s a pity, though. I can’t build this blueprint on other territories, otherwise I could build dozens of them on yours."
Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but feel a bit of regret upon hearing this.

Shen Yun continued, "It’s alright, Brother Xing. We’ve already built the Spiritual Shield Pyramid, so we have some defensive capability. Plus, we got the top ten rewards, and a few Silver Armor Puppets to help guard our territory. No one should dare to mess with us."
Han Xing nodded.
Shen Yun went on to ask, "Brother Xing, got any plans for what to do next?"
"Or should we consider teaming up to hunt monsters?"
Han Xing pondered for a moment. His original plan was for the four of them to form a team and take a look at the Abyssal Rift.
Through trading, he had already gathered a large number of Strong Fragments, equivalent to thousands of Abyssal Rift Passes.
The system’s introduction mentioned that the Abyssal Rift had many unique items and equipment, divided into several layers.
And the first layer, the lowest requirement for entry is Level 10.
Currently, all four of them had broken through in levels and completed their profession advancements.
Taking on the first layer of the Abyssal Rift shouldn’t be too difficult.
Han Xing laid out his plan on the table.
Both Shen Yun and Cheng Jianyong nodded in agreement after hearing it.
At this moment, Shen Yun asked, "This Abyssal Rift sounds good, with our strength, we should be able to get through the first layer."
"So should we take action now?"
Han Xing looked at Shen Yun, then at Cheng Jianyong, and said, "Hold on a sec. I see most of your equipment is Blue Armor, and even a couple of pieces are Green Armor."
The two of them exchanged glances, then nodded.
Cheng Jianyong chimed in, "Well, the strength of my equipment ranks among the top in the Warrior sector of District 107!"
"I’ve met several Survivors before, all begging to team up with me, constantly calling me big brother and asking me to guide them through the clouds!"
"But I ignored them, hehe!"
He said with a hint of pride, evidently very confident in his equipment.
Han Xing glanced at him and asked, "Are you saying your equipment strength is already sufficient?"

Cheng Jianyong seemed to realize something and quickly abandoned his proud expression, exclaiming excitedly, "Ah, not nearly enough! Compared to Brother Xing’s equipment, mine is just a pile of scrap metal, too worthless to even keep in storage."
His tone shifted instantly, "Brother Xing, do you have any extra Purple Armor you can spare me?"
Before Han Xing could say anything, Zhang Lianmeng laughed.
"Pfft!"
She seemed amused by Cheng Jianyong’s shamelessness.
Cheng Jianyong chuckled, "Even sister-in-law is amused, Brother Xing, you see..."
"You this guy..."

sentences.text: Cheng Jianyong listened, glanced at the teleportation array’s function interface.
"I see, Brother Xing, what’s your teleportation array number?"
Han Xing took a look and replied, "1377."

This number is randomly generated, not determined by the order in which survivors establish teleportation arrays, and it can be rerandomized later, equivalent to a login password but requires the lord’s approval.
"Got it!
I’ll teleport over first, Xiaoyunzi will wait for the next batch."
Since the teleportation array can only send one person per hour, Shen Yun had to wait for the cooldown to end.
Shen Yun expressed that he had no objections.
A prompt appeared before Han Xing’s eyes.
[Survivor ’Cheng Jianyong’ is applying to enter your territory through the teleportation array number, do you agree?]
"Yes."
The next moment.
A white light shone in the middle of the teleportation array, and a human figure started to appear faintly.
Zhang Lianmeng stood behind Han Xing, poking her head nervously.
Before the light from the teleportation array dissipated, Cheng Jianyong’s loud laughter echoed.
"Hey hey hey!
I’m coming, damn it!"
His voice arrived before he did.
Han Xing watched the teleportation array with a look of speechless exasperation.
The next moment, a tall, burly man, carrying a great sword and donned in a full set of blue light armor appeared.
This person was none other than Cheng Jianyong.
Cheng Jianyong’s eyes lit up the moment he saw Han Xing.
With excitement, he leapt forward and shouted, "Brother Xing!
I’m here!"
However, midway through his charge, he suddenly noticed Zhang Lianmeng behind Han Xing.
His forward momentum halted abruptly, and Cheng Jianyong exclaimed in shock, "Oh my... such a beautiful woman..."
With a face full of terror, Cheng Jianyong saw Han Xing approaching with Zhang Lianmeng.
Yet Cheng Jianyong stepped back abruptly and shouted, "Stop!
What kind of monster are you, halt!"
He raised his great sword, eyeing Han Xing and Zhang Lianmeng with caution.
"Cheng Jianyong, what craziness are you on?" Han Xing asked, puzzled.
Cheng Jianyong shouted, "Brother Xing, come over quickly, this woman beside you is a banshee, she has already bewitched you!"
Beside him, Zhang Lianmeng was flustered, glancing at Han Xing and then at Cheng Jianyong, nervously saying.
"Brother Xing...
I’m not a monster..."
"I know."
Han Xing gently patted her shoulder, speechless, "Cheng Jianyong, stop acting crazy here."
Seeing the somewhat intimate actions between the two, Cheng Jianyong was bewildered.
But upon seeing Zhang Lianmeng’s survivor status, he breathed a sigh of relief, "Hey!
She’s really not a monster!"
"I thought someone as solitary as Brother Xing would never have anything to do with women in his life..."
Han Xing rolled his eyes at him and said, "Cheng Jianyong, shut up."
Cheng Jianyong rubbed his head and laughed awkwardly two times.
After the three gathered.
Cheng Jianyong curiously looked at Zhang Lianmeng, and occasionally glanced at Han Xing, his face showing a strange expression.
Zhang Lianmeng lowered her head in nervousness.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong seemed to think of something, a mischievous smile appearing on his face.
However, Cheng Jianyong dragged Han Xing to the side, chuckled quietly, and asked, "Brother Xing, when did this happen?"
Han Xing was confused by the question, "When did what happen?"
"Hmm?" Cheng Jianyong widened his eyes, "Trying to hide it from this brother?
Let me tell you, I’m a married man, I can tell at a glance that this woman has an unusual relationship with you."
Han Xing rolled his eyes at him, shrugged, which was a disguised acknowledgment.
Come to think of it, he didn’t have anything to hide.
Being a young guy, finding a woman is perfectly normal.
Seeing Han Xing’s reaction, Cheng Jianyong’s eyes lit up, and then he gave a thumbs up.
"Brother Xing, impressive!"
At this moment, he looked at Zhang Lianmeng beside him and praised, "Nice choice, sister-in-law is really beautiful!"
He made no attempt to hide his words, and Zhang Lianmeng not far away could clearly hear them.
Zhang Lianmeng blushed, quickly denying, "Not... not sister-in-law..."
However, Cheng Jianyong internally accepted it and continued chuckling non-stop.
Zhang Lianmeng was so embarrassed by his laughter that she lowered her head bashfully.
At this moment, Han Xing briefly introduced the two and explained how he met Zhang Lianmeng.
After listening, Cheng Jianyong nodded, his face displaying a smile, "I see, so Sister Lianmeng saved Brother Xing once... and then Brother Xing offered his life, right?"
"Hahaha, Brother Xing finally got it this time!"
Zhang Lianmeng was once again rendered red-faced by Cheng Jianyong’s teasing words.
Seeing that he wanted to say more, Han Xing directly ordered, "Cheng Jianyong, just shut up!"
"Any more nonsense, don’t you want the Black Vine Wine?"
Those words seemed to hit Cheng Jianyong’s weak spot, and he quickly covered his mouth, exclaiming, "Brother Xing, I won’t say it, I won’t say it!"
Then he looked on expectantly and said, "Give me some!"
Han Xing helplessly took out a 200ml bottle of Black Vine Wine from his backpack and tossed it over to him.
Cheng Jianyong caught it and immediately fell silent.
Han Xing, speechless, said, "Just stay put and wait for Shen Yun to come over."
Cheng Jianyong quickly replied, "Got it, Brother Xing!"
Then, Han Xing grabbed a stool and waited for Shen Yun to come over together with Cheng Jianyong.
A few dozen minutes later, the teleportation array finished cooling down.
After Shen Yun teleported over, he saw Zhang Lianmeng and also let out a stunning gasp of amazement.
Cheng Jianyong hastily pulled Shen Yun aside to explain the situation.
After listening, Shen Yun’s shock was no less than Cheng Jianyong’s.
It seemed he didn’t expect that Han Xing, who had never interacted much with other girls, could suddenly bring out such a stunning beauty.
Speaking of which, Zhang Lianmeng practically outshone most of the women they had met before in terms of both figure and looks.
Although she was a bit older, that mature charm added a distinct flavor.
However, Shen Yun’s reaction wasn’t as exaggerated as Cheng Jianyong’s; he just patted Han Xing on the shoulder and nodded.
On the lawn of the territory outside the castle.
A round table was set up.
Han Xing, Cheng Jianyong, Shen Yun.
The three of them each sat in a corner.
Zhang Lianmeng stood prettily beside Han Xing, quite pleasing to the eye.
At this point, Cheng Jianyong looked around and sighed, "I have to say, Brother Xing, this territory is really beautiful!"
"With your own castle, lawn, and private vegetable garden, if you raise a bunch of cattle and sheep in the future, it’ll be a truly heavenly life!"
Indeed, Han Xing’s territory looked much more beautiful now than it did before.
Before, it was just a barren piece of land, and with the different land resources merged from various clouds, the whole place looked somewhat colorful.
After being tended to by Zhang Lianmeng, it was all replaced with tender green lawns.
Ah, that touch of sophistication instantly came through!
Unlike Cheng Jianyong, Shen Yun kept his eyes on the few hundred siege crossbow arrow launcher platforms in Han Xing’s territory; he was more interested in these.
Shen Yun asked curiously, "Brother Xing, are these things attack-type structures?"
Han Xing nodded, "Yeah, siege crossbow arrow launcher platforms.
A single volley can instantly kill even leader-level monsters!"
After hearing Han Xing’s description, the two of them gasped in amazement.
Then they both gave Han Xing a thumbs-up.
"Impressive!"
"With these, even if we encounter hordes of enemies, a single volley, and they’d be wiped out!"
Han Xing nodded, "It’s a pity, though.
I can’t build this blueprint on other territories, otherwise I could build dozens of them on yours."
Cheng Jianyong couldn’t help but feel a bit of regret upon hearing this.
Shen Yun continued, "It’s alright, Brother Xing.
We’ve already built the Spiritual Shield Pyramid, so we have some defensive capability.
Plus, we got the top ten rewards, and a few Silver Armor Puppets to help guard our territory.
No one should dare to mess with us."
Han Xing nodded.
Shen Yun went on to ask, "Brother Xing, got any plans for what to do next?"
"Or should we consider teaming up to hunt monsters?"
Han Xing pondered for a moment.
His original plan was for the four of them to form a team and take a look at the Abyssal Rift.
Through trading, he had already gathered a large number of Strong Fragments, equivalent to thousands of Abyssal Rift Passes.
The system’s introduction mentioned that the Abyssal Rift had many unique items and equipment, divided into several layers.
And the first layer, the lowest requirement for entry is Level 10.
Currently, all four of them had broken through in levels and completed their profession advancements.
Taking on the first layer of the Abyssal Rift shouldn’t be too difficult.
Han Xing laid out his plan on the table.
Both Shen Yun and Cheng Jianyong nodded in agreement after hearing it.
At this moment, Shen Yun asked, "This Abyssal Rift sounds good, with our strength, we should be able to get through the first layer."
"So should we take action now?"
Han Xing looked at Shen Yun, then at Cheng Jianyong, and said, "Hold on a sec.
I see most of your equipment is Blue Armor, and even a couple of pieces are Green Armor."
The two of them exchanged glances, then nodded.
Cheng Jianyong chimed in, "Well, the strength of my equipment ranks among the top in the Warrior sector of District 107!"
"I’ve met several Survivors before, all begging to team up with me, constantly calling me big brother and asking me to guide them through the clouds!"
"But I ignored them, hehe!"
He said with a hint of pride, evidently very confident in his equipment.
Han Xing glanced at him and asked, "Are you saying your equipment strength is already sufficient?"
Cheng Jianyong seemed to realize something and quickly abandoned his proud expression, exclaiming excitedly, "Ah, not nearly enough!
Compared to Brother Xing’s equipment, mine is just a pile of scrap metal, too worthless to even keep in storage."
His tone shifted instantly, "Brother Xing, do you have any extra Purple Armor you can spare me?"
Before Han Xing could say anything, Zhang Lianmeng laughed.
"Pfft!"
She seemed amused by Cheng Jianyong’s shamelessness.
Cheng Jianyong chuckled, "Even sister-in-law is amused, Brother Xing, you see..."
"You this guy..."

chapters.title: Chapter 100 - 90: New Expansion: [Blood Tide]
paragraphs: Han Xing helplessly sent a trade request to Cheng Jianyong.
Looking at the trade window, with all those purple equipment with amazing attributes, Cheng Jianyong swallowed hard.
Then he widened his eyes and exclaimed, "Wow, the Red Bull Power Necklace, Withered Vine Chest Armor!"
"So much power boost, and so many effects, damn!"
"So fierce! So fierce!"
Cheng Jianyong was totally shocked, then happily accepted, immediately equipping them.
With a full set of purple light armor on, Cheng Jianyong’s attributes soared.
At this moment, he confidently said, "With this equipment, I feel even Xiaoyunzi can’t withstand my strike!"
Cheng Jianyong’s advanced profession choice was Swordsman, a melee output type profession, highly reliant on power.
With the bonus from so many top-grade equipment, Cheng Jianyong’s current power reached an unprecedented height.
points of power!
At this current stage, facing other survivors of the same level, he could truly one-shot them.
On the side, Shen Yun could only look on speechlessly, this guy just loves to show off in front of me with any little improvement.
However, when he saw Cheng Jianyong’s set of gorgeously styled, powerful purple equipment, he couldn’t hide a bit of envy in his heart.
"Brother Xing... Is there anything for me?" Shen Yun also expectantly asked from the side.
Han Xing nodded, "Of course there is."
Upon hearing this, Shen Yun’s heart instantly filled with joy. Under his excited gaze, Han Xing directly initiated a trade, then routinely put up a set of purple equipment.
However, the equipment given to Shen Yun was different from Cheng Jianyong’s; he picked a set of purple heavy armor, mostly increasing spirit and constitution.
Moreover, he attached a Chaos Rune to each piece of equipment.

Although the attributes increased by basic Chaos Runes weren’t much, stacking them on so many pieces of equipment made the gains quite considerable, almost equivalent to half a piece of equipment’s enhancement.
There were also the ring and necklace, carefully selected by Han Xing.
These were the Ancient Brass Ring and Sapphire Necklace.
Both pieces of jewelry added over ten points each in spirit and constitution.
The Spirit Attribute affects the strength of the Holy Profession’s Healing Skills and other auxiliary strength.
Constitution increases how much punishment the Holy Profession can take.
Even though Shen Yun’s profession was Priest, and the constitution gain wasn’t as great as the Holy Profession’s other branch, Knight.
In critical moments, Priests can also pick up a shield and temporarily serve as a tank.
The main material required for these purple equipment is Mithril, which Han Xing has plenty of in stock.
Combined with the 100% success rate granted by the Divine-level Artisan, he can absolutely produce them in batches.
But for other survivors, a set of purple equipment represents a dramatic transformation.
At this current stage, even the top survivors don’t have a single piece of purple equipment.
At this moment, Cheng Jianyong looked at Shen Yun donning a set of purple heavy armor, whose solid defense left one without the thought of confrontation.
Cheng Jianyong circled Shen Yun, looking at his luxurious equipment, and said somewhat sheepishly, "Oh no, now I can’t bully Xiaoyunzi anymore."
Shen Yun glanced at him disdainfully.
At this time, Han Xing, after some thought, sent another trade request to Shen Yun.
Under Shen Yun’s puzzled gaze, he placed up the Golden Shield he had previously obtained from a Golden Treasure Chest, the Shield of Immortality.
Looking at the Shield of Immortality’s formidable attributes, Shen Yun was instantly dumbfounded.
Even with his composure, he couldn’t help shouting, "Damn! Golden Shield!"
Hearing Golden Shield, Cheng Jianyong suddenly realized something, and his expression changed.
The next moment, a dark yellow shield suddenly appeared in Shen Yun’s hands.
"Damn, over 50 defense points and a legendary effect, it’s terrifying!"
Holding the shield, a sense of unparalleled power surged from within Shen Yun, he even felt like he could face Leader-level monsters head-on.
At this point, Shen Yun spoke spiritedly, "Just now, who was it that said they’d take me down in one strike?"
"Come on, I’ll stand right here, let you hit me for ten seconds, if I step back even a bit, I lose!"
The legendary effect of the Shield of Immortality, Indestructible, lasts for ten seconds.
In this state, the damage Shen Yun takes is reduced by 50%, and no attacks can knock him back.
Under Cheng Jianyong’s envious gaze, Shen Yun, brandishing the Golden Great Shield, would occasionally strut in front of him, making him fume with anger.
"Shen Yun, you Priest, what are you doing with a shield, go swing your hammer and boost my state."
However, Shen Yun deliberately said, "Hah, I won’t, I’ll just strut in front of you, hahaha!"
Cheng Jianyong was so angry, he felt like giving him a Mid-air Slash.
Suddenly, inspiration struck him, and he lifted his Great Sword, slashing fiercely toward Shen Yun.
"Hmm? Are you sneak attacking?" Shen Yun instantly raised his shield and blocked Cheng Jianyong’s Great Sword.
Bang!
A dull sound, Shen Yun didn’t step back even one bit.
In front of the terrifying defense of the Shield of Immortality, even Cheng Jianyong with his full purple gear couldn’t do much damage to him.
"Damn, so tough!" Cheng Jianyong was peeved beyond words.
"Haha, loser, you can’t beat me even with sneak attacks!" Shen Yun taunted without restraint.
Cheng Jianyong seemed a bit unconvinced, he took a deep breath, jumped up vehemently, and charged at Shen Yun at a shocking speed!
A sudden burst of killing intent!
After advancing to the Swordsman profession from Warrior, an auto-learned burst skill.
Instantly attacks the enemy, causing massive damage, with a chance to inflict a ’crippled’ effect on the enemy.
